verses.187: Waith akhatha Allahu meethaqa allatheena ootoo alkitaba latubayyinunnahu li  nnasi wala taktumoonahu fanabathoohu waraa _th_ uhoorihim wa  shtaraw bihi thamanan qaleelan fabisa ma yashtaroon
verses.188: La tahsabanna allatheena yafrahoona bima ataw wayuhibboona an yuhmadoo bima lam yaf'aloo fala tahsabannahum bimafazatin mina al'athabi walahum 'athabun aleem
verses.189: Walillahi mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi wa  llahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.190: Inna fee khalqi a  ssamawati wa  lardi wa  khtilafi allayli wa  nnahari laayatin liolee alalbab
verses.191: Allatheena yathkuroona Allaha qiyaman waqu'oodan wa'ala junoobihim wayatafakkaroona fee khalqi a  ssamawati wa  lardi rabbana ma khalaqta hatha batilan subhanaka faqina 'athaba a  nnar
verses.192: Rabbana innaka man tudkhili a  nnara faqad akhzaytahu wama li  _thth_ alimeena min ansar
verses.193: Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadee lileemani an aminoo birabbikum faamanna rabbana fa  ghfir lanathunoobana wakaffir 'anna sayyiatina watawaffana ma'a alabrar
verses.194: Rabbana waatina ma wa'adtana 'ala rusulika wala tukhzina yawma alqiyamati innaka la tukhlifu almee'ad
verses.195: Fa  stajaba lahum rabbuhum annee la odee'u 'amala 'amilin minkum min thakarin aw ontha ba'dukum min ba'din fa  llatheena hajaroo waokhrijoo min diyarihim waoothoo fee sabeelee waqataloo waqutiloo laokaffiranna 'anhum sayyiatihim walaodkhilannahum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu thawaban min 'indi Allahi wa  llahu 'indahu husnu a  ththawab
verses.196: La yaghurrannaka taqallubu allatheena kafaroo fee albilad
verses.197: Mata'un qaleelun thumma mawahum jahannamu wabisa almihad
verses.198: Lakini allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha nuzulan min 'indi Allahi wama 'inda Allahi khayrun lilabrar
verses.199: Wainna min ahli alkitabi laman yuminu bi  llahi wama onzila ilaykum wama onzila ilayhim khashi'eena lillahi la yashtaroona biayati Allahi thamanan qaleelan olaika lahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim inna Allaha saree'u alhisab
verses.200: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo isbiroo wasabiroo warabitoo wa  ttaqoo Allaha la'allakum tuflihoon

verses.1: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu ittaqoo rabbakumu allathee khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin wakhalaqa minha zawjaha wabaththa minhuma rijalan katheeran wanisaan wa  ttaqoo Allaha allathee tasaaloona bihi wa  larhama inna Allaha kana 'alaykum raqeeb
verses.2: Waatoo alyatama amwalahum wala tatabaddaloo alkhabeetha bi  ttayyibi wala takuloo amwalahum ila amwalikum innahu kana hooban kabeera
verses.3: Wain khiftum alla tuqsitoo fee alyatama fa  nkihoo mataba lakum mina a  nnisai mathna wathulatha waruba'a fain khiftum alla ta'diloo fawahidatan aw ma malakat aymanukum thalika adna alla ta'ooloo
verses.4: Waatoo a  nnisaa saduqatihinna nihlatan fain tibna lakum 'an shayin minhu nafsan fakuloohu haneean mareea
verses.5: Wala tutoo a  ssufahaa amwalakumu allatee ja'ala Allahu lakum qiyaman wa  rzuqoohum feeha wa  ksoohum waqooloo lahum qawlan ma'roofa
verses.6: Wa  btaloo alyatamahatta itha balaghoo a  nnikaha fain anastum minhum rushdan fa  dfa'oo ilayhim amwalahum wala takulooha israfan wabidaran an yakbaroo waman kana ghaniyyan falyasta'fif waman kana faqeeran falyakul bi  lma'roofi faitha dafa'tum ilayhim amwalahum faashhidoo 'alayhim wakafa bi  llahi haseeba
verses.7: Li  rrijali naseebun mimma taraka alwalidani wa  laqraboona wali  nnisai naseebun mimma taraka alwalidani wa  laqraboona mimma qalla minhu aw kathura naseeban mafrooda
verses.8: Waithahadara alqismata oloo alqurba wa  lyatama wa  lmasakeenu fa  rzuqoohum minhu waqooloo lahum qawlan ma'roofa
verses.9: Walyakhsha allatheena law tarakoo min khalfihim thurriyyatan di'afan khafoo 'alayhim falyattaqoo Allaha walyaqooloo qawlan sadeeda
verses.10: Inna allatheena yakuloona amwala alyatama _th_ ulman innama yakuloona fee butoonihim naran wasayaslawna sa'eera
verses.11: Yooseekumu Allahu fee awladikum li  ththakari mithlu ha _thth_ i alonthayayni fain kunna nisaan fawqa ithnatayni falahunna thulutha ma taraka wain kanat wahidatan falaha a  nnisfu waliabawayhi likulli wahidin minhuma a  ssudusu mimma taraka in kana lahu waladun fain lam yakun lahu waladun wawarithahu abawahu faliommihi a  ththuluthu fain kana lahu ikhwatun faliommihi a  ssudusu min ba'di wasiyyatin yoosee biha aw daynin abaokum waabnaokum la tadroona ayyuhum aqrabu lakum naf'an fareedatan mina Allahi inna Allaha kana 'aleeman hakeema
verses.12: Walakum nisfu ma taraka azwajukum in lam yakun lahunna waladun fain kana lahunna waladun falakumu a  rrubu'u mimma tarakna min ba'di wasiyyatin yooseena biha aw daynin walahunna a  rrubu'u mimma taraktum in lam yakun lakum waladun fain kana lakum waladun falahunna a  ththumunu mimma taraktum min ba'di wasiyyatin toosoona biha aw daynin wain kana rajulun yoorathu kalalatan awi imraatun walahu akhun aw okhtun falikulli wahidin minhuma a  ssudusu fain kanoo akthara min thalika fahum shurakao fee a  ththuluthi min ba'di wasiyyatin yoosa biha aw daynin ghayra mudarrin wasiyyatan mina Allahi wa  llahu 'aleemun haleem
verses.13: Tilka hudoodu Allahi waman yuti'i Allaha warasoolahu yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wathalika alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.14: Waman ya'si Allaha warasoolahu wayata'adda hudoodahu yudkhilhu naran khalidan feeha walahu 'athabun muheen
verses.15: Wa  llatee yateena alfahishata min nisaikum fa  stashhidoo 'alayhinna arba'atan minkum fain shahidoo faamsikoohunna fee albuyooti hatta yatawaffahunna almawtu aw yaj'ala Allahu lahunna sabeela
verses.16: Wa  llathani yatiyaniha minkum faathoohuma fain taba waaslaha faa'ridoo 'anhuma inna Allaha kana tawwaban raheema
verses.17: Innama a  ttawbatu 'ala Allahi lillatheena ya'maloona a  ssooa bijahalatin thumma yatooboona min qareebin faolaika yatoobu Allahu 'alayhim wakana Allahu 'aleeman hakeema
verses.18: Walaysati a  ttawbatu lillatheena ya'maloona a  ssayyiati hatta ithahadara ahadahumu almawtu qala innee tubtu alana wala allatheena yamootoona wahum kuffarun olaika a'tadna lahum 'athaban aleema
verses.19: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la yahillu lakum an tarithoo a  nnisaa karhan wala ta'duloohunna litathhaboo biba'di maataytumoohunna illa an yateena bifahishatin mubayyinatin wa'ashiroohunna bi  lma'roofi fain karihtumoohunna fa'asa an takrahoo shayan wayaj'ala Allahu feehi khayran katheera
verses.20: Wain aradtumu istibdala zawjin makana zawjin waataytum ihdahunna qintaran fala takhuthoo minhu shayan atakhuthoonahu buhtanan waithman mubeena
verses.21: Wakayfa takhuthoonahu waqad afda ba'dukum ila ba'din waakhathna minkum meethaqan ghalee _th_ a
verses.22: Wala tankihoo ma nakaha abaokum mina a  nnisai illa ma qad salafa innahu kana fahishatan wamaqtan wasaa sabeela
verses.23: Hurrimat 'alaykum ommahatukum wabanatukum waakhawatukum wa'ammatukum wakhalatukum wabanatu alakhi wabanatu alokhti waommahatukumu allatee arda'nakum waakhawatukum mina a  rrada'ati waommahatu nisaikum warabaibukumu allatee fee hujoorikum min nisaikumu allatee dakhatum bihinna fain lam takoonoo dakhatum bihinna fala junaha 'alaykum wahalailu abnaikumu allatheena min aslabikum waan tajma'oo bayna alokhtayni illa ma qad salafa inna Allaha kana ghafooran raheema
verses.24: Wa  lmuhsanatu mina a  nnisai illa ma malakat aymanukum kitaba Allahi 'alaykum waohilla lakum ma waraa thalikum an tabtaghoo biamwalikum muhsineena ghayra musafiheena fama istamta'tum bihi minhunna faatoohunna ojoorahunna fareedatan wala junaha 'alaykum feema taradaytum bihi min ba'di alfareedati inna Allaha kana 'aleeman hakeema
verses.25: Waman lam yastati' minkum tawlan an yankiha almuhsanati almuminati famin ma malakat aymanukum min fatayatikumu almuminati wa  llahu a'lamu bieemanikum ba'dukum min ba'din fa  nkihoohunna biithni ahlihinna waatoohunna ojoorahunna bi  lma'roofi muhsanatin ghayra masafihatin wala muttakhithati akhdanin faitha ohsinna fain atayna bifahishatin fa'alayhinna nisfu ma 'ala almuhsanati mina al'athabi thalika liman khashiya al'anata minkum waan tasbiroo khayrun lakum wa  llahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.26: Yureedu Allahu liyubayyina lakum wayahdiyakum sunana allatheena min qablikum wayatooba 'alaykum wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.27: Wa  llahu yureedu an yatooba 'alaykum wayureedu allatheena yattabi'oona a  shshahawati an tameeloo maylan 'a _th_ eem
verses.28: Yureedu Allahu an yukhaffifa 'ankum wakhuliqa alinsanu da'eefa
verses.29: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la takuloo amwalakum baynakum bi  lbatili illa an takoona tijaratan 'an taradin minkum wala taqtuloo anfusakum inna Allaha kana bikum raheema
verses.30: Waman yaf'al thalika 'udwanan wa _th_ ulman fasawfa nusleehi naran wakana thalika 'ala Allahi yaseera
verses.31: In tajtaniboo kabaira ma tunhawna 'anhu nukaffir 'ankum sayyiatikum wanudkhilkum mudkhalan kareema
verses.32: Wala tatamannaw ma faddala Allahu bihi ba'dakum 'ala ba'din li  rrijali naseebun mimma iktasaboo wali  nnisai naseebun mimma iktasabna wa  saloo Allaha min fadlihi inna Allaha kana bikulli shayin 'aleema
verses.33: Walikullin ja'ana mawaliya mimma taraka alwalidani wa  laqraboona wa  llatheena 'aqadat aymanukum faatoohum naseebahum inna Allaha kana 'ala kulli shayin shaheeda
verses.34: A  rrijalu qawwamoona 'ala a  nnisai bima faddala Allahu ba'dahum 'ala ba'din wabima anfaqoo min amwalihim fa  ssalihatu qanitatun hafi _th_ atun lilghaybi bimahafi _th_ a Allahu wa  llatee takhafoona nushoozahunna fa'i _th_ oohunna wa  hjuroohunna fee almadaji'i wa  driboohunna fain ata'nakum fala tabghoo 'alayhinna sabeelan inna Allaha kana 'aliyyan kabeera
verses.35: Wain khiftum shiqaqa baynihima fa  b'athoo hakaman min ahlihi wahakaman min ahliha in yureeda islahan yuwaffiqi Allahu baynahuma inna Allaha kana 'aleeman khabeera
verses.36: Wa  'budoo Allaha wala tushrikoo bihi shayan wabi  lwalidayni ihsanan wabithee alqurba wa  lyatama wa  lmasakeeni wa  ljari thee alqurba wa  ljari aljunubi wa  ssahibi bi  ljanbi wa  bni a  ssabeeli wama malakat aymanukum inna Allaha la yuhibbu man kana mukhtalan fakhoora
verses.37: Allatheena yabkhaloona wayamuroona a  nnasa bi  lbukhli wayaktumoona maatahumu Allahu min fadlihi waa'tadna lilkafireena 'athaban muheena
verses.38: Wa  llatheena yunfiqoona amwalahum riaa a  nnasi wala yuminoona bi  llahi wala bi  lyawmi alakhiri waman yakuni a  shshaytanu lahu qareenan fasaa qareena
verses.39: Wamatha 'alayhim law amanoo bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri waanfaqoo mimma razaqahumu Allahu wakana Allahu bihim 'aleema
verses.40: Inna Allaha la ya _th_ limu mithqala tharratin wain taku hasanatan yuda'ifha wayuti min ladunhu ajran 'a _th_ eema
verses.41: Fakayfa itha jina min kulli ommatin bishaheedin wajina bika 'ala haolai shaheeda
verses.42: Yawmaithin yawaddu allatheena kafaroo wa'asawoo a  rrasoola law tusawwa bihimu alardu wala yaktumoona Allaha hadeetha
verses.43: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la taqraboo a  ssalata waantum sukarahatta ta'lamoo ma taqooloona wala junuban illa 'abiree sabeelin hatta taghtasiloo wain kuntum marda aw 'ala safarin aw jaa ahadun minkum mina alghaiti aw lamastumu a  nnisaa falam tajidoo maan fatayammamoo sa'eedan tayyiban fa  msahoo biwujoohikum waaydeekum inna Allaha kana 'afuwwan ghafoora
verses.44: Alam tara ila allatheena ootoo naseeban mina alkitabi yashtaroona a  ddalalata wayureedoona an tadilloo a  ssabeel
verses.45: Wa  llahu a'lamu bia'daikum wakafa bi  llahi waliyyan wakafa bi  llahi naseera
verses.46: Mina allatheena hadoo yuharrifoona alkalima 'an mawadi'ihi wayaqooloona sami'na wa'asayna wa  sma' ghayra musma'in wara'ina layyan biasinatihim wata'nan fee a  ddeeni walaw annahum qaloo sami'na waata'na wa  sma' wa  n _th_ urna lakana khayran lahum waaqwama walakin la'anahumu Allahu bikufrihim fala yuminoona illa qaleela
verses.47: Ya ayyuha allatheena ootoo alkitaba aminoo bima nazzana musaddiqan lima ma'akum min qabli an natmisa wujoohan fanaruddaha 'ala adbariha aw nal'anahum kama la'anna ashaba a  ssabti wakana amru Allahi maf'oola
verses.48: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wayaghfiru ma doona thalika liman yashao waman yushrik bi  llahi faqadi iftara ithman 'a _th_ eema
verses.49: Alam tara ila allatheena yuzakkoona anfusahum bali Allahu yuzakkee man yashao wala yu _th_ lamoona fateela
verses.50: On _th_ ur kayfa yaftaroona 'ala Allahi alkathiba wakafa bihi ithman mubeena
verses.51: Alam tara ila allatheena ootoo naseeban mina alkitabi yuminoona bi  ljibti wa  ttaghooti wayaqooloona lillatheena kafaroo haolai ahda mina allatheena amanoo sabeela
verses.52: Olaika allatheena la'anahumu Allahu waman yal'ani Allahu falan tajida lahu naseera
verses.53: Am lahum naseebun mina almulki faithan la yutoona a  nnasa naqeera
verses.54: Am yahsudoona a  nnasa 'ala maatahumu Allahu min fadlihi faqad ataynaala ibraheema alkitaba wa  lhikmata waataynahum mulkan 'a _th_ eema
verses.55: Faminhum man amana bihi waminhum man sadda 'anhu wakafa bijahannama sa'eera
verses.56: Inna allatheena kafaroo biayatina sawfa nusleehim naran kullama nadijat julooduhum baddanahum juloodan ghayraha liyathooqoo al'athaba inna Allaha kana 'azeezan hakeema
verses.57: Wa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati sanudkhiluhum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan lahum feeha azwajun mutahharatun wanudkhiluhum _th_ illan _th_ aleela
verses.58: Inna Allaha yamurukum an tuaddoo alamanati ila ahliha waithahakamtum bayna a  nnasi an tahkumoo bi  l'adli inna Allaha ni'imma ya'i _th_ ukum bihi inna Allaha kana samee'an baseera
verses.59: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo atee'oo Allaha waatee'oo a  rrasoola waolee alamri minkum fain tanaza'tum fee shayin faruddoohu ila Allahi wa  rrasooli in kuntum tuminoona bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri thalika khayrun waahsanu taweela
verses.60: Alam tara ila allatheena yaz'umoona annahum amanoo bima onzila ilayka wama onzila min qablika yureedoona an yatahakamoo ila a  ttaghooti waqad omiroo an yakfuroo bihi wayureedu a  shshaytanu an yudillahum dalalan ba'eeda
verses.61: Waitha qeela lahum ta'alaw ila ma anzala Allahu waila a  rrasooli raayta almunafiqeena yasuddoona 'anka sudooda
verses.62: Fakayfa itha asabathum museebatun bima qaddamat aydeehim thumma jaooka yahlifoona bi  llahi in aradna illa ihsanan watawfeeqa
verses.63: Olaika allatheena ya'lamu Allahu ma fee quloobihim faa'rid 'anhum wa'i _th_ hum waqul lahum fee anfusihim qawlan baleegha
verses.64: Wama arsana min rasoolin illa liyuta'a biithni Allahi walaw annahum ith _th_ alamoo anfusahum jaooka fa  staghfaroo Allaha wa  staghfara lahumu a  rrasoolu lawajadoo Allaha tawwaban raheema
verses.65: Fala warabbika la yuminoona hatta yuhakkimooka feema shajara baynahum thumma la yajidoo fee anfusihim harajan mimma qadayta wayusallimoo tasleema
verses.66: Walaw anna katabna 'alayhim ani oqtuloo anfusakum awi okhrujoo min diyarikum ma fa'aloohu illa qaleelun minhum walaw annahum fa'aloo ma yoo'a _th_ oona bihi lakana khayran lahum waashadda tathbeeta
verses.67: Waithan laataynahum min ladunna ajran 'a _th_ eema
verses.68: Walahadaynahum siratan mustaqeema
verses.69: Waman yuti'i Allaha wa  rrasoola faolaika ma'a allatheena an'ama Allahu 'alayhim mina a  nnabiyyeena wa  ssiddeeqeena wa  shshuhadai wa  ssaliheena wahasuna olaika rafeeqa
verses.70: Thalika alfadlu mina Allahi wakafa bi  llahi 'aleema
verses.71: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo khuthoo hithrakum fa  nfiroo thubatin awi infiroo jamee'a
verses.72: Wainna minkum laman layubattianna fain asabatkum museebatun qala qad an'ama Allahu 'alayya ith lam akun ma'ahum shaheeda
verses.73: Walain asabakum fadlun mina Allahi layaqoolanna kaan lam takun baynakum wabaynahu mawaddatun ya laytanee kuntu ma'ahum faafooza fawzan 'a _th_ eema
verses.74: Falyuqatil fee sabeeli Allahi allatheena yashroona alhayata a  ddunya bi  lakhirati waman yuqatil fee sabeeli Allahi fayuqtal aw yaghlib fasawfa nuteehi ajran 'a _th_ eema
verses.75: Wama lakum la tuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi wa  lmustad'afeena mina a  rrijali wa  nnisai wa  lwildani allatheena yaqooloona rabbana akhrijna min hathihi alqaryati a  _thth_ alimi ahluha wa  j'al lana min ladunka waliyyan wa  j'al lana min ladunka naseera
verses.76: Allatheena amanoo yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi wa  llatheena kafaroo yuqatiloona fee sabeeli a  ttaghooti faqatiloo awliyaa a  shshaytani inna kayda a  shshaytani kana da'eefa
verses.77: Alam tara ila allatheena qeela lahum kuffoo aydiyakum waaqeemoo a  ssalata waatoo a  zzakata falamma kutiba 'alayhimu alqitalu itha fareequn minhum yakhshawna a  nnasa kakhashyati Allahi aw ashadda khashyatan waqaloo rabbana lima katabta 'alayna alqitala lawla akhkhartana ila ajalin qareebin qul mata'u a  ddunya qaleelun wa  lakhiratu khayrun limani ittaqa wala tu _th_ lamoona fateela
verses.78: Aynama takoonoo yudrikkumu almawtu walaw kuntum fee buroojin mushayyadatin wain tusibhum hasanatun yaqooloo hathihi min 'indi Allahi wain tusibhum sayyiatun yaqooloo hathihi min 'indika qul kullun min 'indi Allahi famali haolai alqawmi la yakadoona yafqahoona hadeetha
verses.79: Ma asabaka min hasanatin famina Allahi wama asabaka min sayyiatin famin nafsika waarsanaka li  nnasi rasoolan wakafa bi  llahi shaheedan
verses.80: Man yuti'i a  rrasoola faqad ata'a Allaha waman tawalla fama arsanaka 'alayhim hafee _th_ a
verses.81: Wayaqooloona ta'atun faitha barazoo min 'indika bayyata taifatun minhum ghayra allathee taqoolu wa  llahu yaktubu ma yubayyitoona faa'rid 'anhum watawakkal 'ala Allahi wakafa bi  llahi wakeela
verses.82: Afala yatadabbaroona alqurana walaw kana min 'indi ghayri Allahi lawajadoo feehi ikhtilafan katheera
verses.83: Waitha jaahum amrun mina alamni awi alkhawfi atha'oo bihi walaw raddoohu ila a  rrasooli waila olee alamri minhum la'alimahu allatheena yastanbitoonahu minhum walawla fadlu Allahi 'alaykum warahmatuhu la  ttaba'tumu a  shshaytana illa qaleela
verses.84: Faqatil fee sabeeli Allahi la tukallafu illa nafsaka waharridi almumineena 'asa Allahu an yakuffa basa allatheena kafaroo wa  llahu ashaddu basan waashaddu tankeela
verses.85: Man yashfa' shafa'atan hasanatan yakun lahu naseebun minha waman yashfa' shafa'atan sayyiatan yakun lahu kiflun minha wakana Allahu 'ala kulli shayin muqeeta
verses.86: Waithahuyyeetum bitahiyyatin fahayyoo biahsana minha aw ruddooha inna Allaha kana 'ala kulli shayin haseeba
verses.87: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa layajma'annakum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi waman asdaqu mina Allahi hadeetha
verses.88: Fama lakum fee almunafiqeena fiatayni wa  llahu arkasahum bima kasaboo atureedoona an tahdoo man adalla Allahu waman yudlili Allahu falan tajida lahu sabeela
verses.89: Waddoo law takfuroona kama kafaroo fatakoonoona sawaan fala tattakhithoo minhum awliyaa hatta yuhajiroo fee sabeeli Allahi fain tawallaw fakhuthoohum wa  qtuloohum haythu wajadtumoohum wala tattakhithoo minhum waliyyan wala naseera
verses.90: Illa allatheena yasiloona ila qawmin baynakum wabaynahum meethaqun aw jaookum hasirat sudooruhum an yuqatilookum aw yuqatiloo qawmahum walaw shaa Allahu lasallatahum 'alaykum falaqatalookum faini i'tazalookum falam yuqatilookum waalqaw ilaykumu a  ssalama fama ja'ala Allahu lakum 'alayhim sabeela
verses.91: Satajidoona akhareena yureedoona an yamanookum wayamanoo qawmahum kulla ma ruddoo ila alfitnati orkisoo feeha fain lam ya'tazilookum wayulqoo ilaykumu a  ssalama wayakuffoo aydiyahum fakhuthoohum wa  qtuloohum haythu thaqiftumoohum waolaikum ja'ana lakum 'alayhim sultanan mubeena
verses.92: Wama kana limuminin an yaqtula muminan illa khataan waman qatala muminan khataan fatahreeru raqabatin muminatin wadiyatun musallamatun ila ahlihi illa an yassaddaqoo fain kana min qawmin 'aduwwin lakum wahuwa muminun fatahreeru raqabatin muminatin wain kana min qawmin baynakum wabaynahum meethaqun fadiyatun musallamatun ila ahlihi watahreeru raqabatin muminatin faman lam yajid fasiyamu shahrayni mutatabi'ayni tawbatan mina Allahi wakana Allahu 'aleeman hakeema
verses.93: Waman yaqtul muminan muta'ammidan fajazaohu jahannamu khalidan feeha waghadiba Allahu 'alayhi wala'anahu waa'adda lahu 'athaban 'a _th_ eema
verses.94: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ithadarabtum fee sabeeli Allahi fatabayyanoo wala taqooloo liman alqa ilaykumu a  ssalama lasta muminan tabtaghoona 'arada alhayati a  ddunya fa'inda Allahi maghanimu katheeratun kathalika kuntum min qablu famanna Allahu 'alaykum fatabayyanoo inna Allaha kana bima ta'maloona khabeera
verses.95: La yastawee alqa'idoona mina almumineena ghayru olee a  ddarari wa  lmujahidoona fee sabeeli Allahi biamwalihim waanfusihim faddala Allahu almujahideena biamwalihim waanfusihim 'ala alqa'ideena darajatan wakullan wa'ada Allahu alhusna wafaddala Allahu almujahideena 'ala alqa'ideena ajran 'a _th_ eema
verses.96: Darajatin minhu wamaghfiratan warahmatan wakana Allahu ghafooran raheema
verses.97: Inna allatheena tawaffahumu almalaikatu _th_ alimee anfusihim qaloo feema kuntum qaloo kunna mustad'afeena fee alardi qaloo alam takun ardu Allahi wasi'atan fatuhajiroo feeha faolaika mawahum jahannamu wasaat maseera
verses.98: Illa almustad'afeena mina a  rrijali wa  nnisai wa  lwildani la yastatee'oona heelatan wala yahtadoona sabeela
verses.99: Faolaika 'asa Allahu an ya'fuwa 'anhum wakana Allahu 'afuwwan ghafoora
verses.100: Waman yuhajir fee sabeeli Allahi yajid fee alardi muraghaman katheeran wasa'atan waman yakhruj min baytihi muhajiran ila Allahi warasoolihi thumma yudrikhu almawtu faqad waqa'a ajruhu 'ala Allahi wakana Allahu ghafooran raheema
verses.101: Waithadarabtum fee alardi falaysa 'alaykum junahun an taqsuroo mina a  ssalati in khiftum an yaftinakumu allatheena kafaroo inna alkafireena kanoo lakum 'aduwwan mubeena
verses.102: Waitha kunta feehim faaqamta lahumu a  ssalata fataqum taifatun minhum ma'aka walyakhuthoo aslihatahum faitha sajadoo falyakoonoo min waraikum watati taifatun okhra lam yusalloo falyusalloo ma'aka walyakhuthoo hithrahum waaslihatahum wadda allatheena kafaroo law taghfuloona 'an aslihatikum waamti'atikum fayameeloona 'alaykum maylatan wahidatan wala junaha 'alaykum in kana bikum athan min matarin aw kuntum marda an tada'oo aslihatakum wakhuthoo hithrakum inna Allaha a'adda lilkafireena 'athaban muheena
verses.103: Faitha qadaytumu a  ssalata fa  thkuroo Allaha qiyaman waqu'oodan wa'ala junoobikum faitha itmanantum faaqeemoo a  ssalata inna a  ssalata kanat 'ala almumineena kitaban mawqoota
verses.104: Wala tahinoo fee ibtighai alqawmi in takoonoo talamoona fainnahum yalamoona kama talamoona watarjoona mina Allahi ma la yarjoona wakana Allahu 'aleeman hakeema
verses.105: Inna anzana ilayka alkitaba bi  lhaqqi litahkuma bayna a  nnasi bima araka Allahu wala takun lilkhaineena khaseema
verses.106: Wa  staghfiri Allaha inna Allaha kana ghafooran raheema
verses.107: Wala tujadil 'ani allatheena yakhtanoona anfusahum inna Allaha la yuhibbu man kana khawwanan atheema
verses.108: Yastakhfoona mina a  nnasi wala yastakhfoona mina Allahi wahuwa ma'ahum ith yubayyitoona ma la yarda mina alqawli wakana Allahu bima ya'maloona muheeta
verses.109: Haantum haolai jadatum 'anhum fee alhayati a  ddunya faman yujadilu Allaha 'anhum yawma alqiyamati am man yakoonu 'alayhim wakeela
verses.110: Waman ya'mal sooan aw ya _th_ lim nafsahu thumma yastaghfiri Allaha yajidi Allaha ghafooran raheema
verses.111: Waman yaksib ithman fainnama yaksibuhu 'ala nafsihi wakana Allahu 'aleeman hakeema
verses.112: Waman yaksib khateeatan aw ithman thumma yarmi bihi bareean faqadi ihtamala buhtanan waithman mubeena
verses.113: Walawla fadlu Allahi 'alayka warahmatuhu lahammat taifatun minhum an yudillooka wama yudilloona illa anfusahum wama yadurroonaka min shayin waanzala Allahu 'alayka alkitaba wa  lhikmata wa'allamaka ma lam takun ta'lamu wakana fadlu Allahi 'alayka 'a _th_ eema
verses.114: La khayra fee katheerin min najwahum illa man amara bisadaqatin aw ma'roofin aw islahin bayna a  nnasi waman yaf'al thalika ibtighaa mardati Allahi fasawfa nuteehi ajran 'a _th_ eema
verses.115: Waman yushaqiqi a  rrasoola min ba'di ma tabayyana lahu alhuda wayattabi' ghayra sabeeli almumineena nuwallihi ma tawalla wanuslihi jahannama wasaat maseera
verses.116: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wayaghfiru ma doona thalika liman yashao waman yushrik bi  llahi faqad dalla dalalan ba'eeda
verses.117: In yad'oona min doonihi illa inathan wain yad'oona illa shaytanan mareeda
verses.118: La'anahu Allahu waqala laattakhithanna min 'ibadika naseeban mafrooda
verses.119: Walaodillannahum walaomanniyannahum walaamurannahum falayubattikunna athana alan'ami walaamurannahum falayughayyirunna khalqa Allahi waman yattakhithi a  shshaytana waliyyan min dooni Allahi faqad khasira khusranan mubeena
verses.120: Ya'iduhum wayumanneehim wama ya'iduhumu a  shshaytanu illa ghuroora
verses.121: Olaika mawahum jahannamu wala yajidoona 'anha maheesa
verses.122: Wa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati sanudkhiluhum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan wa'da Allahi haqqan waman asdaqu mina Allahi qeela
verses.123: Laysa biamaniyyikum wala amaniyyi ahli alkitabi man ya'mal sooan yujza bihi wala yajid lahu min dooni Allahi waliyyan wala naseera
verses.124: Waman ya'mal mina a  ssalihati min thakarin aw ontha wahuwa muminun faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yu _th_ lamoona naqeera
verses.125: Waman ahsanu deenan mimman aslama wajhahu lillahi wahuwa muhsinun wa  ttaba'a millata ibraheema haneefan wa  ttakhatha Allahu ibraheema khaleela
verses.126: Walillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi wakana Allahu bikulli shayin muheeta
verses.127: Wayastaftoonaka fee a  nnisai quli Allahu yufteekum feehinna wama yutla 'alaykum fee alkitabi fee yatama a  nnisai allatee la tutoonahunna ma kutiba lahunna watarghaboona an tankihoohunna wa  lmustad'afeena mina alwildani waan taqoomoo lilyatama bi  lqisti wama taf'aloo min khayrin fainna Allaha kana bihi 'aleema
verses.128: Waini imraatun khafat min ba'liha nushoozan aw i'radan fala junaha 'alayhima an yusliha baynahumasulhan wa  ssulhu khayrun waohdirati alanfusu a  shshuhha wain tuhsinoo watattaqoo fainna Allaha kana bima ta'maloona khabeera
verses.129: Walan tastatee'oo an ta'diloo bayna a  nnisai walaw harastum fala tameeloo kulla almayli fatatharooha ka  lmu'allaqati wain tuslihoo watattaqoo fainna Allaha kana ghafooran raheema
verses.130: Wain yatafarraqa yughni Allahu kullan min sa'atihi wakana Allahu wasi'an hakeema
verses.131: Walillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi walaqad wassayna allatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablikum waiyyakum ani ittaqoo Allaha wain takfuroo fainna lillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi wakana Allahu ghaniyyan hameeda
verses.132: Walillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi wakafa bi  llahi wakeela
verses.133: In yasha yuthhibkum ayyuha a  nnasu wayati biakhareena wakana Allahu 'alathalika qadeera
verses.134: Man kana yureedu thawaba a  ddunya fa'inda Allahi thawabu a  ddunya wa  lakhirati wakana Allahu samee'an baseera
verses.135: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo koonoo qawwameena bi  lqisti shuhadaa lillahi walaw 'ala anfusikum awi alwalidayni wa  laqrabeena in yakun ghaniyyan aw faqeeran fa  llahu awla bihima fala tattabi'oo alhawa an ta'diloo wain talwoo aw tu'ridoo fainna Allaha kana bima ta'maloona khabeera
verses.136: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo aminoo bi  llahi warasoolihi wa  lkitabi allathee nazzala 'ala rasoolihi wa  lkitabi allathee anzala min qablu waman yakfur bi  llahi wamalaikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi wa  lyawmi alakhiri faqad dalla dalalan ba'eeda
verses.137: Inna allatheena amanoo thumma kafaroo thumma amanoo thumma kafaroo thumma izdadoo kufran lam yakuni Allahu liyaghfira lahum wala liyahdiyahum sabeela
verses.139: Allatheena yattakhithoona alkafireena awliyaa min dooni almumineena ayabtaghoona 'indahumu al'izzata fainna al'izzata lillahi jamee'a
verses.140: Waqad nazzala 'alaykum fee alkitabi an itha sami'tum ayati Allahi yukfaru biha wayustahzao biha fala taq'udoo ma'ahum hatta yakhoodoo fee hadeethin ghayrihi innakum ithan mithluhum inna Allaha jami'u almunafiqeena wa  lkafireena fee jahannama jamee'a
verses.141: Allatheena yatarabbasoona bikum fain kana lakum fathun mina Allahi qaloo alam nakun ma'akum wain kana lilkafireena naseebun qaloo alam nastahwith 'alaykum wanamna'kum mina almumineena fa  llahu yahkumu baynakum yawma alqiyamati walan yaj'ala Allahu lilkafireena 'ala almumineena sabeela
verses.142: Inna almunafiqeena yukhadi'oona Allaha wahuwa khadi'uhum waitha qamoo ila a  ssalati qamoo kusala yuraoona a  nnasa wala yathkuroona Allaha illa qaleela
verses.143: Muthabthabeena bayna thalika la ila haolai wala ila haolai waman yudlili Allahu falan tajida lahu sabeela
verses.144: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo alkafireena awliyaa min dooni almumineena atureedoona an taj'aloo lillahi 'alaykum sultanan mubeena
verses.145: Inna almunafiqeena fee a  ddarki alasfali mina a  nnari walan tajida lahum naseera
verses.146: Illa allatheena taboo waaslahoo wa  'tasamoo bi  llahi waakhlasoo deenahum lillahi faolaika ma'a almumineena wasawfa yuti Allahu almumineena ajran 'a _th_ eema
verses.147: Ma yaf'alu Allahu bi'athabikum in shakartum waamantum wakana Allahu shakiran 'aleema
verses.148: La yuhibbu Allahu aljahra bi  ssooi mina alqawli illa man _th_ ulima wakana Allahu samee'an 'aleema
verses.149: In tubdoo khayran aw tukhfoohu aw ta'foo 'an sooin fainna Allaha kana 'afuwwan qadeera
verses.150: Inna allatheena yakfuroona bi  llahi warusulihi wayureedoona an yufarriqoo bayna Allahi warusulihi wayaqooloona numinu biba'din wanakfuru biba'din wayureedoona an yattakhithoo bayna thalika sabeela
verses.151: Olaika humu alkafiroona haqqan waa'tadna lilkafireena 'athaban muheena
verses.152: Wa  llatheena amanoo bi  llahi warusulihi walam yufarriqoo bayna ahadin minhum olaika sawfa yuteehim ojoorahum wakana Allahu ghafooran raheema
verses.153: Yasaluka ahlu alkitabi an tunazzila 'alayhim kitaban mina a  ssamai faqad saaloo moosa akbara min thalika faqaloo arina Allaha jahratan faakhathathumu a  ssa'iqatu bi _th_ ulmihim thumma ittakhathoo al'ijla min ba'di ma jaathumu albayyinatu fa'afawna 'an thalika waatayna moosa sultanan mubeena
verses.154: Warafa'na fawqahumu a  ttoora bimeethaqihim waqulna lahumu odkhuloo albaba sujjadan waqulna lahum la ta'doo fee a  ssabti waakhathna minhum meethaqan ghalee _th_ a
verses.155: Fabima naqdihim meethaqahum wakufrihim biayati Allahi waqatlihimu alanbiyaa bighayri haqqin waqawlihim quloobuna ghulfun bal taba'a Allahu 'alayha bikufrihim fala yuminoona illa qaleela
verses.157: Waqawlihim inna qatana almaseeha 'eesa ibna maryama rasoola Allahi wama qataloohu wamasalaboohu walakin shubbiha lahum wainna allatheena ikhtalafoo feehi lafee shakkin minhu ma lahum bihi min 'ilmin illa ittiba'a a  _thth_ anni wama qataloohu yaqeena
verses.158: Bal rafa'ahu Allahu ilayhi wakana Allahu 'azeezan hakeema
verses.159: Wain min ahli alkitabi illa layuminanna bihi qabla mawtihi wayawma alqiyamati yakoonu 'alayhim shaheeda
verses.160: Fabi _th_ ulmin mina allatheena hadoo harramna 'alayhim tayyibatin ohillat lahum wabisaddihim 'an sabeeli Allahi katheera
verses.161: Waakhthihimu a  rriba waqad nuhoo 'anhu waaklihim amwala a  nnasi bi  lbatili waa'tadna lilkafireena minhum 'athaban aleema
verses.162: Lakini a  rrasikhoona fee al'ilmi minhum wa  lmuminoona yuminoona bima onzila ilayka wama onzila min qablika wa  lmuqeemeena a  ssalata wa  lmutoona a  zzakata wa  lmuminoona bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri olaika sanuteehim ajran 'a _th_ eema
verses.163: Inna awhayna ilayka kama awhayna ila noohin wa  nnabiyyeena min ba'dihi waawhayna ila ibraheema waisma'eela waishaqa waya'qooba wa  lasbati wa'eesa waayyooba wayoonusa waharoona wasulaymana waatayna dawooda zaboora
verses.164: Warusulan qad qasasnahum 'alayka min qablu warusulan lam naqsushum 'alayka wakallama Allahu moosa takleema
verses.165: Rusulan mubashshireena wamunthireena lialla yakoona li  nnasi 'ala Allahi hujjatun ba'da a  rrusuli wakana Allahu 'azeezan hakeema
verses.166: Lakini Allahu yashhadu bima anzala ilayka anzalahu bi'ilmihi wa  lmalaikatu yashhadoona wakafa bi  llahi shaheeda
verses.167: Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo 'an sabeeli Allahi qad dalloo dalalan ba'eeda
verses.168: Inna allatheena kafaroo wa _th_ alamoo lam yakuni Allahu liyaghfira lahum wala liyahdiyahum tareeqa
verses.169: Illatareeqa jahannama khalideena feeha abadan wakana thalika 'ala Allahi yaseera
verses.170: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu qad jaakumu a  rrasoolu bi  lhaqqi min rabbikum faaminoo khayran lakum wain takfuroo fainna lillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi wakana Allahu 'aleeman hakeema
verses.171: Ya ahla alkitabi la taghloo fee deenikum wala taqooloo 'ala Allahi illa alhaqqa innama almaseehu 'eesa ibnu maryama rasoolu Allahi wakalimatuhu alqaha ila maryama waroohun minhu faaminoo bi  llahi warusulihi wala taqooloo thalathatun intahoo khayran lakum innama Allahu ilahun wahidun subhanahu an yakoona lahu waladun lahu ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi wakafa bi  llahi wakeela
verses.172: Lan yastankifa almaseehu an yakoona 'abdan lillahi wala almalaikatu almuqarraboona waman yastankif 'an 'ibadatihi wayastakbir fasayahshuruhum ilayhi jamee'a
verses.173: Faamma allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati fayuwaffeehim ojoorahum wayazeeduhum min fadlihi waamma allatheena istankafoo wa  stakbaroo fayu'aththibuhum 'athaban aleeman wala yajidoona lahum min dooni Allahi waliyyan wala naseera
verses.174: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu qad jaakum burhanun min rabbikum waanzana ilaykum nooran mubeena
verses.175: Faamma allatheena amanoo bi  llahi wa  'tasamoo bihi fasayudkhiluhum fee rahmatin minhu wafadlin wayahdeehim ilayhi siratan mustaqeema
verses.176: Yastaftoonaka quli Allahu yufteekum fee alkalalati ini imruon halaka laysa lahu waladun walahu okhtun falaha nisfu ma taraka wahuwa yarithuha in lam yakun laha waladun fain kanata ithnatayni falahuma a  ththuluthani mimma taraka wain kanoo ikhwatan rijalan wanisaan fali  ththakari mithlu ha _thth_ i alonthayayni yubayyinu Allahu lakum an tadilloo wa  llahu bikulli shayin 'aleem

verses.1: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo awfoo bi  l'uqoodi ohillat lakum baheematu alan'ami illa ma yutla 'alaykum ghayra muhillee a  ssaydi waantum hurumun inna Allaha yahkumu ma yureed
verses.2: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tuhilloo sha'aira Allahi wala a  shshahra alharama wala alhadya wala alqalaida walaammeena albayta alharama yabtaghoona fadlan min rabbihim waridwanan waithahalatum fa  stadoo wala yajrimannakum shanaanu qawmin an saddookum 'ani almasjidi alharami an ta'tadoo wata'awanoo 'ala albirri wa  ttaqwa wala ta'awanoo 'ala alithmi wa  l'udwani wa  ttaqoo Allaha inna Allaha shadeedu al'iqab
verses.3: Hurrimat 'alaykumu almaytatu wa  ddamu walahmu alkhinzeeri wama ohilla lighayri Allahi bihi wa  lmunkhaniqatu wa  lmawqoothatu wa  lmutaraddiyatu wa  nnateehatu wama akala a  ssabu'u illa ma thakkaytum wamathubiha 'ala a  nnusubi waan tastaqsimoo bi  lazlami thalikum fisqun alyawma yaisa allatheena kafaroo min deenikum fala takhshawhum wa  khshawni alyawma akmatu lakum deenakum waatmamtu 'alaykum ni'matee waradeetu lakumu alislama deenan famani idturra fee makhmasatin ghayra mutajanifin liithmin fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.4: Yasaloonaka matha ohilla lahum qul ohilla lakumu a  ttayyibatu wama 'allamtum mina aljawarihi mukallibeena tu'allimoonahunna mimma 'allamakumu Allahu fakuloo mimma amsakna 'alaykum wa  thkuroo isma Allahi 'alayhi wa  ttaqoo Allaha inna Allaha saree'u alhisab
verses.5: Alyawma ohilla lakumu a  ttayyibatu wata'amu allatheena ootoo alkitaba hillun lakum wata'amukum hillun lahum wa  lmuhsanatu mina almuminati wa  lmuhsanatu mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablikum ithaataytumoohunna ojoorahunna muhsineena ghayra musafiheena wala muttakhithee akhdanin waman yakfur bi  leemani faqad habita 'amaluhu wahuwa fee alakhirati mina alkhasireen
verses.6: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha qumtum ila a  ssalati fa  ghsiloo wujoohakum waaydiyakum ila almarafiqi wa  msahoo biruoosikum waarjulakum ila alka'bayni wain kuntum junuban fa  ttahharoo wain kuntum marda aw 'ala safarin aw jaa ahadun minkum mina alghaiti aw lamastumu a  nnisaa falam tajidoo maan fatayammamoo sa'eedan tayyiban fa  msahoo biwujoohikum waaydeekum minhu ma yureedu Allahu liyaj'ala 'alaykum min harajin walakin yureedu liyutahhirakum waliyutimma ni'matahu 'alaykum la'allakum tashkuroon
verses.7: Wa  thkuroo ni'mata Allahi 'alaykum wameethaqahu allathee wathaqakum bihi ith qultum sami'na waata'na wa  ttaqoo Allaha inna Allaha 'aleemun bithati a  ssudoor
verses.8: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo koonoo qawwameena lillahi shuhadaa bi  lqisti wala yajrimannakum shanaanu qawmin 'ala alla ta'diloo i'diloo huwa aqrabu li  ttaqwa wa  ttaqoo Allaha inna Allaha khabeerun bima ta'maloon
verses.9: Wa'ada Allahu allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati lahum maghfiratun waajrun 'a _th_ eem
verses.10: Wa  llatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu aljaheem
verses.11: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo othkuroo ni'mata Allahi 'alaykum ith hamma qawmun an yabsutoo ilaykum aydiyahum fakaffa aydiyahum 'ankum wa  ttaqoo Allaha wa'ala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoon
verses.12: Walaqad akhatha Allahu meethaqa banee israeela waba'athna minhumu ithnay 'ashara naqeeban waqala Allahu innee ma'akum lain aqamtumu a  ssalata waataytumu a  zzakata waamantum birusulee wa'azzartumoohum waaqradtumu Allaha qardan hasanan laokaffiranna 'ankum sayyiatikum walaodkhilannakum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu faman kafara ba'da thalika minkum faqad dalla sawaa a  ssabeel
verses.13: Fabima naqdihim meethaqahum la'annahum waja'ana quloobahum qasiyatan yuharrifoona alkalima 'an mawadi'ihi wanasoo ha _thth_ an mimmathukkiroo bihi wala tazalu tattali'u 'ala khainatin minhum illa qaleelan minhum fa  'fu 'anhum wa  sfah inna Allaha yuhibbu almuhsineen
verses.14: Wamina allatheena qaloo inna nasara akhathna meethaqahum fanasoo ha _thth_ an mimmathukkiroo bihi faaghrayna baynahumu al'adawata wa  lbaghdaa ila yawmi alqiyamati wasawfa yunabbiohumu Allahu bima kanoo yasna'oon
verses.15: Ya ahla alkitabi qad jaakum rasooluna yubayyinu lakum katheeran mimma kuntum tukhfoona mina alkitabi waya'foo 'an katheerin qad jaakum mina Allahi noorun wakitabun mubeen
verses.16: Yahdee bihi Allahu mani ittaba'a ridwanahu subula a  ssalami wayukhrijuhum mina a  _thth_ ulumati ila a  nnoori biithnihi wayahdeehim ilasiratin mustaqeem
verses.17: Laqad kafara allatheena qaloo inna Allaha huwa almaseehu ibnu maryama qul faman yamliku mina Allahi shayan in arada an yuhlika almaseeha ibna maryama waommahu waman fee alardi jamee'an walillahi mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi wama baynahuma yakhluqu ma yashao wa  llahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.18: Waqalati alyahoodu wa  nnasara nahnu abnao Allahi waahibbaohu qul falima yu'aththibukum bithunoobikum bal antum basharun mimman khalaqa yaghfiru liman yashao wayu'aththibu man yashao walillahi mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi wama baynahuma wailayhi almaseer
verses.19: Ya ahla alkitabi qad jaakum rasooluna yubayyinu lakum 'ala fatratin mina a  rrusuli an taqooloo ma jaana min basheerin wala natheerin faqad jaakum basheerun wanatheerun wa  llahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.20: Waith qala moosa liqawmihi ya qawmi othkuroo ni'mata Allahi 'alaykum ith ja'ala feekum anbiyaa waja'alakum mulookan waatakum ma lam yuti ahadan mina al'alameen
verses.21: Ya qawmi odkhuloo alarda almuqaddasata allatee kataba Allahu lakum wala tartaddoo 'ala adbarikum fatanqaliboo khasireen
verses.22: Qaloo ya moosa inna feeha qawman jabbareena wainna lan nadkhulahahatta yakhrujoo minha fain yakhrujoo minha fainna dakhiloon
verses.23: Qala rajulani mina allatheena yakhafoona an'ama Allahu 'alayhima odkhuloo 'alayhimu albaba faitha dakhatumoohu fainnakum ghaliboona wa'ala Allahi fatawakkaloo in kuntum mumineen
verses.24: Qaloo ya moosa inna lan nadkhulaha abadan ma damoo feeha faithhab anta warabbuka faqatila inna hahuna qa'idoon
verses.25: Qala rabbi innee la amliku illa nafsee waakhee fa  fruq baynana wabayna alqawmi alfasiqeen
verses.26: Qala fainnaha muharramatun 'alayhim arba'eena sanatan yateehoona fee alardi fala tasa 'ala alqawmi alfasiqeen
verses.27: Wa  tlu 'alayhim nabaa ibnay adama bi  lhaqqi ith qarraba qurbanan fatuqubbila min ahadihima walam yutaqabbal mina alakhari qala laaqtulannaka qala innama yataqabbalu Allahu mina almuttaqeen
verses.28: Lain basatta ilayya yadaka litaqtulanee ma ana bibasitin yadiya ilayka liaqtulaka innee akhafu Allaha rabba al'alameen
verses.29: Innee oreedu an tabooa biithmee waithmika fatakoona min ashabi a  nnari wathalika jazao a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.30: Fatawwa'at lahu nafsuhu qatla akheehi faqatalahu faasbaha mina alkhasireen
verses.31: Faba'atha Allahu ghuraban yabhathu fee alardi liyuriyahu kayfa yuwaree sawata akheehi qala ya waylata a'ajaztu an akoona mithla hatha alghurabi faowariya sawata akhee faasbaha mina a  nnadimeen
verses.32: Min ajli thalika katabna 'ala banee israeela annahu man qatala nafsan bighayri nafsin aw fasadin fee alardi fakaannama qatala a  nnasa jamee'an waman ahyaha fakaannama ahya a  nnasa jamee'an walaqad jaa thum rusuluna bi  lbayyinati thumma inna katheeran minhum ba'da thalika fee alardi lamusrifoon
verses.33: Innama jazao allatheena yuhariboona Allaha warasoolahu wayas'awna fee alardi fasadan an yuqattaloo aw yusallaboo aw tuqatta'a aydeehim waarjuluhum min khilafin aw yunfaw mina alardi thalika lahum khizyun fee a  ddunya walahum fee alakhirati 'athabun 'a _th_ eem
verses.34: Illa allatheena taboo min qabli an taqdiroo 'alayhim fa  'lamoo anna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.35: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha wa  btaghoo ilayhi alwaseelata wajahidoo fee sabeelihi la'allakum tuflihoon
verses.36: Inna allatheena kafaroo law anna lahum ma fee alardi jamee'an wamithlahu ma'ahu liyaftadoo bihi min 'athabi yawmi alqiyamati ma tuqubbila minhum walahum 'athabun aleem
verses.37: Yureedoona an yakhrujoo mina a  nnari wama hum bikharijeena minha walahum 'athabun muqeem
verses.38: Wa  ssariqu wa  ssariqatu fa  qta'oo aydiyahuma jazaan bima kasaba nakalan mina Allahi wa  llahu 'azeezun hakeem
verses.39: Faman taba min ba'di _th_ ulmihi waaslaha fainna Allaha yatoobu 'alayhi inna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.40: Alam ta'lam anna Allaha lahu mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi yu'aththibu man yashao wayaghfiru liman yashao wa  llahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.41: Ya ayyuha a  rrasoolu la yahzunka allatheena yusari'oona fee alkufri mina allatheena qaloo amanna biafwahihim walam tumin quloobuhum wamina allatheena hadoo samma'oona lilkathibi samma'oona liqawmin akhareena lam yatooka yuharrifoona alkalima min ba'di mawadi'ihi yaqooloona in ooteetum hatha fakhuthoohu wain lam tutawhu fa  htharoo waman yuridi Allahu fitnatahu falan tamlika lahu mina Allahi shayan olaika allatheena lam yuridi Allahu an yutahhira quloobahum lahum fee a  ddunya khizyun walahum fee alakhirati 'athabun 'a _th_ eem
verses.42: Samma'oona lilkathibi akkaloona li  ssuhti fain jaooka fa  hkum baynahum aw a'rid 'anhum wain tu'rid 'anhum falan yadurrooka shayan wain hakamta fa  hkum baynahum bi  lqisti inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteen
verses.43: Wakayfa yuhakkimoonaka wa'indahumu a  ttawratu feehahukmu Allahi thumma yatawallawna min ba'di thalika wama olaika bi  lmumineen
verses.44: Inna anzana a  ttawrata feeha hudan wanoorun yahkumu biha a  nnabiyyoona allatheena aslamoo lillatheena hadoo wa  rrabbaniyyoona wa  lahbaru bima istuhfi _th_ oo min kitabi Allahi wakanoo 'alayhi shuhadaa fala takhshawoo a  nnasa wa  khshawni wala tashtaroo biayatee thamanan qaleelan waman lam yahkum bima anzala Allahu faolaika humu alkafiroon
verses.45: Wakatabna 'alayhim feeha anna a  nnafsa bi  nnafsi wa  l'ayna bi  l'ayni wa  lanfa bi  lanfi wa  lothuna bi  lothuni wa  ssinna bi  ssinni wa  ljurooha qisasun faman tasaddaqa bihi fahuwa kaffaratun lahu waman lam yahkum bima anzala Allahu faolaika humu a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.46: Waqaffayna 'alaatharihim bi'eesa ibni maryama musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina a  ttawrati waataynahu alinjeela feehi hudan wanoorun wamusaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina a  ttawrati wahudan wamaw'i _th_ atan lilmuttaqeen
verses.47: Walyahkum ahlu alinjeeli bima anzala Allahu feehi waman lam yahkum bima anzala Allahu faolaika humu alfasiqoon
verses.48: Waanzana ilayka alkitaba bi  lhaqqi musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina alkitabi wamuhayminan 'alayhi fa  hkum baynahum bima anzala Allahu wala tattabi' ahwaahum 'amma jaaka mina alhaqqi likullin ja'ana minkum shir'atan waminhajan walaw shaa Allahu laja'alakum ommatan wahidatan walakin liyabluwakum fee maatakum fa  stabiqoo alkhayrati ila Allahi marji'ukum jamee'an fayunabbiokum bima kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
verses.49: Waani ohkum baynahum bima anzala Allahu wala tattabi' ahwaahum wa  htharhum an yaftinooka 'an ba'di ma anzala Allahu ilayka fain tawallaw fa  'lam annama yureedu Allahu an yuseebahum biba'di thunoobihim wainna katheeran mina a  nnasi lafasiqoon
verses.50: Afahukma aljahiliyyati yabghoona waman ahsanu mina Allahu hukman liqawmin yooqinoon
verses.51: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo alyahooda wa  nnasara awliyaa ba'duhum awliyao ba'din waman yatawallahum minkum fainnahu minhum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.52: Fatara allatheena fee quloobihim maradun yusari'oona feehim yaqooloona nakhsha an tuseebana dairatun fa'asa Allahu an yatiya bi  lfathi aw amrin min 'indihi fayusbihoo 'ala ma asarroo fee anfusihim nadimeen
verses.53: Wayaqoolu allatheena amanoo ahaolai allatheena aqsamoo bi  llahi jahda aymanihim innahum lama'akum habitat a'maluhum faasbahoo khasireen
verses.54: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo man yartadda minkum 'an deenihi fasawfa yatee Allahu biqawmin yuhibbuhum wayuhibboonahu athillatin 'ala almumineena a'izzatin 'ala alkafireena yujahidoona fee sabeeli Allahi wala yakhafoona lawmata laimin thalika fadlu Allahi yuteehi man yashao wa  llahu wasi'un 'aleem
verses.55: Innama waliyyukumu Allahu warasooluhu wa  llatheena amanoo allatheena yuqeemoona a  ssalata wayutoona a  zzakata wahum raki'oon
verses.56: Waman yatawalla Allaha warasoolahu wa  llatheena amanoo fainna hizba Allahi humu alghaliboon
verses.57: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo allatheena ittakhathoo deenakum huzuwan wala'iban mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablikum wa  lkuffara awliyaa wa  ttaqoo Allaha in kuntum mumineen
verses.58: Waitha nadaytum ila a  ssalati ittakhathooha huzuwan wala'iban thalika biannahum qawmun la ya'qiloon
verses.59: Qul ya ahla alkitabi hal tanqimoona minna illa an amanna bi  llahi wama onzila ilayna wama onzila min qablu waanna aktharakum fasiqoon
verses.60: Qul hal onabbiokum bisharrin min thalika mathoobatan 'inda Allahi man la'anahu Allahu waghadiba 'alayhi waja'ala minhumu alqiradata wa  lkhanazeera wa'abada a  ttaghooti olaika sharrun makanan waadallu 'an sawai a  ssabeel
verses.61: Waitha jaookum qaloo amanna waqad dakhaloo bi  lkufri wahum qad kharajoo bihi wa  llahu a'lamu bima kanoo yaktumoon
verses.62: Watara katheeran minhum yusari'oona fee alithmi wa  l'udwani waaklihimu a  ssuhta labisa ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.63: Lawla yanhahumu a  rrabbaniyyoona wa  lahbaru 'an qawlihimu alithma waaklihimu a  ssuhta labisa ma kanoo yasna'oon
verses.64: Waqalati alyahoodu yadu Allahi maghloolatun ghullat aydeehim walu'inoo bima qaloo bal yadahu mabsootatani yunfiqu kayfa yashao walayazeedanna katheeran minhum ma onzila ilayka min rabbika tughyanan wakufran waalqayna baynahumu al'adawata wa  lbaghdaa ila yawmi alqiyamati kullama awqadoo naran lilharbi atfaaha Allahu wayas'awna fee alardi fasadan wa  llahu la yuhibbu almufsideen
verses.65: Walaw anna ahla alkitabi amanoo wa  ttaqaw lakaffarna 'anhum sayyiatihim walaadkhanahum jannati a  nna'eem
verses.66: Walaw annahum aqamoo a  ttawrata wa  linjeela wama onzila ilayhim min rabbihim laakaloo min fawqihim wamin tahti arjulihim minhum ommatun muqtasidatun wakatheerun minhum saa ma ya'maloon
verses.67: Ya ayyuha a  rrasoolu balligh ma onzila ilayka min rabbika wain lam taf'al fama ballaghta risalatahu wa  llahu ya'simuka mina a  nnasi inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alkafireen
verses.68: Qul ya ahla alkitabi lastum 'ala shayin hatta tuqeemoo a  ttawrata wa  linjeela wama onzila ilaykum min rabbikum walayazeedanna katheeran minhum ma onzila ilayka min rabbika tughyanan wakufran fala tasa 'ala alqawmi alkafireen
verses.69: Inna allatheena amanoo wa  llatheena hadoo wa  ssabioona wa  nnasara man amana bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri wa'amila salihan fala khawfun 'alayhim wala hum yahzanoon
verses.70: Laqad akhathna meethaqa banee israeela waarsana ilayhim rusulan kullama jaahum rasoolun bima la tahwa anfusuhum fareeqan kaththaboo wafareeqan yaqtuloon
verses.71: Wahasiboo alla takoona fitnatun fa'amoo wasammoo thumma taba Allahu 'alayhim thumma 'amoo wasammoo katheerun minhum wa  llahu baseerun bima ya'maloon
verses.72: Laqad kafara allatheena qaloo inna Allaha huwa almaseehu ibnu maryama waqala almaseehu ya banee israeela o'budoo Allaha rabbee warabbakum innahu man yushrik bi  llahi faqad harrama Allahu 'alayhi aljannata wamawahu a  nnaru wama li  _thth_ alimeena min ansar
verses.73: Laqad kafara allatheena qaloo inna Allaha thalithu thalathatin wama min ilahin illa ilahun wahidun wain lam yantahoo 'amma yaqooloona layamassanna allatheena kafaroo minhum 'athabun aleem
verses.74: Afala yatooboona ila Allahi wayastaghfiroonahu wa  llahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.75: Ma almaseehu ibnu maryama illa rasoolun qad khalat min qablihi a  rrusulu waommuhu siddeeqatun kana yakulani a  tta'ama on _th_ ur kayfa nubayyinu lahumu alayati thumma on _th_ ur anna yufakoon
verses.76: Qul ata'budoona min dooni Allahi ma la yamliku lakum darran wala naf'an wa  llahu huwa a  ssamee'u al'aleem
verses.77: Qul ya ahla alkitabi la taghloo fee deenikum ghayra alhaqqi wala tattabi'oo ahwaa qawmin qad dalloo min qablu waadalloo katheeran wadalloo 'an sawai a  ssabeel
verses.78: Lu'ina allatheena kafaroo min banee israeela 'ala lisani dawooda wa'eesa ibni maryama thalika bima 'asaw wakanoo ya'tadoon
verses.79: Kanoo la yatanahawna 'an munkarin fa'aloohu labisa ma kanoo yaf'aloon
verses.80: Tara katheeran minhum yatawallawna allatheena kafaroo labisa ma qaddamat lahum anfusuhum an sakhita Allahu 'alayhim wafee al'athabi hum khalidoon
verses.81: Walaw kanoo yuminoona bi  llahi wa  nnabiyyi wama onzila ilayhi ma ittakhathoohum awliyaa walakinna katheeran minhum fasiqoon
verses.82: Latajidanna ashadda a  nnasi 'adawatan lillatheena amanoo alyahooda wa  llatheena ashrakoo walatajidanna aqrabahum mawaddatan lillatheena amanoo allatheena qaloo inna nasarathalika bianna minhum qisseeseena waruhbanan waannahum la yastakbiroon
verses.83: Waitha sami'oo ma onzila ila a  rrasooli tara a'yunahum tafeedu mina a  ddam'i mimma 'arafoo mina alhaqqi yaqooloona rabbanaamanna fa  ktubna ma'a a  shshahideen
verses.84: Wama lana la numinu bi  llahi wama jaana mina alhaqqi wanatma'u an yudkhilana rabbuna ma'a alqawmi a  ssaliheen
verses.85: Faathabahumu Allahu bima qaloo jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wathalika jazao almuhsineen
verses.86: Wa  llatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu aljaheem
verses.87: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tuharrimoo tayyibati ma ahalla Allahu lakum wala ta'tadoo inna Allaha la yuhibbu almu'tadeen
verses.88: Wakuloo mimma razaqakumu Allahu halalan tayyiban wa  ttaqoo Allaha allathee antum bihi muminoon
verses.89: La yuakhithukumu Allahu bi  llaghwi fee aymanikum walakin yuakhithukum bima 'aqqadtumu alaymana fakaffaratuhu it'amu 'asharati masakeena min awsati ma tut'imoona ahleekum aw kiswatuhum aw tahreeru raqabatin faman lam yajid fasiyamu thalathati ayyamin thalika kaffaratu aymanikum ithahalaftum wa  hfa _th_ oo aymanakum kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi la'allakum tashkuroon
verses.90: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo innama alkhamru wa  lmaysiru wa  lansabu wa  lazlamu rijsun min 'amali a  shshaytani fa  jtaniboohu la'allakum tuflihoon
verses.91: Innama yureedu a  shshaytanu an yooqi'a baynakumu al'adawata wa  lbaghdaa fee alkhamri wa  lmaysiri wayasuddakum 'an thikri Allahi wa'ani a  ssalati fahal antum muntahoon
verses.92: Waatee'oo Allaha waatee'oo a  rrasoola wa  htharoo fain tawallaytum fa  'lamoo annama 'ala rasoolina albalaghu almubeen
verses.93: Laysa 'ala allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati junahun feemata'imoo itha ma ittaqaw waamanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati thumma ittaqaw waamanoo thumma ittaqaw waahsanoo wa  llahu yuhibbu almuhsineen
verses.94: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo layabluwannakumu Allahu bishayin mina a  ssaydi tanaluhu aydeekum warimahukum liya'lama Allahu man yakhafuhu bi  lghaybi famani i'tada ba'da thalika falahu 'athabun aleem
verses.95: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la taqtuloo a  ssayda waantum hurumun waman qatalahu minkum muta'ammidan fajazaon mithlu ma qatala mina a  nna'ami yahkumu bihi thawa 'adlin minkum hadyan baligha alka'bati aw kaffaratun ta'amu masakeena aw 'adlu thalika siyaman liyathooqa wabala amrihi 'afa Allahu 'amma salafa waman 'ada fayantaqimu Allahu minhu wa  llahu 'azeezun thoo intiqam
verses.96: Ohilla lakum saydu albahri wata'amuhu mata'an lakum wali  ssayyarati wahurrima 'alaykum saydu albarri ma dumtum huruman wa  ttaqoo Allaha allathee ilayhi tuhsharoon
verses.97: Ja'ala Allahu alka'bata albayta alharama qiyaman li  nnasi wa  shshahra alharama wa  lhadya wa  lqalaida thalika lita'lamoo anna Allaha ya'lamu ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi waanna Allaha bikulli shayin 'aleem
verses.98: I'lamoo anna Allaha shadeedu al'iqabi waanna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.99: Ma 'ala a  rrasooli illa albalaghu wa  llahu ya'lamu ma tubdoona wama taktumoon
verses.100: Qul la yastawee alkhabeethu wa  ttayyibu walaw a'jabaka kathratu alkhabeethi fa  ttaqoo Allaha ya olee alalbabi la'allakum tuflihoon
verses.101: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tasaloo 'an ashyaa in tubda lakum tasukum wain tasaloo 'anhaheena yunazzalu alquranu tubda lakum 'afa Allahu 'anha wa  llahu ghafoorun haleem
verses.102: Qad saalaha qawmun min qablikum thumma asbahoo biha kafireen
verses.103: Ma ja'ala Allahu min baheeratin wala saibatin wala waseelatin walahamin walakinna allatheena kafaroo yaftaroona 'ala Allahi alkathiba waaktharuhum la ya'qiloon
verses.104: Waitha qeela lahum ta'alaw ila ma anzala Allahu waila a  rrasooli qaloo hasbuna ma wajadna 'alayhi abaana awalaw kana abaohum la ya'lamoona shayan wala yahtadoon
verses.105: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo 'alaykum anfusakum la yadurrukum man dalla itha ihtadaytum ila Allahi marji'ukum jamee'an fayunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.106: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo shahadatu baynikum ithahadara ahadakumu almawtu heena alwasiyyati ithnani thawa 'adlin minkum aw akharani min ghayrikum in antum darabtum fee alardi faasabatkum museebatu almawti tahbisoonahuma min ba'di a  ssalati fayuqsimani bi  llahi ini irtabtum la nashtaree bihi thamanan walaw kana tha qurba wala naktumu shahadata Allahi inna ithan lamina alathimeen
verses.107: Fain 'uthira 'ala annahuma istahaqqa ithman faakharani yaqoomani maqamahuma mina allatheena istahaqqa 'alayhimu alawlayani fayuqsimani bi  llahi lashahadatuna ahaqqu min shahadatihima wama i'tadayna inna ithan lamina a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.108: Thalika adna an yatoo bi  shshahadati 'ala wajhiha aw yakhafoo an turadda aymanun ba'da aymanihim wa  ttaqoo Allaha wa  sma'oo wa  llahu la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeen
verses.109: Yawma yajma'u Allahu a  rrusula fayaqoolu matha ojibtum qaloo la 'ilma lana innaka anta 'allamu alghuyoob
verses.110: Ith qala Allahu ya 'eesa ibna maryama othkur ni'matee 'alayka wa'ala walidatika ith ayyadtuka biroohi alqudusi tukallimu a  nnasa fee almahdi wakahlan waith 'allamtuka alkitaba wa  lhikmata wa  ttawrata wa  linjeela waith takhluqu mina a  tteeni kahayati a  ttayri biithnee fatanfukhu feeha fatakoonu tayran biithnee watubrio alakmaha wa  labrasa biithnee waith tukhriju almawta biithnee waith kafaftu banee israeela 'anka ith jitahum bi  lbayyinati faqala allatheena kafaroo minhum in hatha illa sihrun mubeen
verses.111: Waith awhaytu ila alhawariyyeena an aminoo bee wabirasoolee qaloo amanna wa  shhad biannana muslimoon
verses.112: Ith qala alhawariyyoona ya 'eesa ibna maryama hal yastatee'u rabbuka an yunazzila 'alayna maidatan mina a  ssamai qala ittaqoo Allaha in kuntum mumineen
verses.113: Qaloo nureedu an nakula minha watatmainna quloobuna wana'lama an qad sadaqtana wanakoona 'alayha mina a  shshahideen
verses.114: Qala 'eesa ibnu maryama allahumma rabbana anzil 'alayna maidatan mina a  ssamai takoonu lana 'eedan liawwalina waakhirina waayatan minka wa  rzuqna waanta khayru a  rraziqeen
verses.115: Qala Allahu innee munazziluha 'alaykum faman yakfur ba'du minkum fainnee o'aththibuhu 'athaban la o'aththibuhu ahadan mina al'alameen
verses.116: Waith qala Allahu ya 'eesa ibna maryama aanta qulta li  nnasi ittakhithoonee waommiya ilahayni min dooni Allahi qala subhanaka ma yakoonu lee an aqoola ma laysa lee bihaqqin in kuntu qultuhu faqad 'alimtahu ta'lamu ma fee nafsee wala a'lamu ma fee nafsika innaka anta 'allamu alghuyoob
verses.117: Ma qultu lahum illa ma amartanee bihi ani o'budoo Allaha rabbee warabbakum wakuntu 'alayhim shaheedan ma dumtu feehim falamma tawaffaytanee kunta anta a  rraqeeba 'alayhim waanta 'ala kulli shayin shaheed
verses.118: In tu'aththibhum fainnahum 'ibaduka wain taghfir lahum fainnaka anta al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.119: Qala Allahu hatha yawmu yanfa'u a  ssadiqeena sidquhum lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan radiya Allahu 'anhum waradoo 'anhu thalika alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.120: Lillahi mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi wama feehinna wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer

verses.1: Alhamdu lillahi allathee khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda waja'ala a  _thth_ ulumati wa  nnoora thumma allatheena kafaroo birabbihim ya'diloon
verses.2: Huwa allathee khalaqakum min teenin thumma qada ajalan waajalun musamman 'indahu thumma antum tamtaroon
verses.3: Wahuwa Allahu fee a  ssamawati wafee alardi ya'lamu sirrakum wajahrakum waya'lamu ma taksiboon
verses.4: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo 'anha mu'rideen
verses.5: Faqad kaththaboo bi  lhaqqi lamma jaahum fasawfa yateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioon
verses.6: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin makkannahum fee alardi ma lam numakkin lakum waarsana a  ssamaa 'alayhim midraran waja'ana alanhara tajree min tahtihim faahlaknahum bithunoobihim waanshana min ba'dihim qarnan akhareen
verses.7: Walaw nazzana 'alayka kitaban fee qirtasin falamasoohu biaydeehim laqala allatheena kafaroo in hatha illa sihrun mubeen
verses.8: Waqaloo lawla onzila 'alayhi malakun walaw anzana malakan laqudiya alamru thumma la yun _th_ aroon
verses.9: Walaw ja'anahu malakan laja'anahu rajulan walalabasna 'alayhim ma yalbisoon
verses.10: Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa bi  llatheena sakhiroo minhum ma kanoo bihi yastahzioon
verses.11: Qul seeroo fee alardi thumma on _th_ uroo kayfa kana 'aqibatu almukaththibeen
verses.12: Qul liman ma fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi qul lillahi kataba 'ala nafsihi a  rrahmata layajma'annakum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fahum la yuminoon
verses.13: Walahu ma sakana fee allayli wa  nnahari wahuwa a  ssamee'u al'aleem
verses.14: Qul aghayra Allahi attakhithu waliyyan fatiri a  ssamawati wa  lardi wahuwa yut'imu wala yut'amu qul innee omirtu an akoona awwala man aslama wala takoonanna mina almushrikeen
verses.15: Qul innee akhafu in 'asaytu rabbee 'athaba yawmin 'a _th_ eem
verses.16: Man yusraf 'anhu yawmaithin faqad rahimahu wathalika alfawzu almubeen
verses.17: Wain yamsaska Allahu bidurrin fala kashifa lahu illa huwa wain yamsaska bikhayrin fahuwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.18: Wahuwa alqahiru fawqa 'ibadihi wahuwa alhakeemu alkhabeer
verses.19: Qul ayyu shayin akbaru shahadatan quli Allahu shaheedun baynee wabaynakum waoohiya ilayya hatha alquranu lionthirakum bihi waman balagha ainnakum latashhadoona anna ma'a Allahi alihatan okhra qul la ashhadu qul innama huwa ilahun wahidun wainnanee bareeon mimma tushrikoon
verses.20: Allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba ya'rifoonahu kama ya'rifoona abnaahum allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fahum la yuminoon
verses.21: Waman a _th_ lamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allahi kathiban aw kaththaba biayatihi innahu la yuflihu a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.22: Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'an thumma naqoolu lillatheena ashrakoo ayna shurakaokumu allatheena kuntum taz'umoon
verses.23: Thumma lam takun fitnatuhum illa an qaloo wa  llahi rabbina ma kunna mushrikeen
verses.24: On _th_ ur kayfa kathaboo 'ala anfusihim wadalla 'anhum ma kanoo yaftaroon
verses.25: Waminhum man yastami'u ilayka waja'ana 'ala quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wafee athanihim waqran wain yaraw kulla ayatin la yuminoo bihahatta itha jaooka yujadiloonaka yaqoolu allatheena kafaroo in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleen
verses.26: Wahum yanhawna 'anhu wayanawna 'anhu wain yuhlikoona illa anfusahum wama yash'uroon
verses.27: Walaw tara ith wuqifoo 'ala a  nnari faqaloo ya laytana nuraddu wala nukaththiba biayati rabbina wanakoona mina almumineen
verses.28: Bal bada lahum ma kanoo yukhfoona min qablu walaw ruddoo la'adoo lima nuhoo 'anhu wainnahum lakathiboon
verses.29: Waqaloo in hiya illahayatuna a  ddunya wama nahnu bimab'ootheen
verses.30: Walaw tara ith wuqifoo 'ala rabbihim qala alaysa hatha bi  lhaqqi qaloo bala warabbina qala fathooqoo al'athaba bima kuntum takfuroon
verses.31: Qad khasira allatheena kaththaboo biliqai Allahi hatta itha jaathumu a  ssa'atu baghtatan qaloo yahasratana 'ala ma farratna feeha wahum yahmiloona awzarahum 'ala _th_ uhoorihim ala saa ma yaziroon
verses.32: Wama alhayatu a  ddunya illa la'ibun walahwun wala  ddaru alakhirati khayrun lillatheena yattaqoona afala ta'qiloon
verses.33: Qad na'lamu innahu layahzunuka allathee yaqooloona fainnahum la yukaththiboonaka walakinna a  _thth_ alimeena biayati Allahi yajhadoon
verses.34: Walaqad kuththibat rusulun min qablika fasabaroo 'ala ma kuththiboo waoothoo hatta atahum nasruna wala mubaddila likalimati Allahi walaqad jaaka min nabai almursaleen
verses.35: Wain kana kabura 'alayka i'raduhum faini istata'ta an tabtaghiya nafaqan fee alardi aw sullaman fee a  ssamai fatatiyahum biayatin walaw shaa Allahu lajama'ahum 'ala alhuda fala takoonanna mina aljahileen
verses.36: Innama yastajeebu allatheena yasma'oona wa  lmawta yab'athuhumu Allahu thumma ilayhi yurja'oon
verses.37: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila 'alayhi ayatun min rabbihi qul inna Allaha qadirun 'ala an yunazzila ayatan walakinna aktharahum la ya'lamoon
verses.38: Wama min dabbatin fee alardi walatairin yateeru bijanahayhi illa omamun amthalukum ma farratna fee alkitabi min shayin thumma ila rabbihim yuhsharoon
verses.39: Wa  llatheena kaththaboo biayatinasummun wabukmun fee a  _thth_ ulumati man yashai Allahu yudlilhu waman yasha yaj'alhu 'alasiratin mustaqeem
verses.40: Qul araaytakum in atakum 'athabu Allahi aw atatkumu a  ssa'atu aghayra Allahi tad'oona in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.41: Bal iyyahu tad'oona fayakshifu ma tad'oona ilayhi in shaa watansawna ma tushrikoon
verses.42: Walaqad arsana ila omamin min qablika faakhathnahum bi  lbasai wa  ddarrai la'allahum yatadarra'oon
verses.43: Falawla ith jaahum basuna tadarra'oo walakin qasat quloobuhum wazayyana lahumu a  shshaytanu ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.44: Falamma nasoo mathukkiroo bihi fatahna 'alayhim abwaba kulli shayin hatta itha farihoo bima ootoo akhathnahum baghtatan faitha hum mublisoon
verses.45: Faquti'a dabiru alqawmi allatheena _th_ alamoo wa  lhamdu lillahi rabbi al'alameen
verses.46: Qul araaytum in akhatha Allahu sam'akum waabsarakum wakhatama 'ala quloobikum man ilahun ghayru Allahi yateekum bihi on _th_ ur kayfa nusarrifu alayati thumma hum yasdifoon
verses.47: Qul araaytakum in atakum 'athabu Allahi baghtatan aw jahratan hal yuhlaku illa alqawmu a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.48: Wama nursilu almursaleena illa mubashshireena wamunthireena faman amana waaslaha fala khawfun 'alayhim wala hum yahzanoon
verses.49: Wa  llatheena kaththaboo biayatina yamassuhumu al'athabu bima kanoo yafsuqoon
verses.50: Qul la aqoolu lakum 'indee khazainu Allahi wala a'lamu alghayba wala aqoolu lakum innee malakun in attabi'u illa ma yooha ilayya qul hal yastawee ala'ma wa  lbaseeru afala tatafakkaroon
verses.51: Waanthir bihi allatheena yakhafoona an yuhsharoo ila rabbihim laysa lahum min doonihi waliyyun wala shafee'un la'allahum yattaqoon
verses.52: Wala tatrudi allatheena yad'oona rabbahum bi  lghadati wa  l'ashiyyi yureedoona wajhahu ma 'alayka min hisabihim min shayin wama min hisabika 'alayhim min shayin fatatrudahum fatakoona mina a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.53: Wakathalika fatanna ba'dahum biba'din liyaqooloo ahaolai manna Allahu 'alayhim min baynina alaysa Allahu bia'lama bi  shshakireen
verses.54: Waitha jaaka allatheena yuminoona biayatina faqul salamun 'alaykum kataba rabbukum 'ala nafsihi a  rrahmata annahu man 'amila minkum sooan bijahalatin thumma taba min ba'dihi waaslaha faannahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.55: Wakathalika nufassilu alayati walitastabeena sabeelu almujrimeen
verses.56: Qul innee nuheetu an a'buda allatheena tad'oona min dooni Allahi qul la attabi'u ahwaakum qad dalatu ithan wama ana mina almuhtadeen
verses.57: Qul innee 'ala bayyinatin min rabbee wakaththabtum bihi ma 'indee ma tasta'jiloona bihi ini alhukmu illa lillahi yaqussu alhaqqa wahuwa khayru alfasileen
verses.58: Qul law anna 'indee ma tasta'jiloona bihi laqudiya alamru baynee wabaynakum wa  llahu a'lamu bi  _thth_ alimeen
verses.59: Wa'indahu mafatihu alghaybi la ya'lamuha illa huwa waya'lamu ma fee albarri wa  lbahri wama tasqutu min waraqatin illa ya'lamuha walahabbatin fee _th_ ulumati alardi wala ratbin wala yabisin illa fee kitabin mubeen
verses.60: Wahuwa allathee yatawaffakum bi  llayli waya'lamu ma jarahtum bi  nnahari thumma yab'athukum feehi liyuqda ajalun musamman thumma ilayhi marji'ukum thumma yunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.61: Wahuwa alqahiru fawqa 'ibadihi wayursilu 'alaykum hafa _th_ atan hatta itha jaa ahadakumu almawtu tawaffathu rusuluna wahum la yufarritoon
verses.62: Thumma ruddoo ila Allahi mawlahumu alhaqqi ala lahu alhukmu wahuwa asra'u alhasibeen
verses.63: Qul man yunajjeekum min _th_ ulumati albarri wa  lbahri tad'oonahu tadarru'an wakhufyatan lain anjana min hathihi lanakoonanna mina a  shshakireen
verses.64: Quli Allahu yunajjeekum minha wamin kulli karbin thumma antum tushrikoon
verses.65: Qul huwa alqadiru 'ala an yab'atha 'alaykum 'athaban min fawqikum aw min tahti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiya'an wayutheeqa ba'dakum basa ba'din on _th_ ur kayfa nusarrifu alayati la'allahum yafqahoon
verses.66: Wakaththaba bihi qawmuka wahuwa alhaqqu qul lastu 'alaykum biwakeel
verses.67: Likulli nabain mustaqarrun wasawfa ta'lamoon
verses.68: Waitha raayta allatheena yakhoodoona fee ayatina faa'rid 'anhum hatta yakhoodoo fee hadeethin ghayrihi waimma yunsiyannaka a  shshaytanu fala taq'ud ba'da a  ththikra ma'a alqawmi a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.69: Wama 'ala allatheena yattaqoona min hisabihim min shayin walakin thikra la'allahum yattaqoon
verses.70: Wathari allatheena ittakhathoo deenahum la'iban walahwan wagharrathumu alhayatu a  ddunya wathakkir bihi an tubsala nafsun bima kasabat laysa laha min dooni Allahi waliyyun wala shafee'un wain ta'dil kulla 'adlin la yukhath minha olaika allatheena obsiloo bima kasaboo lahum sharabun min hameemin wa'athabun aleemun bima kanoo yakfuroon
verses.71: Qul anad'oo min dooni Allahi ma la yanfa'una wala yadurruna wanuraddu 'ala a'qabina ba'da ith hadana Allahu ka  llatheeistahwathu a  shshayateenu fee alardi hayrana lahu ashabun yad'oonahu ila alhuda itina qul inna huda Allahi huwa alhuda waomirna linuslima lirabbi al'alameen
verses.72: Waan aqeemoo a  ssalata wa  ttaqoohu wahuwa allathee ilayhi tuhsharoon
verses.73: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda bi  lhaqqi wayawma yaqoolu kun fayakoonu qawluhu alhaqqu walahu almulku yawma yunfakhu fee a  ssoori 'alimu alghaybi wa  shshahadati wahuwa alhakeemu alkhabeer
verses.74: Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi azara atattakhithu asnaman alihatan innee araka waqawmaka fee dalalin mubeen
verses.75: Wakathalika nuree ibraheema malakoota a  ssamawati wa  lardi waliyakoona mina almooqineen
verses.76: Falamma janna 'alayhi allaylu raa kawkaban qala hatha rabbee falamma afala qala la ohibbu alafileen
verses.77: Falamma raa alqamara bazighan qala hatha rabbee falamma afala qala lain lam yahdinee rabbee laakoonanna mina alqawmi a  ddalleen
verses.78: Falamma raa a  shshamsa bazighatan qala hatha rabbee hatha akbaru falamma afalat qala ya qawmi innee bareeon mimma tushrikoon
verses.79: Innee wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fatara a  ssamawati wa  larda haneefan wama ana mina almushrikeen
verses.80: Wahajjahu qawmuhu qala atuhajjoonnee fee Allahi waqad hadani wala akhafu ma tushrikoona bihi illa an yashaa rabbee shayan wasi'a rabbee kulla shayin 'ilman afala tatathakkaroon
verses.81: Wakayfa akhafu ma ashraktum wala takhafoona annakum ashraktum bi  llahi ma lam yunazzil bihi 'alaykum sultanan faayyu alfareeqayni ahaqqu bi  lamni in kuntum ta'lamoon
verses.82: Allatheena amanoo walam yalbisoo eemanahum bi _th_ ulmin olaika lahumu alamnu wahum muhtadoon
verses.83: Watilka hujjatunaataynaha ibraheema 'ala qawmihi narfa'u darajatin man nashao inna rabbaka hakeemun 'aleem
verses.84: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa waya'qooba kullan hadayna wanoohan hadayna min qablu wamin thurriyyatihi dawooda wasulaymana waayyooba wayoosufa wamoosa waharoona wakathalika najzee almuhsineen
verses.85: Wazakariyya wayahya wa'eesa wa  lyasa kullun mina a  ssaliheen
verses.86: Waisma'eela wa  lyasa'a wayoonusa walootan wakullan faddana 'ala al'alameen
verses.87: Wamin abaihim wathurriyyatihim waikhwanihim wa  jtabaynahum wahadaynahum ilasiratin mustaqeem
verses.88: Thalika huda Allahi yahdee bihi man yashao min 'ibadihi walaw ashrakoo lahabita 'anhum ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.89: Olaika allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba wa  lhukma wa  nnubuwwata fain yakfur biha haolai faqad wakkana biha qawman laysoo biha bikafireen
verses.90: Olaika allatheena hada Allahu fabihudahumu iqtadih qul la asalukum 'alayhi ajran in huwa illathikra lil'alameen
verses.91: Wama qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi ith qaloo ma anzala Allahu 'ala basharin min shayin qul man anzala alkitaba allathee jaa bihi moosa nooran wahudan li  nnasi taj'aloonahu qarateesa tubdoonaha watukhfoona katheeran wa'ullimtum ma lam ta'lamoo antum walaabaokum quli Allahu thumma tharhum fee khawdihim yal'aboon
verses.92: Wahatha kitabun anzanahu mubarakun musaddiqu allathee bayna yadayhi walitunthira omma alqura waman hawlaha wa  llatheena yuminoona bi  lakhirati yuminoona bihi wahum 'alasalatihim yuhafi _th_ oon
verses.93: Waman a _th_ lamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allahi kathiban aw qala oohiya ilayya walam yooha ilayhi shayon waman qala saonzilu mithla ma anzala Allahu walaw tara ithi a  _thth_ alimoona fee ghamarati almawti wa  lmalaikatu basitoo aydeehim akhrijoo anfusakumu alyawma tujzawna 'athaba alhooni bima kuntum taqooloona 'ala Allahi ghayra alhaqqi wakuntum 'an ayatihi tastakbiroon
verses.94: Walaqad jitumoona furada kama khalaqnakum awwala marratin wataraktum ma khawwanakum waraa _th_ uhoorikum wama nara ma'akum shufa'aakumu allatheena za'amtum annahum feekum shurakao laqad taqatta'a baynakum wadalla 'ankum ma kuntum taz'umoon
verses.95: Inna Allaha faliqu alhabbi wa  nnawa yukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti wamukhriju almayyiti mina alhayyi thalikumu Allahu faanna tufakoon
verses.96: Faliqu alisbahi waja'ala allayla sakanan wa  shshamsa wa  lqamara husbanan thalika taqdeeru al'azeezi al'aleem
verses.97: Wahuwa allathee ja'ala lakumu a  nnujooma litahtadoo biha fee _th_ ulumati albarri wa  lbahri qad fassana alayati liqawmin ya'lamoon
verses.98: Wahuwa allathee anshaakum min nafsin wahidatin famustaqarrun wamustawda'un qad fassana alayati liqawmin yafqahoon
verses.99: Wahuwa allathee anzala mina a  ssamai maan faakhrajna bihi nabata kulli shayin faakhrajna minhu khadiran nukhriju minhu habban mutarakiban wamina a  nnakhli min tal'iha qinwanun daniyatun wajannatin min a'nabin wa  zzaytoona wa  rrummana mushtabihan waghayra mutashabihin on _th_ uroo ila thamarihi itha athmara wayan'ihi inna fee thalikum laayatin liqawmin yuminoon
verses.100: Waja'aloo lillahi shurakaa aljinna wakhalaqahum wakharaqoo lahu baneena wabanatin bighayri 'ilmin subhanahu wata'ala 'amma yasifoon
verses.101: Badee'u a  ssamawati wa  lardi anna yakoonu lahu waladun walam takun lahu sahibatun wakhalaqa kulla shayin wahuwa bikulli shayin 'aleem
verses.102: Thalikumu Allahu rabbukum la ilaha illa huwa khaliqu kulli shayin fa  'budoohu wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin wakeel
verses.103: La tudrikuhu alabsaru wahuwa yudriku alabsara wahuwa allateefu alkhabeer
verses.104: Qad jaakum basairu min rabbikum faman absara falinafsihi waman 'amiya fa'alayha wama ana 'alaykum bihafee _th_
verses.105: Wakathalika nusarrifu alayati waliyaqooloo darasta walinubayyinahu liqawmin ya'lamoon
verses.106: Ittabi' ma oohiya ilayka min rabbika la ilaha illa huwa waa'rid 'ani almushrikeen
verses.107: Walaw shaa Allahu ma ashrakoo wama ja'anaka 'alayhim hafee _th_ an wama anta 'alayhim biwakeel
verses.108: Wala tasubboo allatheena yad'oona min dooni Allahi fayasubboo Allaha 'adwan bighayri 'ilmin kathalika zayyanna likulli ommatin 'amalahum thumma ila rabbihim marji'uhum fayunabbiohum bima kanoo ya'maloon
verses.109: Waaqsamoo bi  llahi jahda aymanihim lain jaathum ayatun layuminunna biha qul innama alayatu 'inda Allahi wama yush'irukum annaha itha jaat la yuminoon
verses.110: Wanuqallibu afidatahum waabsarahum kama lam yuminoo bihi awwala marratin wanatharuhum fee tughyanihim ya'mahoon
verses.111: Walaw annana nazzana ilayhimu almalaikata wakallamahumu almawta wahasharna 'alayhim kulla shayin qubulan ma kanoo liyuminoo illa an yashaa Allahu walakinna aktharahum yajhaloon
verses.112: Wakathalika ja'ana likulli nabiyyin 'aduwwan shayateena alinsi wa  ljinni yoohee ba'duhum ila ba'din zukhrufa alqawli ghurooran walaw shaa rabbuka ma fa'aloohu fatharhum wama yaftaroon
verses.113: Walitasgha ilayhi afidatu allatheena la yuminoona bi  lakhirati waliyardawhu waliyaqtarifoo ma hum muqtarifoon
verses.114: Afaghayra Allahi abtaghee hakaman wahuwa allathee anzala ilaykumu alkitaba mufassalan wa  llatheena ataynahumu alkitaba ya'lamoona annahu munazzalun min rabbika bi  lhaqqi fala takoonanna mina almumtareen
verses.115: Watammat kalimatu rabbika sidqan wa'adlan la mubaddila likalimatihi wahuwa a  ssamee'u al'aleem
verses.116: Wain tuti' akthara man fee alardi yudillooka 'an sabeeli Allahi in yattabi'oona illa a  _thth_ anna wain hum illa yakhrusoon
verses.117: Inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu man yadillu 'an sabeelihi wahuwa a'lamu bi  lmuhtadeen
verses.118: Fakuloo mimmathukira ismu Allahi 'alayhi in kuntum biayatihi mumineen
verses.119: Wama lakum alla takuloo mimmathukira ismu Allahi 'alayhi waqad fassala lakum maharrama 'alaykum illa ma idturirtum ilayhi wainna katheeran layudilloona biahwaihim bighayri 'ilmin inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu bi  lmu'tadeen
verses.120: Watharoo _th_ ahira alithmi wabatinahu inna allatheena yaksiboona alithma sayujzawna bima kanoo yaqtarifoon
verses.121: Wala takuloo mimma lam yuthkari ismu Allahi 'alayhi wainnahu lafisqun wainna a  shshayateena layoohoona ila awliyaihim liyujadilookum wain ata'tumoohum innakum lamushrikoon
verses.122: Awa man kana maytan faahyaynahu waja'ana lahu nooran yamshee bihi fee a  nnasi kaman mathaluhu fee a  _thth_ ulumati laysa bikharijin minha kathalika zuyyina lilkafireena ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.123: Wakathalika ja'ana fee kulli qaryatin akabira mujrimeeha liyamkuroo feeha wama yamkuroona illa bianfusihim wama yash'uroon
verses.124: Waitha jaathum ayatun qaloo lan numina hatta nuta mithla ma ootiya rusulu Allahi Allahu a'lamu haythu yaj'alu risalatahu sayuseebu allatheena ajramoo sagharun 'inda Allahi wa'athabun shadeedun bima kanoo yamkuroon
verses.125: Faman yuridi Allahu an yahdiyahu yashrahsadrahu lilislami waman yurid an yudillahu yaj'al sadrahu dayyiqan harajan kaannama yassa''adu fee a  ssamai kathalika yaj'alu Allahu a  rrijsa 'ala allatheena la yuminoon
verses.126: Wahathasiratu rabbika mustaqeeman qad fassana alayati liqawmin yaththakkaroon
verses.127: Lahum daru a  ssalami 'inda rabbihim wahuwa waliyyuhum bima kanoo ya'maloon
verses.128: Wayawma yahshuruhum jamee'an ya ma'shara aljinni qadi istakthartum mina alinsi waqala awliyaohum mina alinsi rabbana istamta'a ba'duna biba'din wabalaghna ajalana allathee ajjata lana qala a  nnaru mathwakum khalideena feeha illa ma shaa Allahu inna rabbaka hakeemun 'aleem
verses.129: Wakathalika nuwallee ba'da a  _thth_ alimeena ba'dan bima kanoo yaksiboon
verses.130: Ya ma'shara aljinni wa  linsi alam yatikum rusulun minkum yaqussoona 'alaykum ayatee wayunthiroonakum liqaa yawmikum hatha qaloo shahidna 'ala anfusina wagharrathumu alhayatu a  ddunya washahidoo 'ala anfusihim annahum kanoo kafireen
verses.131: Thalika an lam yakun rabbuka muhlika alqura bi _th_ ulmin waahluha ghafiloon
verses.132: Walikullin darajatun mimma 'amiloo wama rabbuka bighafilin 'amma ya'maloon
verses.133: Warabbuka alghaniyyu thoo a  rrahmati in yasha yuthhibkum wayastakhlif min ba'dikum ma yashao kama anshaakum min thurriyyati qawmin akhareen
verses.134: Inna ma too'adoona laatin wama antum bimu'jizeen
verses.135: Qul ya qawmi i'maloo 'ala makanatikum innee 'amilun fasawfa ta'lamoona man takoonu lahu 'aqibatu a  ddari innahu la yuflihu a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.136: Waja'aloo lillahi mimmatharaa mina alharthi wa  lan'ami naseeban faqaloo hatha lillahi biza'mihim wahatha lishurakaina fama kana lishurakaihim fala yasilu ila Allahi wama kana lillahi fahuwa yasilu ila shurakaihim saa ma yahkumoon
verses.137: Wakathalika zayyana likatheerin mina almushrikeena qatla awladihim shurakaohum liyurdoohum waliyalbisoo 'alayhim deenahum walaw shaa Allahu ma fa'aloohu fatharhum wama yaftaroon
verses.138: Waqaloo hathihi an'amun waharthun hijrun la yat'amuha illa man nashao biza'mihim waan'amun hurrimat _th_ uhooruha waan'amun la yathkuroona isma Allahi 'alayha iftiraan 'alayhi sayajzeehim bima kanoo yaftaroon
verses.139: Waqaloo ma fee butooni hathihi alan'ami khalisatun lithukoorina wamuharramun 'ala azwajina wain yakun maytatan fahum feehi shurakao sayajzeehim wasfahum innahu hakeemun 'aleem
verses.140: Qad khasira allatheena qataloo awladahum safahan bighayri 'ilmin waharramoo ma razaqahumu Allahu iftiraan 'ala Allahi qad dalloo wama kanoo muhtadeen
verses.141: Wahuwa allathee anshaa jannatin ma'rooshatin waghayra ma'rooshatin wa  nnakhla wa  zzar'a mukhtalifan okuluhu wa  zzaytoona wa  rrummana mutashabihan waghayra mutashabihin kuloo min thamarihi itha athmara waatoo haqqahu yawma hasadihi wala tusrifoo innahu la yuhibbu almusrifeen
verses.142: Wamina alan'ami hamoolatan wafarshan kuloo mimma razaqakumu Allahu wala tattabi'oo khutuwati a  shshaytani innahu lakum 'aduwwun mubeen
verses.143: Thamaniyata azwajin mina a  ddani ithnayni wamina alma'zi ithnayni qul a  ththakarayni harrama ami alonthayayni amma ishtamalat 'alayhi arhamu alonthayayni nabbioonee bi'ilmin in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.144: Wamina alibili ithnayni wamina albaqari ithnayni qul a  ththakarayni harrama ami alonthayayni amma ishtamalat 'alayhi arhamu alonthayayni am kuntum shuhadaa ith wassakumu Allahu bihatha faman a _th_ lamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allahi kathiban liyudilla a  nnasa bighayri 'ilmin inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.145: Qul la ajidu fee ma oohiya ilayya muharraman 'alata'imin yat'amuhu illa an yakoona maytatan aw daman masfoohan aw lahma khinzeerin fainnahu rijsun aw fisqan ohilla lighayri Allahi bihi famani idturra ghayra baghin wala 'adin fainna rabbaka ghafoorun raheem
verses.146: Wa'ala allatheena hadoo harramna kulla thee _th_ ufurin wamina albaqari wa  lghanami harramna 'alayhim shuhoomahuma illa mahamalat _th_ uhooruhuma awi alhawaya aw ma ikhtalata bi'a _th_ min thalika jazaynahum bibaghyihim wainna lasadiqoon
