verses.147: Fain kaththabooka faqul rabbukum thoo rahmatin wasi'atin wala yuraddu basuhu 'ani alqawmi almujrimeen
verses.148: Sayaqoolu allatheena ashrakoo law shaa Allahu ma ashrakna walaabaona walaharramna min shayin kathalika kaththaba allatheena min qablihim hattathaqoo basana qul hal 'indakum min 'ilmin fatukhrijoohu lana in tattabi'oona illa a  _thth_ anna wain antum illa takhrusoon
verses.149: Qul falillahi alhujjatu albalighatu falaw shaa lahadakum ajma'een
verses.150: Qul halumma shuhadaakumu allatheena yashhadoona anna Allaha harrama hatha fain shahidoo fala tashhad ma'ahum wala tattabi' ahwaa allatheena kaththaboo biayatina wa  llatheena la yuminoona bi  lakhirati wahum birabbihim ya'diloon
verses.151: Qul ta'alaw atlu maharrama rabbukum 'alaykum alla tushrikoo bihi shayan wabi  lwalidayni ihsanan wala taqtuloo awladakum min imlaqin nahnu narzuqukum waiyyahum wala taqraboo alfawahisha ma _th_ ahara minha wama batana wala taqtuloo a  nnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bi  lhaqqi thalikum wassakum bihi la'allakum ta'qiloon
verses.152: Wala taqraboo mala alyateemi illa bi  llatee hiya ahsanu hatta yablugha ashuddahu waawfoo alkayla wa  lmeezana bi  lqisti la nukallifu nafsan illa wus'aha waitha qultum fa  'diloo walaw kana tha qurba wabi'ahdi Allahi awfoo thalikum wassakum bihi la'allakum tathakkaroon
verses.153: Waanna hathasiratee mustaqeeman fa  ttabi'oohu wala tattabi'oo a  ssubula fatafarraqa bikum 'an sabeelihi thalikum wassakum bihi la'allakum tattaqoon
verses.154: Thumma atayna moosa alkitaba tamaman 'ala allathee ahsana watafseelan likulli shayin wahudan warahmatan la'allahum biliqai rabbihim yuminoon
verses.155: Wahatha kitabun anzanahu mubarakun fa  ttabi'oohu wa  ttaqoo la'allakum turhamoon
verses.156: An taqooloo innama onzila alkitabu 'alataifatayni min qablina wain kunna 'an dirasatihim laghafileen
verses.157: Aw taqooloo law anna onzila 'alayna alkitabu lakunna ahda minhum faqad jaakum bayyinatun min rabbikum wahudan warahmatun faman a _th_ lamu mimman kaththaba biayati Allahi wasadafa 'anha sanajzee allatheena yasdifoona 'an ayatina sooa al'athabi bima kanoo yasdifoon
verses.158: Hal yan _th_ uroona illa an tatiyahumu almalaikatu aw yatiya rabbuka aw yatiya ba'du ayati rabbika yawma yatee ba'du ayati rabbika la yanfa'u nafsan eemanuha lam takun amanat min qablu aw kasabat fee eemaniha khayran quli inta _th_ iroo inna munta _th_ iroon
verses.159: Inna allatheena farraqoo deenahum wakanoo shiya'an lasta minhum fee shayin innama amruhum ila Allahi thumma yunabbiohum bima kanoo yaf'aloon
verses.160: Man jaa bi  lhasanati falahu 'ashru amthaliha waman jaa bi  ssayyiati fala yujza illa mithlaha wahum la yu _th_ lamoon
verses.161: Qul innanee hadanee rabbee ilasiratin mustaqeemin deenan qiyaman millata ibraheema haneefan wama kana mina almushrikeen
verses.162: Qul inna salatee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamatee lillahi rabbi al'alameen
verses.163: La shareeka lahu wabithalika omirtu waana awwalu almuslimeen
verses.164: Qul aghayra Allahi abghee rabban wahuwa rabbu kulli shayin wala taksibu kullu nafsin illa 'alayha wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra thumma ila rabbikum marji'ukum fayunabbiokum bima kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
verses.165: Wahuwa allathee ja'alakum khalaifa alardi warafa'a ba'dakum fawqa ba'din darajatin liyabluwakum fee maatakum inna rabbaka saree'u al'iqabi wainnahu laghafoorun raheem

verses.2: Kitabun onzila ilayka fala yakun fee sadrika harajun minhu litunthira bihi wathikra lilmumineen
verses.3: Ittabi'oo ma onzila ilaykum min rabbikum wala tattabi'oo min doonihi awliyaa qaleelan ma tathakkaroon
verses.4: Wakam min qaryatin ahlaknaha fajaaha basuna bayatan aw hum qailoon
verses.5: Fama kana da'wahum ith jaahum basuna illa an qaloo inna kunna _th_ alimeen
verses.6: Falanasalanna allatheena orsila ilayhim walanasalanna almursaleen
verses.7: Falanaqussanna 'alayhim bi'ilmin wama kunna ghaibeen
verses.8: Wa  lwaznu yawmaithini alhaqqu faman thaqulat mawazeenuhu faolaika humu almuflihoon
verses.9: Waman khaffat mawazeenuhu faolaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum bima kanoo biayatina ya _th_ limoon
verses.10: Walaqad makkannakum fee alardi waja'ana lakum feeha ma'ayisha qaleelan ma tashkuroon
verses.11: Walaqad khalaqnakum thumma sawwarnakum thumma qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa lam yakun mina a  ssajideen
verses.12: Qala ma mana'aka alla tasjuda ith amartuka qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teen
verses.13: Qala fa  hbit minha fama yakoonu laka an tatakabbara feeha fa  khruj innaka mina a  ssaghireen
verses.14: Qala an _th_ irnee ila yawmi yub'athoon
verses.15: Qala innaka mina almun _th_ areen
verses.16: Qala fabima aghwaytanee laaq'udanna lahum sirataka almustaqeem
verses.17: Thumma laatiyannahum min bayni aydeehim wamin khalfihim wa'an aymanihim wa'an shamailihim wala tajidu aktharahum shakireen
verses.18: Qala okhruj minha mathooman madhooran laman tabi'aka minhum laamlaanna jahannama minkum ajma'een
verses.19: Wayaadamu oskun anta wazawjuka aljannata fakula min haythu shituma wala taqraba hathihi a  shshajarata fatakoona mina a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.20: Fawaswasa lahuma a  shshaytanu liyubdiya lahuma ma wooriya 'anhuma min sawatihima waqala ma nahakuma rabbukuma 'an hathihi a  shshajarati illa an takoona malakayni aw takoona mina alkhalideen
verses.21: Waqasamahuma innee lakuma lamina a  nnasiheen
verses.22: Fadallahuma bighuroorin falammathaqa a  shshajarata badat lahuma sawatuhuma watafiqa yakhsifani 'alayhima min waraqi aljannati wanadahuma rabbuhuma alam anhakuma 'an tilkuma a  shshajarati waaqul lakuma inna a  shshaytana lakuma 'aduwwun mubeen
verses.23: Qala rabbana _th_ alamna anfusana wain lam taghfir lana watarhamna lanakoonanna mina alkhasireen
verses.24: Qala ihbitoo ba'dukum liba'din 'aduwwun walakum fee alardi mustaqarrun wamata'un ilaheen
verses.25: Qala feeha tahyawna wafeeha tamootoona waminha tukhrajoon
verses.26: Ya banee adama qad anzana 'alaykum libasan yuwaree sawatikum wareeshan walibasu a  ttaqwathalika khayrun thalika min ayati Allahi la'allahum yaththakkaroon
verses.27: Ya banee adama la yaftinannakumu a  shshaytanu kama akhraja abawaykum mina aljannati yanzi'u 'anhuma libasahuma liyuriyahuma sawatihima innahu yarakum huwa waqabeeluhu min haythu la tarawnahum inna ja'ana a  shshayateena awliyaa lillatheena la yuminoon
verses.28: Waitha fa'aloo fahishatan qaloo wajadna 'alayhaabaana wa  llahu amarana biha qul inna Allaha la yamuru bi  lfahshai ataqooloona 'ala Allahi ma la ta'lamoon
verses.29: Qul amara rabbee bi  lqisti waaqeemoo wujoohakum 'inda kulli masjidin wa  d'oohu mukhliseena lahu a  ddeena kama badaakum ta'oodoon
verses.30: Fareeqan hada wafareeqan haqqa 'alayhimu a  ddalalatu innahumu ittakhathoo a  shshayateena awliyaa min dooni Allahi wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoon
verses.31: Ya banee adama khuthoo zeenatakum 'inda kulli masjidin wakuloo wa  shraboo wala tusrifoo innahu la yuhibbu almusrifeen
verses.32: Qul man harrama zeenata Allahi allatee akhraja li'ibadihi wa  ttayyibati mina a  rrizqi qul hiya lillatheena amanoo fee alhayati a  ddunya khalisatan yawma alqiyamati kathalika nufassilu alayati liqawmin ya'lamoon
verses.33: Qul innamaharrama rabbiya alfawahisha ma _th_ ahara minha wama batana wa  lithma wa  lbaghya bighayri alhaqqi waan tushrikoo bi  llahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanan waan taqooloo 'ala Allahi ma la ta'lamoon
verses.34: Walikulli ommatin ajalun faitha jaa ajaluhum la yastakhiroona sa'atan wala yastaqdimoon
verses.35: Ya banee adama imma yatiyannakum rusulun minkum yaqussoona 'alaykum ayatee famani ittaqa waaslaha fala khawfun 'alayhim wala hum yahzanoon
verses.36: Wa  llatheena kaththaboo biayatina wa  stakbaroo 'anha olaika ashabu a  nnari hum feeha khalidoon
verses.37: Faman a _th_ lamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allahi kathiban aw kaththaba biayatihi olaika yanaluhum naseebuhum mina alkitabi hatta itha jaathum rusuluna yatawaffawnahum qaloo ayna ma kuntum tad'oona min dooni Allahi qaloo dalloo 'anna washahidoo 'ala anfusihim annahum kanoo kafireen
verses.38: Qala odkhuloo fee omamin qad khalat min qablikum mina aljinni wa  linsi fee a  nnari kullama dakhalat ommatun la'anat okhtahahatta itha iddarakoo feeha jamee'an qalat okhrahum lioolahum rabbana haolai adalloona faatihim 'athaban di'fan mina a  nnari qala likullin di'fun walakin la ta'lamoon
verses.39: Waqalat oolahum liokhrahum fama kana lakum 'alayna min fadlin fathooqoo al'athaba bima kuntum taksiboon
verses.40: Inna allatheena kaththaboo biayatina wa  stakbaroo 'anha la tufattahu lahum abwabu a  ssamai wala yadkhuloona aljannata hatta yalija aljamalu fee sammi alkhiyati wakathalika najzee almujrimeen
verses.41: Lahum min jahannama mihadun wamin fawqihim ghawashin wakathalika najzee a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.42: Wa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati la nukallifu nafsan illa wus'aha olaika ashabu aljannati hum feeha khalidoon
verses.43: Wanaza'na ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin tajree min tahtihimu alanharu waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee hadana lihatha wama kunna linahtadiya lawla an hadana Allahu laqad jaat rusulu rabbina bi  lhaqqi wanoodoo an tilkumu aljannatu oorithtumooha bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.44: Wanada ashabu aljannati ashaba a  nnari an qad wajadna ma wa'adana rabbunahaqqan fahal wajadtum ma wa'ada rabbukum haqqan qaloo na'am faaththana muaththinun baynahum an la'natu Allahi 'ala a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.45: Allatheena yasuddoona 'an sabeeli Allahi wayabghoonaha 'iwajan wahum bi  lakhirati kafiroon
verses.46: Wabaynahumahijabun wa'ala ala'rafi rijalun ya'rifoona kullan biseemahum wanadaw ashaba aljannati an salamun 'alaykum lam yadkhulooha wahum yatma'oon
verses.47: Waithasurifat absaruhum tilqaa ashabi a  nnari qaloo rabbana la taj'ana ma'a alqawmi a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.48: Wanada ashabu ala'rafi rijalan ya'rifoonahum biseemahum qaloo ma aghna 'ankum jam'ukum wama kuntum tastakbiroon
verses.49: Ahaolai allatheena aqsamtum la yanaluhumu Allahu birahmatin odkhuloo aljannata la khawfun 'alaykum wala antum tahzanoon
verses.50: Wanada ashabu a  nari ashaba aljannati an afeedoo 'alayna mina almai aw mimma razaqakumu Allahu qaloo inna Allaha harramahuma 'ala alkafireen
verses.51: Allatheena ittakhathoo deenahum lahwan wala'iban wagharrathumu alhayatu a  ddunya fa  lyawma nansahum kama nasoo liqaa yawmihim hatha wama kanoo biayatina yajhadoon
verses.52: Walaqad jinahum bikitabin fassanahu 'ala 'ilmin hudan warahmatan liqawmin yuminoon
verses.53: Hal yan _th_ uroona illa taweelahu yawma yatee taweeluhu yaqoolu allatheena nasoohu min qablu qad jaat rusulu rabbina bi  lhaqqi fahal lana min shufa'aa fayashfa'oo lana aw nuraddu fana'mala ghayra allathee kunna na'malu qad khasiroo anfusahum wadalla 'anhum ma kanoo yaftaroon
verses.54: Inna rabbakumu Allahu allathee khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa 'ala al'arshi yughshee allayla a  nnahara yatlubuhu hatheethan wa  shshamsa wa  lqamara wa  nnujooma musakhkharatin biamrihi ala lahu alkhalqu wa  lamru tabaraka Allahu rabbu al'alameen
verses.55: Od'oo rabbakum tadarru'an wakhufyatan innahu la yuhibbu almu'tadeen
verses.56: Wala tufsidoo fee alardi ba'da islahiha wa  d'oohu khawfan watama'an inna rahmata Allahi qareebun mina almuhsineen
verses.57: Wahuwa allathee yursilu a  rriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi hatta itha aqallat sahaban thiqalan suqnahu libaladin mayyitin faanzana bihi almaa faakhrajna bihi min kulli a  ththamarati kathalika nukhriju almawta la'allakum tathakkaroon
verses.58: Wa  lbaladu a  ttayyibu yakhruju nabatuhu biithni rabbihi wa  llathee khabutha la yakhruju illa nakidan kathalika nusarrifu alayati liqawmin yashkuroon
verses.59: Laqad arsana noohan ila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi o'budoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu innee akhafu 'alaykum 'athaba yawmin 'a _th_ eem
verses.60: Qala almalao min qawmihi inna lanaraka fee dalalin mubeen
verses.61: Qala ya qawmi laysa bee dalalatun walakinnee rasoolun min rabbi al'alameen
verses.62: Oballighukum risalati rabbee waansahu lakum waa'lamu mina Allahi ma la ta'lamoon
verses.63: Awa'ajibtum an jaakum thikrun min rabbikum 'ala rajulin minkum liyunthirakum walitattaqoo wala'allakum turhamoon
verses.64: Fakaththaboohu faanjaynahu wa  llatheena ma'ahu fee alfulki waaghraqna allatheena kaththaboo biayatina innahum kanoo qawman 'ameen
verses.65: Waila 'adin akhahum hoodan qala ya qawmi o'budoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoon
verses.66: Qala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi inna lanaraka fee safahatin wainna lana _th_ unnuka mina alkathibeen
verses.67: Qala ya qawmi laysa bee safahatun walakinnee rasoolun min rabbi al'alameen
verses.68: Oballighukum risalati rabbee waana lakum nasihun ameen
verses.69: Awa'ajibtum an jaakum thikrun min rabbikum 'ala rajulin minkum liyunthirakum wa  thkuroo ith ja'alakum khulafaa min ba'di qawmi noohin wazadakum fee alkhalqi bastatan fa  thkuroo alaa Allahi la'allakum tuflihoon
verses.70: Qaloo ajitana lina'buda Allaha wahdahu wanathara ma kana ya'budu abaona fatina bima ta'iduna in kunta mina a  ssadiqeen
verses.71: Qala qad waqa'a 'alaykum min rabbikum rijsun waghadabun atujadiloonanee fee asmain sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma nazzala Allahu biha min sultanin fa  nta _th_ iroo innee ma'akum mina almunta _th_ ireen
verses.72: Faanjaynahu wa  llatheena ma'ahu birahmatin minna waqata'na dabira allatheena kaththaboo biayatina wama kanoo mumineen
verses.73: Waila thamooda akhahum salihan qala ya qawmi o'budoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu qad jaatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum hathihi naqatu Allahi lakum ayatan fatharooha takul fee ardi Allahi wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum 'athabun aleem
verses.74: Wa  thkuroo ith ja'alakum khulafaa min ba'di 'adin wabawwaakum fee alardi tattakhithoona min suhooliha qusooran watanhitoona aljibala buyootan fa  thkuroo alaa Allahi wala ta'thaw fee alardi mufsideen
verses.75: Qala almalao allatheena istakbaroo min qawmihi lillatheena istud'ifoo liman amana minhum ata'lamoona anna salihan mursalun min rabbihi qaloo inna bima orsila bihi muminoon
verses.76: Qala allatheena istakbaroo inna bi  llathee amantum bihi kafiroon
verses.77: Fa'aqaroo a  nnaqata wa'ataw 'an amri rabbihim waqaloo yasalihu itina bima ta'iduna in kunta mina almursaleen
verses.78: Faakhathathumu a  rrajfatu faasbahoo fee darihim jathimeen
verses.79: Fatawalla 'anhum waqala ya qawmi laqad ablaghtukum risalata rabbee wanasahtu lakum walakin la tuhibboona a  nnasiheen
verses.80: Walootan ith qala liqawmihi atatoona alfahishata ma sabaqakum biha min ahadin mina al'alameen
verses.81: Innakum latatoona a  rrijala shahwatan min dooni a  nnisai bal antum qawmun musrifoon
verses.82: Wama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo akhrijoohum min qaryatikum innahum onasun yatatahharoon
verses.83: Faanjaynahu waahlahu illa imraatahu kanat mina alghabireen
verses.84: Waamtarna 'alayhim mataran fa  n _th_ ur kayfa kana 'aqibatu almujrimeen
verses.85: Waila madyana akhahum shu'ayban qala ya qawmi o'budoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu qad jaatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum faawfoo alkayla wa  lmeezana wala tabkhasoo a  nnasa ashyaahum wala tufsidoo fee alardi ba'da islahihathalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum mumineen
verses.86: Wala taq'udoo bikulli siratin too'idoona watasuddoona 'an sabeeli Allahi man amana bihi watabghoonaha 'iwajan wa  thkuroo ith kuntum qaleelan fakaththarakum wa  n _th_ uroo kayfa kana 'aqibatu almufsideen
verses.87: Wain kana taifatun minkum amanoo bi  llathee orsiltu bihi wataifatun lam yuminoo fa  sbiroo hatta yahkuma Allahu baynana wahuwa khayru alhakimeen
verses.88: Qala almalao allatheena istakbaroo min qawmihi lanukhrijannaka ya shu'aybu wa  llatheena amanoo ma'aka min qaryatina aw lata'oodunna fee millatina qala awalaw kunna kariheen
verses.89: Qadi iftarayna 'ala Allahi kathiban in 'udna fee millatikum ba'da ith najjana Allahu minha wama yakoonu lana an na'ooda feeha illa an yashaa Allahu rabbuna wasi'a rabbuna kulla shayin 'ilman 'ala Allahi tawakkana rabbana iftah baynana wabayna qawmina bi  lhaqqi waanta khayru alfatiheen
verses.90: Waqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi laini ittaba'tum shu'ayban innakum ithan lakhasiroon
verses.91: Faakhathathumu a  rrajfatu faasbahoo fee darihim jathimeen
verses.92: Allatheena kaththaboo shu'ayban kaan lam yaghnaw feeha allatheena kaththaboo shu'ayban kanoo humu alkhasireen
verses.93: Fatawalla 'anhum waqala ya qawmi laqad ablaghtukum risalati rabbee wanasahtu lakum fakayfa asa 'ala qawmin kafireen
verses.94: Wama arsana fee qaryatin min nabiyyin illa akhathna ahlaha bi  lbasai wa  ddarrai la'allahum yaddarra'oon
verses.95: Thumma baddana makana a  ssayyiati alhasanata hatta 'afaw waqaloo qad massa abaana a  ddarrao wa  ssarrao faakhathnahum baghtatan wahum la yash'uroon
verses.96: Walaw anna ahla alquraamanoo wa  ttaqaw lafatahna 'alayhim barakatin mina a  ssamai wa  lardi walakin kaththaboo faakhathnahum bima kanoo yaksiboon
verses.97: Afaamina ahlu alqura an yatiyahum basuna bayatan wahum naimoon
verses.98: Awa amina ahlu alqura an yatiyahum basunaduhan wahum yal'aboon
verses.99: Afaaminoo makra Allahi fala yamanu makra Allahi illa alqawmu alkhasiroon
verses.100: Awalam yahdi lillatheena yarithoona alarda min ba'di ahliha an law nashao asabnahum bithunoobihim wanatba'u 'ala quloobihim fahum la yasma'oon
verses.101: Tilka alqura naqussu 'alayka min anbaiha walaqad jaathum rusuluhum bi  lbayyinati fama kanoo liyuminoo bima kaththaboo min qablu kathalika yatba'u Allahu 'ala quloobi alkafireen
verses.102: Wama wajadna liaktharihim min 'ahdin wain wajadna aktharahum lafasiqeen
verses.103: Thumma ba'athna min ba'dihim moosa biayatina ila fir'awna wamalaihi fa _th_ alamoo biha fa  nu _th_ ur kayfa kana 'aqibatu almufsideen
verses.104: Waqala moosa ya fir'awnu innee rasoolun min rabbi al'alameen
verses.105: Haqeequn 'ala an la aqoola 'ala Allahi illa alhaqqa qad jitukum bibayyinatin min rabbikum faarsil ma'iya banee israeel
verses.106: Qala in kunta jita biayatin fati biha in kunta mina a  ssadiqeen
verses.108: Wanaza'a yadahu faitha hiya baydao li  nna _th_ ireen
verses.109: Qala almalao min qawmi fir'awna inna hatha lasahirun 'aleem
verses.110: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum famatha tamuroon
verses.111: Qaloo arjih waakhahu waarsil fee almadaini hashireen
verses.113: Wajaa a  ssaharatu fir'awna qaloo inna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeen
verses.115: Qaloo ya moosa imma an tulqiya waimma an nakoona nahnu almulqeen
verses.116: Qala alqoo falamma alqaw saharoo a'yuna a  nnasi wa  starhaboohum wajaoo bisihrin 'a _th_ eem
verses.117: Waawhayna ila moosa an alqi 'asaka faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoon
verses.118: Fawaqa'a alhaqqu wabatala ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.123: Qala fir'awnu amantum bihi qabla an athana lakum inna hatha lamakrun makartumoohu fee almadeenati litukhrijoo minha ahlaha fasawfa ta'lamoon
verses.124: Laoqati'anna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin thumma laosallibannakum ajma'een
verses.126: Wama tanqimu minna illa an amanna biayati rabbina lamma jaatna rabbana afrigh 'alaynasabran watawaffana muslimeen
verses.127: Waqala almalao min qawmi fir'awna atatharu moosa waqawmahu liyufsidoo fee alardi wayatharaka waalihataka qala sanuqattilu abnaahum wanastahyee nisaahum wainna fawqahum qahiroon
verses.128: Qala moosa liqawmihi ista'eenoo bi  llahi wa  sbiroo inna alarda lillahi yoorithuha man yashao min 'ibadihi wa  l'aqibatu lilmuttaqeen
verses.129: Qaloo ootheena min qabli an tatiyana wamin ba'di ma jitana qala 'asa rabbukum an yuhlika 'aduwwakum wayastakhlifakum fee alardi fayan _th_ ura kayfa ta'maloon
verses.130: Walaqad akhathnaala fir'awna bi  ssineena wanaqsin mina a  ththamarati la'allahum yaththakkaroon
verses.131: Faitha jaathumu alhasanatu qaloo lana hathihi wain tusibhum sayyiatun yattayyaroo bimoosa waman ma'ahu ala innamatairuhum 'inda Allahi walakinna aktharahum la ya'lamoon
verses.132: Waqaloo mahma tatina bihi min ayatin litasharana biha fama nahnu laka bimumineen
verses.133: Faarsana 'alayhimu a  ttoofana wa  ljarada wa  lqummala wa  ddafadi'a wa  ddama ayatin mufassalatin fa  stakbaroo wakanoo qawman mujrimeen
verses.134: Walamma waqa'a 'alayhimu a  rrijzu qaloo ya moosa od'u lana rabbaka bima 'ahida 'indaka lain kashafta 'anna a  rrijza lanuminanna laka walanursilanna ma'aka banee israeel
verses.135: Falamma kashafna 'anhumu a  rrijza ila ajalin hum balighoohu itha hum yankuthoon
verses.136: Fa  ntaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum fee alyammi biannahum kaththaboo biayatina wakanoo 'anha ghafileen
verses.137: Waawrathna alqawma allatheena kanoo yustad'afoona mashariqa alardi wamagharibaha allatee barakna feeha watammat kalimatu rabbika alhusna 'ala banee israeela bimasabaroo wadammarna ma kana yasna'u fir'awnu waqawmuhu wama kanoo ya'rishoon
verses.138: Wajawazna bibanee israeela albahra faataw 'ala qawmin ya'kufoona 'ala asnamin lahum qaloo ya moosa ij'al lana ilahan kama lahum alihatun qala innakum qawmun tajhaloon
verses.139: Inna haolai mutabbarun ma hum feehi wabatilun ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.140: Qala aghayra Allahi abgheekum ilahan wahuwa faddalakum 'ala al'alameen
verses.141: Waith anjaynakum min ali fir'awna yasoomoonakum sooa al'athabi yuqattiloona abnaakum wayastahyoona nisaakum wafee thalikum balaon min rabbikum 'a _th_ eem
verses.142: Wawa'adna moosa thalatheena laylatan waatmamnaha bi'ashrin fatamma meeqatu rabbihi arba'eena laylatan waqala moosa liakheehi haroona okhlufnee fee qawmee waaslih wala tattabi' sabeela almufsideen
verses.143: Walamma jaa moosa limeeqatina wakallamahu rabbuhu qala rabbi arinee an _th_ ur ilayka qala lan taranee walakini on _th_ ur ila aljabali faini istaqarra makanahu fasawfa taranee falamma tajalla rabbuhu liljabali ja'alahu dakkan wakharra moosasa'iqan falamma afaqa qala subhanaka tubtu ilayka waana awwalu almumineen
verses.144: Qala ya moosa innee istafaytuka 'ala a  nnasi birisalatee wabikalamee fakhuth maataytuka wakun mina a  shshakireen
verses.145: Wakatabna lahu fee alalwahi min kulli shayin maw'i _th_ atan watafseelan likulli shayin fakhuthha biquwwatin wamur qawmaka yakhuthoo biahsaniha saoreekum dara alfasiqeen
verses.146: Saasrifu 'an ayatiya allatheena yatakabbaroona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wain yaraw kulla ayatin la yuminoo biha wain yaraw sabeela a  rrushdi la yattakhithoohu sabeelan wain yaraw sabeela alghayyi yattakhithoohu sabeelan thalika biannahum kaththaboo biayatina wakanoo 'anha ghafileen
verses.147: Wa  llatheena kaththaboo biayatina waliqai alakhirati habitat a'maluhum hal yujzawna illa ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.148: Wa  ttakhatha qawmu moosa min ba'dihi min huliyyihim 'ijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun alam yaraw annahu la yukallimuhum wala yahdeehim sabeelan ittakhathoohu wakanoo _th_ alimeen
verses.149: Walamma suqita fee aydeehim waraaw annahum qad dalloo qaloo lain lam yarhamna rabbuna wayaghfir lana lanakoonanna mina alkhasireen
verses.150: Walamma raja'a moosa ila qawmihi ghadbana asifan qala bisama khalaftumoonee min ba'dee a'ajiltum amra rabbikum waalqa alalwaha waakhatha birasi akheehi yajurruhu ilayhi qala ibna omma inna alqawma istad'afoonee wakadoo yaqtuloonanee fala tushmit biya ala'daa wala taj'anee ma'a alqawmi a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.151: Qala rabbi ighfir lee waliakhee waadkhilna fee rahmatika waanta arhamu a  rrahimeen
verses.152: Inna allatheena ittakhathoo al'ijla sayanaluhum ghadabun min rabbihim wathillatun fee alhayati a  ddunya wakathalika najzee almuftareen
verses.153: Wa  llatheena 'amiloo a  ssayyiati thumma taboo min ba'diha waamanoo inna rabbaka min ba'diha laghafoorun raheem
verses.154: Walamma sakata 'an moosa alghadabu akhatha alalwaha wafee nuskhatiha hudan warahmatun lillatheena hum lirabbihim yarhaboon
verses.155: Wa  khtara moosa qawmahu sab'eena rajulan limeeqatina falamma akhathathumu a  rrajfatu qala rabbi law shita ahlaktahum min qablu waiyyaya atuhlikuna bima fa'ala a  ssufahao minna in hiya illa fitnatuka tudillu biha man tashao watahdee man tashao anta waliyyuna fa  ghfir lana wa  rhamna waanta khayru alghafireen
verses.156: Wa  ktub lana fee hathihi a  ddunyahasanatan wafee alakhirati inna hudna ilayka qala 'athabee oseebu bihi man ashao warahmatee wasi'at kulla shayin fasaaktubuha lillatheena yattaqoona wayutoona a  zzakata wa  llatheena hum biayatina yuminoon
verses.157: Allatheena yattabi'oona a  rrasoola a  nnabiyya alommiyya allathee yajidoonahu maktooban 'indahum fee a  ttawrati wa  linjeeli yamuruhum bi  lma'roofi wayanhahum 'ani almunkari wayuhillu lahumu a  ttayyibati wayuharrimu 'alayhimu alkhabaitha wayada'u 'anhum israhum wa  laghlala allatee kanat 'alayhim fa  llatheena amanoo bihi wa'azzaroohu wanasaroohu wa  ttaba'oo a  nnoora allathee onzila ma'ahu olaika humu almuflihoon
verses.158: Qul ya ayyuha a  nnasu innee rasoolu Allahi ilaykum jamee'an allathee lahu mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi la ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu faaminoo bi  llahi warasoolihi a  nnabiyyi alommiyyi allathee yuminu bi  llahi wakalimatihi wa  ttabi'oohu la'allakum tahtadoon
verses.159: Wamin qawmi moosa ommatun yahdoona bi  lhaqqi wabihi ya'diloon
verses.160: Waqatta'nahumu ithnatay 'ashrata asbatan omaman waawhayna ila moosa ithi istasqahu qawmuhu ani idrib bi'asaka alhajara fa  nbajasat minhu ithnata 'ashrata 'aynan qad 'alima kullu onasin mashrabahum wa _th_ allana 'alayhimu alghamama waanzana 'alayhimu almanna wa  ssalwa kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum wama _th_ alamoona walakin kanoo anfusahum ya _th_ limoon
verses.161: Waith qeela lahumu oskunoo hathihi alqaryata wakuloo minhahaythu shitum waqooloo hittatun wa  dkhuloo albaba sujjadan naghfir lakum khateeatikum sanazeedu almuhsineen
verses.162: Fabaddala allatheena _th_ alamoo minhum qawlan ghayra allathee qeela lahum faarsana 'alayhim rijzan mina a  ssamai bima kanoo ya _th_ limoon
verses.163: Wa  salhum 'ani alqaryati allatee kanat hadirata albahri ith ya'doona fee a  ssabti ith tateehim heetanuhum yawma sabtihim shurra'an wayawma la yasbitoona la tateehim kathalika nabloohum bima kanoo yafsuqoon
verses.164: Waith qalat ommatun minhum lima ta'i _th_ oona qawman Allahu muhlikuhum aw mu'aththibuhum 'athaban shadeedan qaloo ma'thiratan ila rabbikum wala'allahum yattaqoon
verses.165: Falamma nasoo mathukkiroo bihi anjayna allatheena yanhawna 'ani a  ssooi waakhathna allatheena _th_ alamoo bi'athabin baeesin bima kanoo yafsuqoon
verses.166: Falamma 'ataw 'an ma nuhoo 'anhu qulna lahum koonoo qiradatan khasieen
verses.167: Waith taaththana rabbuka layab'athanna 'alayhim ila yawmi alqiyamati man yasoomuhum sooa al'athabi inna rabbaka lasaree'u al'iqabi wainnahu laghafoorun raheem
verses.168: Waqatta'nahum fee alardi omaman minhumu a  ssalihoona waminhum doona thalika wabalawnahum bi  lhasanati wa  ssayyiati la'allahum yarji'oon
verses.169: Fakhalafa min ba'dihim khalfun warithoo alkitaba yakhuthoona 'arada hatha aladna wayaqooloona sayughfaru lana wain yatihim 'aradun mithluhu yakhuthoohu alam yukhath 'alayhim meethaqu alkitabi an la yaqooloo 'ala Allahi illa alhaqqa wadarasoo ma feehi wa  ddaru alakhiratu khayrun lillatheena yattaqoona afala ta'qiloon
verses.170: Wa  llatheena yumassikoona bi  lkitabi waaqamoo a  ssalata inna la nudee'u ajra almusliheen
verses.171: Waith nataqna aljabala fawqahum kaannahu _th_ ullatun wa _th_ annoo annahu waqi'un bihim khuthoo maataynakum biquwwatin wa  thkuroo ma feehi la'allakum tattaqoon
verses.172: Waith akhatha rabbuka min banee adama min _th_ uhoorihim thurriyyatahum waashhadahum 'ala anfusihim alastu birabbikum qaloo bala shahidna an taqooloo yawma alqiyamati inna kunna 'an hatha ghafileen
verses.173: Aw taqooloo innama ashraka abaona min qablu wakunnathurriyyatan min ba'dihim afatuhlikuna bima fa'ala almubtiloon
verses.175: Wa  tlu 'alayhim nabaa allathee ataynahu ayatina fa  nsalakha minha faatba'ahu a  shshaytanu fakana mina alghaween
verses.176: Walaw shina larafa'nahu biha walakinnahu akhlada ila alardi wa  ttaba'a hawahu famathaluhu kamathali alkalbi in tahmil 'alayhi yalhath aw tatrukhu yalhath thalika mathalu alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina fa  qsusi alqasasa la'allahum yatafakkaroon
verses.177: Saa mathalan alqawmu allatheena kaththaboo biayatina waanfusahum kanoo ya _th_ limoon
verses.178: Man yahdi Allahu fahuwa almuhtadee waman yudlil faolaika humu alkhasiroon
verses.179: Walaqad tharana lijahannama katheeran mina aljinni wa  linsi lahum quloobun la yafqahoona biha walahum a'yunun la yubsiroona biha walahum athanun la yasma'oona biha olaika ka  lan'ami bal hum adallu olaika humu alghafiloon
verses.180: Walillahi alasmao alhusna fa  d'oohu biha watharoo allatheena yulhidoona fee asmaihi sayujzawna ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.181: Wamimman khalaqna ommatun yahdoona bi  lhaqqi wabihi ya'diloon
verses.182: Wa  llatheena kaththaboo biayatina sanastadrijuhum min haythu la ya'lamoon
verses.184: Awalam yatafakkaroo ma bisahibihim min jinnatin in huwa illa natheerun mubeen
verses.185: Awalam yan _th_ uroo fee malakooti a  ssamawati wa  lardi wama khalaqa Allahu min shayin waan 'asa an yakoona qadi iqtaraba ajaluhum fabiayyi hadeethin ba'dahu yuminoon
verses.186: Man yudlili Allahu fala hadiya lahu wayatharuhum fee tughyanihim ya'mahoon
verses.187: Yasaloonaka 'ani a  ssa'ati ayyana mursaha qul innama 'ilmuha 'inda rabbee la yujalleeha liwaqtiha illa huwa thaqulat fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi la tateekum illa baghtatan yasaloonaka kaannaka hafiyyun 'anha qul innama 'ilmuha 'inda Allahi walakinna akthara a  nnasi la ya'lamoon
verses.188: Qul la amliku linafsee naf'an waladarran illa ma shaa Allahu walaw kuntu a'lamu alghayba la  stakthartu mina alkhayri wama massaniya a  ssooo in ana illa natheerun wabasheerun liqawmin yuminoon
verses.189: Huwa allathee khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin waja'ala minha zawjaha liyaskuna ilayha falamma taghashshahahamalat hamlan khafeefan famarrat bihi falamma athqalat da'awa Allaha rabbahuma lain ataytanasalihan lanakoonanna mina a  shshakireen
verses.190: Falammaatahumasalihan ja'ala lahu shurakaa feemaatahuma fata'ala Allahu 'amma yushrikoon
verses.191: Ayushrikoona ma la yakhluqu shayan wahum yukhlaqoon
verses.192: Wala yastatee'oona lahum nasran wala anfusahum yansuroon
verses.193: Wain tad'oohum ila alhuda la yattabi'ookum sawaon 'alaykum ada'awtumoohum am antum samitoon
verses.194: Inna allatheena tad'oona min dooni Allahi 'ibadun amthalukum fa  d'oohum falyastajeeboo lakum in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.195: Alahum arjulun yamshoona biha am lahum aydin yabtishoona biha am lahum a'yunun yubsiroona biha am lahum athanun yasma'oona biha quli od'oo shurakaakum thumma keedooni fala tun _th_ iroon
verses.196: Inna waliyyiya Allahu allathee nazzala alkitaba wahuwa yatawalla a  ssaliheen
verses.197: Wa  llatheena tad'oona min doonihi la yastatee'oona nasrakum wala anfusahum yansuroon
verses.198: Wain tad'oohum ila alhuda la yasma'oo watarahum yan _th_ uroona ilayka wahum la yubsiroon
verses.199: Khuthi al'afwa wamur bi  l'urfi waa'rid 'ani aljahileen
verses.200: Waimma yanzaghannaka mina a  shshaytani nazghun fa  sta'ith bi  llahi innahu samee'un 'aleem
verses.201: Inna allatheena ittaqaw itha massahum taifun mina a  shshaytani tathakkaroo faitha hum mubsiroon
verses.202: Waikhwanuhum yamuddoonahum fee alghayyi thumma la yuqsiroon
verses.203: Waitha lam tatihim biayatin qaloo lawla ijtabaytaha qul innama attabi'u ma yooha ilayya min rabbee hatha basairu min rabbikum wahudan warahmatun liqawmin yuminoon
verses.204: Waitha quria alquranu fa  stami'oo lahu waansitoo la'allakum turhamoon
verses.205: Wa  thkur rabbaka fee nafsika tadarru'an wakheefatan wadoona aljahri mina alqawli bi  lghuduwwi wa  lasali wala takun mina alghafileen
verses.206: Inna allatheena 'inda rabbika la yastakbiroona 'an 'ibadatihi wayusabbihoonahu walahu yasjudoon

verses.1: Yasaloonaka 'ani alanfali quli alanfalu lillahi wa  rrasooli fa  ttaqoo Allaha waaslihoo thata baynikum waatee'oo Allaha warasoolahu in kuntum mumineen
verses.2: Innama almuminoona allatheena ithathukira Allahu wajilat quloobuhum waitha tuliyat 'alayhim ayatuhu zadathum eemanan wa'ala rabbihim yatawakkaloon
verses.3: Allatheena yuqeemoona a  ssalata wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoon
verses.4: Olaika humu almuminoona haqqan lahum darajatun 'inda rabbihim wamaghfiratun warizqun kareem
verses.5: Kama akhrajaka rabbuka min baytika bi  lhaqqi wainna fareeqan mina almumineena lakarihoon
verses.6: Yujadiloonaka fee alhaqqi ba'dama tabayyana kaannama yusaqoona ila almawti wahum yan _th_ uroon
verses.7: Waith ya'idukumu Allahu ihda a  ttaifatayni annaha lakum watawaddoona anna ghayra thati a  shshawkati takoonu lakum wayureedu Allahu an yuhiqqa alhaqqa bikalimatihi wayaqta'a dabira alkafireen
verses.8: Liyuhiqqa alhaqqa wayubtila albatila walaw kariha almujrimoon
verses.9: Ith tastagheethoona rabbakum fa  stajaba lakum annee mumiddukum bialfin mina almalaikati murdifeen
verses.10: Wama ja'alahu Allahu illa bushra walitatmainna bihi quloobukum wama a  nnasru illa min 'indi Allahi inna Allaha 'azeezun hakeem
verses.11: Ith yughashsheekumu a  nnu'asa amanatan minhu wayunazzilu 'alaykum mina a  ssamai maan liyutahhirakum bihi wayuthhiba 'ankum rijza a  shshaytani waliyarbita 'ala quloobikum wayuthabbita bihi alaqdam
verses.12: Ith yoohee rabbuka ila almalaikati annee ma'akum fathabbitoo allatheena amanoo saolqee fee quloobi allatheena kafaroo a  rru'ba fa  driboo fawqa ala'naqi wa  driboo minhum kulla banan
verses.13: Thalika biannahum shaqqoo Allaha warasoolahu waman yushaqiqi Allaha warasoolahu fainna Allaha shadeedu al'iqab
verses.14: Thalikum fathooqoohu waanna lilkafireena 'athaba a  nnar
verses.15: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha laqeetumu allatheena kafaroo zahfan fala tuwalloohumu aladbar
verses.16: Waman yuwallihim yawmaithin duburahu illa mutaharrifan liqitalin aw mutahayyizan ila fiatin faqad baa bighadabin mina Allahi wamawahu jahannamu wabisa almaseer
verses.17: Falam taqtuloohum walakinna Allaha qatalahum wama ramayta ith ramayta walakinna Allaha rama waliyubliya almumineena minhu balaan hasanan inna Allaha samee'un 'aleem
verses.18: Thalikum waanna Allaha moohinu kaydi alkafireen
verses.19: In tastaftihoo faqad jaakumu alfathu wain tantahoo fahuwa khayrun lakum wain ta'oodoo na'ud walan tughniya 'ankum fiatukum shayan walaw kathurat waanna Allaha ma'a almumineen
verses.20: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo atee'oo Allaha warasoolahu wala tawallaw 'anhu waantum tasma'oon
verses.21: Wala takoonoo ka  llatheena qaloo sami'na wahum la yasma'oon
verses.22: Inna sharra a  ddawabbi 'inda Allahi a  ssummu albukmu allatheena la ya'qiloon
verses.23: Walaw 'alima Allahu feehim khayran laasma'ahum walaw asma'ahum latawallaw wahum mu'ridoon
verses.24: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo istajeeboo lillahi wali  rrasooli itha da'akum lima yuhyeekum wa  'lamoo anna Allaha yahoolu bayna almari waqalbihi waannahu ilayhi tuhsharoon
verses.25: Wa  ttaqoo fitnatan la tuseebanna allatheena _th_ alamoo minkum khassatan wa  'lamoo anna Allaha shadeedu al'iqab
verses.26: Wa  thkuroo ith antum qaleelun mustad'afoona fee alardi takhafoona an yatakhattafakumu a  nnasu faawakum waayyadakum binasrihi warazaqakum mina a  ttayyibati la'allakum tashkuroon
verses.27: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la takhoonoo Allaha wa  rrasoola watakhoonoo amanatikum waantum ta'lamoon
verses.28: Wa  'lamoo annama amwalukum waawladukum fitnatun waanna Allaha 'indahu ajrun 'a _th_ eem
verses.29: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in tattaqoo Allaha yaj'al lakum furqanan wayukaffir 'ankum sayyiatikum wayaghfir lakum wa  llahu thoo alfadli al'a _th_ eem
verses.30: Waith yamkuru bika allatheena kafaroo liyuthbitooka aw yaqtulooka aw yukhrijooka wayamkuroona wayamkuru Allahu wa  llahu khayru almakireen
verses.31: Waitha tutla 'alayhim ayatuna qaloo qad sami'na law nashao laqulna mithla hatha in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleen
verses.32: Waith qaloo allahumma in kana hatha huwa alhaqqa min 'indika faamtir 'alaynahijaratan mina a  ssamai awi itina bi'athabin aleem
verses.33: Wama kana Allahu liyu'aththibahum waanta feehim wama kana Allahu mu'aththibahum wahum yastaghfiroon
verses.34: Wama lahum alla yu'aththibahumu Allahu wahum yasuddoona 'ani almasjidi alharami wama kanoo awliyaahu in awliyaohu illa almuttaqoona walakinna aktharahum la ya'lamoon
verses.35: Wama kana salatuhum 'inda albayti illa mukaan watasdiyatan fathooqoo al'athaba bima kuntum takfuroon
verses.36: Inna allatheena kafaroo yunfiqoona amwalahum liyasuddoo 'an sabeeli Allahi fasayunfiqoonaha thumma takoonu 'alayhim hasratan thumma yughlaboona wa  llatheena kafaroo ila jahannama yuhsharoon
verses.37: Liyameeza Allahu alkhabeetha mina a  ttayyibi wayaj'ala alkhabeetha ba'dahu 'ala ba'din fayarkumahu jamee'an fayaj'alahu fee jahannama olaika humu alkhasiroon
verses.38: Qul lillatheena kafaroo in yantahoo yughfar lahum ma qad salafa wain ya'oodoo faqad madat sunnatu alawwaleen
verses.39: Waqatiloohum hatta la takoona fitnatun wayakoona a  ddeenu kulluhu lillahi faini intahaw fainna Allaha bima ya'maloona baseer
verses.40: Wain tawallaw fa  'lamoo anna Allaha mawlakum ni'ma almawla wani'ma a  nnaseer
verses.41: Wa  'lamoo annama ghanimtum min shayin faanna lillahi khumusahu wali  rrasooli walithee alqurba wa  lyatama wa  lmasakeeni wa  bni a  ssabeeli in kuntum amantum bi  llahi wama anzana 'ala 'abdina yawma alfurqani yawma iltaqa aljam'ani wa  llahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.42: Ith antum bi  l'udwati a  ddunya wahum bi  l'udwati alquswa wa  rrakbu asfala minkum walaw tawa'adtum la  khtalaftum fee almee'adi walakin liyaqdiya Allahu amran kana maf'oolan liyahlika man halaka 'an bayyinatin wayahya man hayya 'an bayyinatin wainna Allaha lasamee'un 'aleem
verses.43: Ith yureekahumu Allahu fee manamika qaleelan walaw arakahum katheeran lafashiltum walatanaza'tum fee alamri walakinna Allaha sallama innahu 'aleemun bithati a  ssudoor
verses.44: Waith yureekumoohum ithi iltaqaytum fee a'yunikum qaleelan wayuqallilukum fee a'yunihim liyaqdiya Allahu amran kana maf'oolan waila Allahi turja'u alomoor
verses.45: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha laqeetum fiatan fa  thbutoo wa  thkuroo Allaha katheeran la'allakum tuflihoon
verses.46: Waatee'oo Allaha warasoolahu wala tanaza'oo fatafshaloo watathhaba reehukum wa  sbiroo inna Allaha ma'a a  ssabireen
verses.47: Wala takoonoo ka  llatheena kharajoo min diyarihim bataran wariaa a  nnasi wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli Allahi wa  llahu bima ya'maloona muheet
verses.48: Waith zayyana lahumu a  shshaytanu a'malahum waqala la ghaliba lakumu alyawma mina a  nnasi wainnee jarun lakum falamma taraati alfiatani nakasa 'ala 'aqibayhi waqala innee bareeon minkum innee ara ma la tarawna innee akhafu Allaha wa  llahu shadeedu al'iqab
verses.49: Ith yaqoolu almunafiqoona wa  llatheena fee quloobihim maradun gharra haolai deenuhum waman yatawakkal 'ala Allahi fainna Allaha 'azeezun hakeem
verses.50: Walaw tara ith yatawaffa allatheena kafaroo almalaikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbarahum wathooqoo 'athaba alhareeq
verses.51: Thalika bima qaddamat aydeekum waanna Allaha laysa bi _th_ allamin lil'abeed
verses.52: Kadabi ali fir'awna wa  llatheena min qablihim kafaroo biayati Allahi faakhathahumu Allahu bithunoobihim inna Allaha qawiyyun shadeedu al'iqab
verses.53: Thalika bianna Allaha lam yaku mughayyiran ni'matan an'amaha 'ala qawmin hatta yughayyiroo ma bianfusihim waanna Allaha samee'un 'aleem
verses.54: Kadabi ali fir'awna wa  llatheena min qablihim kaththaboo biayati rabbihim faahlaknahum bithunoobihim waaghraqnaala fir'awna wakullun kanoo _th_ alimeen
verses.55: Inna sharra a  ddawabbi 'inda Allahi allatheena kafaroo fahum la yuminoon
verses.56: Allatheena 'ahadta minhum thumma yanqudoona 'ahdahum fee kulli marratin wahum la yattaqoon
verses.57: Faimma tathqafannahum fee alharbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum la'allahum yaththakkaroon
verses.58: Waimma takhafanna min qawmin khiyanatan fa  nbith ilayhim 'ala sawain inna Allaha la yuhibbu alkhaineen
verses.59: Wala yahsabanna allatheena kafaroo sabaqoo innahum la yu'jizoon
verses.60: Waa'iddoo lahum ma istata'tum min quwwatin wamin ribati alkhayli turhiboona bihi 'aduwwa Allahi wa'aduwwakum waakhareena min doonihim la ta'lamoonahumu Allahu ya'lamuhum wama tunfiqoo min shayin fee sabeeli Allahi yuwaffa ilaykum waantum la tu _th_ lamoon
verses.61: Wain janahoo li  ssalmi fa  jnah laha watawakkal 'ala Allahi innahu huwa a  ssamee'u al'aleem
verses.62: Wain yureedoo an yakhda'ooka fainna hasbaka Allahu huwa allathee ayyadaka binasrihi wabi  lmumineen
verses.63: Waallafa bayna quloobihim law anfaqta ma fee alardi jamee'an ma allafta bayna quloobihim walakinna Allaha allafa baynahum innahu 'azeezun hakeem
verses.64: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu hasbuka Allahu wamani ittaba'aka mina almumineen
verses.65: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu harridi almumineena 'ala alqitali in yakun minkum 'ishroona sabiroona yaghliboo miatayni wain yakun minkum miatun yaghliboo alfan mina allatheena kafaroo biannahum qawmun la yafqahoon
verses.66: Alana khaffafa Allahu 'ankum wa'alima anna feekum da'fan fain yakun minkum miatun sabiratun yaghliboo miatayni wain yakun minkum alfun yaghliboo alfayni biithni Allahi wa  llahu ma'a a  ssabireen
verses.67: Ma kana linabiyyin an yakoona lahu asrahatta yuthkhina fee alardi tureedoona 'arada a  ddunya wa  llahu yureedu alakhirata wa  llahu 'azeezun hakeem
verses.68: Lawla kitabun mina Allahi sabaqa lamassakum feema akhathtum 'athabun 'a _th_ eem
verses.69: Fakuloo mimma ghanimtum halalan tayyiban wa  ttaqoo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.70: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu qul liman fee aydeekum mina alasra in ya'lami Allahu fee quloobikum khayran yutikum khayran mimma okhitha minkum wayaghfir lakum wa  llahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.71: Wain yureedoo khiyanataka faqad khanoo Allaha min qablu faamkana minhum wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.72: Inna allatheena amanoo wahajaroo wajahadoo biamwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allahi wa  llatheena awaw wanasaroo olaika ba'duhum awliyao ba'din wa  llatheena amanoo walam yuhajiroo ma lakum min walayatihim min shayin hatta yuhajiroo waini istansarookum fee a  ddeeni fa'alaykumu a  nnasru illa 'ala qawmin baynakum wabaynahum meethaqun wa  llahu bima ta'maloona baseer
verses.73: Wa  llatheena kafaroo ba'duhum awliyao ba'din illa taf'aloohu takun fitnatun fee alardi wafasadun kabeer
verses.74: Wa  llatheena amanoo wahajaroo wajahadoo fee sabeeli Allahi wa  llatheena awaw wanasaroo olaika humu almuminoona haqqan lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareem
verses.75: Wa  llatheena amanoo min ba'du wahajaroo wajahadoo ma'akum faolaika minkum waoloo alarhami ba'duhum awla biba'din fee kitabi Allahi inna Allaha bikulli shayin 'aleem

verses.1: Baraatun mina Allahi warasoolihi ila allatheena 'ahadtum mina almushrikeen
verses.2: Faseehoo fee alardi arba'ata ashhurin wa  'lamoo annakum ghayru mu'jizee Allahi waanna Allaha mukhzee alkafireen
verses.3: Waathanun mina Allahi warasoolihi ila a  nnasi yawma alhajji alakbari anna Allaha bareeon mina almushrikeena warasooluhu fain tubtum fahuwa khayrun lakum wain tawallaytum fa  'lamoo annakum ghayru mu'jizee Allahi wabashshiri allatheena kafaroo bi'athabin aleem
verses.4: Illa allatheena 'ahadtum mina almushrikeena thumma lam yanqusookum shayan walam yu _th_ ahiroo 'alaykum ahadan faatimmoo ilayhim 'ahdahum ila muddatihim inna Allaha yuhibbu almuttaqeen
verses.5: Faitha insalakha alashhuru alhurumu fa  qtuloo almushrikeena haythu wajadtumoohum wakhuthoohum wa  hsuroohum wa  q'udoo lahum kulla marsadin fain taboo waaqamoo a  ssalata waatawoo a  zzakata fakhalloo sabeelahum inna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.6: Wain ahadun mina almushrikeena istajaraka faajirhu hatta yasma'a kalama Allahi thumma ablighhu mamanahu thalika biannahum qawmun la ya'lamoon
verses.7: Kayfa yakoonu lilmushrikeena 'ahdun 'inda Allahi wa'inda rasoolihi illa allatheena 'ahadtum 'inda almasjidi alharami fama istaqamoo lakum fa  staqeemoo lahum inna Allaha yuhibbu almuttaqeen
verses.8: Kayfa wain ya _th_ haroo 'alaykum la yarquboo feekum illan walathimmatan yurdoonakum biafwahihim wataba quloobuhum waaktharuhum fasiqoon
verses.9: Ishtaraw biayati Allahi thamanan qaleelan fasaddoo 'an sabeelihi innahum saa ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.10: La yarquboona fee muminin illan walathimmatan waolaika humu almu'tadoon
verses.11: Fain taboo waaqamoo a  ssalata waatawoo a  zzakata faikhwanukum fee a  ddeeni wanufassilu alayati liqawmin ya'lamoon
verses.12: Wain nakathoo aymanahum min ba'di 'ahdihim wata'anoo fee deenikum faqatiloo aimmata alkufri innahum la aymana lahum la'allahum yantahoon
verses.13: Ala tuqatiloona qawman nakathoo aymanahum wahammoo biikhraji a  rrasooli wahum badaookum awwala marratin atakhshawnahum fa  llahu ahaqqu an takhshawhu in kuntum mumineen
verses.14: Qatiloohum yu'aththibhumu Allahu biaydeekum wayukhzihim wayansurkum 'alayhim wayashfi sudoora qawmin mumineen
verses.15: Wayuthhib ghay _th_ a quloobihim wayatoobu Allahu 'ala man yashao wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.16: Am hasibtum an tutrakoo walamma ya'lami Allahu allatheena jahadoo minkum walam yattakhithoo min dooni Allahi wala rasoolihi wala almumineena waleejatan wa  llahu khabeerun bima ta'maloon
verses.17: Ma kana lilmushrikeena an ya'muroo masajida Allahi shahideena 'ala anfusihim bi  lkufri olaika habitat a'maluhum wafee a  nnari hum khalidoon
verses.18: Innama ya'muru masajida Allahi man amana bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri waaqama a  ssalata waata a  zzakata walam yakhsha illa Allaha fa'asa olaika an yakoonoo mina almuhtadeen
verses.19: Aja'atum siqayata alhajji wa'imarata almasjidi alharami kaman amana bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri wajahada fee sabeeli Allahi la yastawoona 'inda Allahi wa  llahu la yahdee alqawma a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.20: Allatheena amanoo wahajaroo wajahadoo fee sabeeli Allahi biamwalihim waanfusihim a' _th_ amu darajatan 'inda Allahi waolaika humu alfaizoon
verses.21: Yubashshiruhum rabbuhum birahmatin minhu waridwanin wajannatin lahum feeha na'eemun muqeem
verses.22: Khalideena feeha abadan inna Allaha 'indahu ajrun 'a _th_ eem
verses.23: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo abaakum waikhwanakum awliyaa ini istahabboo alkufra 'ala aleemani waman yatawallahum minkum faolaika humu a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.24: Qul in kana abaokum waabnaokum waikhwanukum waazwajukum wa'asheeratukum waamwalun iqtaraftumooha watijaratun takhshawna kasadaha wamasakinu tardawnaha ahabba ilaykum mina Allahi warasoolihi wajihadin fee sabeelihi fatarabbasoo hatta yatiya Allahu biamrihi wa  llahu la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeen
verses.25: Laqad nasarakumu Allahu fee mawatina katheeratin wayawma hunaynin ith a'jabatkum kathratukum falam tughni 'ankum shayan wadaqat 'alaykumu alardu bima rahubat thumma wallaytum mudbireen
verses.26: Thumma anzala Allahu sakeenatahu 'ala rasoolihi wa'ala almumineena waanzala junoodan lam tarawha wa'aththaba allatheena kafaroo wathalika jazao alkafireen
verses.27: Thumma yatoobu Allahu min ba'di thalika 'ala man yashao wa  llahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.28: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo innama almushrikoona najasun fala yaqraboo almasjida alharama ba'da 'amihim hatha wain khiftum 'aylatan fasawfa yughneekumu Allahu min fadlihi in shaa inna Allaha 'aleemun hakeem
verses.29: Qatiloo allatheena la yuminoona bi  llahi wala bi  lyawmi alakhiri wala yuharrimoona maharrama Allahu warasooluhu wala yadeenoona deena alhaqqi mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba hatta yu'too aljizyata 'an yadin wahum saghiroon
verses.30: Waqalati alyahoodu 'uzayrun ibnu Allahi waqalati a  nnasara almaseehu ibnu Allahi thalika qawluhum biafwahihim yudahioona qawla allatheena kafaroo min qablu qatalahumu Allahu anna yufakoon
verses.31: Ittakhathoo ahbarahum waruhbanahum arbaban min dooni Allahi wa  lmaseeha ibna maryama wama omiroo illa liya'budoo ilahan wahidan la ilaha illa huwa subhanahu 'amma yushrikoon
verses.32: Yureedoona an yutfioo noora Allahi biafwahihim wayaba Allahu illa an yutimma noorahu walaw kariha alkafiroon
verses.33: Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bi  lhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyu _th_ hirahu 'ala a  ddeeni kullihi walaw kariha almushrikoon
verses.34: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo inna katheeran mina alahbari wa  rruhbani layakuloona amwala a  nnasi bi  lbatili wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli Allahi wa  llatheena yaknizoona a  ththahaba wa  lfiddata wala yunfiqoonaha fee sabeeli Allahi fabashshirhum bi'athabin aleem
verses.35: Yawma yuhma 'alayha fee nari jahannama fatukwa biha jibahuhum wajunoobuhum wa _th_ uhooruhum hatha ma kanaztum lianfusikum fathooqoo ma kuntum taknizoon
verses.36: Inna 'iddata a  shshuhoori 'inda Allahi ithna 'ashara shahran fee kitabi Allahi yawma khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda minha arba'atun hurumun thalika a  ddeenu alqayyimu fala ta _th_ limoo feehinna anfusakum waqatiloo almushrikeena kaffatan kama yuqatiloonakum kaffatan wa  'lamoo anna Allaha ma'a almuttaqeen
verses.37: Innama a  nnaseeo ziyadatun fee alkufri yudallu bihi allatheena kafaroo yuhilloonahu 'aman wayuharrimoonahu 'aman liyuwatioo 'iddata maharrama Allahu fayuhilloo maharrama Allahu zuyyina lahum sooo a'malihim wa  llahu la yahdee alqawma alkafireen
verses.38: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ma lakum itha qeela lakumu infiroo fee sabeeli Allahi iththaqatum ila alardi aradeetum bi  lhayati a  ddunya mina alakhirati fama mata'u alhayati a  ddunya fee alakhirati illa qaleel
verses.39: Illa tanfiroo yu'aththibkum 'athaban aleeman wayastabdil qawman ghayrakum wala tadurroohu shayan wa  llahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.40: Illa tansuroohu faqad nasarahu Allahu ith akhrajahu allatheena kafaroo thaniya ithnayni ith huma fee alghari ith yaqoolu lisahibihi la tahzan inna Allaha ma'ana faanzala Allahu sakeenatahu 'alayhi waayyadahu bijunoodin lam tarawha waja'ala kalimata allatheena kafaroo a  ssufla wakalimatu Allahi hiya al'ulya wa  llahu 'azeezun hakeem
verses.41: Infiroo khifafan wathiqalan wajahidoo biamwalikum waanfusikum fee sabeeli Allahi thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
verses.42: Law kana 'aradan qareeban wasafaran qasidan la  ttaba'ooka walakin ba'udat 'alayhimu a  shshuqqatu wasayahlifoona bi  llahi lawi istata'na lakharajna ma'akum yuhlikoona anfusahum wa  llahu ya'lamu innahum lakathiboon
verses.43: 'afa Allahu 'anka lima athinta lahum hatta yatabayyana laka allatheena sadaqoo wata'lama alkathibeen
verses.44: La yastathinuka allatheena yuminoona bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri an yujahidoo biamwalihim waanfusihim wa  llahu 'aleemun bi  lmuttaqeen
verses.45: Innama yastathinuka allatheena la yuminoona bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri wa  rtabat quloobuhum fahum fee raybihim yataraddadoon
verses.46: Walaw aradoo alkhurooja laa'addoo lahu 'uddatan walakin kariha Allahu inbi'athahum fathabbatahum waqeela oq'udoo ma'a alqa'ideen
verses.47: Law kharajoo feekum ma zadookum illa khabalan walaawda'oo khilalakum yabghoonakumu alfitnata wafeekum samma'oona lahum wa  llahu 'aleemun bi  _thth_ alimeen
verses.48: Laqadi ibtaghawoo alfitnata min qablu waqallaboo laka alomoora hatta jaa alhaqqu wa _th_ ahara amru Allahi wahum karihoon
verses.49: Waminhum man yaqoolu ithan lee wala taftinnee ala fee alfitnati saqatoo wainna jahannama lamuheetatun bi  lkafireen
verses.50: In tusibka hasanatun tasuhum wain tusibka museebatun yaqooloo qad akhathna amrana min qablu wayatawallaw wahum farihoon
verses.51: Qul lan yuseebana illa ma kataba Allahu lana huwa mawlana wa'ala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoon
verses.52: Qul hal tarabbasoona bina illa ihda alhusnayayni wanahnu natarabbasu bikum an yuseebakumu Allahu bi'athabin min 'indihi aw biaydeena fatarabbasoo inna ma'akum mutarabbisoon
verses.53: Qul anfiqoo taw'an aw karhan lan yutaqabbala minkum innakum kuntum qawman fasiqeen
verses.54: Wama mana'ahum an tuqbala minhum nafaqatuhum illa annahum kafaroo bi  llahi wabirasoolihi wala yatoona a  ssalata illa wahum kusala wala yunfiqoona illa wahum karihoon
verses.55: Fala tu'jibka amwaluhum wala awladuhum innama yureedu Allahu liyu'aththibahum biha fee alhayati a  ddunya watazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kafiroon
verses.56: Wayahlifoona bi  llahi innahum laminkum wama hum minkum walakinnahum qawmun yafraqoon
verses.57: Law yajidoona maljaan aw magharatin aw muddakhalan lawallaw ilayhi wahum yajmahoon
verses.58: Waminhum man yalmizuka fee a  ssadaqati fain o'too minha radoo wain lam yu'taw minha itha hum yaskhatoon
verses.59: Walaw annahum radoo maatahumu Allahu warasooluhu waqaloo hasbuna Allahu sayuteena Allahu min fadlihi warasooluhu inna ila Allahi raghiboon
verses.60: Innama a  ssadaqatu lilfuqarai wa  lmasakeeni wa  l'amileena 'alayha wa  lmuallafati quloobuhum wafee a  rriqabi wa  lgharimeena wafee sabeeli Allahi wa  bni a  ssabeeli fareedatan mina Allahi wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeemun
verses.61: Waminhumu allatheena yuthoona a  nnabiyya wayaqooloona huwa othunun qul othunu khayrin lakum yuminu bi  llahi wayuminu lilmumineena warahmatun lillatheena amanoo minkum wa  llatheena yuthoona rasoola Allahi lahum 'athabun aleem
verses.62: Yahlifoona bi  llahi lakum liyurdookum wa  llahu warasooluhu ahaqqu an yurdoohu in kanoo mumineen
verses.63: Alam ya'lamoo annahu man yuhadidi Allaha warasoolahu faanna lahu nara jahannama khalidan feehathalika alkhizyu al'a _th_ eem
verses.64: Yahtharu almunafiqoona an tunazzala 'alayhim sooratun tunabbiohum bima fee quloobihim quli istahzioo inna Allaha mukhrijun ma tahtharoon
verses.65: Walain saatahum layaqoolunna innama kunna nakhoodu wanal'abu qul abi  llahi waayatihi warasoolihi kuntum tastahzioon
verses.66: La ta'tathiroo qad kafartum ba'da eemanikum in na'fu 'an taifatin minkum nu'aththib taifatan biannahum kanoo mujrimeen
verses.67: Almunafiqoona wa  lmunafiqatu ba'duhum min ba'din yamuroona bi  lmunkari wayanhawna 'ani alma'roofi wayaqbidoona aydiyahum nasoo Allaha fanasiyahum inna almunafiqeena humu alfasiqoon
verses.68: Wa'ada Allahu almunafiqeena wa  lmunafiqati wa  lkuffara nara jahannama khalideena feeha hiya hasbuhum wala'anahumu Allahu walahum 'athabun muqeem
verses.69: Ka  llatheena min qablikum kanoo ashadda minkum quwwatan waakthara amwalan waawladan fa  stamta'oo bikhalaqihim fa  stamta'tum bikhalaqikum kama istamta'a allatheena min qablikum bikhalaqihim wakhudtum ka  llathee khadoo olaika habitat a'maluhum fee a  ddunya wa  lakhirati waolaika humu alkhasiroon
verses.70: Alam yatihim nabao allatheena min qablihim qawmi noohin wa'adin wathamooda waqawmi ibraheema waashabi madyana wa  lmutafikati atathum rusuluhum bi  lbayyinati fama kana Allahu liya _th_ limahum walakin kanoo anfusahum ya _th_ limoon
verses.71: Wa  lmuminoona wa  lmuminatu ba'duhum awliyao ba'din yamuroona bi  lma'roofi wayanhawna 'ani almunkari wayuqeemoona a  ssalata wayutoona a  zzakata wayutee'oona Allaha warasoolahu olaika sayarhamuhumu Allahu inna Allaha 'azeezun hakeem
verses.72: Wa'ada Allahu almumineena wa  lmuminati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wamasakina tayyibatan fee jannati 'adnin waridwanun mina Allahi akbaru thalika huwa alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.73: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu jahidi alkuffara wa  lmunafiqeena wa  ghlu _th_ 'alayhim wamawahum jahannamu wabisa almaseer
verses.74: Yahlifoona bi  llahi ma qaloo walaqad qaloo kalimata alkufri wakafaroo ba'da islamihim wahammoo bima lam yanaloo wama naqamoo illa an aghnahumu Allahu warasooluhu min fadlihi fain yatooboo yaku khayran lahum wain yatawallaw yu'aththibhumu Allahu 'athaban aleeman fee a  ddunya wa  lakhirati wama lahum fee alardi min waliyyin wala naseer
verses.75: Waminhum man 'ahada Allaha lain atana min fadlihi lanassaddaqanna walanakoonanna mina a  ssaliheen
verses.76: Falammaatahum min fadlihi bakhiloo bihi watawallaw wahum mu'ridoon
verses.77: Faa'qabahum nifaqan fee quloobihim ila yawmi yalqawnahu bima akhlafoo Allaha ma wa'adoohu wabima kanoo yakthiboon
verses.78: Alam ya'lamoo anna Allaha ya'lamu sirrahum wanajwahum waanna Allaha 'allamu alghuyoob
verses.79: Allatheena yalmizoona almuttawwi'eena mina almumineena fee a  ssadaqati wa  llatheena la yajidoona illa juhdahum fayaskharoona minhum sakhira Allahu minhum walahum 'athabun aleem
verses.80: Istaghfir lahum aw la tastaghfir lahum in tastaghfir lahum sab'eena marratan falan yaghfira Allahu lahum thalika biannahum kafaroo bi  llahi warasoolihi wa  llahu la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeen
verses.81: Fariha almukhallafoona bimaq'adihim khilafa rasooli Allahi wakarihoo an yujahidoo biamwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allahi waqaloo la tanfiroo fee alharri qul naru jahannama ashaddu harran law kanoo yafqahoon
verses.82: Falyadhakoo qaleelan walyabkoo katheeran jazaan bima kanoo yaksiboon
verses.83: Fain raja'aka Allahu ilataifatin minhum fa  stathanooka lilkhurooji faqul lan takhrujoo ma'iya abadan walan tuqatiloo ma'iya 'aduwwan innakum radeetum bi  lqu'oodi awwala marratin fa  q'udoo ma'a alkhalifeen
verses.84: Wala tusalli 'ala ahadin minhum mata abadan wala taqum 'ala qabrihi innahum kafaroo bi  llahi warasoolihi wamatoo wahum fasiqoon
verses.85: Wala tu'jibka amwaluhum waawladuhum innama yureedu Allahu an yu'aththibahum biha fee a  ddunya watazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kafiroon
verses.86: Waitha onzilat sooratun an aminoo bi  llahi wajahidoo ma'a rasoolihi istathanaka oloo a  ttawli minhum waqaloo tharna nakun ma'a alqa'ideen
verses.87: Radoo bian yakoonoo ma'a alkhawalifi watubi'a 'ala quloobihim fahum la yafqahoon
verses.88: Lakini a  rrasoolu wa  llatheena amanoo ma'ahu jahadoo biamwalihim waanfusihim waolaika lahumu alkhayratu waolaika humu almuflihoon
verses.89: a'adda Allahu lahum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feehathalika alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.90: Wajaa almu'aththiroona mina ala'rabi liyuthana lahum waqa'ada allatheena kathaboo Allaha warasoolahu sayuseebu allatheena kafaroo minhum 'athabun aleem
verses.91: Laysa 'ala a  ddu'afai wala 'ala almarda wala 'ala allatheena la yajidoona ma yunfiqoona harajun itha nasahoo lillahi warasoolihi ma 'ala almuhsineena min sabeelin wa  llahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.92: Wala 'ala allatheena itha ma atawka litahmilahum qulta la ajidu ma ahmilukum 'alayhi tawallaw waa'yunuhum tafeedu mina a  ddam'i hazanan alla yajidoo ma yunfiqoon
verses.93: Innama a  ssabeelu 'ala allatheena yastathinoonaka wahum aghniyao radoo bian yakoonoo ma'a alkhawalifi wataba'a Allahu 'ala quloobihim fahum la ya'lamoon
verses.94: Ya'tathiroona ilaykum itha raja'tum ilayhim qul la ta'tathiroo lan numina lakum qad nabbaana Allahu min akhbarikum wasayara Allahu 'amalakum warasooluhu thumma turaddoona ila 'alimi alghaybi wa  shshahadati fayunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.95: Sayahlifoona bi  llahi lakum itha inqalabtum ilayhim litu'ridoo 'anhum faa'ridoo 'anhum innahum rijsun wamawahum jahannamu jazaan bima kanoo yaksiboon
verses.96: Yahlifoona lakum litardaw 'anhum fain tardaw 'anhum fainna Allaha la yarda 'ani alqawmi alfasiqeen
verses.97: Ala'rabu ashaddu kufran wanifaqan waajdaru alla ya'lamoo hudooda ma anzala Allahu 'ala rasoolihi wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.98: Wamina ala'rabi man yattakhithu ma yunfiqu maghraman wayatarabbasu bikumu a  ddawaira 'alayhim dairatu a  ssawi wa  llahu samee'un 'aleem
verses.99: Wamina ala'rabi man yuminu bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri wayattakhithu ma yunfiqu qurubatin 'inda Allahi wasalawati a  rrasooli ala innaha qurbatun lahum sayudkhiluhumu Allahu fee rahmatihi inna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.100: Wa  ssabiqoona alawwaloona mina almuhajireena wa  lansari wa  llatheena ittaba'oohum biihsanin radiya Allahu 'anhum waradoo 'anhu waa'adda lahum jannatin tajree tahtaha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan thalika alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.101: Wamimman hawlakum mina ala'rabi munafiqoona wamin ahli almadeenati maradoo 'ala a  nnifaqi la ta'lamuhum nahnu na'lamuhum sanu'aththibuhum marratayni thumma yuraddoona ila 'athabin 'a _th_ eem
verses.102: Waakharoona i'tarafoo bithunoobihim khalatoo 'amalan salihan waakhara sayyian 'asa Allahu an yatooba 'alayhim inna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.103: Khuth min amwalihim sadaqatan tutahhiruhum watuzakkeehim biha wasalli 'alayhim inna salataka sakanun lahum wa  llahu samee'un 'aleem
verses.104: Alam ya'lamoo anna Allaha huwa yaqbalu a  ttawbata 'an 'ibadihi wayakhuthu a  ssadaqati waanna Allaha huwa a  ttawwabu a  rraheem
verses.105: Waquli i'maloo fasayara Allahu 'amalakum warasooluhu wa  lmuminoona wasaturaddoona ila 'alimi alghaybi wa  shshahadati fayunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.106: Waakharoona murjawna liamri Allahi imma yu'aththibuhum waimma yatoobu 'alayhim wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.107: Wa  llatheena ittakhathoo masjidan diraran wakufran watafreeqan bayna almumineena wairsadan liman haraba Allaha warasoolahu min qablu walayahlifunna in aradna illa alhusna wa  llahu yashhadu innahum lakathiboon
verses.108: La taqum feehi abadan lamasjidun ossisa 'ala a  ttaqwa min awwali yawmin ahaqqu an taqooma feehi feehi rijalun yuhibboona an yatatahharoo wa  llahu yuhibbu almuttahhireen
verses.109: Afaman assasa bunyanahu 'ala taqwa mina Allahi waridwanin khayrun am man assasa bunyanahu 'ala shafa jurufin harin fa  nhara bihi fee nari jahannama wa  llahu la yahdee alqawma a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.110: La yazalu bunyanuhumu allathee banaw reebatan fee quloobihim illa an taqatta'a quloobuhum wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.111: Inna Allaha ishtara mina almumineena anfusahum waamwalahum bianna lahumu aljannata yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi fayaqtuloona wayuqtaloona wa'dan 'alayhi haqqan fee a  ttawrati wa  linjeeli wa  lqurani waman awfa bi'ahdihi mina Allahi fa  stabshiroo bibay'ikumu allathee baya'tum bihi wathalika huwa alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.112: A  ttaiboona al'abidoona alhamidoona a  ssaihoona a  rraki'oona a  ssajidoona alamiroona bi  lma'roofi wa  nnahoona 'ani almunkari wa  lhafi _th_ oona lihudoodi Allahi wabashshiri almumineen
verses.113: Ma kana li  nnabiyyi wa  llatheena amanoo an yastaghfiroo lilmushrikeena walaw kanoo olee qurba min ba'di ma tabayyana lahum annahum ashabu aljaheem
verses.114: Wama kana istighfaru ibraheema liabeehi illa 'an maw'idatin wa'adaha iyyahu falamma tabayyana lahu annahu 'aduwwun lillahi tabarraa minhu inna ibraheema laawwahun haleem
verses.115: Wama kana Allahu liyudilla qawman ba'da ith hadahum hatta yubayyina lahum ma yattaqoona inna Allaha bikulli shayin 'aleem
verses.116: Inna Allaha lahu mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi yuhyee wayumeetu wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseer
verses.117: Laqad taba Allahu 'ala a  nnabiyyi wa  lmuhajireena wa  lansari allatheena ittaba'oohu fee sa'ati al'usrati min ba'di ma kada yazeeghu quloobu fareeqin minhum thumma taba 'alayhim innahu bihim raoofun raheem
verses.118: Wa'ala a  ththalathati allatheena khullifoo hatta ithadaqat 'alayhimu alardu bima rahubat wadaqat 'alayhim anfusuhum wa _th_ annoo an la maljaa mina Allahi illa ilayhi thumma taba 'alayhim liyatooboo inna Allaha huwa a  ttawwabu a  rraheem
verses.119: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha wakoonoo ma'a a  ssadiqeen
verses.120: Ma kana liahli almadeenati waman hawlahum mina ala'rabi an yatakhallafoo 'an rasooli Allahi wala yarghaboo bianfusihim 'an nafsihi thalika biannahum la yuseebuhum _th_ amaon wala nasabun wala makhmasatun fee sabeeli Allahi wala yataoona mawtian yaghee _th_ u alkuffara wala yanaloona min 'aduwwin naylan illa kutiba lahum bihi 'amalun salihun inna Allaha la yudee'u ajra almuhsineen
verses.121: Wala yunfiqoona nafaqatan sagheeratan wala kabeeratan wala yaqta'oona wadiyan illa kutiba lahum liyajziyahumu Allahu ahsana ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.122: Wama kana almuminoona liyanfiroo kaffatan falawla nafara min kulli firqatin minhum taifatun liyatafaqqahoo fee a  ddeeni waliyunthiroo qawmahum itha raja'oo ilayhim la'allahum yahtharoon
verses.123: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo qatiloo allatheena yaloonakum mina alkuffari walyajidoo feekum ghil _th_ atan wa  'lamoo anna Allaha ma'a almuttaqeen
verses.124: Waitha ma onzilat sooratun faminhum man yaqoolu ayyukum zadathu hathihi eemanan faamma allatheena amanoo fazadathum eemanan wahum yastabshiroon
verses.125: Waamma allatheena fee quloobihim maradun fazadathum rijsan ila rijsihim wamatoo wahum kafiroon
verses.126: Awala yarawna annahum yuftanoona fee kulli 'amin marratan aw marratayni thumma la yatooboona wala hum yaththakkaroon
verses.127: Waitha ma onzilat sooratun na _th_ ara ba'duhum ila ba'din hal yarakum min ahadin thumma insarafoo sarafa Allahu quloobahum biannahum qawmun la yafqahoon
verses.128: Laqad jaakum rasoolun min anfusikum 'azeezun 'alayhi ma 'anittum hareesun 'alaykum bi  lmumineena raoofun raheem
verses.129: Fain tawallaw faqul hasbiya Allahu la ilaha illa huwa 'alayhi tawakkatu wahuwa rabbu al'arshi al'a _th_ eem

verses.2: Akana li  nnasi 'ajaban an awhayna ila rajulin minhum an anthiri a  nnasa wabashshiri allatheena amanoo anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim qala alkafiroona inna hatha lasahirun mubeen
verses.3: Inna rabbakumu Allahu allathee khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa 'ala al'arshi yudabbiru alamra ma min shafee'in illa min ba'di ithnihi thalikumu Allahu rabbukum fa  'budoohu afala tathakkaroon
verses.4: Ilayhi marji'ukum jamee'an wa'da Allahi haqqan innahu yabdao alkhalqa thumma yu'eeduhu liyajziya allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati bi  lqisti wa  llatheena kafaroo lahum sharabun min hameemin wa'athabun aleemun bima kanoo yakfuroon
verses.5: Huwa allathee ja'ala a  shshamsa diyaan wa  lqamara nooran waqaddarahu manazila lita'lamoo 'adada a  ssineena wa  lhisaba ma khalaqa Allahu thalika illa bi  lhaqqi yufassilu alayati liqawmin ya'lamoon
verses.6: Inna fee ikhtilafi allayli wa  nnahari wama khalaqa Allahu fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi laayatin liqawmin yattaqoon
verses.7: Inna allatheena la yarjoona liqaana waradoo bi  lhayati a  ddunya wa  tmaannoo biha wa  llatheena hum 'an ayatina ghafiloon
verses.8: Olaika mawahumu a  nnaru bima kanoo yaksiboon
verses.9: Inna allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati yahdeehim rabbuhum bieemanihim tajree min tahtihimu alanharu fee jannati a  nna'eem
verses.10: Da'wahum feeha subhanaka allahumma watahiyyatuhum feeha salamun waakhiru da'wahum ani alhamdu lillahi rabbi al'alameen
verses.11: Walaw yu'ajjilu Allahu li  nnasi a  shsharra isti'jalahum bi  lkhayri laqudiya ilayhim ajaluhum fanatharu allatheena la yarjoona liqaana fee tughyanihim ya'mahoon
verses.12: Waitha massa alinsana a  ddurru da'ana lijanbihi aw qa'idan aw qaiman falamma kashafna 'anhu durrahu marra kaan lam yad'una iladurrin massahu kathalika zuyyina lilmusrifeena ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.13: Walaqad ahlakna alquroona min qablikum lamma _th_ alamoo wajaathum rusuluhum bi  lbayyinati wama kanoo liyuminoo kathalika najzee alqawma almujrimeen
verses.14: Thumma ja'anakum khalaifa fee alardi min ba'dihim linan _th_ ura kayfa ta'maloon
verses.15: Waitha tutla 'alayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena la yarjoona liqaana iti biquranin ghayri hatha aw baddilhu qul ma yakoonu lee an obaddilahu min tilqai nafsee in attabi'u illa ma yooha ilayya innee akhafu in 'asaytu rabbee 'athaba yawmin 'a _th_ eem
verses.16: Qul law shaa Allahu ma talawtuhu 'alaykum wala adrakum bihi faqad labithtu feekum 'umuran min qablihi afala ta'qiloon
verses.17: Faman a _th_ lamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allahi kathiban aw kaththaba biayatihi innahu la yuflihu almujrimoon
verses.18: Waya'budoona min dooni Allahi ma la yadurruhum wala yanfa'uhum wayaqooloona haolai shufa'aona 'inda Allahi qul atunabbioona Allaha bima la ya'lamu fee a  ssamawati wala fee alardi subhanahu wata'ala 'amma yushrikoon
verses.19: Wama kana a  nnasu illa ommatan wahidatan fa  khtalafoo walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum feema feehi yakhtalifoon
verses.20: Wayaqooloona lawla onzila 'alayhi ayatun min rabbihi faqul innama alghaybu lillahi fa  nta _th_ iroo innee ma'akum mina almunta _th_ ireen
verses.21: Waitha athaqna a  nnasa rahmatan min ba'di darraa massathum itha lahum makrun fee ayatina quli Allahu asra'u makran inna rusulana yaktuboona ma tamkuroon
verses.22: Huwa allathee yusayyirukum fee albarri wa  lbahri hatta itha kuntum fee alfulki wajarayna bihim bireehin tayyibatin wafarihoo biha jaatha reehun 'asifun wajaahumu almawju min kulli makanin wa _th_ annoo annahum oheeta bihim da'awoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu a  ddeena lain anjaytana min hathihi lanakoonanna mina a  shshakireen
verses.23: Falamma anjahum itha hum yabghoona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi ya ayyuha a  nnasu innama baghyukum 'ala anfusikum mata'a alhayati a  ddunya thumma ilayna marji'ukum fanunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.24: Innama mathalu alhayati a  ddunya kamain anzanahu mina a  ssamai fa  khtalata bihi nabatu alardi mimma yakulu a  nnasu wa  lan'amu hatta itha akhathati alardu zukhrufaha wa  zzayyanat wa _th_ anna ahluha annahum qadiroona 'alayha ataha amruna laylan aw naharan faja'anahahaseedan kaan lam taghna bi  lamsi kathalika nufassilu alayati liqawmin yatafakkaroon
verses.25: Wa  llahu yad'oo ila dari a  ssalami wayahdee man yashao ilasiratin mustaqeem
verses.26: Lillatheena ahsanoo alhusna waziyadatun wala yarhaqu wujoohahum qatarun walathillatun olaika ashabu aljannati hum feeha khalidoon
verses.27: Wa  llatheena kasaboo a  ssayyiati jazao sayyiatin bimithliha watarhaquhum thillatun ma lahum mina Allahi min 'asimin kaannama oghshiyat wujoohuhum qita'an mina allayli mu _th_ liman olaika ashabu a  nnari hum feeha khalidoon
verses.28: Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'an thumma naqoolu lillatheena ashrakoo makanakum antum washurakaokum fazayyana baynahum waqala shurakaohum ma kuntum iyyana ta'budoon
verses.29: Fakafa bi  llahi shaheedan baynana wabaynakum in kunna 'an 'ibadatikum laghafileen
verses.30: Hunalika tabloo kullu nafsin ma aslafat waruddoo ila Allahi mawlahumu alhaqqi wadalla 'anhum ma kanoo yaftaroon
verses.31: Qul man yarzuqukum mina a  ssamai wa  lardi amman yamliku a  ssam'a wa  labsara waman yukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti wayukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi waman yudabbiru alamra fasayaqooloona Allahu faqul afala tattaqoon
verses.32: Fathalikumu Allahu rabbukumu alhaqqu famatha ba'da alhaqqi illa a  ddalalu faanna tusrafoon
verses.33: Kathalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika 'ala allatheena fasaqoo annahum la yuminoon
verses.34: Qul hal min shurakaikum man yabdao alkhalqa thumma yu'eeduhu quli Allahu yabdao alkhalqa thumma yu'eeduhu faanna tufakoon
verses.35: Qul hal min shurakaikum man yahdee ila alhaqqi quli Allahu yahdee lilhaqqi afaman yahdee ila alhaqqi ahaqqu an yuttaba'a amman la yahiddee illa an yuhda fama lakum kayfa tahkumoon
verses.36: Wama yattabi'u aktharuhum illa _th_ annan inna a  _thth_ anna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan inna Allaha 'aleemun bima yaf'aloon
verses.37: Wama kana hatha alquranu an yuftara min dooni Allahi walakin tasdeeqa allathee bayna yadayhi watafseela alkitabi la rayba feehi min rabbi al'alameen
verses.38: Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul fatoo bisooratin mithlihi wa  d'oo mani istata'tum min dooni Allahi in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.39: Bal kaththaboo bima lam yuheetoo bi'ilmihi walamma yatihim taweeluhu kathalika kaththaba allatheena min qablihim fa  n _th_ ur kayfa kana 'aqibatu a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.40: Waminhum man yuminu bihi waminhum man la yuminu bihi warabbuka a'lamu bi  lmufsideen
verses.41: Wain kaththabooka faqul lee 'amalee walakum 'amalukum antum bareeoona mimma a'malu waana bareeon mimma ta'maloon
verses.42: Waminhum man yastami'oona ilayka afaanta tusmi'u a  ssumma walaw kanoo la ya'qiloon
verses.43: Waminhum man yan _th_ uru ilayka afaanta tahdee al'umya walaw kanoo la yubsiroon
verses.44: Inna Allaha la ya _th_ limu a  nnasa shayan walakinna a  nnasa anfusahum ya _th_ limoon
verses.45: Wayawma yahshuruhum kaan lam yalbathoo illa sa'atan mina a  nnahari yata'arafoona baynahum qad khasira allatheena kaththaboo biliqai Allahi wama kanoo muhtadeen
verses.46: Waimma nuriyannaka ba'da allathee na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka failayna marji'uhum thumma Allahu shaheedun 'ala ma yaf'aloon
verses.47: Walikulli ommatin rasoolun faitha jaa rasooluhum qudiya baynahum bi  lqisti wahum la yu _th_ lamoon
verses.48: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwa'du in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.49: Qul la amliku linafsee darran wala naf'an illa ma shaa Allahu likulli ommatin ajalun itha jaa ajaluhum fala yastakhiroona sa'atan wala yastaqdimoon
verses.50: Qul araaytum in atakum 'athabuhu bayatan aw naharan matha yasta'jilu minhu almujrimoon
verses.51: Athumma itha ma waqa'a amantum bihi alana waqad kuntum bihi tasta'jiloon
verses.52: Thumma qeela lillatheena _th_ alamoo thooqoo 'athaba alkhuldi hal tujzawna illa bima kuntum taksiboon
verses.53: Wayastanbioonaka ahaqqun huwa qul ee warabbee innahu lahaqqun wama antum bimu'jizeen
verses.54: Walaw anna likulli nafsin _th_ alamat ma fee alardi la  ftadat bihi waasarroo a  nnadamata lamma raawoo al'athaba waqudiya baynahum bi  lqisti wahum la yu _th_ lamoon
verses.55: Ala inna lillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi ala inna wa'da Allahi haqqun walakinna aktharahum la ya'lamoon
verses.56: Huwa yuhyee wayumeetu wailayhi turja'oon
verses.57: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu qad jaatkum maw'i _th_ atun min rabbikum washifaon lima fee a  ssudoori wahudan warahmatun lilmumineen
verses.58: Qul bifadli Allahi wabirahmatihi fabithalika falyafrahoo huwa khayrun mimma yajma'oon
verses.59: Qul araaytum ma anzala Allahu lakum min rizqin faja'atum minhu haraman wahalalan qul allahu athina lakum am 'ala Allahi taftaroon
verses.60: Wama _th_ annu allatheena yaftaroona 'ala Allahi alkathiba yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha lathoo fadlin 'ala a  nnasi walakinna aktharahum la yashkuroon
verses.61: Wama takoonu fee shanin wama tatloo minhu min quranin wala ta'maloona min 'amalin illa kunna 'alaykum shuhoodan ith tufeedoona feehi wama ya'zubu 'an rabbika min mithqali tharratin fee alardi wala fee a  ssamai wala asghara min thalika wala akbara illa fee kitabin mubeen
verses.62: Ala inna awliyaa Allahi la khawfun 'alayhim wala hum yahzanoon
verses.63: Allatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoon
verses.64: Lahumu albushra fee alhayati a  ddunya wafee alakhirati la tabdeela likalimati Allahi thalika huwa alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.65: Wala yahzunka qawluhum inna al'izzata lillahi jamee'an huwa a  ssamee'u al'aleem
verses.66: Ala inna lillahi man fee a  ssamawati waman fee alardi wama yattabi'u allatheena yad'oona min dooni Allahi shurakaa in yattabi'oona illa a  _thth_ anna wain hum illa yakhrusoon
verses.67: Huwa allathee ja'ala lakumu allayla litaskunoo feehi wa  nnahara mubsiran inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yasma'oon
verses.68: Qaloo ittakhatha Allahu waladan subhanahu huwa alghaniyyu lahu ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi in 'indakum min sultanin bihatha ataqooloona 'ala Allahi ma la ta'lamoon
verses.69: Qul inna allatheena yaftaroona 'ala Allahi alkathiba la yuflihoon
verses.70: Mata'un fee a  ddunya thumma ilayna marji'uhum thumma nutheequhumu al'athaba a  shshadeeda bima kanoo yakfuroon
verses.71: Wa  tlu 'alayhim nabaa noohin ith qala liqawmihi ya qawmi in kana kabura 'alaykum maqamee watathkeeree biayati Allahi fa'ala Allahi tawakkatu faajmi'oo amrakum washurakaakum thumma la yakun amrukum 'alaykum ghummatan thumma iqdoo ilayya wala tun _th_ iroon
verses.72: Fain tawallaytum fama saatukum min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala Allahi waomirtu an akoona mina almuslimeen
verses.73: Fakaththaboohu fanajjaynahu waman ma'ahu fee alfulki waja'anahum khalaifa waaghraqna allatheena kaththaboo biayatina fa  n _th_ ur kayfa kana 'aqibatu almunthareen
verses.74: Thumma ba'athna min ba'dihi rusulan ila qawmihim fajaoohum bi  lbayyinati fama kanoo liyuminoo bima kaththaboo bihi min qablu kathalika natba'u 'ala quloobi almu'tadeen
verses.75: Thumma ba'athna min ba'dihim moosa waharoona ila fir'awna wamalaihi biayatina fa  stakbaroo wakanoo qawman mujrimeen
verses.76: Falamma jaahumu alhaqqu min 'indina qaloo inna hatha lasihrun mubeen
verses.77: Qala moosa ataqooloona lilhaqqi lamma jaakum asihrun hatha wala yuflihu a  ssahiroon
verses.78: Qaloo ajitana litalfitana 'amma wajadna 'alayhi abaana watakoona lakuma alkibriyao fee alardi wama nahnu lakuma bimumineen
verses.79: Waqala fir'awnu itoonee bikulli sahirin 'aleem
verses.80: Falamma jaa a  ssaharatu qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoon
verses.81: Falamma alqaw qala moosa ma jitum bihi a  ssihru inna Allaha sayubtiluhu inna Allaha la yuslihu 'amala almufsideen
verses.82: Wayuhiqqu Allahu alhaqqa bikalimatihi walaw kariha almujrimoon
verses.83: Famaamana limoosa illathurriyyatun min qawmihi 'ala khawfin min fir'awna wamalaihim an yaftinahum wainna fir'awna la'alin fee alardi wainnahu lamina almusrifeen
verses.84: Waqala moosa ya qawmi in kuntum amantum bi  llahi fa'alayhi tawakkaloo in kuntum muslimeen
verses.85: Faqaloo 'ala Allahi tawakkana rabbana la taj'ana fitnatan lilqawmi a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.86: Wanajjina birahmatika mina alqawmi alkafireen
verses.87: Waawhayna ila moosa waakheehi an tabawwaa liqawmikuma bimisra buyootan wa  j'aloo buyootakum qiblatan waaqeemoo a  ssalata wabashshiri almumineen
verses.88: Waqala moosa rabbana innaka atayta fir'awna wamalaahu zeenatan waamwalan fee alhayati a  ddunya rabbana liyudilloo 'an sabeelika rabbana itmis 'ala amwalihim wa  shdud 'ala quloobihim fala yuminoo hatta yarawoo al'athaba alaleem
verses.89: Qala qad ojeebat da'watukuma fa  staqeema wala tattabi'anni sabeela allatheena la ya'lamoon
verses.90: Wajawazna bibanee israeela albahra faatba'ahum fir'awnu wajunooduhu baghyan wa'adwan hatta itha adrakahu algharaqu qala amantu annahu la ilaha illa allathee amanat bihi banoo israeela waana mina almuslimeen
verses.91: Alana waqad 'asayta qablu wakunta mina almufsideen
verses.92: Fa  lyawma nunajjeeka bibadanika litakoona liman khalfaka ayatan wainna katheeran mina a  nnasi 'an ayatina laghafiloon
verses.93: Walaqad bawwana banee israeela mubawwaa sidqin warazaqnahum mina a  ttayyibati fama ikhtalafoo hatta jaahumu al'ilmu inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
verses.94: Fain kunta fee shakkin mimma anzanna ilayka fa  sali allatheena yaqraoona alkitaba min qablika laqad jaaka alhaqqu min rabbika fala takoonanna mina almumtareen
verses.95: Wala takoonanna mina allatheena kaththaboo biayati Allahi fatakoona mina alkhasireen
verses.96: Inna allatheena haqqat 'alayhim kalimatu rabbika la yuminoon
verses.97: Walaw jaathum kullu ayatin hatta yarawoo al'athaba alaleem
verses.98: Falawla kanat qaryatun amanat fanafa'aha eemanuha illa qawma yoonusa lammaamanoo kashafna 'anhum 'athaba alkhizyi fee alhayati a  ddunya wamatta'nahum ilaheen
verses.99: Walaw shaa rabbuka laamana man fee alardi kulluhum jamee'an afaanta tukrihu a  nnasa hatta yakoonoo mumineen
verses.100: Wama kana linafsin an tumina illa biithni Allahi wayaj'alu a  rrijsa 'ala allatheena la ya'qiloon
verses.101: Quli on _th_ uroo matha fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi wama tughnee alayatu wa  nnuthuru 'an qawmin la yuminoon
verses.102: Fahal yanta _th_ iroona illa mithla ayyami allatheena khalaw min qablihim qul fa  nta _th_ iroo innee ma'akum mina almunta _th_ ireen
verses.103: Thumma nunajjee rusulana wa  llatheena amanoo kathalika haqqan 'alayna nunjee almumineen
verses.104: Qul ya ayyuha a  nnasu in kuntum fee shakkin min deenee fala a'budu allatheena ta'budoona min dooni Allahi walakin a'budu Allaha allathee yatawaffakum waomirtu an akoona mina almumineen
verses.105: Waan aqim wajhaka li  ddeeni haneefan wala takoonanna mina almushrikeen
verses.106: Wala tad'u min dooni Allahi ma la yanfa'uka wala yadurruka fain fa'ata fainnaka ithan mina a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.107: Wain yamsaska Allahu bidurrin fala kashifa lahu illa huwa wain yuridka bikhayrin fala radda lifadlihi yuseebu bihi man yashao min 'ibadihi wahuwa alghafooru a  rraheem
verses.108: Qul ya ayyuha a  nnasu qad jaakumu alhaqqu min rabbikum famani ihtada fainnama yahtadee linafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu 'alayha wama ana 'alaykum biwakeel
verses.109: Wa  ttabi' ma yooha ilayka wa  sbir hatta yahkuma Allahu wahuwa khayru alhakimeen

verses.1: Aliflamra kitabun ohkimat ayatuhu thumma fussilat min ladun hakeemin khabeer
verses.2: Alla ta'budoo illa Allaha innanee lakum minhu natheerun wabasheer
