verses.3: Waani istaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yumatti'kum mata'an hasanan ila ajalin musamman wayuti kulla thee fadlin fadlahu wain tawallaw fainee akhafu 'alaykum 'athaba yawmin kabeer
verses.4: Ila Allahi marji'ukum wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.5: Ala innahum yathnoona sudoorahum liyastakhfoo minhu alaheena yastaghshoona thiyabahum ya'lamu ma yusirroona wama yu'linoona innahu 'aleemun bithati a  ssudoor
verses.6: Wama min dabbatin fee alardi illa 'ala Allahi rizquha waya'lamu mustaqarraha wamustawda'aha kullun fee kitabin mubeen
verses.7: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda fee sittati ayyamin wakana 'arshuhu 'ala almai liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalan walain qulta innakum mab'oothoona min ba'di almawti layaqoolanna allatheena kafaroo in hatha illa sihrun mubeen
verses.8: Walain akhkharna 'anhumu al'athaba ila ommatin ma'doodatin layaqoolunna ma yahbisuhu ala yawma yateehim laysa masroofan 'anhum wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioon
verses.9: Walain athaqna alinsana minna rahmatan thumma naza'naha minhu innahu layaoosun kafoor
verses.10: Walain athaqnahu na'maa ba'da darraa massathu layaqoolanna thahaba a  ssayyiatu 'annee innahu lafarihun fakhoor
verses.11: Illa allatheena sabaroo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati olaika lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeer
verses.12: Fala'allaka tarikun ba'da ma yooha ilayka wadaiqun bihi sadruka an yaqooloo lawla onzila 'alayhi kanzun aw jaa ma'ahu malakun innama anta natheerun wa  llahu 'ala kulli shayin wakeel
verses.13: Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul fatoo bi'ashri suwarin mithlihi muftarayatin wa  d'oo mani istata'tum min dooni Allahi in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.14: Fai llam yastajeeboo lakum fa  'lamoo annama onzila bi'ilmi Allahi waan la ilaha illa huwa fahal antum muslimoon
verses.15: Man kana yureedu alhayata a  ddunya wazeenataha nuwaffi ilayhim a'malahum feeha wahum feeha la yubkhasoon
verses.16: Olaika allatheena laysa lahum fee alakhirati illa a  nnaru wahabita masana'oo feeha wabatilun ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.17: Afaman kana 'ala bayyinatin min rabbihi wayatloohu shahidun minhu wamin qablihi kitabu moosa imaman warahmatan olaika yuminoona bihi waman yakfur bihi mina alahzabi fa  nnaru maw'iduhu fala taku fee miryatin minhu innahu alhaqqu min rabbika walakinna akthara a  nnasi la yuminoon
verses.18: Waman a _th_ lamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allahi kathiban olaika yu'radoona 'ala rabbihim wayaqoolu alashhadu haolai allatheena kathaboo 'ala rabbihim ala la'natu Allahi 'ala a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.19: Allatheena yasuddoona 'an sabeeli Allahi wayabghoonaha 'iwajan wahum bi  lakhirati hum kafiroon
verses.20: Olaika lam yakoonoo mu'jizeena fee alardi wama kana lahum min dooni Allahi min awliyaa yuda'afu lahumu al'athabu ma kanoo yastatee'oona a  ssam'a wama kanoo yubsiroon
verses.21: Olaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum wadalla 'anhum ma kanoo yaftaroon
verses.22: La jarama annahum fee alakhirati humu alakhsaroon
verses.23: Inna allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  salihati waakhbatoo ila rabbihim olaika ashabu aljannati hum feeha khalidoon
verses.24: Mathalu alfareeqayni ka  la'ma wa  lasammi wa  lbaseeri wa  ssamee'i hal yastawiyani mathalan afala tathakkaroon
verses.25: Walaqad arsana noohan ila qawmihi innee lakum natheerun mubeen
verses.26: An la ta'budoo illa Allaha innee akhafu 'alaykum 'athaba yawmin aleem
verses.27: Faqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi ma naraka illa basharan mithlana wama naraka ittaba'aka illa allatheena hum arathiluna badiya a  rrayi wama nara lakum 'alayna min fadlin bal na _th_ unnukum kathibeen
verses.28: Qala ya qawmi araaytum in kuntu 'ala bayyinatin min rabbee waatanee rahmatan min 'indihi fa'ummiyat 'alaykum anulzimukumooha waantum laha karihoon
verses.29: Waya qawmi la asalukum 'alayhi malan in ajriya illa 'ala Allahi wama ana bitaridi allatheena amanoo innahum mulaqoo rabbihim walakinnee arakum qawman tajhaloon
verses.30: Waya qawmi man yansurunee mina Allahi in taradtuhum afala tathakkaroon
verses.31: Wala aqoolu lakum 'indee khazainu Allahi wala a'lamu alghayba wala aqoolu innee malakun wala aqoolu lillatheena tazdaree a'yunukum lan yutiyahumu Allahu khayran Allahu a'lamu bima fee anfusihim innee ithan lamina a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.32: Qaloo ya noohu qad jadatana faaktharta jidalana fatina bima ta'iduna in kunta mina a  ssadiqeen
verses.33: Qala innama yateekum bihi Allahu in shaa wama antum bimu'jizeen
verses.34: Wala yanfa'ukum nushee in aradtu an ansaha lakum in kana Allahu yureedu an yughwiyakum huwa rabbukum wailayhi turja'oon
verses.35: Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul ini iftaraytuhu fa'alayya ijramee waana bareeon mimma tujrimoon
verses.36: Waoohiya ila noohin annahu lan yumina min qawmika illa man qad amana fala tabtais bima kanoo yaf'aloon
verses.37: Wa  sna'i alfulka bia'yunina wawahyina wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena _th_ alamoo innahum mughraqoon
verses.38: Wayasna'u alfulka wakullama marra 'alayhi malaon min qawmihi sakhiroo minhu qala in taskharoo minna fainna naskharu minkum kama taskharoon
verses.39: Fasawfa ta'lamoona man yateehi 'athabun yukhzeehi wayahillu 'alayhi 'athabun muqeem
verses.40: Hatta itha jaa amruna wafara a  ttannooru qulna ihmil feeha min kullin zawjayni ithnayni waahlaka illa man sabaqa 'alayhi alqawlu waman amana wamaamana ma'ahu illa qaleel
verses.41: Waqala irkaboo feeha bismi Allahi majraha wamursaha inna rabbee laghafoorun raheem
verses.42: Wahiya tajree bihim fee mawjin ka  ljibali wanada noohunu ibnahu wakana fee ma'zilin ya bunayya irkab ma'ana wala takun ma'a alkafireen
verses.43: Qala saawee ila jabalin ya'simunee mina almai qala la 'asima alyawma min amri Allahi illa man rahima wahala baynahuma almawju fakana mina almughraqeen
verses.44: Waqeela ya ardu ibla'ee maaki waya samao aqli'ee wagheeda almao waqudiya alamru wa  stawat 'ala aljoodiyyi waqeela bu'dan lilqawmi a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.45: Wanada noohun rabbahu faqala rabbi inna ibnee min ahlee wainna wa'daka alhaqqu waanta ahkamu alhakimeen
verses.46: Qala ya noohu innahu laysa min ahlika innahu 'amalun ghayru salihin fala tasani ma laysa laka bihi 'ilmun innee a'i _th_ uka an takoona mina aljahileen
verses.47: Qala rabbi innee a'oothu bika an asalaka ma laysa lee bihi 'ilmun wailla taghfir lee watarhamnee akun mina alkhasireen
verses.48: Qeela ya noohu ihbit bisalamin minna wabarakatin 'alayka wa'ala omamin mimman ma'aka waomamun sanumatti'uhum thumma yamassuhum minna 'athabun aleem
verses.49: Tilka min anbai alghaybi nooheeha ilayka ma kunta ta'lamuha anta wala qawmuka min qabli hatha fa  sbir inna al'aqibata lilmuttaqeen
verses.50: Waila 'adin akhahum hoodan qala ya qawmi o'budoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu in antum illa muftaroon
verses.51: Ya qawmi la asalukum 'alayhi ajran in ajriya illa 'ala allathee fataranee afala ta'qiloon
verses.52: Waya qawmi istaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yursili a  ssamaa 'alaykum midraran wayazidkum quwwatan ila quwwatikum wala tatawallaw mujrimeen
verses.53: Qaloo ya hoodu ma jitana bibayyinatin wama nahnu bitarikee alihatina 'an qawlika wama nahnu laka bimumineen
verses.54: In naqoolu illa i'taraka ba'du alihatina bisooin qala innee oshhidu Allaha wa  shhadoo annee bareeon mimma tushrikoon
verses.55: Min doonihi fakeedoonee jamee'an thumma la tun _th_ iroon
verses.56: Innee tawakkatu 'ala Allahi rabbee warabbikum ma min dabbatin illa huwa akhithun binasiyatiha inna rabbee 'alasiratin mustaqeem
verses.57: Fain tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum ma orsiltu bihi ilaykum wayastakhlifu rabbee qawman ghayrakum wala tadurroonahu shayan inna rabbee 'ala kulli shayin hafee _th_
verses.58: Walamma jaa amruna najjayna hoodan wa  llatheena amanoo ma'ahu birahmatin minna wanajjaynahum min 'athabin ghalee _th_
verses.59: Watilka 'adun jahadoo biayati rabbihim wa'asaw rusulahu wa  ttaba'oo amra kulli jabbarin 'aneed
verses.60: Waotbi'oo fee hathihi a  ddunya la'natan wayawma alqiyamati ala inna 'adan kafaroo rabbahum ala bu'dan li'adin qawmi hood
verses.61: Waila thamooda akhahum salihan qala ya qawmi o'budoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu huwa anshaakum mina alardi wa  sta'marakum feeha fa  staghfiroohu thumma tooboo ilayhi inna rabbee qareebun mujeeb
verses.62: Qaloo yasalihu qad kunta feena marjuwwan qabla hatha atanhana an na'buda ma ya'budu abaona wainnana lafee shakkin mimma tad'oona ilayhi mureeb
verses.63: Qala ya qawmi araaytum in kuntu 'ala bayyinatin min rabbee waatanee minhu rahmatan faman yansurunee mina Allahi in 'asaytuhu fama tazeedoonanee ghayra takhseer
verses.64: Waya qawmi hathihi naqatu Allahi lakum ayatan fatharooha takul fee ardi Allahi wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum 'athabun qareeb
verses.65: Fa'aqarooha faqala tamatta'oo fee darikum thalathata ayyamin thalika wa'dun ghayru makthoob
verses.66: Falamma jaa amruna najjaynasalihan wa  llatheena amanoo ma'ahu birahmatin minna wamin khizyi yawmiithin inna rabbaka huwa alqawiyyu al'azeez
verses.67: Waakhatha allatheena _th_ alamoo a  ssayhatu faasbahoo fee diyarihim jathimeen
verses.68: Kaan lam yaghnaw feeha ala inna thamooda kafaroo rabbahum ala bu'dan lithamood
verses.69: Walaqad jaat rusuluna ibraheema bi  lbushra qaloo salaman qala salamun fama labitha an jaa bi'ijlin haneeth
verses.70: Falamma raa aydiyahum la tasilu ilayhi nakirahum waawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf inna orsilna ila qawmi loot
verses.71: Wa  mraatuhu qaimatun fadahikat fabashsharnaha biishaqa wamin warai ishaqa ya'qoob
verses.72: Qalat ya waylata aalidu waana 'ajoozun wahatha ba'lee shaykhan inna hatha lashayon 'ajeeb
verses.73: Qaloo ata'jabeena min amri Allahi rahmatu Allahi wabarakatuhu 'alaykum ahla albayti innahu hameedun majeed
verses.74: Falammathahaba 'an ibraheema a  rraw'u wajaathu albushra yujadiluna fee qawmi loot
verses.75: Inna ibraheema lahaleemun awwahun muneeb
verses.76: Ya ibraheemu a'rid 'an hatha innahu qad jaa amru rabbika wainnahum ateehim 'athabun ghayru mardood
verses.77: Walamma jaat rusuluna lootan seea bihim wadaqa bihim thar'an waqala hatha yawmun 'aseeb
verses.78: Wajaahu qawmuhu yuhra'oona ilayhi wamin qablu kanoo ya'maloona a  ssayyiati qala ya qawmi haolai banatee hunna atharu lakum fa  ttaqoo Allaha wala tukhzooni fee dayfee alaysa minkum rajulun rasheed
verses.79: Qaloo laqad 'alimta ma lana fee banatika min haqqin wainnaka lata'lamu ma nureed
verses.80: Qala law anna lee bikum quwwatan aw awee ila ruknin shadeed
verses.81: Qaloo ya lootu inna rusulu rabbika lan yasiloo ilayka faasri biahlika biqit'in mina allayli wala yatafit minkum ahadun illa imraataka innahu museebuha ma asabahum inna maw'idahumu a  ssubhu alaysa a  ssubhu biqareeb
verses.82: Falamma jaa amruna ja'ana 'aliyaha safilaha waamtarna 'alayhahijaratan min sijjeelin mandood
verses.83: Musawwamatan 'inda rabbika wama hiya mina a  _thth_ alimeena biba'eed
verses.84: Waila madyana akhahum shu'ayban qala ya qawmi o'budoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu wala tanqusoo almikyala wa  lmeezana innee arakum bikhayrin wainnee akhafu 'alaykum 'athaba yawmin muheet
verses.85: Waya qawmi awfoo almikyala wa  lmeezana bi  lqisti wala tabkhasoo a  nnasa ashyaahum wala ta'thaw fee alardi mufsideen
verses.86: Baqiyyatu Allahi khayrun lakum in kuntum mumineena wama ana 'alaykum bihafee _th_
verses.87: Qaloo ya shu'aybu asalatuka tamuruka an natruka ma ya'budu abaona aw an naf'ala fee amwalina ma nashao innaka laanta alhaleemu a  rrasheed
verses.88: Qala ya qawmi araaytum in kuntu 'ala bayyinatin min rabbee warazaqanee minhu rizqan hasanan wama oreedu an okhalifakum ila ma anhakum 'anhu in oreedu illa alislaha ma istata'tu wama tawfeeqee illa bi  llahi 'alayhi tawakkatu wailayhi oneeb
verses.89: Waya qawmi la yajrimannakum shiqaqee an yuseebakum mithlu ma asaba qawma noohin aw qawma hoodin aw qawma salihin wama qawmu lootin minkum biba'eed
verses.90: Wa  staghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi inna rabbee raheemun wadood
verses.91: Qaloo ya shu'aybu ma nafqahu katheeran mimma taqoolu wainna lanaraka feenada'eefan walawla rahtuka larajamnaka wama anta 'alayna bi'azeez
verses.92: Qala ya qawmi arahtee a'azzu 'alaykum mina Allahi wa  ttakhathtumoohu waraakum _th_ ihriyyan inna rabbee bima ta'maloona muheet
verses.93: Waya qawmi i'maloo 'ala makanatikum innee 'amilun sawfa ta'lamoona man yateehi 'athabun yukhzeehi waman huwa kathibun wa  rtaqiboo inne ma'akum raqeeb
verses.94: Walamma jaa amruna najjayna shu'ayban wa  llatheena amanoo ma'ahu birahmatin minna waakhathati allatheena _th_ alamoo a  ssayhatu faasbahoo fee diyarihim jathimeen
verses.95: Kaan lam yaghnaw feeha ala bu'dan limadyana kama ba'idat thamood
verses.96: Walaqad arsana moosa biayatina wasultanin mubeen
verses.97: Ila fir'awna wamalaihi fa  ttaba'oo amra fir'awna wama amru fir'awna birasheed
verses.98: Yaqdumu qawmahu yawma alqiyamati faawradahumu a  nnara wabisa alwirdu almawrood
verses.99: Waotbi'oo fee hathihi la'natan wayawma alqiyamati bisa a  rrifdu almarfood
verses.100: Thalika min anbai alqura naqussuhu 'alayka minha qaimun wahaseed
verses.101: Wama _th_ alamnahum walakin _th_ alamoo anfusahum fama aghnat 'anhum alihatuhumu allatee yad'oona min dooni Allahi min shayin lamma jaa amru rabbika wama zadoohum ghayra tatbeeb
verses.102: Wakathalika akhthu rabbika itha akhatha alqura wahiya _th_ alimatun inna akhthahu aleemun shadeed
verses.103: Inna fee thalika laayatan liman khafa 'athaba alakhirati thalika yawmun majmoo'un lahu a  nnasu wathalika yawmun mashhoodun
verses.105: Yawma yati la takallamu nafsun illa biithnihi faminhum shaqiyyun wasa'eed
verses.106: Faamma allatheena shaqoo fafee a  nnari lahum feeha zafeerun washaheeq
verses.107: Khalideena feeha ma damati a  ssamawatu wa  lardu illa ma shaa rabbuka inna rabbaka fa''alun lima yureed
verses.108: Waamma allatheena su'idoo fafee aljannati khalideena feeha ma damati a  ssamawatu wa  lardu illa ma shaa rabbuka 'ataan ghayra majthooth
verses.109: Fala taku fee miryatin mimma ya'budu haolai ma ya'budoona illa kama ya'budu abaohum min qablu wainna lamuwaffoohum naseebahum ghayra manqoos
verses.110: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba fa  khtulifa feehi walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum wainnahum lafee shakkin minhu mureeb
verses.111: Wainna kullan lamma layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka a'malahum innahu bima ya'maloona khabeer
verses.112: Fa  staqim kama omirta waman taba ma'aka wala tatghaw innahu bima ta'maloona baseer
verses.113: Wala tarkanoo ila allatheena _th_ alamoo fatamassakumu a  nnaru wama lakum min dooni Allahi min awliyaa thumma la tunsaroon
verses.114: Waaqimi a  ssalata tarafayi a  nnahari wazulafan mina allayli inna alhasanati yuthhibna a  ssayyiati thalika thikra li  ththakireen
verses.115: Wa  sbir fainna Allaha la yudee'u ajra almuhsineen
verses.116: Falawla kana mina alqurooni min qablikum oloo baqiyyatin yanhawna 'ani alfasadi fee alardi illa qaleelan mimman anjayna minhum wa  ttaba'a allatheena _th_ alamoo ma otrifoo feehi wakanoo mujrimeen
verses.117: Wama kana rabbuka liyuhlika alqura bi _th_ ulmin waahluha muslihoon
verses.118: Walaw shaa rabbuka laja'ala a  nnasa ommatan wahidatan wala yazaloona mukhtalifeen
verses.119: Illa man rahima rabbuka walithalika khalaqahum watammat kalimatu rabbika laamlaanna jahannama mina aljinnati wa  nnasi ajma'een
verses.120: Wakullan naqussu 'alayka min anbai a  rrusuli ma nuthabbitu bihi fuadaka wajaaka fee hathihi alhaqqu wamaw'i _th_ atun wathikra lilmumineen
verses.121: Waqul lillatheena la yuminoona i'maloo 'ala makanatikum inna 'amiloon
verses.122: Wa  nta _th_ iroo inna munta _th_ iroon
verses.123: Walillahi ghaybu a  ssamawati wa  lardi wailayhi yurja'u alamru kulluhu fa  'budhu watawakkal 'alayhi wama rabbuka bighafilin 'amma ta'maloon

verses.3: Nahnu naqussu 'alayka ahsana alqasasi bima awhayna ilayka hatha alqurana wain kunta min qablihi lamina alghafileen
verses.4: Ith qala yoosufu liabeehi ya abati innee raaytu ahada 'ashara kawkaban wa  shshamsa wa  lqamara raaytuhum lee sajideen
verses.5: Qala ya bunayya la taqsus ruyaka 'ala ikhwatika fayakeedoo laka kaydan inna a  shshaytana lilinsani 'aduwwun mubeen
verses.6: Wakathalika yajtabeeka rabbuka wayu'allimuka min taweeli alahadeethi wayutimmu ni'matahu 'alayka wa'alaali ya'qooba kama atammaha 'ala abawayka min qablu ibraheema waishaqa inna rabbaka 'aleemun hakeem
verses.7: Laqad kana fee yoosufa waikhwatihi ayatun li  ssaileen
verses.8: Ith qaloo layoosufu waakhoohu ahabbu ila abeena minna wanahnu 'usbatun inna abana lafee dalalin mubeen
verses.9: Oqtuloo yoosufa awi itrahoohu ardan yakhlu lakum wajhu abeekum watakoonoo min ba'dihi qawman saliheen
verses.10: Qala qailun minhum la taqtuloo yoosufa waalqoohu fee ghayabati aljubbi yataqithu ba'du a  ssayyarati in kuntum fa'ileen
verses.11: Qaloo ya abana ma laka la tamanna 'ala yoosufa wainna lahu lanasihoon
verses.12: Arsilhu ma'ana ghadan yarta' wayal'ab wainna lahu lahafi _th_ oon
verses.13: Qala innee layahzununee an thathhaboo bihi waakhafu an yakulahu a  ththibu waantum 'anhu ghafiloon
verses.14: Qaloo lain akalahu a  ththibu wanahnu 'usbatun inna ithan lakhasiroon
verses.15: Falammathahaboo bihi waajma'oo an yaj'aloohu fee ghayabati aljubbi waawhayna ilayhi latunabiannahum biamrihim hatha wahum la yash'uroon
verses.16: Wajaoo abahum 'ishaan yabkoon
verses.17: Qaloo ya abana innathahabna nastabiqu watarakna yoosufa 'inda mata'ina faakalahu a  ththibu wama anta bimuminin lana walaw kunnasadiqeen
verses.18: Wajaoo 'ala qameesihi bidamin kathibin qala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran fasabrun jameelun wa  llahu almusta'anu 'ala ma tasifoon
verses.19: Wajaat sayyaratun faarsaloo waridahum faadla dalwahu qala ya bushra hatha ghulamun waasarroohu bida'atan wa  llahu 'aleemun bima ya'maloon
verses.20: Washarawhu bithamanin bakhsin darahima ma'doodatin wakanoo feehi mina a  zzahideen
verses.21: Waqala allathee ishtarahu min misra li  mraatihi akrimee mathwahu 'asa an yanfa'ana aw nattakhithahu waladan wakathalika makkanna liyoosufa fee alardi walinu'allimahu min taweeli alahadeethi wa  llahu ghalibun 'ala amrihi walakinna akthara a  nnasi la ya'lamoon
verses.22: Walamma balagha ashuddahu ataynahu hukman wa'ilman wakathalika najzee almuhsineen
verses.23: Warawadathu allatee huwa fee baytiha 'an nafsihi waghallaqati alabwaba waqalat hayta laka qala ma'atha Allahi innahu rabbee ahsana mathwaya innahu la yuflihu a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.24: Walaqad hammat bihi wahamma biha lawla an raa burhana rabbihi kathalika linasrifa 'anhu a  ssooa wa  lfahshaa innahu min 'ibadina almukhlaseen
verses.25: Wa  stabaqa albaba waqaddat qameesahu min duburin waalfaya sayyidaha lada albabi qalat ma jazao man arada biahlika sooan illa an yusjana aw 'athabun aleem
verses.26: Qala hiya rawadatnee 'an nafsee washahida shahidun min ahliha in kana qameesuhu qudda min qubulin fasadaqat wahuwa mina alkathibeen
verses.27: Wain kana qameesuhu qudda min duburin fakathabat wahuwa mina a  ssadiqeen
verses.28: Falamma raa qameesahu qudda min duburin qala innahu min kaydikunna inna kaydakunna 'a _th_ eem
verses.29: Yoosufu a'rid 'an hatha wa  staghfiree lithanbiki innaki kunti mina alkhatieen
verses.30: Waqala niswatun fee almadeenati imraatu al'azeezi turawidu fataha 'an nafsihi qad shaghafahahubban inna lanaraha fee dalalin mubeen
verses.31: Falamma sami'at bimakrihinna arsalat ilayhinna waa'tadat lahunna muttakaan waatat kulla wahidatin minhunna sikkeenan waqalati okhruj 'alayhinna falamma raaynahu akbarnahu waqatta'na aydiyahunna waqulna hasha lillahi ma hatha basharan in hatha illa malakun kareem
verses.32: Qalat fathalikunna allathee lumtunnanee feehi walaqad rawadtuhu 'an nafsihi fa  st'sama walain lam yaf'al maamuruhu layusjananna walayakoonan mina a  ssaghireen
verses.33: Qala rabbi a  ssijnu ahabbu ilayya mimma yad'oonanee ilayhi wailla tasrif 'annee kaydahunna asbu ilayhinna waakun mina aljahileen
verses.34: Fa  stajaba lahu rabbuhu fasarafa 'anhu kaydahunna innahu huwa a  ssamee'u al'aleem
verses.35: Thumma bada lahum min ba'di ma raawoo alayati layasjununnahu hattaheen
verses.36: Wadakhala ma'ahu a  ssijna fatayani qala ahaduhuma innee aranee a'siru khamran waqala alakharu innee aranee ahmilu fawqa rasee khubzan takulu a  ttayru minhu nabbina bitaweelihi inna naraka mina almuhsineen
verses.37: Qala la yateekumata'amun turzaqanihi illa nabbatukuma bitaweelihi qabla an yatiyakumathalikuma mimma 'allamanee rabbee innee taraktu millata qawmin la yuminoona bi  llahi wahum bi  lakhirati hum kafiroon
verses.38: Wa  ttaba'tu millata abaee ibraheema waishaqa waya'qooba ma kana lana an nushrika bi  llahi min shayin thalika min fadli Allahi 'alayna wa'ala a  nnasi walakinna akthara a  nnasi la yashkuroon
verses.39: Yasahibayi a  ssijni aarbabun mutafarriqoona khayrun ami Allahu alwahidu alqahhar
verses.40: Ma ta'budoona min doonihi illa asmaan sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultanin ini alhukmu illa lillahi amara alla ta'budoo illa iyyahu thalika a  ddeenu alqayyimu walakinna akthara a  nnasi la ya'lamoon
verses.41: Yasahibayi a  ssijni amma ahadukuma fayasqee rabbahu khamran waamma alakharu fayuslabu fatakulu a  ttayru min rasihi qudiya alamru allathee feehi tastaftiyan
verses.42: Waqala lillathee _th_ anna annahu najin minhuma othkurnee 'inda rabbika faansahu a  shshaytanu thikra rabbihi falabitha fee a  ssijni bid'a sineen
verses.43: Waqala almaliku innee ara sab'a baqaratin simanin yakuluhunna sab'un 'ijafun wasab'a sunbulatin khudrin waokhara yabisatin ya ayyuha almalao aftoonee fee ruyaya in kuntum li  rruya ta'buroon
verses.44: Qaloo adghathu ahlamin wama nahnu bitaweeli alahlami bi'alimeen
verses.45: Waqala allathee naja minhuma wa  ddakara ba'da ommatin ana onabbiokum bitaweelihi faarsiloon
verses.46: Yoosufu ayyuha a  ssiddeequ aftina fee sab'i baqaratin simanin yakuluhunna sab'un 'ijafun wasab'i sunbulatin khudrin waokhara yabisatin la'allee arji'u ila a  nnasi la'allahum ya'lamoon
verses.47: Qala tazra'oona sab'a sineena daaban famahasadtum fatharoohu fee sunbulihi illa qaleelan mimma takuloon
verses.48: Thumma yatee min ba'di thalika sab'un shidadun yakulna ma qaddamtum lahunna illa qaleelan mimma tuhsinoon
verses.49: Thumma yatee min ba'di thalika 'amun feehi yughathu a  nnasu wafeehi ya'siroon
verses.50: Waqala almaliku itoonee bihi falamma jaahu a  rrasoolu qala irji' ila rabbika fa  salhu ma balu a  nniswati allatee qatta'na aydiyahunna inna rabbee bikaydihinna 'aleem
verses.51: Qala ma khatbukunna ith rawadtunna yoosufa 'an nafsihi qulna hasha lillahi ma 'alimna 'alayhi min sooin qalati imraatu al'azeezi alana hashasa alhaqqu ana rawadtuhu 'an nafsihi wainnahu lamina a  ssadiqeen
verses.52: Thalika liya'lama annee lam akhunhu bi  lghaybi waanna Allaha la yahdee kayda alkhaineen
verses.53: Wama obarrio nafsee inna a  nnafsa laammaratun bi  ssooi illa ma rahima rabbee inna rabbee ghafoorun raheem
verses.54: Waqala almaliku itoonee bihi astakhlishu linafsee falamma kallamahu qala innaka alyawma ladayna makeenun ameen
verses.55: Qala ij'anee 'ala khazaini alardi innee hafee _th_ un 'aleem
verses.56: Wakathalika makanna liyoosufa fee alardi yatabawwao minhahaythu yashao nuseebu birahmatina man nashao wala nudee'u ajra almuhsineen
verses.57: Walaajru alakhirati khayrun lillatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoon
verses.58: Wajaa ikhwatu yoosufa fadakhaloo 'alayhi fa'arafahum wahum lahu munkiroon
verses.59: Walamma jahhazahum bijahazihim qala itoonee biakhin lakum min abeekum ala tarawna annee oofee alkayla waana khayru almunzileen
verses.60: Fain lam tatoonee bihi fala kayla lakum 'indee wala taqraboon
verses.61: Qaloo sanurawidu 'anhu abahu wainna lafa'iloon
verses.62: Waqala lifityanihi ij'aloo bida'atahum fee rihalihim la'allahum ya'rifoonaha itha inqalaboo ila ahlihim la'allahum yarji'oon
verses.63: Falamma raja'oo ila abeehim qaloo ya abana muni'a minna alkaylu faarsil ma'ana akhana naktal wainna lahu lahafi _th_ oon
verses.64: Qala hal amanukum 'alayhi illa kama amintukum 'ala akheehi min qablu fa  llahu khayrun hafi _th_ an wahuwa arhamu a  rrahimeen
verses.65: Walamma fatahoo mata'ahum wajadoo bida'atahum ruddat ilayhim qaloo ya abana ma nabghee hathihi bida'atuna ruddat ilayna wanameeru ahlana wanahfa _th_ u akhana wanazdadu kayla ba'eerin thalika kaylun yaseer
verses.66: Qala lan orsilahu ma'akum hatta tutooni mawthiqan mina Allahi latatunnanee bihi illa an yuhata bikum falammaatawhu mawthiqahum qala Allahu 'ala ma naqoolu wakeel
verses.67: Waqala ya baniyya la tadkhuloo min babin wahidin wa  dkhuloo min abwabin mutafarriqatin wama oghnee 'ankum mina Allahi min shayin ini alhukmu illa lillahi 'alayhi tawakkatu wa'alayhi falyatawakkali almutawakkiloon
verses.68: Walamma dakhaloo min haythu amarahum aboohum ma kana yughnee 'anhum mina Allahi min shayin illahajatan fee nafsi ya'qooba qadaha wainnahu lathoo 'ilmin lima 'allamnahu walakinna akthara a  nnasi la ya'lamoon
verses.69: Walamma dakhaloo 'ala yoosufa awa ilayhi akhahu qala innee ana akhooka fala tabtais bima kanoo ya'maloon
verses.70: Falamma jahhazahum bijahazihim ja'ala a  ssiqayata fee rahli akheehi thumma aththana muaththinun ayyatuha al'eeru innakum lasariqoon
verses.71: Qaloo waaqbaloo 'alayhim matha tafqidoon
verses.72: Qaloo nafqidu suwa'a almaliki waliman jaa bihi himlu ba'eerin waana bihi za'eem
verses.73: Qaloo ta  llahi laqad 'alimtum ma jina linufsida fee alardi wama kunna sariqeen
verses.74: Qaloo fama jazaohu in kuntum kathibeen
verses.75: Qaloo jazaohu man wujida fee rahlihi fahuwa jazaohu kathalika najzee a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.76: Fabadaa biaw'iyatihim qabla wi'ai akheehi thumma istakhrajaha min wi'ai akheehi kathalika kidna liyoosufa ma kana liyakhutha akhahu fee deeni almaliki illa an yashaa Allahu narfa'u darajatin man nashao wafawqa kulli thee 'ilmin 'aleem
verses.77: Qaloo in yasriq faqad saraqa akhun lahu min qablu faasarraha yoosufu fee nafsihi walam yubdiha lahum qala antum sharrun makanan wa  llahu a'lamu bima tasifoon
verses.78: Qaloo ya ayyuha al'azeezu inna lahu aban shaykhan kabeeran fakhuth ahadana makanahu inna naraka mina almuhsineen
verses.79: Qala ma'atha Allahi an nakhutha illa man wajadna mata'ana 'indahu inna ithan la _th_ alimoon
verses.80: Falamma istayasoo minhu khalasoo najiyyan qala kabeeruhum alam ta'lamoo anna abakum qad akhatha 'alaykum mawthiqan mina Allahi wamin qablu ma farrattum fee yoosufa falan abraha alarda hatta yathana lee abee aw yahkuma Allahu lee wahuwa khayru alhakimeen
verses.81: Irji'oo ila abeekum faqooloo ya abana inna ibnaka saraqa wama shahidna illa bima 'alimna wama kunna lilghaybi hafi _th_ een
verses.82: Wa  sali alqaryata allatee kunna feeha wa  l'eera allatee aqbana feeha wainna lasadiqoon
verses.83: Qala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran fasabrun jameelun 'asa Allahu an yatiyanee bihim jamee'an innahu huwa al'aleemu alhakeem
verses.84: Watawalla 'anhum waqala ya asafa 'ala yoosufa wa  byaddat 'aynahu mina alhuzni fahuwa ka _th_ eem
verses.85: Qaloo ta  llahi taftao tathkuru yoosufa hatta takoona haradan aw takoona mina alhalikeen
verses.86: Qala innama ashkoo baththee wahuznee ila Allahi waa'lamu mina Allahi ma la ta'lamoon
verses.87: Ya baniyya ithhaboo fatahassasoo min yoosufa waakheehi wala tayasoo min rawhi Allahi innahu la yayasu min rawhi Allahi illa alqawmu alkafiroon
verses.88: Falamma dakhaloo 'alayhi qaloo ya ayyuha al'azeezu massana waahlana a  ddurru wajina bibida'atin muzjatin faawfi lana alkayla watasaddaq 'alayna inna Allaha yajzee almutasaddiqeen
verses.89: Qala hal 'alimtum ma fa'atum biyoosufa waakheehi ith antum jahiloon
verses.90: Qaloo ainnaka laanta yoosufa qala ana yoosufu wahatha akhee qad manna Allahu 'alayna innahu man yattaqi wayasbir fainna Allaha la yudee'u ajra almuhsineen
verses.91: Qaloo ta  llahi laqad atharaka Allahu 'alayna wain kunna lakhatieen
verses.92: Qala la tathreeba 'alaykumu alyawma yaghfiru Allahu lakum wahuwa arhamu a  rrahimeen
verses.93: Ithhaboo biqameesee hatha faalqoohu 'ala wajhi abee yati baseeran watoonee biahlikum ajma'een
verses.94: Walamma fasalati al'eeru qala aboohum innee laajidu reeha yoosufa lawla an tufannidoon
verses.95: Qaloo ta  llahi innaka lafee dalalika alqadeem
verses.96: Falamma an jaa albasheeru alqahu 'ala wajhihi fa  rtadda baseeran qala alam aqul lakum innee a'lamu mina Allahi ma la ta'lamoon
verses.97: Qaloo ya abana istaghfir lanathunoobana inna kunna khatieen
verses.98: Qala sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbee innahu huwa alghafooru a  rraheem
verses.99: Falamma dakhaloo 'ala yoosufa awa ilayhi abawayhi waqala odkhuloo misra in shaa Allahu amineen
verses.100: Warafa'a abawayhi 'ala al'arshi wakharroo lahu sujjadan waqala ya abati hatha taweelu ruyaya min qablu qad ja'alaha rabbee haqqan waqad ahsana bee ith akhrajanee mina a  ssijni wajaa bikum mina albadwi min ba'di an nazagha a  shshaytanu baynee wabayna ikhwatee inna rabbee lateefun lima yashao innahu huwa al'aleemu alhakeem
verses.101: Rabbi qad ataytanee mina almulki wa'allamtanee min taweeli alahadeethi fatira a  ssamawati wa  lardi anta waliyyee fee a  ddunya wa  lakhirati tawaffanee musliman waalhiqnee bi  ssaliheen
verses.102: Thalika min anbai alghaybi nooheehi ilayka wama kunta ladayhim ith ajma'oo amrahum wahum yamkuroon
verses.103: Wama aktharu a  nnasi walaw harasta bimumineen
verses.104: Wama tasaluhum 'alayhi min ajrin in huwa illathikrun lil'alameen
verses.105: Wakaayyin min ayatin fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi yamurroona 'alayha wahum 'anha mu'ridoon
verses.106: Wama yuminu aktharuhum bi  llahi illa wahum mushrikoon
verses.107: Afaaminoo an tatiyahum ghashiyatun min 'athabi Allahi aw tatiyahumu a  ssa'atu baghtatan wahum la yash'uroon
verses.108: Qul hathihi sabeelee ad'oo ila Allahi 'ala baseeratin ana wamani ittaba'anee wasubhana Allahi wama ana mina almushrikeen
verses.109: Wama arsana min qablika illa rijalan noohee ilayhim min ahli alqura afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayan _th_ uroo kayfa kana 'aqibatu allatheena min qablihim waladaru alakhirati khayrun lillatheena ittaqaw afala ta'qiloon
verses.110: Hatta itha istayasa a  rrusulu wa _th_ annoo annahum qad kuthiboo jaahum nasruna fanujjiya man nashao wala yuraddu basuna 'ani alqawmi almujrimeen
verses.111: Laqad kana fee qasasihim 'ibratun liolee alalbabi ma kana hadeethan yuftara walakin tasdeeqa allathee bayna yadayhi watafseela kulli shayin wahudan warahmatan liqawmin yuminoon

verses.1: Aliflammeemra tilka ayatu alkitabi wa  llathee onzila ilayka min rabbika alhaqqu walakinna akthara a  nnasi la yuminoon
verses.2: Allahu allathee rafa'a a  ssamawati bighayri 'amadin tarawnaha thumma istawa 'ala al'arshi wasakhkhara a  shshamsa wa  lqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman yudabbiru alamra yufassilu alayati la'allakum biliqai rabbikum tooqinoon
verses.3: Wahuwa allathee madda alarda waja'ala feeha rawasiya waanharan wamin kulli a  ththamarati ja'ala feeha zawjayni ithnayni yughshee allayla a  nnahara inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroon
verses.4: Wafee alardi qita'un mutajawiratun wajannatun min a'nabin wazar'un wanakheelun sinwanun waghayru sinwanin yusqa bimain wahidin wanufaddilu ba'daha 'ala ba'din fee alokuli inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin ya'qiloon
verses.5: Wain ta'jab fa'ajabun qawluhum aitha kunna turaban ainna lafee khalqin jadeedin olaika allatheena kafaroo birabbihim waolaika alaghlalu fee a'naqihim waolaika ashabu a  nnari hum feeha khalidoon
verses.6: Wayasta'jiloonaka bi  ssayyiati qabla alhasanati waqad khalat min qablihimu almathulatu wainna rabbaka lathoo maghfiratin li  nnasi 'ala _th_ ulmihim wainna rabbaka lashadeedu al'iqab
verses.7: Wayaqoolu allatheena kafaroo lawla onzila 'alayhi ayatun min rabbihi innama anta munthirun walikulli qawmin had
verses.8: Allahu ya'lamu ma tahmilu kullu ontha wama tagheedu alarhamu wama tazdadu wakullu shayin 'indahu bimiqdar
verses.9: 'alimu alghaybi wa  shshahadati alkabeeru almuta'al
verses.10: Sawaon minkum man asarra alqawla waman jahara bihi waman huwa mustakhfin bi  llayli wasaribun bi  nnahar
verses.11: Lahu mu'aqqibatun min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi yahfa _th_ oonahu min amri Allahi inna Allaha la yughayyiru ma biqawmin hatta yughayyiroo ma bianfusihim waitha arada Allahu biqawmin sooan fala maradda lahu wama lahum min doonihi min wal
verses.12: Huwa allathee yureekumu albarqa khawfan watama'an wayunshio a  ssahaba a  ththiqal
verses.13: Wayusabbihu a  rra'du bihamdihi wa  lmalaikatu min kheefatihi wayursilu a  ssawa'iqa fayuseebu biha man yashao wahum yujadiloona fee Allahi wahuwa shadeedu almihal
verses.14: Lahu da'watu alhaqqi wa  llatheena yad'oona min doonihi la yastajeeboona lahum bishayin illa kabasiti kaffayhi ila almai liyablugha fahu wama huwa bibalighihi wama du'ao alkafireena illa fee dalal
verses.15: Walillahi yasjudu man fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi taw'an wakarhan wa _th_ ilaluhum bi  lghuduwwi wa  lasal
verses.16: Qul man rabbu a  ssamawati wa  lardi quli Allahu qul afa  ttakhathtum min doonihi awliyaa la yamlikoona lianfusihim naf'an waladarran qul hal yastawee ala'ma wa  lbaseeru am hal tastawee a  _thth_ ulumatu wa  nnooru am ja'aloo lillahi shurakaa khalaqoo kakhalqihi fatashabaha alkhalqu 'alayhim quli Allahu khaliqu kulli shayin wahuwa alwahidu alqahhar
verses.17: Anzala mina a  ssamai maan fasalat awdiyatun biqadariha fa  htamala a  ssaylu zabadan rabiyan wamimma yooqidoona 'alayhi fee a  nnari ibtighaa hilyatin aw mata'in zabadun mithluhu kathalika yadribu Allahu alhaqqa wa  lbatila faamma a  zzabadu fayathhabu jufaan waamma ma yanfa'u a  nnasa fayamkuthu fee alardi kathalika yadribu Allahu alamthal
verses.18: Lillatheena istajaboo lirabbihimu alhusna wa  llatheena lam yastajeeboo lahu law anna lahum ma fee alardi jamee'an wamithlahu ma'ahu la  ftadaw bihi olaika lahum sooo alhisabi wamawahum jahannamu wabisa almihad
verses.19: Afaman ya'lamu annama onzila ilayka min rabbika alhaqqu kaman huwa a'ma innama yatathakkaru oloo alalbab
verses.20: Allatheena yoofoona bi'ahdi Allahi wala yanqudoona almeethaq
verses.21: Wa  llatheena yasiloona ma amara Allahu bihi an yoosala wayakhshawna rabbahum wayakhafoona sooa alhisab
verses.22: Wa  llatheena sabaroo ibtighaa wajhi rabbihim waaqamoo a  ssalata waanfaqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran wa'alaniyatan wayadraoona bi  lhasanati a  ssayyiata olaika lahum 'uqba a  ddar
verses.23: Jannatu 'adnin yadkhuloonaha waman salaha min abaihim waazwajihim wathurriyyatihim wa  lmalaikatu yadkhuloona 'alayhim min kulli bab
verses.24: Salamun 'alaykum bimasabartum fani'ma 'uqba a  ddar
verses.25: Wa  llatheena yanqudoona 'ahda Allahi min ba'di meethaqihi wayaqta'oona ma amara Allahu bihi an yoosala wayufsidoona fee alardi olaika lahumu alla'natu walahum sooo a  ddar
verses.26: Allahu yabsutu a  rrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru wafarihoo bi  lhayati a  ddunya wama alhayatu a  ddunya fee alakhirati illa mata'
verses.27: Wayaqoolu allatheena kafaroo lawla onzila 'alayhi ayatun min rabbihi qul inna Allaha yudillu man yashao wayahdee ilayhi man anab
verses.28: Allatheena amanoo watatmainnu quloobuhum bithikri Allahi ala bithikri Allahi tatmainnu alquloob
verses.29: Allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati tooba lahum wahusnu maab
verses.30: Kathalika arsanaka fee ommatin qad khalat min qabliha omamun litatluwa 'alayhimu allathee awhayna ilayka wahum yakfuroona bi  rrahmani qul huwa rabbee la ilaha illa huwa 'alayhi tawakkatu wailayhi matab
verses.31: Walaw anna quranan suyyirat bihi aljibalu aw qutti'at bihi alardu aw kullima bihi almawta bal lillahi alamru jamee'an afalam yayasi allatheena amanoo an law yashao Allahu lahada a  nnasa jamee'an wala yazalu allatheena kafaroo tuseebuhum bimasana'oo qari'atun aw tahullu qareeban min darihim hatta yatiya wa'du Allahi inna Allaha la yukhlifu almee'ad
verses.32: Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika faamlaytu lillatheena kafaroo thumma akhathtuhum fakayfa kana 'iqab
verses.33: Afaman huwa qaimun 'ala kulli nafsin bima kasabat waja'aloo lillahi shurakaa qul sammoohum am tunabbioonahu bima la ya'lamu fee alardi am bi _th_ ahirin mina alqawli bal zuyyina lillatheena kafaroo makruhum wasuddoo 'ani a  ssabeeli waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min had
verses.34: Lahum 'athabun fee alhayati a  ddunya wala'athabu alakhirati ashaqqu wama lahum mina Allahi min waq
verses.35: Mathalu aljannati allatee wu'ida almuttaqoona tajree min tahtiha alanharu okuluha daimun wa _th_ illuha tilka 'uqba allatheena ittaqaw wa'uqba alkafireena a  nnar
verses.36: Wa  llatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yafrahoona bima onzila ilayka wamina alahzabi man yunkiru ba'dahu qul innama omirtu an a'buda Allaha wala oshrika bihi ilayhi ad'oo wailayhi maab
verses.37: Wakathalika anzanahu hukman 'arabiyyan walaini ittaba'ta ahwaahum ba'da ma jaaka mina al'ilmi ma laka mina Allahi min waliyyin wala waq
verses.38: Walaqad arsana rusulan min qablika waja'ana lahum azwajan wathurriyyatan wama kana lirasoolin an yatiya biayatin illa biithni Allahi likulli ajalin kitab
verses.39: Yamhoo Allahu ma yashao wayuthbitu wa'indahu ommu alkitab
verses.40: Wain ma nuriyannaka ba'da allathee na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fainnama 'alayka albalaghu wa'alayna alhisab
verses.41: Awalam yaraw anna natee alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha wa  llahu yahkumu la mu'aqqiba lihukmihi wahuwa saree'u alhisab
verses.42: Waqad makara allatheena min qablihim falillahi almakru jamee'an ya'lamu ma taksibu kullu nafsin wasaya'lamu alkuffaru liman 'uqba a  ddar
verses.43: Wayaqoolu allatheena kafaroo lasta mursalan qul kafa bi  llahi shaheedan baynee wabaynakum waman 'indahu 'ilmu alkitab

verses.1: Aliflamra kitabun anzanahu ilayka litukhrija a  nnasa mina a  _thth_ ulumati ila a  nnoori biithni rabbihim ilasirati al'azeezi alhameed
verses.2: Allahi allathee lahu ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi wawaylun lilkafireena min 'athabin shadeed
verses.3: Allatheena yastahibboona alhayata a  ddunya 'ala alakhirati wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli Allahi wayabghoonaha 'iwajan olaika fee dalalin ba'eed
verses.4: Wama arsana min rasoolin illa bilisani qawmihi liyubayyina lahum fayudillu Allahu man yashao wayahdee man yashao wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.5: Walaqad arsana moosa biayatina an akhrij qawmaka mina a  _thth_ ulumati ila a  nnoori wathakkirhum biayyami Allahi inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoor
verses.6: Waith qala moosa liqawmihi othkuroo ni'mata Allahi 'alaykum ith anjakum min ali fir'awna yasoomoonakum sooa al'athabi wayuthabbihoona abnaakum wayastahyoona nisaakum wafee thalikum balaon min rabbikum 'a _th_ eem
verses.7: Waith taaththana rabbukum lain shakartum laazeedannakum walain kafartum inna 'athabee lashadeed
verses.8: Waqala moosa in takfuroo antum waman fee alardi jamee'an fainna Allaha laghaniyyun hameed
verses.9: Alam yatikum nabao allatheena min qablikum qawmi noohin wa'adin wathamooda wa  llatheena min ba'dihim la ya'lamuhum illa Allahu jaathum rusuluhum bi  lbayyinati faraddoo aydiyahum fee afwahihim waqaloo inna kafarna bima orsiltum bihi wainna lafee shakkin mimma tad'oonana ilayhi mureeb
verses.10: Qalat rusuluhum afee Allahi shakkun fatiri a  ssamawati wa  lardi yad'ookum liyaghfira lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirakum ila ajalin musamman qaloo in antum illa basharun mithluna tureedoona an tasuddoona 'amma kana ya'budu abaona fatoona bisultanin mubeen
verses.11: Qalat lahum rusuluhum in nahnu illa basharun mithlukum walakinna Allaha yamunnu 'ala man yashao min 'ibadihi wama kana lana an natiyakum bisultanin illa biithni Allahi wa'ala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoon
verses.12: Wama lana alla natawakkala 'ala Allahi waqad hadana subulana walanasbiranna 'ala maathaytumoona wa'ala Allahi falyatawakkali almutawakkiloon
verses.13: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lirusulihim lanukhrijannakum min ardina aw lata'oodunna fee millatina faawha ilayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikanna a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.14: Walanuskinannakumu alarda min ba'dihim thalika liman khafa maqamee wakhafa wa'eed
verses.15: Wa  staftahoo wakhaba kullu jabbarin 'aneed
verses.16: Min waraihi jahannamu wayusqa min main sadeed
verses.17: Yatajarra'uhu wala yakadu yuseeghuhu wayateehi almawtu min kulli makanin wama huwa bimayyitin wamin waraihi 'athabun ghalee _th_
verses.18: Mathalu allatheena kafaroo birabbihim a'maluhum karamadin ishtaddat bihi a  rreehu fee yawmin 'asifin la yaqdiroona mimma kasaboo 'ala shayin thalika huwa a  ddalalu alba'eed
verses.19: Alam tara anna Allaha khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda bi  lhaqqi in yasha yuthhibkum wayati bikhalqin jadeed
verses.20: Wamathalika 'ala Allahi bi'azeez
verses.21: Wabarazoo lillahi jamee'an faqala a  ddu'afao lillatheena istakbaroo inna kunna lakum taba'an fahal antum mughnoona 'anna min 'athabi Allahi min shayin qaloo law hadana Allahu lahadaynakum sawaon 'alayna ajazi'na am sabarna ma lana min mahees
verses.22: Waqala a  shshaytanu lamma qudiya alamru inna Allaha wa'adakum wa'da alhaqqi wawa'adtukum faakhlaftukum wama kana liya 'alaykum min sultanin illa an da'awtukum fa  stajabtum lee fala taloomoonee waloomoo anfusakum ma ana bimusrikhikum wama antum bimusrikhiyya innee kafartu bima ashraktumooni min qablu inna a  _thth_ alimeena lahum 'athabun aleem
verses.23: Waodkhila allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha biithni rabbihim tahiyyatuhum feeha salam
verses.24: Alam tara kayfa daraba Allahu mathalan kalimatan tayyibatan kashajaratin tayyibatin asluha thabitun wafar'uha fee a  ssama
verses.25: Tutee okulaha kulla heenin biithni rabbiha wayadribu Allahu alamthala li  nnasi la'allahum yatathakkaroon
verses.26: Wamathalu kalimatin khabeethatin kashajaratin khabeethatin ijtuththat min fawqi alardi ma laha min qarar
verses.27: Yuthabbitu Allahu allatheena amanoo bi  lqawli a  ththabiti fee alhayati a  ddunya wafee alakhirati wayudillu Allahu a  _thth_ alimeena wayaf'alu Allahu ma yasha
verses.28: Alam tara ila allatheena baddaloo ni'mata Allahi kufran waahalloo qawmahum dara albawar
verses.29: Jahannama yaslawnaha wabisa alqarar
verses.30: Waja'aloo lillahi andadan liyudilloo 'an sabeelihi qul tamatta'oo fainna maseerakum ila a  nnar
verses.31: Qul li'ibadiya allatheena amanoo yuqeemoo a  ssalata wayunfiqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran wa'alaniyatan min qabli an yatiya yawmun la bay'un feehi wala khilal
verses.32: Allahu allathee khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda waanzala mina a  ssamai maan faakhraja bihi mina a  ththamarati rizqan lakum wasakhkhara lakumu alfulka litajriya fee albahri biamrihi wasakhkhara lakumu alanhar
verses.33: Wasakhkhara lakumu a  shshamsa wa  lqamara daibayni wasakhkhara lakumu allayla wa  nnahar
verses.34: Waatakum min kulli ma saatumoohu wain ta'uddoo ni'mata Allahi la tuhsooha inna alinsana la _th_ aloomun kaffar
verses.35: Waith qala ibraheemu rabbi ij'al hatha albalada aminan wa  jnubnee wabaniyya an na'buda alasnam
verses.36: Rabbi innahunna adlana katheeran mina a  nnasi faman tabi'anee fainnahu minnee waman 'asanee fainnaka ghafoorun raheem
verses.37: Rabbana innee askantu min thurriyyatee biwadin ghayri thee zar'in 'inda baytika almuharrami rabbana liyuqeemoo a  ssalata fa  j'al afidatan mina a  nnasi tahwee ilayhim wa  rzuqhum mina a  ththamarati la'allahum yashkuroon
verses.38: Rabbana innaka ta'lamu ma nukhfee wama nu'linu wama yakhfa 'ala Allahi min shayin fee alardi wala fee a  ssama
verses.39: Alhamdu lillahi allathee wahaba lee 'ala alkibari isma'eela waishaqa inna rabbee lasamee'u a  ddu'a
verses.40: Rabbi ij'anee muqeema a  ssalati wamin thurriyyatee rabbana wtaqabbal du'a
verses.41: Rabbana ighfir lee waliwalidayya walilmumineena yawma yaqoomu alhisab
verses.42: Wala tahsabanna Allaha ghafilan 'amma ya'malu a  _thth_ alimoona innama yuakhkhiruhum liyawmin tashkhasu feehi alabsar
verses.43: Muhti'eena muqni'ee ruoosihim la yartaddu ilayhim tarfuhum waafidatuhum hawa
verses.44: Waanthiri a  nnasa yawma yateehimu al'athabu fayaqoolu allatheena _th_ alamoo rabbana akhkhirna ila ajalin qareebin nujib da'wataka wanattabi'i a  rrusula awalam takoonoo aqsamtum min qablu ma lakum min zawal
verses.45: Wasakantum fee masakini allatheena _th_ alamoo anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa fa'ana bihim wadarabna lakumu alamthal
verses.46: Waqad makaroo makrahum wa'inda Allahi makruhum wain kana makruhum litazoola minhu aljibal
verses.47: Fala tahsabanna Allaha mukhlifa wa'dihi rusulahu inna Allaha 'azeezun thoo intiqam
verses.48: Yawma tubaddalu alardu ghayra alardi wa  ssamawatu wabarazoo lillahi alwahidi alqahhar
verses.49: Watara almujrimeena yawmaithin muqarraneena fee alasfad
verses.50: Sarabeeluhum min qatranin wataghsha wujoohahumu a  nnar
verses.51: Liyajziya Allahu kulla nafsin ma kasabat inna Allaha saree'u alhisab
verses.52: Hatha balaghun li  nnasi waliyuntharoo bihi waliya'lamoo annama huwa ilahun wahidun waliyaththakkara oloo alalbab
