verses.1: Ata amru Allahi fala tasta'jiloohu subhanahu wata'ala 'amma yushrikoon
verses.2: Yunazzilu almalaikata bi  rroohi min amrihi 'ala man yashao min 'ibadihi an anthiroo annahu la ilaha illa ana fa  ttaqoon
verses.3: Khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda bi  lhaqqi ta'ala 'amma yushrikoon
verses.4: Khalaqa alinsana min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeen
verses.5: Wa  lan'ama khalaqaha lakum feeha difon wamanafi'u waminha takuloon
verses.6: Walakum feeha jamalun heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoon
verses.7: Watahmilu athqalakum ila baladin lam takoonoo baligheehi illa bishiqqi alanfusi inna rabbakum laraoofun raheem
verses.8: Wa  lkhayla wa  lbighala wa  lhameera litarkabooha wazeenatan wayakhluqu ma la ta'lamoon
verses.9: Wa'ala Allahi qasdu a  ssabeeli waminha jairun walaw shaa lahadakum ajma'een
verses.10: Huwa allathee anzala mina a  ssamai maan lakum minhu sharabun waminhu shajarun feehi tuseemoon
verses.11: Yunbitu lakum bihi a  zzar'a wa  zzaytoona wa  nnakheela wa  la'naba wamin kulli a  ththamarati inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroon
verses.12: Wasakhkhara lakumu allayla wa  nnahara wa  shshamsa wa  lqamara wa  nnujoomu musakhkharatun biamrihi inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin ya'qiloon
verses.13: Wamatharaa lakum fee alardi mukhtalifan alwanuhu inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaththakkaroon
verses.14: Wahuwa allathee sakhkhara albahra litakuloo minhu lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka mawakhira feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi wala'allakum tashkuroon
verses.15: Waalqa fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bikum waanharan wasubulan la'allakum tahtadoon
verses.16: Wa'alamatin wabi  nnajmi hum yahtadoon
verses.17: Afaman yakhluqu kaman la yakhluqu afala tathakkaroon
verses.18: Wain ta'uddoo ni'mata Allahi la tuhsooha inna Allaha laghafoorun raheem
verses.19: Wa  llahu ya'lamu ma tusirroona wama tu'linoon
verses.20: Wa  llatheena yad'oona min dooni Allahi la yakhluqoona shayan wahum yukhlaqoon
verses.21: Amwatun ghayru ahyain wama yash'uroona ayyana yub'athoon
verses.22: Ilahukum ilahun wahidun fa  llatheena la yuminoona bi  lakhirati quloobuhum munkiratun wahum mustakbiroon
verses.23: La jarama anna Allaha ya'lamu ma yusirroona wama yu'linoona innahu la yuhibbu almustakbireen
verses.24: Waitha qeela lahum matha anzala rabbukum qaloo asateeru alawwaleen
verses.25: Liyahmiloo awzarahum kamilatan yawma alqiyamati wamin awzari allatheena yudilloonahum bighayri 'ilmin ala saa ma yaziroon
verses.26: Qad makara allatheena min qablihim faata Allahu bunyanahum mina alqawa'idi fakharra 'alayhimu a  ssaqfu min fawqihim waatahumu al'athabu min haythu la yash'uroon
verses.27: Thumma yawma alqiyamati yukhzeehim wayaqoolu ayna shurakaiya allatheena kuntum tushaqqoona feehim qala allatheena ootoo al'ilma inna alkhizya alyawma wa  ssooa 'ala alkafireen
verses.28: Allatheena tatawaffahumu almalaikatu _th_ alimee anfusihim faalqawoo a  ssalama ma kunna na'malu min sooin bala inna Allaha 'aleemun bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.29: Fa  dkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha falabisa mathwa almutakabbireen
verses.30: Waqeela lillatheena ittaqaw matha anzala rabbukum qaloo khayran lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi a  ddunyahasanatun waladaru alakhirati khayrun walani'ma daru almuttaqeen
verses.31: Jannatu 'adnin yadkhuloonaha tajree min tahtiha alanharu lahum feeha ma yashaoona kathalika yajzee Allahu almuttaqeen
verses.32: Allatheena tatawaffahumu almalaikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona salamun 'alaykumu odkhuloo aljannata bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.33: Hal yan _th_ uroona illa an tatiyahumu almalaikatu aw yatiya amru rabbika kathalika fa'ala allatheena min qablihim wama _th_ alamahumu Allahu walakin kanoo anfusahum ya _th_ limoon
verses.34: Faasabahum sayyiatu ma 'amiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioon
verses.35: Waqala allatheena ashrakoo law shaa Allahu ma 'abadna min doonihi min shayin nahnu walaabaona walaharramna min doonihi min shayin kathalika fa'ala allatheena min qablihim fahal 'ala a  rrusuli illa albalaghu almubeen
verses.36: Walaqad ba'athna fee kulli ommatin rasoolan ani o'budoo Allaha wa  jtaniboo a  ttaghoota faminhum man hada Allahu waminhum man haqqat 'alayhi a  ddalalatu faseeroo fee alardi fa  n _th_ uroo kayfa kana 'aqibatu almukaththibeen
verses.37: In tahris 'ala hudahum fainna Allaha la yahdee man yudillu wama lahum min nasireen
verses.38: Waaqsamoo bi  llahi jahda aymanihim la yab'athu Allahu man yamootu bala wa'dan 'alayhi haqqan walakinna akthara a  nnasi la ya'lamoon
verses.39: Liyubayyina lahumu allathee yakhtalifoona feehi waliya'lama allatheena kafaroo annahum kanoo kathibeen
verses.40: Innama qawluna lishayin itha aradnahu an naqoola lahu kun fayakoon
verses.41: Wa  llatheena hajaroo fee Allahi min ba'di ma _th_ ulimoo lanubawwiannahum fee a  ddunyahasanatan walaajru alakhirati akbaru law kanoo ya'lamoon
verses.42: Allatheena sabaroo wa'ala rabbihim yatawakkaloon
verses.43: Wama arsana min qablika illa rijalan noohee ilayhim fa  saloo ahla a  ththikri in kuntum la ta'lamoon
verses.44: Bi  lbayyinati wa  zzuburi waanzana ilayka a  ththikra litubayyina li  nnasi ma nuzzila ilayhim wala'allahum yatafakkaroon
verses.45: Afaamina allatheena makaroo a  ssayyiati an yakhsifa Allahu bihimu alarda aw yatiyahumu al'athabu min haythu la yash'uroon
verses.46: Aw yakhuthahum fee taqallubihim fama hum bimu'jizeen
verses.47: Aw yakhuthahum 'ala takhawwufin fainna rabbakum laraoofun raheem
verses.48: Awa lam yaraw ila ma khalaqa Allahu min shayin yatafayyao _th_ ilaluhu 'ani alyameeni wa  shshamaili sujjadan lillahi wahum dakhiroon
verses.49: Walillahi yasjudu ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi min dabbatin wa  lmalaikatu wahum la yastakbiroon
verses.50: Yakhafoona rabbahum min fawqihim wayaf'aloona ma yumaroon
verses.51: Waqala Allahu la tattakhithoo ilahayni ithnayni innama huwa ilahun wahidun faiyyaya fa  rhaboon
verses.52: Walahu ma fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi walahu a  ddeenu wasiban afaghayra Allahi tattaqoon
verses.53: Wama bikum min ni'matin famina Allahi thumma itha massakumu a  ddurru failayhi tajaroon
verses.54: Thumma itha kashafa a  ddurra 'ankum itha fareequn minkum birabbihim yushrikoon
verses.55: Liyakfuroo bimaataynahum fatamatta'oo fasawfa ta'lamoon
verses.56: Wayaj'aloona lima la ya'lamoona naseeban mimma razaqnahum ta  llahi latusalunna 'amma kuntum taftaroon
verses.57: Wayaj'aloona lillahi albanati subhanahu walahum ma yashtahoon
verses.58: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bi  lontha _th_ alla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa ka _th_ eem
verses.59: Yatawara mina alqawmi min sooi ma bushshira bihi ayumsikuhu 'ala hoonin am yadussuhu fee a  tturabi ala saa ma yahkumoon
verses.60: Lillatheena la yuminoona bi  lakhirati mathalu a  ssawi walillahi almathalu ala'la wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.61: Walaw yuakhithu Allahu a  nnasa bi _th_ ulmihim ma taraka 'alayha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum la yastakhiroona sa'atan wala yastaqdimoon
verses.62: Wayaj'aloona lillahi ma yakrahoona watasifu asinatuhumu alkathiba anna lahumu alhusna la jarama anna lahumu a  nnara waannahum mufratoon
verses.63: Ta  llahi laqad arsana ila omamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu a  shshaytanu a'malahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu alyawma walahum 'athabun aleem
verses.64: Wama anzana 'alayka alkitaba illa litubayyina lahumu allathee ikhtalafoo feehi wahudan warahmatan liqawmin yuminoon
verses.65: Wa  llahu anzala mina a  ssamai maan faahya bihi alarda ba'da mawtiha inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yasma'oon
verses.66: Wainna lakum fee alan'ami la'ibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butoonihi min bayni farthin wadamin labanan khalisan saighan li  shsharibeen
verses.67: Wamin thamarati a  nnakheeli wa  la'nabi tattakhithoona minhu sakaran warizqan hasanan inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin ya'qiloon
verses.68: Waawha rabbuka ila a  nnahli ani ittakhithee mina aljibali buyootan wamina a  shshajari wamimma ya'rishoon
verses.69: Thumma kulee min kulli a  ththamarati fa  slukee subula rabbiki thululan yakhruju min butooniha sharabun mukhtalifun alwanuhu feehi shifaon li  nnasi inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroon
verses.70: Wa  llahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffakum waminkum man yuraddu ila arthali al'umuri likay la ya'lama ba'da 'ilmin shayan inna Allaha 'aleemun qadeer
verses.71: Wa  llahu faddala ba'dakum 'ala ba'din fee a  rrizqi fama allatheena fuddiloo biraddee rizqihim 'ala ma malakat aymanuhum fahum feehi sawaon afabini'mati Allahi yajhadoon
verses.72: Wa  llahu ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwajan waja'ala lakum min azwajikum baneena wahafadatan warazaqakum mina a  ttayyibati afabi  lbatili yuminoona wabini'mati Allahi hum yakfuroon
verses.73: Waya'budoona min dooni Allahi ma la yamliku lahum rizqan mina a  ssamawati wa  lardi shayan wala yastatee'oon
verses.74: Fala tadriboo lillahi alamthala inna Allaha ya'lamu waantum la ta'lamoon
verses.75: Daraba Allahu mathalan 'abdan mamlookan la yaqdiru 'ala shayin waman razaqnahu minna rizqan hasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirran wajahran hal yastawoona alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la ya'lamoon
verses.76: Wadaraba Allahu mathalan rajulayni ahaduhuma abkamu la yaqdiru 'ala shayin wahuwa kallun 'ala mawlahu aynama yuwajjihhu la yati bikhayrin hal yastawee huwa waman yamuru bi  l'adli wahuwa 'alasiratin mustaqeem
verses.77: Walillahi ghaybu a  ssamawati wa  lardi wama amru a  ssa'ati illa kalamhi albasari aw huwa aqrabu inna Allaha 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.78: Wa  llahu akhrajakum min butooni ommahatikum la ta'lamoona shayan waja'ala lakumu a  ssam'a wa  labsara wa  lafidata la'allakum tashkuroon
verses.79: Alam yaraw ila a  ttayri musakhkharatin fee jawwi a  ssamai ma yumsikuhunna illa Allahu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoon
verses.80: Wa  llahu ja'ala lakum min buyootikum sakanan waja'ala lakum min juloodi alan'ami buyootan tastakhiffoonaha yawma _th_ a'nikum wayawma iqamatikum wamin aswafiha waawbariha waash'ariha athathan wamata'an ilaheen
verses.81: Wa  llahu ja'ala lakum mimma khalaqa _th_ ilalan waja'ala lakum mina aljibali aknanan waja'ala lakum sarabeela taqeekumu alharra wasarabeela taqeekum basakum kathalika yutimmu ni'matahu 'alaykum la'allakum tuslimoon
verses.82: Fain tawallaw fainnama 'alayka albalaghu almubeen
verses.83: Ya'rifoona ni'mata Allahi thumma yunkiroonaha waaktharuhumu alkafiroon
verses.84: Wayawma nab'athu min kulli ommatin shaheedan thumma la yuthanu lillatheena kafaroo wala hum yusta'taboon
verses.85: Waitha raa allatheena _th_ alamoo al'athaba fala yukhaffafu 'anhum wala hum yun _th_ aroon
verses.86: Waitha raa allatheena ashrakoo shurakaahum qaloo rabbana haolai shurakaona allatheena kunna nad'oo min doonika faalqaw ilayhimu alqawla innakum lakathiboon
verses.87: Waalqaw ila Allahi yawmaithin a  ssalama wadalla 'anhum ma kanoo yaftaroon
verses.88: Allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo 'an sabeeli Allahi zidnahum 'athaban fawqa al'athabi bima kanoo yufsidoon
verses.89: Wayawma nab'athu fee kulli ommatin shaheedan 'alayhim min anfusihim wajina bika shaheedan 'ala haolai wanazzana 'alayka alkitaba tibyanan likulli shayin wahudan warahmatan wabushra lilmuslimeen
verses.90: Inna Allaha yamuru bi  l'adli wa  lihsani waeetai thee alqurba wayanha 'ani alfahshai wa  lmunkari wa  lbaghyi ya'i _th_ ukum la'allakum tathakkaroon
verses.91: Waawfoo bi'ahdi Allahi itha 'ahadtum wala tanqudoo alaymana ba'da tawkeediha waqad ja'atumu Allaha 'alaykum kafeelan inna Allaha ya'lamu ma taf'aloon
verses.92: Wala takoonoo ka  llatee naqadat ghazlaha min ba'di quwwatin ankathan tattakhithoona aymanakum dakhalan baynakum an takoona ommatun hiya arba min ommatin innama yablookumu Allahu bihi walayubayyinanna lakum yawma alqiyamati ma kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
verses.93: Walaw shaa Allahu laja'alakum ommatan wahidatan walakin yudillu man yashao wayahdee man yashao walatusalunna 'amma kuntum ta'maloon
verses.94: Wala tattakhithoo aymanakum dakhalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun ba'da thubootiha watathooqoo a  ssooa bimasadadtum 'an sabeeli Allahi walakum 'athabun 'a _th_ eem
verses.95: Wala tashtaroo bi'ahdi Allahi thamanan qaleelan innama 'inda Allahi huwa khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
verses.96: Ma 'indakum yanfadu wama 'inda Allahi baqin walanajziyanna allatheena sabaroo ajrahum biahsani ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.97: Man 'amila salihan min thakarin aw ontha wahuwa muminun falanuhyiyannahu hayatan tayyibatan walanajziyannahum ajrahum biahsani ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.98: Faitha qarata alqurana fa  sta'ith bi  llahi mina a  shshaytani a  rrajeem
verses.99: Innahu laysa lahu sultanun 'ala allatheena amanoo wa'ala rabbihim yatawakkaloon
verses.100: Innama sultanuhu 'ala allatheena yatawallawnahu wa  llatheena hum bihi mushrikoon
verses.101: Waitha baddanaayatan makana ayatin wa  llahu a'lamu bima yunazzilu qaloo innama anta muftarin bal aktharuhum la ya'lamoon
verses.102: Qul nazzalahu roohu alqudusi min rabbika bi  lhaqqi liyuthabbita allatheena amanoo wahudan wabushra lilmuslimeen
verses.103: Walaqad na'lamu annahum yaqooloona innama yu'allimuhu basharun lisanu allathee yulhidoona ilayhi a'jamiyyun wahatha lisanun 'arabiyyun mubeen
verses.104: Inna allatheena la yuminoona biayati Allahi la yahdeehimu Allahu walahum 'athabun aleem
verses.105: Innama yaftaree alkathiba allatheena la yuminoona biayati Allahi waolaika humu alkathiboon
verses.106: Man kafara bi  llahi min ba'di eemanihi illa man okriha waqalbuhu mutmainnun bi  leemani walakin man sharaha bi  lkufri sadran fa'alayhim ghadabun mina Allahi walahum 'athabun 'a _th_ eem
verses.107: Thalika biannahumu istahabboo alhayata a  ddunya 'ala alakhirati waanna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alkafireen
verses.108: Olaika allatheena taba'a Allahu 'ala quloobihim wasam'ihim waabsarihim waolaika humu alghafiloon
verses.109: La jarama annahum fee alakhirati humu alkhasiroon
verses.110: Thumma inna rabbaka lillatheena hajaroo min ba'di ma futinoo thumma jahadoo wasabaroo inna rabbaka min ba'diha laghafoorun raheem
verses.111: Yawma tatee kullu nafsin tujadilu 'an nafsiha watuwaffa kullu nafsin ma 'amilat wahum la yu _th_ lamoon
verses.112: Wadaraba Allahu mathalan qaryatan kanat aminatan mutmainnatan yateeha rizquha raghadan min kulli makanin fakafarat bian'umi Allahi faathaqaha Allahu libasa aljoo'i wa  lkhawfi bima kanoo yasna'oon
verses.113: Walaqad jaahum rasoolun minhum fakaththaboohu faakhathahumu al'athabu wahum _th_ alimoon
verses.114: Fakuloo mimma razaqakumu Allahu halalan tayyiban wa  shkuroo ni'mata Allahi in kuntum iyyahu ta'budoon
verses.115: Innamaharrama 'alaykumu almaytata wa  ddama walahma alkhinzeeri wama ohilla lighayri Allahi bihi famani idturra ghayra baghin wala 'adin fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.116: Wala taqooloo lima tasifu asinatukumu alkathiba hathahalalun wahathaharamun litaftaroo 'ala Allahi alkathiba inna allatheena yaftaroona 'ala Allahi alkathiba la yuflihoon
verses.118: Wa'ala allatheena hadoo harramna ma qasasna 'alayka min qablu wama _th_ alamnahum walakin kanoo anfusahum ya _th_ limoon
verses.119: Thumma inna rabbaka lillatheena 'amiloo a  ssooa bijahalatin thumma taboo min ba'di thalika waaslahoo inna rabbaka min ba'diha laghafoorun raheem
verses.120: Inna ibraheema kana ommatan qanitan lillahi haneefan walam yaku mina almushrikeen
verses.121: Shakiran lian'umihi ijtabahu wahadahu ilasiratin mustaqeem
verses.122: Waataynahu fee a  ddunyahasanatan wainnahu fee alakhirati lamina a  ssaliheen
verses.123: Thumma awhayna ilayka ani ittabi' millata ibraheema haneefan wama kana mina almushrikeen
verses.124: Innama ju'ila a  ssabtu 'ala allatheena ikhtalafoo feehi wainna rabbaka layahkumu baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
verses.125: Od'u ila sabeeli rabbika bi  lhikmati wa  lmaw'i _th_ ati alhasanati wajadilhum bi  llatee hiya ahsanu inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabeelihi wahuwa a'lamu bi  lmuhtadeen
verses.126: Wain 'aqabtum fa'aqiboo bimithli ma 'ooqibtum bihi walain sabartum lahuwa khayrun li  ssabireen
verses.127: Wa  sbir wamasabruka illa bi  llahi wala tahzan 'alayhim wala taku fee dayqin mimma yamkuroon
verses.128: Inna Allaha ma'a allatheena ittaqaw wa  llatheena hum muhsinoon

verses.1: Subhana allathee asra bi'abdihi laylan mina almasjidi alharami ila almasjidi alaqsa allathee baraknahawlahu linuriyahu min ayatina innahu huwa a  ssamee'u albaseer
verses.2: Waatayna moosa alkitaba waja'anahu hudan libanee israeela alla tattakhithoo min doonee wakeela
verses.3: Thurriyyata man hamana ma'a noohin innahu kana 'abdan shakoora
verses.4: Waqadayna ila banee israeela fee alkitabi latufsidunna fee alardi marratayni walata'lunna 'uluwwan kabeera
verses.5: Faitha jaa wa'du oolahuma ba'athna 'alaykum 'ibadan lana olee basin shadeedin fajasoo khilala a  ddiyari wakana wa'dan maf'oola
verses.6: Thumma radadna lakumu alkarrata 'alayhim waamdadnakum biamwalin wabaneena waja'anakum akthara nafeera
verses.7: In ahsantum ahsantum lianfusikum wain asatum falaha faitha jaa wa'du alakhirati liyasoooo wujoohakum waliyadkhuloo almasjida kama dakhaloohu awwala marratin waliyutabbiroo ma 'alaw tatbeera
verses.8: 'asa rabbukum an yarhamakum wain 'udtum 'udna waja'ana jahannama lilkafireena haseera
verses.9: Inna hatha alqurana yahdee lillatee hiya aqwamu wayubashshiru almumineena allatheena ya'maloona a  ssalihati anna lahum ajran kabeera
verses.10: Waanna allatheena la yuminoona bi  lakhirati a'tadna lahum 'athaban aleema
verses.11: Wayad'u alinsanu bi  shsharri du'aahu bi  lkhayri wakana alinsanu 'ajoola
verses.12: Waja'ana allayla wa  nnahara ayatayni famahawnaayata allayli waja'anaayata a  nnahari mubsiratan litabtaghoo fadlan min rabbikum walita'lamoo 'adada a  ssineena wa  lhisaba wakulla shayin fassanahu tafseela
verses.13: Wakulla insanin azamnahu tairahu fee 'unuqihi wanukhriju lahu yawma alqiyamati kitaban yalqahu manshoora
verses.14: Iqra kitabaka kafa binafsika alyawma 'alayka haseeba
verses.15: Mani ihtada fainnama yahtadee linafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu 'alayha wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra wama kunna mu'aththibeena hatta nab'atha rasoola
verses.16: Waitha aradna an nuhlika qaryatan amarna mutrafeeha fafasaqoo feeha fahaqqa 'alayha alqawlu fadammarnaha tadmeera
verses.17: Wakam ahlakna mina alqurooni min ba'di noohin wakafa birabbika bithunoobi 'ibadihi khabeeran baseera
verses.18: Man kana yureedu al'ajilata 'ajjana lahu feeha ma nashao liman nureedu thumma ja'ana lahu jahannama yaslaha mathmooman madhoora
verses.19: Waman arada alakhirata wasa'a laha sa'yaha wahuwa muminun faolaika kana sa'yuhum mashkoora
verses.20: Kullan numiddu haolai wahaolai min 'atai rabbika wama kana 'atao rabbika mah _th_ oora
verses.21: On _th_ ur kayfa faddana ba'dahum 'ala ba'din walalakhiratu akbaru darajatin waakbaru tafdeela
verses.22: La taj'al ma'a Allahi ilahan akhara fataq'uda mathmooman makhthoola
verses.23: Waqada rabbuka alla ta'budoo illa iyyahu wabi  lwalidayni ihsanan imma yablughanna 'indaka alkibara ahaduhuma aw kilahuma fala taqul lahuma offin wala tanharhuma waqul lahuma qawlan kareema
verses.24: Wa  khfid lahuma janaha a  ththulli mina a  rrahmati waqul rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayanee sagheera
verses.25: Rabbukum a'lamu bima fee nufoosikum in takoonoo saliheena fainnahu kana lilawwabeena ghafoora
verses.26: Waati tha alqurbahaqqahu wa  lmiskeena wa  bna a  ssabeeli wala tubaththir tabtheera
verses.27: Inna almubaththireena kanoo ikhwana a  shshayateeni wakana a  shshaytanu lirabbihi kafoora
verses.28: Waimma tu'ridanna 'anhumu ibtighaa rahmatin min rabbika tarjooha faqul lahum qawlan maysoora
verses.29: Wala taj'al yadaka maghloolatan ila 'unuqika wala tabsutha kulla albasti fataq'uda malooman mahsoora
verses.30: Inna rabbaka yabsutu a  rrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru innahu kana bi'ibadihi khabeeran baseera
verses.31: Wala taqtuloo awladakum khashyata imlaqin nahnu narzuquhum waiyyakum inna qatlahum kana khitan kabeera
verses.32: Wala taqraboo a  zzina innahu kana fahishatan wasaa sabeela
verses.33: Wala taqtuloo a  nnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bi  lhaqqi waman qutila ma _th_ looman faqad ja'ana liwaliyyihi sultanan fala yusrif fee alqatli innahu kana mansoora
verses.34: Wala taqraboo mala alyateemi illa bi  llatee hiya ahsanu hatta yablugha ashuddahu waawfoo bi  l'ahdi inna al'ahda kana masoola
verses.35: Waawfoo alkayla itha kiltum wazinoo bi  lqistasi almustaqeemi thalika khayrun waahsanu taweela
verses.36: Wala taqfu ma laysa laka bihi 'ilmun inna a  ssam'a wa  lbasara wa  lfuada kullu olaika kana 'anhu masoola
verses.37: Wala tamshi fee alardi marahan innaka lan takhriqa alarda walan tablugha aljibala toola
verses.38: Kullu thalika kana sayyiohu 'inda rabbika makrooha
verses.39: Thalika mimma awha ilayka rabbuka mina alhikmati wala taj'al ma'a Allahi ilahan akhara fatulqa fee jahannama malooman madhoora
verses.40: Afaasfakum rabbukum bi  lbaneena wa  ttakhatha mina almalaikati inathan innakum lataqooloona qawlan 'a _th_ eema
verses.41: Walaqad sarrafna fee hatha alqurani liyaththakkaroo wama yazeeduhum illa nufoora
verses.42: Qul law kana ma'ahu alihatun kama yaqooloona ithan la  btaghaw ilathee al'arshi sabeela
verses.43: Subhanahu wata'ala 'amma yaqooloona 'uluwwan kabeera
verses.44: Tusabbihu lahu a  ssamawatu a  ssab'u wa  lardu waman feehinna wain min shayin illa yusabbihu bihamdihi walakin la tafqahoona tasbeehahum innahu kana haleeman ghafoora
verses.45: Waitha qarata alqurana ja'ana baynaka wabayna allatheena la yuminoona bi  lakhirati hijaban mastoora
verses.46: Waja'ana 'ala quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wafee athanihim waqran waithathakarta rabbaka fee alqurani wahdahu wallaw 'ala adbarihim nufoora
verses.47: Nahnu a'lamu bima yastami'oona bihi ith yastami'oona ilayka waith hum najwa ith yaqoolu a  _thth_ alimoona in tattabi'oona illa rajulan mashoora
verses.48: On _th_ ur kayfa daraboo laka alamthala fadalloo fala yastatee'oona sabeela
verses.49: Waqaloo aitha kunna 'i _th_ aman warufatan ainna lamab'oothoona khalqan jadeeda
verses.50: Qul koonoo hijaratan aw hadeeda
verses.51: Aw khalqan mimma yakburu fee sudoorikum fasayaqooloona man yu'eeduna quli allathee fatarakum awwala marratin fasayunghidoona ilayka ruoosahum wayaqooloona mata huwa qul 'asa an yakoona qareeba
verses.52: Yawma yad'ookum fatastajeeboona bihamdihi wata _th_ unnoona in labithtum illa qaleela
verses.53: Waqul li'ibadee yaqooloo allatee hiya ahsanu inna a  shshaytana yanzaghu baynahum inna a  shshaytana kana lilinsani 'aduwwan mubeena
verses.54: Rabbukum a'lamu bikum in yasha yarhamkum aw in yasha yu'aththibkum wama arsanaka 'alayhim wakeela
verses.55: Warabbuka a'lamu biman fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi walaqad faddana ba'da a  nnabiyyeena 'ala ba'din waatayna dawooda zaboora
verses.56: Quli od'u allatheena za'amtum min doonihi fala yamlikoona kashfa a  ddurri 'ankum wala tahweela
verses.57: Olaika allatheena yad'oona yabtaghoona ila rabbihimu alwaseelata ayyuhum aqrabu wayarjoona rahmatahu wayakhafoona 'athabahu inna 'athaba rabbika kana mahthoora
verses.58: Wain min qaryatin illa nahnu muhlikooha qabla yawmi alqiyamati aw mu'aththibooha 'athaban shadeedan kana thalika fee alkitabi mastoora
verses.59: Wama mana'ana an nursila bi  layati illa an kaththaba biha alawwaloona waatayna thamooda a  nnaqata mubsiratan fa _th_ alamoo biha wama nursilu bi  layati illa takhweefa
verses.60: Waith qulna laka inna rabbaka ahata bi  nnasi wama ja'ana a  rruya allatee araynaka illa fitnatan li  nnasi wa  shshajarata almal'oonata fee alqurani wanukhawwifuhum fama yazeeduhum illatughyanan kabeera
verses.61: Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa qala aasjudu liman khalaqta teena
verses.62: Qala araaytaka hatha allathee karramta 'alayya lain akhkhartani ila yawmi alqiyamati laahtanikanna thurriyyatahu illa qaleela
verses.63: Qala ithhab faman tabi'aka minhum fainna jahannama jazaokum jazaan mawfoora
verses.64: Wa  stafziz mani istata'ta minhum bisawtika waajlib 'alayhim bikhaylika warajlika washarikhum fee alamwali wa  lawladi wa'idhum wama ya'iduhumu a  shshaytanu illa ghuroora
verses.65: Inna 'ibadee laysa laka 'alayhim sultanun wakafa birabbika wakeela
verses.66: Rabbukumu allathee yuzjee lakumu alfulka fee albahri litabtaghoo min fadlihi innahu kana bikum raheema
verses.67: Waitha massakumu a  ddurru fee albahri dalla man tad'oona illa iyyahu falamma najjakum ila albarri a'radtum wakana alinsanu kafoora
verses.68: Afaamintum an yakhsifa bikum janiba albarri aw yursila 'alaykum hasiban thumma la tajidoo lakum wakeela
verses.69: Am amintum an yu'eedakum feehi taratan okhra fayursila 'alaykum qasifan mina a  rreehi fayughriqakum bima kafartum thumma la tajidoo lakum 'alayna bihi tabee'a
verses.70: Walaqad karramna banee adama wahamanahum fee albarri wa  lbahri warazaqnahum mina a  ttayyibati wafaddanahum 'ala katheerin mimman khalaqna tafdeela
verses.71: Yawma nad'oo kulla onasin biimamihim faman ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi faolaika yaqraoona kitabahum wala yu _th_ lamoona fateela
verses.72: Waman kana fee hathihi a'ma fahuwa fee alakhirati a'ma waadallu sabeela
verses.73: Wain kadoo layaftinoonaka 'ani allathee awhayna ilayka litaftariya 'alayna ghayrahu waithan la  ttakhathooka khaleela
verses.74: Walawla an thabbatnaka laqad kidta tarkanu ilayhim shayan qaleela
verses.75: Ithan laathaqnaka di'fa alhayati wadi'fa almamati thumma la tajidu laka 'alayna naseera
verses.76: Wain kadoo layastafizzoonaka mina alardi liyukhrijooka minha waithan la yalbathoona khilafaka illa qaleela
verses.77: Sunnata man qad arsana qablaka min rusulina wala tajidu lisunnatina tahweela
verses.78: Aqimi a  ssalata lidulooki a  shshamsi ila ghasaqi allayli waqurana alfajri inna qurana alfajri kana mashhooda
verses.79: Wamina allayli fatahajjad bihi nafilatan laka 'asa an yab'athaka rabbuka maqaman mahmooda
verses.80: Waqul rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqin waakhrijnee mukhraja sidqin wa  j'al lee min ladunka sultanan naseera
verses.81: Waqul jaa alhaqqu wazahaqa albatilu inna albatila kana zahooqa
verses.82: Wanunazzilu mina alqurani ma huwa shifaon warahmatun lilmumineena wala yazeedu a  _thth_ alimeena illa khasara
verses.83: Waitha an'amna 'ala alinsani a'rada wanaa bijanibihi waitha massahu a  shsharru kana yaoosa
verses.84: Qul kullun ya'malu 'ala shakilatihi farabbukum a'lamu biman huwa ahda sabeela
verses.85: Wayasaloonaka 'ani a  rroohi quli a  rroohu min amri rabbee wama ooteetum mina al'ilmi illa qaleela
verses.86: Walain shina lanathhabanna bi  llathee awhayna ilayka thumma la tajidu laka bihi 'alayna wakeela
verses.87: Illa rahmatan min rabbika inna fadlahu kana 'alayka kabeera
verses.88: Qul laini ijtama'ati alinsu wa  ljinnu 'ala an yatoo bimithli hatha alqurani la yatoona bimithlihi walaw kana ba'duhum liba'din _th_ aheera
verses.89: Walaqad sarrafna li  nnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin faaba aktharu a  nnasi illa kufoora
verses.90: Waqaloo lan numina laka hatta tafjura lana mina alardi yanboo'a
verses.91: Aw takoona laka jannatun min nakheelin wa'inabin fatufajjira alanhara khilalaha tafjeera
verses.92: Aw tusqita a  ssamaa kama za'amta 'alayna kisafan aw tatiya bi  llahi wa  lmalaikati qabeela
verses.93: Aw yakoona laka baytun min zukhrufin aw tarqa fee a  ssamai walan numina liruqiyyika hatta tunazzila 'alayna kitaban naqraohu qul subhana rabbee hal kuntu illa basharan rasoola
verses.94: Wama mana'a a  nnasa an yuminoo ith jaahumu alhuda illa an qaloo aba'atha Allahu basharan rasoola
verses.95: Qul law kana fee alardi malaikatun yamshoona mutmainneena lanazzana 'alayhim mina a  ssamai malakan rasoola
verses.96: Qul kafa bi  llahi shaheedan baynee wabaynakum innahu kana bi'ibadihi khabeeran baseera
verses.97: Waman yahdi Allahu fahuwa almuhtadi waman yudlil falan tajida lahum awliyaa min doonihi wanahshuruhum yawma alqiyamati 'ala wujoohihim 'umyan wabukman wasumman mawahum jahannamu kullama khabat zidnahum sa'eera
verses.98: Thalika jazaohum biannahum kafaroo biayatina waqaloo aitha kunna 'i _th_ aman warufatan ainna lamab'oothoona khalqan jadeeda
verses.99: Awalam yaraw anna Allaha allathee khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda qadirun 'ala an yakhluqa mithlahum waja'ala lahum ajalan la rayba feehi faaba a  _thth_ alimoona illa kufoora
verses.100: Qul law antum tamlikoona khazaina rahmati rabbee ithan laamsaktum khashyata alinfaqi wakana alinsanu qatoora
verses.101: Walaqad atayna moosa tis'a ayatin bayyinatin fa  sal banee israeela ith jaahum faqala lahu fir'awnu innee laa _th_ unnuka ya moosa mashoora
verses.102: Qala laqad 'alimta ma anzala haolai illa rabbu a  ssamawati wa  lardi basaira wainnee laa _th_ unnuka ya fir'awnu mathboora
verses.103: Faarada an yastafizzahum mina alardi faaghraqnahu waman ma'ahu jamee'a
verses.104: Waqulna min ba'dihi libanee israeela oskunoo alarda faitha jaa wa'du alakhirati jina bikum lafeefa
verses.105: Wabi  lhaqqi anzanahu wabi  lhaqqi nazala wama arsanaka illa mubashshiran wanatheera
verses.106: Waquranan faraqnahu litaqraahu 'ala a  nnasi 'ala mukthin wanazzanahu tanzeela
verses.107: Qul aminoo bihi aw la tuminoo inna allatheena ootoo al'ilma min qablihi itha yutla 'alayhim yakhirroona lilathqani sujjada
verses.108: Wayaqooloona subhana rabbina in kana wa'du rabbina lamaf'oola
verses.110: Quli od'oo Allaha awi od'oo a  rrahmana ayyan ma tad'oo falahu alasmao alhusna wala tajhar bisalatika wala tukhafit biha wa  btaghi bayna thalika sabeela
verses.111: Waquli alhamdu lillahi allathee lam yattakhith waladan walam yakun lahu shareekun fee almulki walam yakun lahu waliyyun mina a  ththulli wakabbirhu takbeera

verses.1: Alhamdu lillahi allathee anzala 'ala 'abdihi alkitaba walam yaj'al lahu 'iwaja
verses.2: Qayyiman liyunthira basan shadeedan min ladunhu wayubashshira almumineena allatheena ya'maloona a  ssalihati anna lahum ajran hasana
verses.3: Makitheena feehi abada
verses.4: Wayunthira allatheena qaloo ittakhatha Allahu walada
verses.5: Ma lahum bihi min 'ilmin wala liabaihim kaburat kalimatan takhruju min afwahihim in yaqooloona illa kathiba
verses.6: Fala'allaka bakhi'un nafsaka 'alaatharihim in lam yuminoo bihatha alhadeethi asafa
verses.7: Inna ja'ana ma 'ala alardi zeenatan laha linabluwahum ayyuhum ahsanu 'amala
verses.8: Wainna laja'iloona ma 'alayhasa'eedan juruza
verses.9: Am hasibta anna ashaba alkahfi wa  rraqeemi kanoo min ayatina 'ajaba
verses.10: Ith awa alfityatu ila alkahfi faqaloo rabbanaatina min ladunka rahmatan wahayyi lana min amrina rashada
verses.11: Fadarabna 'alaathanihim fee alkahfi sineena 'adada
verses.12: Thumma ba'athnahum lina'lama ayyu alhizbayni ahsa lima labithoo amada
verses.13: Nahnu naqussu 'alayka nabaahum bi  lhaqqi innahum fityatun amanoo birabbihim wazidnahum huda
verses.14: Warabatna 'ala quloobihim ith qamoo faqaloo rabbuna rabbu a  ssamawati wa  lardi lan nad'uwa min doonihi ilahan laqad qulna ithan shatata
verses.15: Haolai qawmuna ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan lawla yatoona 'alayhim bisultanin bayyinin faman a _th_ lamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allahi kathiba
verses.16: Waithi i'tazatumoohum wama ya'budoona illa Allaha fawoo ila alkahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum min rahmatihi wayuhayyi lakum min amrikum mirfaqa
verses.17: Watara a  shshamsa ithatala'at tazawaru 'an kahfihim thata alyameeni waitha gharabat taqriduhum thata a  shshimali wahum fee fajwatin minhu thalika min ayati Allahi man yahdi Allahu fahuwa almuhtadi waman yudlil falan tajida lahu waliyyan murshida
verses.18: Watahsabuhum ayqa _th_ an wahum ruqoodun wanuqallibuhum thata alyameeni wathata a  shshimali wakalbuhum basitun thira'ayhi bi  lwaseedi lawi ittala'ta 'alayhim lawallayta minhum firaran walamulita minhum ru'ba
verses.19: Wakathalika ba'athnahum liyatasaaloo baynahum qala qailun minhum kam labithtum qaloo labithna yawman aw ba'da yawmin qaloo rabbukum a'lamu bima labithtum fa  b'athoo ahadakum biwariqikum hathihi ila almadeenati falyan _th_ ur ayyuha azkata'aman falyatikum birizqin minhu walyatalattaf wala yush'iranna bikum ahada
verses.20: Innahum in ya _th_ haroo 'alaykum yarjumookum aw yu'eedookum fee millatihim walan tuflihoo ithan abada
verses.21: Wakathalika a'tharna 'alayhim liya'lamoo anna wa'da Allahi haqqun waanna a  sa'ata la rayba feeha ith yatanaza'oona baynahum amrahum faqaloo ibnoo 'alayhim bunyanan rabbuhum a'lamu bihim qala allatheena ghalaboo 'ala amrihim lanattakhithanna 'alayhim masjida
verses.22: Sayaqooloona thalathatun rabi'uhum kalbuhum wayaqooloona khamsatun sadisuhum kalbuhum rajman bi  lghaybi wayaqooloona sab'atun wathaminuhum kalbuhum qul rabbee a'lamu bi'iddatihim ma ya'lamuhum illa qaleelun fala tumari feehim illa miraan _th_ ahiran wala tastafti feehim minhum ahada
verses.23: Wala taqoolanna lishayin innee fa'ilun thalika ghada
verses.24: Illa an yashaa Allahu wa  thkur rabbaka itha naseeta waqul 'asa an yahdiyani rabbee liaqraba min hatha rashada
verses.25: Walabithoo fee kahfihim thalatha miatin sineena wa  zdadoo tis'a
verses.26: Quli Allahu a'lamu bima labithoo lahu ghaybu a  ssamawati wa  lardi absir bihi waasmi' ma lahum min doonihi min waliyyin wala yushriku fee hukmihi ahada
verses.27: Wa  tlu ma oohiya ilayka min kitabi rabbika la mubaddila likalimatihi walan tajida min doonihi multahada
verses.28: Wa  sbir nafsaka ma'a allatheena yad'oona rabbahum bi  lghadati wa  l'ashiyyi yureedoona wajhahu wala ta'du 'aynaka 'anhum tureedu zeenata alhayati a  ddunya wala tuti' man aghfana qalbahu 'an thikrina wa  ttaba'a hawahu wakana amruhu furuta
verses.29: Waquli alhaqqu min rabbikum faman shaa falyumin waman shaa falyakfur inna a'tadna li  _thth_ alimeena naran ahata bihim suradiquha wain yastagheethoo yughathoo bimain ka  lmuhli yashwee alwujooha bisa a  shsharabu wasaat murtafaqa
verses.30: Inna allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati inna la nudee'u ajra man ahsana 'amala
verses.31: Olaika lahum jannatu 'adnin tajree min tahtihimu alanharu yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin way  lbasoona thiyaban khudran min sundusin waistabraqin muttakieena feeha 'ala alaraiki ni'ma a  ththawabu wahasunat murtafaqa
verses.32: Wa  drib lahum mathalan rajulayni ja'ana liahadihima jannatayni min a'nabin wahafafnahuma binakhlin waja'ana baynahuma zar'a
verses.33: Kilta aljannatayni atat okulaha walam ta _th_ lim minhu shayan wafajjarna khilalahuma nahara
verses.34: Wakana lahu thamarun faqala lisahibihi wahuwa yuhawiruhu ana aktharu minka malan waa'azzu nafara
verses.35: Wadakhala jannatahu wahuwa _th_ alimun linafsihi qala ma a _th_ unnu an tabeeda hathihi abada
verses.36: Wama a _th_ unnu a  ssa'ata qaimatan walain rudidtu ila rabbee laajidanna khayran minha munqalaba
verses.37: Qala lahu sahibuhu wahuwa yuhawiruhu akafarta bi  llathee khalaqaka min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma sawwaka rajula
verses.38: Lakinna huwa Allahu rabbee wala oshriku birabbee ahada
verses.39: Walawla ith dakhata jannataka qulta ma shaa Allahu la quwwata illa bi  llahi in tarani ana aqalla minka malan wawalada
verses.40: Fa'asa rabbee an yutiyani khayran min jannatika wayursila 'alayhahusbanan mina a  ssamai fatusbiha sa'eedan zalaqa
verses.41: Aw yusbiha maoha ghawran falan tastatee'a lahu talaba
verses.42: Waoheeta bithamarihi faasbaha yuqallibu kaffayhi 'ala ma anfaqa feeha wahiya khawiyatun 'ala 'urooshiha wayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oshrik birabbee ahada
verses.43: Walam takun lahu fiatun yansuroonahu min dooni Allahi wama kana muntasira
verses.44: Hunalika alwalayatu lillahi alhaqqi huwa khayrun thawaban wakhayrun 'uqba
verses.45: Wa  drib lahum mathala alhayati a  ddunya kamain anzanahu mina a  ssamai fa  khtalata bihi nabatu alardi faasbaha hasheeman tathroohu a  rriyahu wakana Allahu 'ala kulli shayin muqtadira
verses.46: Almalu wa  lbanoona zeenatu alhayati a  ddunya wa  lbaqiyatu a  ssalihatu khayrun 'inda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun amala
verses.47: Wayawma nusayyiru aljibala watara alarda barizatan wahasharnahum falam nughadir minhum ahada
verses.48: Wa'uridoo 'ala rabbika saffan laqad jitumoona kama khalaqnakum awwala marratin bal za'amtum allan naj'ala lakum maw'ida
verses.49: Wawudi'a alkitabu fatara almujrimeena mushfiqeena mimma feehi wayaqooloona ya waylatana ma lihatha alkitabi la yughadiru sagheeratan wala kabeeratan illa ahsaha wawajadoo ma 'amiloo hadiran wala ya _th_ limu rabbuka ahada
verses.50: Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa kana mina aljinni fafasaqa 'an amri rabbihi afatattakhithoonahu wathurriyyatahu awliyaa min doonee wahum lakum 'aduwwun bisa li  _thth_ alimeena badala
verses.51: Ma ashhadtuhum khalqa a  ssamawati wa  lardi wala khalqa anfusihim wama kuntu muttakhitha almudilleena 'aduda
verses.52: Wayawma yaqoolu nadoo shurakaiya allatheena za'amtum fada'awhum falam yastajeeboo lahum waja'ana baynahum mawbiqa
verses.53: Waraa almujrimoona a  nnara fa _th_ annoo annahum muwaqi'ooha walam yajidoo 'anha masrifa
verses.54: Walaqad sarrafna fee hatha alqurani li  nnasi min kulli mathalin wakana alinsanu akthara shayin jadala
verses.55: Wama mana'a a  nnasa an yuminoo ith jaahumu alhuda wayastaghfiroo rabbahum illa an tatiyahum sunnatu alawwaleena aw yatiyahumu al'athabu qubula
verses.56: Wama nursilu almursaleena illa mubashshireena wamunthireena wayujadilu allatheena kafaroo bi  lbatili liyudhidoo bihi alhaqqa wa  ttakhathoo ayatee wama onthiroo huzuwa
verses.57: Waman a _th_ lamu mimman thukkira biayati rabbihi faa'rada 'anha wanasiya ma qaddamat yadahu inna ja'ana 'ala quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wafee athanihim waqran wain tad'uhum ila alhuda falan yahtadoo ithan abada
verses.58: Warabbuka alghafooru thoo a  rrahmati law yuakhithuhum bima kasaboo la'ajjala lahumu al'athaba bal lahum maw'idun lan yajidoo min doonihi mawila
verses.59: Watilka alqura ahlaknahum lamma _th_ alamoo waja'ana limahlikihim maw'ida
verses.60: Waith qala moosa lifatahu la abrahu hatta ablugha majma'a albahrayni aw amdiya huquba
verses.61: Falamma balagha majma'a baynihima nasiyahootahuma fa  ttakhatha sabeelahu fee albahri saraba
verses.62: Falamma jawaza qala lifatahu atina ghadaana laqad laqeena min safarina hatha nasaba
verses.63: Qala araayta ith awayna ila a  ssakhrati fainnee naseetu alhoota wama ansaneehu illa a  shshaytanu an athkurahu wa  ttakhatha sabeelahu fee albahri 'ajaba
verses.64: Qala thalika ma kunna nabghi fa  rtadda 'alaatharihima qasasa
verses.65: Fawajada 'abdan min 'ibadinaataynahu rahmatan min 'indina wa'allamnahu min ladunna 'ilma
verses.66: Qala lahu moosa hal attabi'uka 'ala an tu'allimani mimma 'ullimta rushda
verses.67: Qala innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabra
verses.68: Wakayfa tasbiru 'ala ma lam tuhit bihi khubra
verses.69: Qala satajidunee in shaa Allahu sabiran wala a'see laka amra
verses.70: Qala faini ittaba'tanee fala tasanee 'an shayin hatta ohditha laka minhu thikra
verses.71: Fa  ntalaqahatta itha rakiba fee a  ssafeenati kharaqaha qala akharaqtaha litughriqa ahlaha laqad jita shayan imra
verses.72: Qala alam aqul innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabra
verses.73: Qala la tuakhithnee bima naseetu wala turhiqnee min amree 'usra
verses.74: Fa  ntalaqahatta itha laqiya ghulaman faqatalahu qala aqatata nafsan zakiyyatan bighayri nafsin laqad jita shayan nukra
verses.75: Qala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabra
verses.76: Qala in saatuka 'an shayin ba'daha fala tusahibnee qad balaghta min ladunnee 'uthra
verses.77: Fa  ntalaqahatta itha ataya ahla qaryatin istat'ama ahlaha faabaw an yudayyifoohuma fawajada feeha jidaran yureedu an yanqadda faaqamahu qala law shita la  ttakhathta 'alayhi ajra
verses.78: Qala hatha firaqu baynee wabaynika saonabbioka bitaweeli ma lam tastati' 'alayhi sabra
verses.79: Amma a  ssafeenatu fakanat limasakeena ya'maloona fee albahri faaradtu an a'eebaha wakana waraahum malikun yakhuthu kulla safeenatin ghasba
verses.80: Waamma alghulamu fakana abawahu muminayni fakhasheena an yurhiqahumatughyanan wakufra
verses.81: Faaradna an yubdilahuma rabbuhuma khayran minhu zakatan waaqraba ruhma
verses.82: Waamma aljidaru fakana lighulamayni yateemayni fee almadeenati wakana tahtahu kanzun lahuma wakana aboohumasalihan faarada rabbuka an yablugha ashuddahuma wayastakhrija kanzahuma rahmatan min rabbika wama fa'atuhu 'an amree thalika taweelu ma lam tasti' 'alayhi sabra
verses.83: Wayasaloonaka 'an thee alqarnayni qul saatloo 'alaykum minhu thikra
verses.84: Inna makkanna lahu fee alardi waataynahu min kulli shayin sababa
verses.85: Faatba'a sababa
verses.86: Hatta itha balagha maghriba a  shshamsi wajadaha taghrubu fee 'aynin hamiatin wawajada 'indaha qawman qulna yatha alqarnayni imma an tu'aththiba waimma an tattakhitha feehim husna
verses.87: Qala amma man _th_ alama fasawfa nu'aththibuhu thumma yuraddu ila rabbihi fayu'aththibuhu 'athaban nukra
verses.88: Waamma man amana wa'amila salihan falahu jazaan alhusna wasanaqoolu lahu min amrina yusra
verses.89: Thumma atba'a sababa
verses.90: Hatta itha balagha matli'a a  shshamsi wajadaha tatlu'u 'ala qawmin lam naj'al lahum min dooniha sitra
verses.91: Kathalika waqad ahatna bima ladayhi khubra
verses.92: Thumma atba'a sababa
verses.93: Hatta itha balagha bayna a  ssaddayni wajada min doonihima qawman la yakadoona yafqahoona qawla
verses.94: Qaloo yatha alqarnayni inna yajooja wamajooja mufsidoona fee alardi fahal naj'alu laka kharjan 'ala an taj'ala baynana wabaynahum sadda
verses.95: Qala ma makkannee feehi rabbee khayrun faa'eenoonee biquwwatin aj'al baynakum wabaynahum radma
verses.96: Atoonee zubara alhadeedi hatta itha sawa bayna a  sadafayni qala onfukhoo hatta itha ja'alahu naran qala atoonee ofrigh 'alayhi qitra
verses.97: Fama ista'oo an ya _th_ haroohu wama istata'oo lahu naqba
verses.98: Qala hatha rahmatun min rabbee faitha jaa wa'du rabbee ja'alahu dakkaa wakana wa'du rabbee haqqa
verses.99: Watarakna ba'dahum yawmaithin yamooju fee ba'din wanufikha fee a  ssoori fajama'nahum jam'a
verses.101: Allatheena kanat a'yunuhum fee ghitain 'an thikree wakanoo la yastatee'oona sam'a
verses.102: Afahasiba allatheena kafaroo an yattakhithoo 'ibadee min doonee awliyaa inna a'tadna jahannama lilkafireena nuzula
verses.103: Qul hal nunabbiokum bi  lakhsareena a'mala
verses.104: Allatheena dalla sa'yuhum fee alhayati a  ddunya wahum yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona sun'a
verses.105: Olaika allatheena kafaroo biayati rabbihim waliqaihi fahabitat a'maluhum fala nuqeemu lahum yawma alqiyamati wazna
verses.106: Thalika jazaohum jahannamu bima kafaroo wa  ttakhathoo ayatee warusulee huzuwa
verses.107: Inna allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati kanat lahum jannatu alfirdawsi nuzula
verses.109: Qul law kana albahru midadan likalimati rabbee lanafida albahru qabla an tanfada kalimatu rabbee walaw jina bimithlihi madada
verses.110: Qul innama ana basharun mithlukum yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun faman kana yarjoo liqaa rabbihi falya'mal 'amalan salihan wala yushrik bi'ibadati rabbihi ahada

verses.3: Ith nada rabbahu nidaan khafiyya
verses.4: Qala rabbi innee wahana al'a _th_ mu minnee wa  shta'ala a  rrasu shayban walam akun bidu'aika rabbi shaqiyya
verses.5: Wainnee khiftu almawaliya min waraee wakanati imraatee 'aqiran fahab lee min ladunka waliyya
verses.6: Yarithunee wayarithu min ali ya'qooba wa  j'alhu rabbi radiyya
verses.7: Ya zakariyya inna nubashshiruka bighulamin ismuhu yahya lam naj'al lahu min qablu samiyya
verses.8: Qala rabbi anna yakoonu lee ghulamun wakanati imraatee 'aqiran waqad balaghtu mina alkibari 'itiyya
verses.9: Qala kathalika qala rabbuka huwa 'alayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shaya
verses.10: Qala rabbi ij'al lee ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima a  nnasa thalatha layalin sawiyya
verses.11: Fakharaja 'ala qawmihi mina almihrabi faawha ilayhim an sabbihoo bukratan wa'ashiyya
verses.12: Ya yahya khuthi alkitaba biquwwatin waataynahu alhukma sabiyya
verses.13: Wahananan min ladunna wazakatan wakana taqiyya
verses.14: Wabarran biwalidayhi walam yakun jabbaran 'asiyya
verses.15: Wasalamun 'alayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamootu wayawma yub'athu hayya
verses.16: Wa  thkur fee alkitabi maryama ithi intabathat min ahliha makanan sharqiyya
verses.17: Fa  ttakhathat min doonihim hijaban faarsana ilayha roohana fatamaththala laha basharan sawiyya
verses.18: Qalat innee a'oothu bi  rrahmani minka in kunta taqiyya
verses.19: Qala innama ana rasoolu rabbiki liahaba laki ghulaman zakiyya
verses.20: Qalat anna yakoonu lee ghulamun walam yamsasnee basharun walam aku baghiyya
verses.21: Qala kathaliki qala rabbuki huwa 'alayya hayyinun walinaj'alahu ayatan li  nnasi warahmatan minna wakana amran maqdiyya
verses.22: Fahamalathu fa  ntabathat bihi makanan qasiyya
verses.23: Faajaaha almakhadu ila jith'i a  nnakhlati qalat ya laytanee mittu qabla hatha wakuntu nasyan mansiyya
verses.24: Fanadaha min tahtiha alla tahzanee qad ja'ala rabbuki tahtaki sariyya
verses.25: Wahuzzee ilayki bijith'i a  nnakhlati tusaqit 'alayki rutaban janiyya
verses.26: Fakulee wa  shrabee waqarree 'aynan faimma tarayinna mina albashari ahadan faqoolee innee nathartu li  rrahmani sawman falan okallima alyawma insiyya
verses.27: Faatat bihi qawmaha tahmiluhu qaloo ya maryamu laqad jiti shayan fariyya
verses.28: Ya okhta haroona ma kana abooki imraa sawin wama kanat ommuki baghiyya
verses.29: Faasharat ilayhi qaloo kayfa nukallimu man kana fee almahdi sabiyya
verses.30: Qala innee 'abdu Allahi ataniya alkitaba waja'alanee nabiyya
verses.31: Waja'alanee mubarakan ayna ma kuntu waawsanee bi  ssalati wa  zzakati ma dumtu hayya
verses.32: Wabarran biwalidatee walam yaj'anee jabbaran shaqiyya
verses.33: Wa  ssalamu 'alayya yawma wulidtu wayawma amootu wayawma ob'athu hayya
verses.34: Thalika 'eesa ibnu maryama qawla alhaqqi allathee feehi yamtaroon
verses.35: Ma kana lillahi an yattakhitha min waladin subhanahu itha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon
verses.36: Wainna Allaha rabbee warabbukum fa  'budoohu hathasiratun mustaqeem
verses.37: Fa  khtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min mashhadi yawmin 'a _th_ eem
verses.38: Asmi' bihim waabsir yawma yatoonana lakini a  _thth_ alimoona alyawma fee dalalin mubeen
verses.39: Waanthirhum yawma alhasrati ith qudiya alamru wahum fee ghaflatin wahum la yuminoon
verses.40: Inna nahnu narithu alarda waman 'alayha wailayna yurja'oon
verses.41: Wa  thkur fee alkitabi ibraheema innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyya
verses.42: Ith qala liabeehi ya abati lima ta'budu ma la yasma'u wala yubsiru wala yughnee 'anka shaya
verses.43: Ya abati innee qad jaanee mina al'ilmi ma lam yatika fa  ttabi'nee ahdika siratan sawiyya
verses.44: Ya abati la ta'budi a  shshaytana inna a  shshaytana kana li  rrahmani 'asiyya
verses.45: Ya abati innee akhafu an yamassaka 'athabun mina a  rrahmani fatakoona li  shshyatani waliyya
verses.46: Qala araghibun anta 'an alihatee ya ibraheemu lain lam tantahi laarjumannaka wa  hjurnee maliyya
verses.47: Qala salamun 'alayka saastaghfiru laka rabbee innahu kana bee hafiyya
verses.48: Waa'tazilukum wama tad'oona min dooni Allahi waad'oo rabbee 'asa alla akoona bidu'ai rabbee shaqiyya
verses.49: Falamma i'tazalahum wama ya'budoona min dooni Allahi wahabna lahu ishaqa waya'qooba wakullan ja'ana nabiyya
verses.50: Wawahabna lahum min rahmatina waja'ana lahum lisana sidqin 'aliyya
verses.51: Wa  thkur fee alkitabi moosa innahu kana mukhlasan wakana rasoolan nabiyya
verses.52: Wanadaynahu min janibi a  ttoori alaymani waqarrabnahu najiyya
verses.53: Wawahabna lahu min rahmatina akhahu haroona nabiyya
verses.54: Wa  thkur fee alkitabi isma'eela innahu kana sadiqa alwa'di wakana rasoolan nabiyya
verses.55: Wakana yamuru ahlahu bi  ssalati wa  zzakati wakana 'inda rabbihi mardiyya
verses.56: Wa  thkur fee alkitabi idreesa innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyya
verses.57: Warafa'nahu makanan 'aliyya
verses.58: Olaika allatheena an'ama Allahu 'alayhim mina a  nnabiyyeena min thurriyyati adama wamimman hamana ma'a noohin wamin thurriyyati ibraheema waisraeela wamimman hadayna wa  jtabayna itha tutla 'alayhim ayatu a  rrahmani kharroo sujjadan wabukiyya
verses.59: Fakhalafa min ba'dihim khalfun ada'oo a  ssalata wa  ttaba'oo a  shshahawati fasawfa yalqawna ghayya
verses.60: Illa man taba waamana wa'amila salihan faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yu _th_ lamoona shaya
verses.61: Jannati 'adnin allatee wa'ada a  rrahmanu 'ibadahu bi  ghaybi innahu kana wa'duhu matiyya
verses.62: La yasma'oona feeha laghwan illa salaman walahum rizquhum feeha bukratan wa'ashiyya
verses.63: Tilka aljannatu allatee noorithu min 'ibadina man kana taqiyya
verses.64: Wama natanazzalu illa biamri rabbika lahu ma bayna aydeena wama khalfana wama bayna thalika wama kana rabbuka nasiyya
verses.65: Rabbu a  ssamawati wa  lardi wama baynahuma fa  'budhu wa  stabir li'ibadatihi hal ta'lamu lahu samiyya
verses.66: Wayaqoolu alinsanu aitha ma mittu lasawfa okhraju hayya

verses.49: Allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bi  lghaybi wahum mina a  ssa'ati mushfiqoon
verses.50: Wahathathikrun mubarakun anzanahu afaantum lahu munkiroon
verses.51: Walaqad atayna ibraheema rushdahu min qablu wakunna bihi 'alimeen
verses.52: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma hathihi a  ttamatheelu allatee antum laha 'akifoon
verses.53: Qaloo wajadnaabaana laha 'abideen
verses.54: Qala laqad kuntum antum waabaokum fee dalalin mubeen
verses.55: Qaloo ajitana bi  lhaqqi am anta mina alla'ibeen
verses.56: Qala bal rabbukum rabbu a  ssamawati wa  lardi allathee fatarahunna waana 'alathalikum mina a  shshahideen
verses.57: Wata  llahi laakeedanna asnamakum ba'da an tuwalloo mudbireen
verses.58: Faja'alahum juthathan illa kabeeran lahum la'allahum ilayhi yarji'oon
verses.59: Qaloo man fa'ala hatha bialihatina innahu lamina a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.60: Qaloo sami'na fatan yathkuruhum yuqalu lahu ibraheem
verses.61: Qaloo fatoo bihi 'ala a'yuni a  nnasi la'allahum yashhadoon
verses.62: Qaloo aanta fa'ata hatha bialihatina ya ibraheem
verses.63: Qala bal fa'alahu kabeeruhum hatha fa  saloohum in kanoo yantiqoon
verses.64: Faraja'oo ila anfusihim faqaloo innakum antumu a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.65: Thumma nukisoo 'ala ruoosihim laqad 'alimta ma haolai yantiqoon
verses.66: Qala afata'budoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfa'ukum shayan wala yadurrukum
verses.67: Offin lakum walima ta'budoona min dooni Allahi afala ta'qiloon
verses.68: Qaloo harriqoohu wa  nsuroo alihatakum in kuntum fa'ileen
verses.69: Qulna ya naru koonee bardan wasalaman 'ala ibraheem
verses.70: Waaradoo bihi kaydan faja'anahumu alakhsareen
verses.71: Wanajjaynahu walootan ila alardi allatee barakna feeha lil'alameen
verses.72: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa waya'qooba nafilatan wakullan ja'anasaliheen
verses.73: Waja'anahum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina waawhayna ilayhim fi'la alkhayrati waiqama a  ssalati waeetaa a  zzakati wakanoo lana 'abideen
verses.74: Walootan ataynahu hukman wa'ilman wanajjaynahu mina alqaryati allatee kanat ta'malu alkhabaitha innahum kanoo qawma sawin fasiqeen
verses.75: Waadkhanahu fee rahmatina innahu mina a  ssaliheen
verses.76: Wanoohan ith nada min qablu fa  stajabna lahu fanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi al'a _th_ eem
verses.77: Wanasarnahu mina alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina innahum kanoo qawma sawin faaghraqnahum ajma'een
verses.78: Wadawooda wasulaymana ith yahkumani fee alharthi ith nafashat feehi ghanamu alqawmi wakunna lihukmihim shahideen
verses.79: Fafahhamnaha sulaymana wakullan ataynahukman wa'ilman wasakhkharna ma'a dawooda aljibala yusabbihna wa  ttayra wakunna fa'ileen
verses.80: Wa'allamnahu san'ata laboosin lakum lituhsinakum min basikum fahal antum shakiroon
verses.81: Walisulaymana a  rreeha 'asifatan tajree biamrihi ila alardi allatee barakna feeha wakunna bikulli shayin 'alimeen
verses.82: Wamina a  shshayateeni man yaghoosoona lahu waya'maloona 'amalan doona thalika wakunna lahum hafi _th_ een
verses.83: Waayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya a  ddurru waanta arhamu a  rrahimeen
verses.84: Fa  stajabna lahu fakashafna ma bihi min durrin waataynahu ahlahu wamithlahum ma'ahum rahmatan min 'indina wathikra lil'abideen
verses.85: Waisma'eela waidreesa watha alkifli kullun mina a  ssabireen
verses.86: Waadkhanahum fee rahmatina innahum mina a  ssaliheen
verses.87: Watha a  nnooni iththahaba mughadiban fa _th_ anna an lan naqdira 'alayhi fanada fee a  _thth_ ulumati an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu mina a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.88: Fa  stajabna lahu wanajjaynahu mina alghammi wakathalika nunjee almumineen
verses.89: Wazakariyya ith nada rabbahu rabbi la tatharnee fardan waanta khayru alwaritheen
verses.90: Fa  stajabna lahu wawahabna lahu yahya waaslahna lahu zawjahu innahum kanoo yusari'oona fee alkhayrati wayad'oonana raghaban warahaban wakanoo lana khashi'een
verses.91: Wa  llatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feeha min roohina waja'anaha wa  bnahaayatan lil'alameen
verses.92: Inna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum fao'budoon
verses.93: Wataqatta'oo amrahum baynahum kullun ilayna raji'oon
verses.94: Faman ya'mal mina a  ssalihati wahuwa muminun fala kufrana lisa'yihi wainna lahu katiboon
verses.95: Waharamun 'ala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarji'oon
verses.96: Hatta itha futihat yajooju wamajooju wahum min kulli hadabin yansiloon
verses.97: Wa  qtaraba alwa'du alhaqqu faitha hiya shakhisatun absaru allatheena kafaroo ya waylana qad kunna fee ghaflatin min hatha bal kunna _th_ alimeen
verses.98: Innakum wama ta'budoona min dooni Allahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridoon
verses.99: Law kana haolai alihatan ma waradooha wakullun feeha khalidoon
verses.100: Lahum feeha zafeerun wahum feeha la yasma'oon
verses.101: Inna allatheena sabaqat lahum minna alhusna olaika 'anha mub'adoon
verses.102: La yasma'oona haseesaha wahum fee ma ishtahat anfusuhum khalidoon
verses.103: La yahzunuhumu alfaza'u alakbaru watatalaqqahumu almalaikatu hatha yawmukumu allathee kuntum too'adoon
verses.104: Yawma natwee a  ssamaa katayyi a  ssijlli lilkutubi kama badana awwala khalqin nu'eeduhu wa'dan 'alayna inna kunna fa'ileen
verses.105: Walaqad katabna fee a  zzaboori min ba'di a  ththikri anna alarda yarithuha 'ibadiya a  ssalihoon
verses.108: Qul innama yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun fahal antum muslimoon
verses.109: Fain tawallaw faqul athantukum 'ala sawain wain adree aqareebun am ba'eedun ma too'adoon
verses.110: Innahu ya'lamu aljahra mina alqawli waya'lamu ma taktumoon
verses.111: Wain adree la'allahu fitnatun lakum wamata'un ilaheen
verses.112: Qala rabbi ohkum bi  lhaqqi warabbuna a  rrahmanu almusta'anu 'ala ma tasifoon

verses.1: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu ittaqoo rabbakum inna zazalata a  ssa'ati shayon 'a _th_ eem
verses.2: Yawma tarawnaha tathhalu kullu murdi'atin 'amma arda'at watada'u kullu thati hamlin hamlaha watara a  nnasa sukara wama hum bisukara walakinna 'athaba Allahi shadeed
verses.3: Wamina a  nnasi man yujadilu fee Allahi bighayri 'ilmin wayattabi'u kulla shaytanin mareed
verses.4: Kutiba 'alayhi annahu man tawallahu faannahu yudilluhu wayahdeehi ila 'athabi a  ssa'eer
verses.5: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu in kuntum fee raybin mina alba'thi fainna khalaqnakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min 'alaqatin thumma min mudghatin mukhallaqatin waghayri mukhallaqatin linubayyina lakum wanuqirru fee alarhami ma nashao ila ajalin musamman thumma nukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum waminkum man yutawaffa waminkum man yuraddu ila arthali al'umuri likayla ya'lama min ba'di 'ilmin shayan watara alarda hamidatan faitha anzana 'alayha almaa ihtazzat warabat waanbatat min kulli zawjin baheej
verses.6: Thalika bianna Allaha huwa alhaqqu waannahu yuhyee almawta waannahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.7: Waanna a  ssa'ata atiyatun la rayba feeha waanna Allaha yab'athu man fee alquboor
verses.8: Wamina a  nnasi man yujadilu fee Allahi bighayri 'ilmin wala hudan wala kitabin muneer
verses.9: Thaniya 'itfihi liyudilla 'an sabeeli Allahi lahu fee a  ddunya khizyun wanutheequhu yawma alqiyamati 'athaba alhareeq
verses.10: Thalika bima qaddamat yadaka waanna Allaha laysa bi _th_ allamin lil'abeed
verses.11: Wamina a  nnasi man ya'budu Allaha 'alaharfin fain asabahu khayrun itmaanna bihi wain asabathu fitnatun inqalaba 'ala wajhihi khasira a  ddunya wa  lakhirata thalika huwa alkhusranu almubeen
verses.12: Yad'oo min dooni Allahi ma la yadurruhu wama la yanfa'uhu thalika huwa a  ddalalu alba'eed
verses.13: Yad'oo laman darruhu aqrabu min naf'ihi labisa almawla walabisa al'asheer
verses.14: Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu inna Allaha yaf'alu ma yureed
verses.15: Man kana ya _th_ unnu an lan yansurahu Allahu fee a  ddunya wa  lakhirati falyamdud bisababin ila a  ssamai thumma liyaqta' falyan _th_ ur hal yuthhibanna kayduhu ma yaghee _th_
verses.16: Wakathalika anzanahu ayatin bayyinatin waanna Allaha yahdee man yureed
verses.17: Inna allatheena amanoo wa  llatheena hadoo wa  ssabieena wa  nnasara wa  lmajoosa wa  llatheena ashrakoo inna Allaha yafsilu baynahum yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha 'ala kulli shayin shaheed
verses.18: Alam tara anna Allaha yasjudu lahu man fee a  ssamawati waman fee alardi wa  shshamsu wa  lqamaru wa  nnujoomu wa  ljibalu wa  shshajaru wa  ddawabbu wakatheerun mina a  nnasi wakatheerun haqqa 'alayhi al'athabu waman yuhini Allahu fama lahu min mukrimin inna Allaha yaf'alu ma yasha
verses.19: Hathani khasmani ikhtasamoo fee rabbihim fa  llatheena kafaroo qutti'at lahum thiyabun min narin yusabbu min fawqi ruoosihimu alhameem
verses.20: Yusharu bihi ma fee butoonihim wa  ljulood
verses.21: Walahum maqami'u min hadeed
verses.22: Kullama aradoo an yakhrujoo minha min ghammin o'eedoo feeha wathooqoo 'athaba alhareeq
verses.23: Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin waluluan walibasuhum feehahareer
verses.24: Wahudoo ila a  ttayyibi mina alqawli wahudoo ilasirati alhameed
verses.25: Inna allatheena kafaroo wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli Allahi wa  lmasjidi alharami allathee ja'anahu li  nnasi sawaan al'akifu feehi wa  lbadi waman yurid feehi biilhadin bi _th_ ulmin nuthiqhu min 'athabin aleem
verses.26: Waith bawwana liibraheema makana albayti an la tushrik bee shayan watahhir baytiya li  ttaifeena wa  lqaimeena wa  rrukka'i a  ssujood
verses.27: Waaththin fee a  nnasi bi  lhajji yatooka rijalan wa'ala kulli damirin yateena min kulli fajjin 'ameeq
verses.28: Liyashhadoo manafi'a lahum wayathkuroo isma Allahi fee ayyamin ma'loomatin 'ala ma razaqahum min baheemati alan'ami fakuloo minha waat'imoo albaisa alfaqeer
verses.29: Thumma lyaqdoo tafathahum walyoofoo nuthoorahum walyattawwafoo bi  lbayti al'ateeq
verses.30: Thalika waman yu'a _thth_ im hurumati Allahi fahuwa khayrun lahu 'inda rabbihi waohillat lakumu alan'amu illa ma yutla 'alaykum fa  jtaniboo a  rrijsa mina alawthani wa  jtaniboo qawla a  zzoor
verses.31: Hunafaa lillahi ghayra mushrikeena bihi waman yushrik bi  llahi fakaannama kharra mina a  ssamai fatakhtafuhu a  ttayru aw tahwee bihi a  rreehu fee makanin saheeq
verses.32: Thalika waman yu'a _thth_ im sha'aira Allahi fainnaha min taqwa alquloob
verses.33: Lakum feeha manafi'u ila ajalin musamman thumma mahilluha ila albayti al'ateeq
verses.34: Walikulli ommatin ja'ana mansakan liyathkuroo isma Allahi 'ala ma razaqahum min baheemati alan'ami failahukum ilahun wahidun falahu aslimoo wabashshiri almukhbiteen
verses.35: Allatheena ithathukira Allahu wajilat quloobuhum wa  ssabireena 'ala ma asabahum wa  lmuqeemee a  ssalati wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoon
verses.36: Wa  lbudna ja'anaha lakum min sha'airi Allahi lakum feeha khayrun fa  thkuroo isma Allahi 'alayhasawaffa faitha wajabat junoobuha fakuloo minha waat'imoo alqani'a wa  lmu'tarra kathalika sakhkharnaha lakum la'allakum tashkuroon
verses.37: Lan yanala Allaha luhoomuha wala dimaoha walakin yanaluhu a  ttaqwa minkum kathalika sakhkharaha lakum litukabbiroo Allaha 'ala ma hadakum wabashshiri almuhsineen
verses.38: Inna Allaha yudafi'u 'ani allatheena amanoo inna Allaha la yuhibbu kulla khawwanin kafoor
verses.39: Othina lillatheena yuqataloona biannahum _th_ ulimoo wainna Allaha 'ala nasrihim laqadeer
verses.40: Allatheena okhrijoo min diyarihim bighayri haqqin illa an yaqooloo rabbuna Allahu walawla daf'u Allahi a  nnasa ba'dahum biba'din lahuddimat sawami'u wabiya'un wasalawatun wamasajidu yuthkaru feeha ismu Allahi katheeran walayansuranna Allahu man yansuruhu inna Allaha laqawiyyun 'azeez
verses.41: Allatheena in makkannahum fee alardi aqamoo a  ssalata waatawoo a  zzakata waamaroo bi  lma'roofi wanahaw 'ani almunkari walillahi 'aqibatu alomoor
verses.42: Wain yukaththibooka faqad kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin wa'adun wathamood
verses.43: Waqawmu ibraheema waqawmu loot
verses.44: Waashabu madyana wakuththiba moosa faamlaytu lilkafireena thumma akhathtuhum fakayfa kana nakeer
verses.45: Fakaayyin min qaryatin ahlaknaha wahiya _th_ alimatun fahiya khawiyatun 'ala 'urooshiha wabirin mu'attalatin waqasrin masheed
verses.46: Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fatakoona lahum quloobun ya'qiloona biha aw athanun yasma'oona biha fainnaha la ta'ma alabsaru walakin ta'ma alquloobu allatee fee a  ssudoor
verses.47: Wayasta'jiloonaka bi  l'athabi walan yukhlifa Allahu wa'dahu wainna yawman 'inda rabbika kaalfi sanatin mimma ta'uddoon
verses.48: Wakaayyin min qaryatin amlaytu laha wahiya _th_ alimatun thumma akhathtuha wailayya almaseer
verses.49: Qul ya ayyuha a  nnasu innama ana lakum natheerun mubeen
verses.50: Fa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareem
verses.51: Wa  llatheena sa'aw fee ayatina mu'ajizeena olaika ashabu aljaheem
verses.52: Wama arsana min qablika min rasoolin wala nabiyyin illa itha tamanna alqa a  shshaytanu fee omniyyatihi fayansakhu Allahu ma yulqee a  shshaytanu thumma yuhkimu Allahu ayatihi wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.53: Liyaj'ala ma yulqee a  shshaytanu fitnatan lillatheena fee quloobihim maradun wa  lqasiyati quloobuhum wainna a  _thth_ alimeena lafee shiqaqin ba'eed
verses.54: Waliya'lama allatheena ootoo al'ilma annahu alhaqqu min rabbika fayuminoo bihi fatukhbita lahu quloobuhum wainna Allaha lahadi allatheena amanoo ilasiratin mustaqeem
verses.55: Wala yazalu allatheena kafaroo fee miryatin minhu hatta tatiyahumu a  ssa'atu baghtatan aw yatiyahum 'athabu yawmin 'aqeem
verses.56: Almulku yawmaithin lillahi yahkumu baynahum fa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati fee jannati a  nna'eem
verses.57: Wa  llatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina faolaika lahum 'athabun muheen
verses.58: Wa  llatheena hajaroo fee sabeeli Allahi thumma qutiloo aw matoo layarzuqannahumu Allahu rizqan hasanan wainna Allaha lahuwa khayru a  rraziqeen
verses.59: Layudkhilannahum mudkhalan yardawnahu wainna Allaha la'aleemun haleem
verses.60: Thalika waman 'aqaba bimithli ma 'ooqiba bihi thumma bughiya 'alayhi layansurannahu Allahu inna Allaha la'afuwwun ghafoor
verses.61: Thalika bianna Allaha yooliju allayla fee a  nnahari wayooliju a  nnahara fee allayli waanna Allaha samee'un baseer
verses.62: Thalika bianna Allaha huwa alhaqqu waanna ma yad'oona min doonihi huwa albatilu waanna Allaha huwa al'aliyyu alkabeer
verses.63: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina a  ssamai maan fatusbihu alardu mukhdarratan inna Allaha lateefun khabeer
verses.64: Lahu ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi wainna Allaha lahuwa alghaniyyu alhameed
verses.65: Alam tara anna Allaha sakhkhara lakum ma fee alardi wa  lfulka tajree fee albahri biamrihi wayumsiku a  ssamaa an taqa'a 'ala alardi illa biithnihi inna Allaha bi  nnasi laraoofun raheem
verses.66: Wahuwa allathee ahyakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum inna alinsana lakafoor
verses.67: Likulli ommatin ja'ana mansakan hum nasikoohu fala yunazi'unnaka fee alamri wa  d'u ila rabbika innaka la'ala hudan mustaqeem
verses.68: Wain jadalooka faquli Allahu a'lamu bima ta'maloon
verses.69: Allahu yahkumu baynakum yawma alqiyamati feema kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
verses.70: Alam ta'lam anna Allaha ya'lamu ma fee a  ssamai wa  lardi inna thalika fee kitabin inna thalika 'ala Allahi yaseer
verses.71: Waya'budoona min dooni Allahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanan wama laysa lahum bihi 'ilmun wama li  _thth_ alimeena min naseer
verses.72: Waitha tutla 'alayhim ayatuna bayyinatin ta'rifu fee wujoohi allatheena kafaroo almunkara yakadoona yastoona bi  llatheena yatloona 'alayhim ayatina qul afaonabbiokum bisharrin min thalikum a  nnaru wa'adaha Allahu allatheena kafaroo wabisa almaseer
verses.73: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu duriba mathalun fa  stami'oo lahu inna allatheena tad'oona min dooni Allahi lan yakhluqoo thubaban walawi ijtama'oo lahu wain yaslubuhumu a  ththubabu shayan la yastanqithoohu minhu da'ufa a  ttalibu wa  lmatloob
verses.74: Ma qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi inna Allaha laqawiyyun 'azeez
verses.75: Allahu yastafee mina almalaikati rusulan wamina a  nnasi inna Allaha samee'un baseer
verses.76: Ya'lamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum waila Allahi turja'u alomoor
verses.77: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo irka'oo wa  sjudoo wa  'budoo rabbakum wa  f'aloo alkhayra la'allakum tuflihoon
verses.78: Wajahidoo fee Allahi haqqa jihadihi huwa ijtabakum wama ja'ala 'alaykum fee a  ddeeni min harajin millata abeekum ibraheema huwa sammakumu almuslimeena min qablu wafee hatha liyakoona a  rrasoolu shaheedan 'alaykum watakoonoo shuhadaa 'ala a  nnasi faaqeemoo a  ssalata waatoo a  zzakata wa  'tasimoo bi  llahi huwa mawlakum fani'ma almawla wani'ma a  nnaseer

verses.3: Wa  llatheena hum 'ani allaghwi mu'ridoon
verses.4: Wa  llatheena hum li  zzakati fa'iloon
verses.5: Wa  llatheena hum lifuroojihim hafi _th_ oon
verses.6: Illa 'ala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeen
verses.7: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu al'adoon
verses.8: Wa  llatheena hum liamanatihim wa'ahdihim ra'oon
verses.9: Wa  llatheena hum 'alasalawatihim yuhafi _th_ oon
verses.10: Olaika humu alwarithoon
verses.11: Allatheena yarithoona alfirdawsa hum feeha khalidoon
verses.12: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min sulalatin min teen
verses.13: Thumma ja'anahu nutfatan fee qararin makeen
verses.14: Thumma khalaqna a  nnutfata 'alaqatan fakhalaqna al'alaqata mudghatan fakhalaqna almudghata 'i _th_ aman fakasawna al'i _th_ ama lahman thumma anshanahu khalqan akhara fatabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeen
verses.15: Thumma innakum ba'da thalika lamayyitoon
verses.16: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati tub'athoon
verses.17: Walaqad khalaqna fawqakum sab'a taraiqa wama kunna 'ani alkhalqi ghafileen
verses.18: Waanzana mina a  ssamai maan biqadarin faaskannahu fee alardi wainna 'alathahabin bihi laqadiroon
verses.19: Faanshana lakum bihi jannatin min nakheelin waa'nabin lakum feeha fawakihu katheeratun waminha takuloon
verses.20: Washajaratan takhruju min toori saynaa tanbutu bi  dduhni wasibghin lilakileen
verses.21: Wainna lakum fee alan'ami la'ibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butooniha walakum feeha manafi'u katheeratun waminha takuloon
verses.22: Wa'alayha wa'ala alfulki tuhmaloon
verses.23: Walaqad arsana noohan ila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi o'budoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoon
verses.24: Faqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yureedu an yatafaddala 'alaykum walaw shaa Allahu laanzala malaikatan ma sami'na bihatha fee abaina alawwaleen
verses.25: In huwa illa rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihi hattaheen
verses.26: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththaboon
verses.27: Faawhayna ilayhi ani isna'i alfulka bia'yunina wawahyina faitha jaa amruna wafara a  ttannooru fa  sluk feeha min kullin zawjayni ithnayni waahlaka illa man sabaqa 'alayhi alqawlu minhum wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena _th_ alamoo innahum mughraqoon
verses.28: Faitha istawayta anta waman ma'aka 'ala alfulki faquli alhamdu lillahi allathee najjana mina alqawmi a  _thth_ alimeen

verses.1: Sooratun anzanaha wafaradnaha waanzana feehaayatin bayyinatin la'allakum tathakkaroon
verses.2: A  zzaniyatu wa  zzanee fa  jlidoo kulla wahidin minhuma miata jadatin wala takhuthkum bihima rafatun fee deeni Allahi in kuntum tuminoona bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri walyashhad 'athabahumataifatun mina almumineen
verses.3: A  zzanee la yankihu illa zaniyatan aw mushrikatan wa  zzaniyatu la yankihuha illa zanin aw mushrikun wahurrima thalika 'ala almumineen
verses.4: Wa  llatheena yarmoona almuhsanati thumma lam yatoo biarba'ati shuhadaa fa  jlidoohum thamaneena jadatan wala taqbaloo lahum shahadatan abadan waolaika humu alfasiqoon
verses.5: Illa allatheena taboo min ba'di thalika waaslahoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.6: Wa  llatheena yarmoona azwajahum walam yakun lahum shuhadao illa anfusuhum fashahadatu ahadihim arba'u shahadatin bi  llahi innahu lamina a  ssadiqeen
verses.7: Wa  lkhamisatu anna la'nata Allahi 'alayhi in kana mina alkathibeen
verses.8: Wayadrao 'anha al'athaba an tashhada arba'a shahadatin bi  llahi innahu lamina alkathibeen
verses.9: Wa  lkhamisata anna ghadaba Allahi 'alayha in kana mina a  ssadiqeen
verses.10: Walawla fadlu Allahi 'alaykum warahmatuhu waanna Allaha tawwabun hakeem
verses.11: Inna allatheena jaoo bi  lifki 'usbatun minkum la tahsaboohu sharran lakum bal huwa khayrun lakum likulli imriin minhum ma iktasaba mina alithmi wa  llathee tawalla kibrahu minhum lahu 'athabun 'a _th_ eem
verses.12: Lawla ith sami'tumoohu _th_ anna almuminoona wa  lmuminatu bianfusihim khayran waqaloo hatha ifkun mubeen
verses.13: Lawla jaoo 'alayhi biarba'ati shuhadaa faith lam yatoo bi  shshuhadai faolaika 'inda Allahi humu alkathiboon
verses.14: Walawla fadlu Allahi 'alaykum warahmatuhu fee a  ddunya wa  lakhirati lamassakum fee ma afadtum feehi 'athabun 'a _th_ eem
verses.15: Ith talaqqawnahu biasinatikum wataqooloona biafwahikum ma laysa lakum bihi 'ilmun watahsaboonahu hayyinan wahuwa 'inda Allahi 'a _th_ eem
verses.16: Walawla ith sami'tumoohu qultum ma yakoonu lana an natakallama bihatha subhanaka hatha buhtanun 'a _th_ eem
verses.17: Ya'i _th_ ukumu Allahu an ta'oodoo limithlihi abadan in kuntum mumineen
verses.18: Wayubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.19: Inna allatheena yuhibboona an tashee'a alfahishatu fee allatheena amanoo lahum 'athabun aleemun fee a  ddunya wa  lakhirati wa  llahu ya'lamu waantum la ta'lamoon
verses.20: Walawla fadlu Allahi 'alaykum warahmatuhu waanna Allaha raoofun raheem
verses.21: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattabi'oo khutuwati a  shshaytani waman yattabi' khutuwati a  shshaytani fainnahu yamuru bi  lfahshai wa  lmunkari walawla fadlu Allahi 'alaykum warahmatuhu ma zaka minkum min ahadin abadan walakinna Allaha yuzakkee man yashao wa  llahu samee'un 'aleem
verses.22: Wala yatali oloo alfadli minkum wa  ssa'ati an yutoo olee alqurba wa  lmasakeena wa  lmuhajireena fee sabeeli Allahi walya'foo walyasfahoo ala tuhibboona an yaghfira Allahu lakum wa  llahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.23: Inna allatheena yarmoona almuhsanati alghafilati almuminati lu'inoo fee a  ddunya wa  lakhirati walahum 'athabun 'a _th_ eem
verses.24: Yawma tashhadu 'alayhim asinatuhum waaydeehim waarjuluhum bima kanoo ya'maloon
verses.25: Yawmaithin yuwaffeehimu Allahu deenahumu alhaqqa waya'lamoona anna Allaha huwa alhaqqu almubeen
verses.26: Alkhabeethatu lilkhabeetheena wa  lkhabeethoona lilkhabeethati wa  ttayyibatu li  ttayyibeena wa  ttayyiboona li  ttayyibati olaika mubarraoona mimma yaqooloona lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareem
verses.27: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra buyootikum hatta tastanisoo watusallimoo 'ala ahlihathalikum khayrun lakum la'allakum tathakkaroon
verses.28: Fain lam tajidoo feeha ahadan fala tadkhuloohahatta yuthana lakum wain qeela lakumu irji'oo fa  rji'oo huwa azka lakum wa  llahu bima ta'maloona 'aleem
verses.29: Laysa 'alaykum junahun an tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra maskoonatin feeha mata'un lakum wa  llahu ya'lamu ma tubdoona wama taktumoon
verses.30: Qul lilmumineena yaghuddoo min absarihum wayahfa _th_ oo furoojahum thalika azka lahum inna Allaha khabeerun bima yasna'oon
verses.31: Waqul lilmuminati yaghdudna min absarihinna wayahfa _th_ na furoojahunna wala yubdeena zeenatahunna illa ma _th_ ahara minha walyadribna bikhumurihinna 'ala juyoobihinna wala yubdeena zeenatahunna illa libu'oolatihinna aw abaihinna aw abai bu'oolatihinna aw abnaihinna aw abnai bu'oolatihinna aw ikhwanihinna aw banee ikhwanihinna aw banee akhawatihinna aw nisaihinna aw ma malakat aymanuhunna awi a  ttabi'eena ghayri olee alirbati mina a  rrijali awi a  ttifli allatheena lam ya _th_ haroo 'ala 'awrati a  nnisai wala yadribna biarjulihinna liyu'lama ma yukhfeena min zeenatihinna watooboo ila Allahi jamee'an ayyuha almuminoona la'allakum tuflihoon
verses.32: Waankihoo alayama minkum wa  ssaliheena min 'ibadikum waimaikum in yakoonoo fuqaraa yughnihimu Allahu min fadlihi wa  llahu wasi'un 'aleem
verses.33: Walyasta'fifi allatheena la yajidoona nikahan hatta yughniyahumu Allahu min fadlihi wa  llatheena yabtaghoona alkitaba mimma malakat aymanukum fakatiboohum in 'alimtum feehim khayran waatoohum min mali Allahi allathee atakum wala tukrihoo fatayatikum 'ala albighai in aradna tahassunan litabtaghoo 'arada alhayati a  ddunya waman yukrihhunna fainna Allaha min ba'di ikrahihinna ghafoorun raheem
verses.34: Walaqad anzana ilaykum ayatin mubayyinatin wamathalan mina allatheena khalaw min qablikum wamaw'i _th_ atan lilmuttaqeen
verses.35: Allahu nooru a  ssamawati wa  lardi mathalu noorihi kamishkatin feeha misbahun almisbahu fee zujajatin a  zzujajatu kaannaha kawkabun durriyyun yooqadu min shajaratin mubarakatin zaytoonatin la sharqiyyatin wala gharbiyyatin yakadu zaytuha yudeeo walaw lam tamsashu narun noorun 'ala noorin yahdee Allahu linoorihi man yashao wayadribu Allahu alamthala li  nnasi wa  llahu bikulli shayin 'aleem
verses.36: Fee buyootin athina Allahu an turfa'a wayuthkara feeha ismuhu yusabbihu lahu feeha bi  lghuduwwi wa  lasal
verses.37: Rijalun la tulheehim tijaratun wala bay'un 'an thikri Allahi waiqami a  ssalati waeetai a  zzakati yakhafoona yawman tataqallabu feehi alquloobu wa  labsar
verses.38: Liyajziyahumu Allahu ahsana ma 'amiloo wayazeedahum min fadlihi wa  llahu yarzuqu man yashao bighayri hisab
verses.39: Wa  llatheena kafaroo a'maluhum kasarabin biqee'atin yahsabuhu a  _thth_ amanu maan hatta itha jaahu lam yajidhu shayan wawajada Allaha 'indahu fawaffahu hisabahu wa  llahu saree'u alhisab
verses.40: Aw ka _th_ ulumatin fee bahrin lujjiyyin yaghshahu mawjun min fawqihi mawjun min fawqihi sahabun _th_ ulumatun ba'duha fawqa ba'din itha akhraja yadahu lam yakad yaraha waman lam yaj'ali Allahu lahu nooran fama lahu min noor
verses.41: Alam tara anna Allaha yusabbihu lahu man fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi wa  ttayru saffatin kullun qad 'alima salatahu watasbeehahu wa  llahu 'aleemun bima yaf'aloon
verses.42: Walillahi mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi waila Allahi almaseer
verses.43: Alam tara anna Allaha yuzjee sahaban thumma yuallifu baynahu thumma yaj'aluhu rukaman fatara alwadqa yakhruju min khilalihi wayunazzilu mina a  ssamai min jibalin feeha min baradin fayuseebu bihi man yashao wayasrifuhu 'an man yashao yakadu sana barqihi yathhabu bi  labsar
verses.44: Yuqallibu Allahu allayla wa  nnahara inna fee thalika la'ibratan liolee alabsar
verses.45: Wa  llahu khalaqa kulla dabbatin min main faminhum man yamshee 'ala batnihi waminhum man yamshee 'ala rijlayni waminhum man yamshee 'ala arba'in yakhluqu Allahu ma yashao inna Allaha 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.46: Laqad anzanaayatin mubayyinatin wa  llahu yahdee man yashao ilasiratin mustaqeem
verses.47: Wayaqooloona amanna bi  llahi wabi  rrasooli waata'na thumma yatawalla fareequn minhum min ba'di thalika wama olaika bi  lmumineen
verses.48: Waitha du'oo ila Allahi warasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum itha fareequn minhum mu'ridoon
verses.49: Wain yakun lahumu alhaqqu yatoo ilayhi muth'ineen
verses.50: Afee quloobihim maradun ami irtaboo am yakhafoona an yaheefa Allahu 'alayhim warasooluhu bal olaika humu a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.51: Innama kana qawla almumineena itha du'oo ila Allahi warasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum an yaqooloo sami'na waata'na waolaika humu almuflihoon
verses.52: Waman yuti'i Allaha warasoolahu wayakhsha Allaha wayattaqhi faolaika humu alfaizoon
verses.53: Waaqsamoo bi  llahi jahda aymanihim lain amartahum layakhrujunna qul la tuqsimoo ta'atun ma'roofatun inna Allaha khabeerun bima ta'maloon
verses.54: Qul atee'oo Allaha waatee'oo a  rrasoola fain tawallaw fainnama 'alayhi mahummila wa'alaykum mahummiltum wain tutee'oohu tahtadoo wama 'ala a  rrasooli illa albalaghu almubeen
verses.55: Wa'ada Allahu allatheena amanoo minkum wa'amiloo a  ssalihati layastakhlifannahum fee alardi kama istakhlafa allatheena min qablihim walayumakkinanna lahum deenahumu allathee irtada lahum walayubaddilannahum min ba'di khawfihim amnan ya'budoonanee la yushrikoona bee shayan waman kafara ba'da thalika faolaika humu alfasiqoon
verses.56: Waaqeemoo a  ssalata waatoo a  zzakata waatee'oo a  rrasoola la'allakum turhamoon
verses.57: La tahsabanna allatheena kafaroo mu'jizeena fee alardi wamawahumu a  nnaru walabisa almaseer
verses.58: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo liyastathinkumu allatheena malakat aymanukum wa  llatheena lam yablughoo alhuluma minkum thalatha marratin min qabli salati alfajri waheena tada'oona thiyabakum mina a  _thth_ aheerati wamin ba'di salati al'ishai thalathu 'awratin lakum laysa 'alaykum wala 'alayhim junahun ba'dahunna tawwafoona 'alaykum ba'dukum 'ala ba'din kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.59: Waitha balagha alatfalu minkumu alhuluma falyastathinoo kama istathana allatheena min qablihim kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.60: Wa  lqawa'idu mina a  nnisai allatee la yarjoona nikahan falaysa 'alayhinna junahun an yada'na thiyabahunna ghayra mutabarrijatin bizeenatin waan yasta'fifna khayrun lahunna wa  llahu samee'un 'aleem
verses.61: Laysa 'ala ala'maharajun wala 'ala ala'raji harajun wala 'ala almareedi harajun wala 'ala anfusikum an takuloo min buyootikum aw buyooti abaikum aw buyooti ommahatikum aw buyooti ikhwanikum aw buyooti akhawatikum aw buyooti a'mamikum aw buyooti 'ammatikum aw buyooti akhwalikum aw buyooti khalatikum aw ma malaktum mafatihahu aw sadeeqikum laysa 'alaykum junahun an takuloo jamee'an aw ashtatan faitha dakhatum buyootan fasallimoo 'ala anfusikum tahiyyatan min 'indi Allahi mubarakatan tayyibatan kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati la'allakum ta'qiloon
verses.62: Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo bi  llahi warasoolihi waitha kanoo ma'ahu 'ala amrin jami'in lam yathhaboo hatta yastathinoohu inna allatheena yastathinoonaka olaika allatheena yuminoona bi  llahi warasoolihi faitha istathanooka liba'di shanihim fathan liman shita minhum wa  staghfir lahumu Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.63: La taj'aloo du'aa a  rrasooli baynakum kadu'ai ba'dikum ba'dan qad ya'lamu Allahu allatheena yatasallaloona minkum liwathan falyahthari allatheena yukhalifoona 'an amrihi an tuseebahum fitnatun aw yuseebahum 'athabun aleem
verses.64: Ala inna lillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi qad ya'lamu ma antum 'alayhi wayawma yurja'oona ilayhi fayunabbiohum bima 'amiloo wa  llahu bikulli shayin 'aleem
