verses.14: Wajahadoo biha wa  stayqanatha anfusuhum _th_ ulman wa'uluwwan fa  n _th_ ur kayfa kana 'aqibatu almufsideen
verses.15: Walaqad atayna dawooda wasulaymana 'ilman waqala alhamdu lillahi allathee faddalana 'ala katheerin min 'ibadihi almumineen
verses.16: Wawaritha sulaymanu dawooda waqala ya ayyuha a  nnasu 'ullimna mantiqa a  ttayri waooteena min kulli shayin inna hatha lahuwa alfadlu almubeen
verses.17: Wahushira lisulaymana junooduhu mina aljinni wa  linsi wa  ttayri fahum yooza'oon
verses.18: Hatta itha ataw 'ala wadi a  nnamli qalat namlatun ya ayyuha a  nnamlu odkhuloo masakinakum la yahtimannakum sulaymanu wajunooduhu wahum la yash'uroon
verses.19: Fatabassama dahikan min qawliha waqala rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mataka allatee an'amta 'alayya wa'ala walidayya waan a'mala salihan tardahu waadkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibadika a  ssaliheen
verses.20: Watafaqqada a  ttayra faqala ma liya la ara alhudhuda am kana mina alghaibeen
verses.21: Lao'aththibannahu 'athaban shadeedan aw laathbahannahu aw layatiyannee bisultanin mubeen
verses.22: Famakatha ghayra ba'eedin faqala ahattu bima lam tuhit bihi wajituka min sabain binabain yaqeen
verses.23: Innee wajadtu imraatan tamlikuhum waootiyat min kulli shayin walaha 'arshun 'a _th_ eem
verses.24: Wajadtuha waqawmaha yasjudoona li  shshamsi min dooni Allahi wazayyana lahumu a  shshaytanu a'malahum fasaddahum 'ani a  ssabeeli fahum la yahtadoon
verses.25: Alla yasjudoo lillahi allathee yukhriju alkhabaa fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi waya'lamu ma tukhfoona wama tu'linoon
verses.26: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu al'arshi al'a _th_ eem
verses.27: Qala sanan _th_ uru asadaqta am kunta mina alkathibeen
verses.28: Ithhab bikitabee hatha faalqih ilayhim thumma tawalla 'anhum fa  n _th_ ur matha yarji'oon
verses.29: Qalat ya ayyuha almalao innee olqiya ilayya kitabun kareem
verses.30: Innahu min sulaymana wainnahu bismi Allahi a  rrahmani a  rraheem
verses.31: Alla ta'loo 'alayya watoonee muslimeen
verses.32: Qalat ya ayyuha almalao aftoonee fee amree ma kuntu qati'atan amran hatta tashhadoon
verses.33: Qaloo nahnu oloo quwwatin waoloo basin shadeedin wa  lamru ilayki fa  n _th_ uree matha tamureen
verses.34: Qalat inna almulooka itha dakhaloo qaryatan afsadooha waja'aloo a'izzata ahliha athillatan wakathalika yaf'aloon
verses.35: Wainnee mursilatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fana _th_ iratun bima yarji'u almursaloon
verses.36: Falamma jaa sulaymana qala atumiddoonani bimalin famaataniya Allahu khayrun mimmaatakum bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafrahoon
verses.37: Irji' ilayhim falanatiyannahum bijunoodin la qibala lahum biha walanukhrijannahum minha athillatan wahum saghiroon
verses.38: Qala ya ayyuha almalao ayyukum yateenee bi'arshiha qabla an yatoonee muslimeen
verses.39: Qala 'ifreetun mina aljinni anaateeka bihi qabla an taqooma min maqamika wainne 'alayhi laqawiyyun ameen
verses.40: Qala allathee 'indahu 'ilmun mina alkitabi anaateeka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka tarfuka falamma raahu mustaqirran 'indahu qala hatha min fadli rabbee liyabluwanee aashkuru am akfuru waman shakara fainnama yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fainna rabbee ghaniyyun kareem
verses.41: Qala nakkiroo laha 'arshaha nan _th_ ur atahtadee am takoonu mina allatheena la yahtadoon
verses.42: Falamma jaat qeela ahakatha 'arshuki qalat kaannahu huwa waooteena al'ilma min qabliha wakunna muslimeen
verses.43: Wasaddaha ma kanat ta'budu min dooni Allahi innaha kanat min qawmin kafireen
verses.44: Qeela laha odkhulee a  ssarha falamma raathu hasibathu lujjatan wakashafat 'an saqayha qala innahu sarhun mumarradun min qawareera qalat rabbi innee _th_ alamtu nafsee waaslamtu ma'a sulaymana lillahi rabbi al'alameen
verses.45: Walaqad arsana ila thamooda akhahum salihan ani o'budoo Allaha faitha hum fareeqani yakhtasimoon
verses.46: Qala ya qawmi lima tasta'jiloona bi  ssayyiati qabla alhasanati lawla tastaghfiroona Allaha la'allakum turhamoon
verses.47: Qaloo ittayyarna bika wabiman ma'aka qala tairukum 'inda Allahi bal antum qawmun tuftanoon
verses.48: Wakana fee almadeenati tis'atu rahtin yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoon
verses.49: Qaloo taqasamoo bi  llahi lanubayyitannahu waahlahu thumma lanaqoolanna liwaliyyihi ma shahidna mahlika ahlihi wainna lasadiqoon
verses.50: Wamakaroo makran wamakarna makran wahum la yash'uroon
verses.51: Fa  n _th_ ur kayfa kana 'aqibatu makrihim anna dammarnahum waqawmahum ajma'een
verses.52: Fatilka buyootuhum khawiyatan bima _th_ alamoo inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin ya'lamoon
verses.53: Waanjayna allatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoon
verses.54: Walootan ith qala liqawmihi atatoona alfahishata waantum tubsiroon
verses.55: Ainnakum latatoona a  rrijala shahwatan min dooni a  nnisai bal antum qawmun tajhaloon
verses.56: Fama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo akhrijoo ala lootin min qaryatikum innahum onasun yatatahharoon
verses.57: Faanjaynahu waahlahu illa imraatahu qaddarnaha mina alghabireen
verses.58: Waamtarna 'alayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareen
verses.59: Quli alhamdu lillahi wasalamun 'ala 'ibadihi allatheena istafaallahu khayrun amma yushrikoon
verses.60: Amman khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda waanzala lakum mina a  ssamai maan faanbatna bihi hadaiqa thata bahjatin ma kana lakum an tunbitoo shajaraha ailahun ma'a Allahi bal hum qawmun ya'diloon
verses.61: Amman ja'ala alarda qararan waja'ala khilalaha anharan waja'ala laha rawasiya waja'ala bayna albahrayni hajizan ailahun ma'a Allahi bal aktharuhum la ya'lamoon
verses.62: Amman yujeebu almudtarra itha da'ahu wayakshifu a  ssooa wayaj'alukum khulafaa alardi ailahun ma'a Allahi qaleelan ma tathakkaroon
verses.63: Amman yahdeekum fee _th_ ulumati albarri wa  lbahri waman yursilu a  rriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi ailahun ma'a Allahi ta'ala Allahu 'amma yushrikoon
verses.64: Amman yabdao alkhalqa thumma yu'eeduhu waman yarzuqukum mina a  ssamai wa  lardi ailahun ma'a Allahi qul hatoo burhanakum in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.65: Qul la ya'lamu man fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi alghayba illa Allahu wama yash'uroona ayyana yub'athoon
verses.66: Bali iddaraka 'ilmuhum fee alakhirati bal hum fee shakkin minha bal hum minha 'amoon
verses.67: Waqala allatheena kafaroo aitha kunna turaban waabaona ainna lamukhrajoon
verses.68: Laqad wu'idna hatha nahnu waabaona min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleen
verses.69: Qul seeroo fee alardi fa  n _th_ uroo kayfa kana 'aqibatu almujrimeen
verses.70: Wala tahzan 'alayhim wala takun fee dayqin mimma yamkuroon
verses.71: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwa'du in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.72: Qul 'asa an yakoona radifa lakum ba'du allathee tasta'jiloon
verses.73: Wainna rabbaka lathoo fadlin 'ala a  nnasi walakinna aktharahum la yashkuroon
verses.74: Wainna rabbaka laya'lamu ma tukinnu sudooruhum wama yu'linoon
verses.75: Wama min ghaibatin fee a  ssamai wa  lardi illa fee kitabin mubeen
verses.76: Inna hatha alqurana yaqussu 'ala banee israeela akthara allathee hum feehi yakhtalifoon
verses.77: Wainnahu lahudan warahmatun lilmumineen
verses.78: Inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum bihukmihi wahuwa al'azeezu al'aleem
verses.79: Fatawakkal 'ala Allahi innaka 'ala alhaqqi almubeen
verses.80: Innaka la tusmi'u almawta wala tusmi'u a  ssumma a  ddu'aa itha wallaw mudbireen
verses.81: Wama anta bihadee al'umyi 'an dalalatihim in tusmi'u illa man yuminu biayatina fahum muslimoon
verses.82: Waitha waqa'a alqawlu 'alayhim akhrajna lahum dabbatan mina alardi tukallimuhum anna a  nnasa kanoo biayatina la yooqinoon
verses.83: Wayawma nahshuru min kulli ommatin fawjan mimman yukaththibu biayatina fahum yooza'oon
verses.84: Hatta itha jaoo qala akaththabtum biayatee walam tuheetoo biha 'ilman ammatha kuntum ta'maloon
verses.85: Wawaqa'a alqawlu 'alayhim bima _th_ alamoo fahum la yantiqoon
verses.86: Alam yaraw anna ja'ana allayla liyaskunoo feehi wa  nnahara mubsiran inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoon
verses.87: Wayawma yunfakhu fee a  ssoori fafazi'a man fee a  ssamawati waman fee alardi illa man shaa Allahu wakullun atawhu dakhireen
verses.88: Watara aljibala tahsabuha jamidatan wahiya tamurru marra a  ssahabi sun'a Allahi allathee atqana kulla shayin innahu khabeerun bima taf'aloon
verses.89: Man jaa bi  lhasanati falahu khayrun minha wahum min faza'in yawmaithin aminoon
verses.90: Waman jaa bi  ssayyiati fakubbat wujoohuhum fee a  nnari hal tujzawna illa ma kuntum ta'maloon
verses.91: Innama omirtu an a'buda rabba hathihi albadati allathee harramaha walahu kullu shayin waomirtu an akoona mina almuslimeen
verses.92: Waan atluwa alqurana famani ihtada fainnama yahtadee linafsihi waman dalla faqul innama ana mina almunthireen
verses.93: Waquli alhamdu lillahi sayureekum ayatihi fata'rifoonaha wama rabbuka bighafilin 'amma ta'maloon

verses.3: Natloo 'alayka min nabai moosa wafir'awna bi  lhaqqi liqawmin yuminoon
verses.4: Inna fir'awna 'ala fee alardi waja'ala ahlaha shiya'an yastad'ifu taifatan minhum yuthabbihu abnaahum wayastahyee nisaahum innahu kana mina almufsideen
verses.5: Wanureedu an namunna 'ala allatheena istud'ifoo fee alardi wanaj'alahum aimmatan wanaj'alahumu alwaritheen
verses.6: Wanumakkina lahum fee alardi wanuriya fir'awna wahamana wajunoodahuma minhum ma kanoo yahtharoon
verses.7: Waawhayna ila ommi moosa an ardi'eehi faitha khifti 'alayhi faalqeehi fee alyammi wala takhafee wala tahzanee inna raddoohu ilayki waja'iloohu mina almursaleen
verses.8: Fa  ltaqatahu alu fir'awna liyakoona lahum 'aduwwan wahazanan inna fir'awna wahamana wajunoodahuma kanoo khatieen
verses.9: Waqalati imraatu fir'awna qurratu 'aynin lee walaka la taqtuloohu 'asa an yanfa'ana aw nattakhithahu waladan wahum la yash'uroon
verses.10: Waasbaha fuadu ommi moosa farighan in kadat latubdee bihi lawla an rabatna 'ala qalbiha litakoona mina almumineen
verses.11: Waqalat liokhtihi qusseehi fabasurat bihi 'an junubin wahum la yash'uroon
verses.12: Waharramna 'alayhi almaradi'a min qablu faqalat hal adullukum 'ala ahli baytin yakfuloonahu lakum wahum lahu nasihoon
verses.13: Faradadnahu ila ommihi kay taqarra 'aynuha wala tahzana walita'lama anna wa'da Allahi haqqun walakinna aktharahum la ya'lamoon
verses.14: Walamma balagha ashuddahu wa  stawaataynahu hukman wa'ilman wakathalika najzee almuhsineen
verses.15: Wadakhala almadeenata 'alaheeni ghaflatin min ahliha fawajada feeha rajulayni yaqtatilani hatha min shee'atihi wahatha min 'aduwwihi fa  staghathahu allathee min shee'atihi 'ala allathee min 'aduwwihi fawakazahu moosa faqada 'alayhi qala hatha min 'amali a  shshaytani innahu 'aduwwun mudillun mubeen
verses.16: Qala rabbi innee _th_ alamtu nafsee fa  ghfir lee faghafara lahu innahu huwa alghafooru a  rraheem
verses.17: Qala rabbi bima an'amta 'alayya falan akoona _th_ aheeran lilmujrimeen
verses.18: Faasbaha fee almadeenati khaifan yataraqqabu faitha allathee istansarahu bi  lamsi yastasrikhuhu qala lahu moosa innaka laghawiyyun mubeen
verses.19: Falamma an arada an yabtisha bi  llathee huwa 'aduwwun lahuma qala ya moosa atureedu an taqtulanee kama qatata nafsan bi  lamsi in tureedu illa an takoona jabbaran fee alardi wama tureedu an takoona mina almusliheen
verses.20: Wajaa rajulun min aqsa almadeenati yas'a qala ya moosa inna almalaa yatamiroona bika liyaqtulooka fa  khruj innee laka mina a  nnasiheen
verses.21: Fakharaja minha khaifan yataraqqabu qala rabbi najjinee mina alqawmi a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.22: Walamma tawajjaha tilqaa madyana qala 'asa rabbee an yahdiyanee sawaa a  ssabeel
verses.23: Walamma warada maa madyana wajada 'alayhi ommatan mina a  nnasi yasqoona wawajada min doonihimu imraatayni tathoodani qala ma khatbukuma qalata la nasqee hatta yusdira a  rri'ao waaboona shaykhun kabeer
verses.24: Fasaqa lahuma thumma tawalla ila a  _thth_ illi faqala rabbi innee lima anzata ilayya min khayrin faqeer
verses.25: Fajaathu ihdahuma tamshee 'ala istihyain qalat inna abee yad'ooka liyajziyaka ajra ma saqayta lana falamma jaahu waqassa 'alayhi alqasasa qala la takhaf najawta mina alqawmi a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.26: Qalat ihdahuma ya abati istajirhu inna khayra mani istajarta alqawiyyu alameen
verses.27: Qala innee oreedu an onkihaka ihda ibnatayya hatayni 'ala an tajuranee thamaniya hijajin fain atmamta 'ashran famin 'indika wama oreedu an ashuqqa 'alayka satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina a  ssaliheen
verses.28: Qala thalika baynee wabaynaka ayyama alajalayni qadaytu fala 'udwana 'alayya wa  llahu 'ala ma naqoolu wakeel
verses.29: Falamma qada moosaalajala wasara biahlihi anasa min janibi a  ttoori naran qala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran la'allee ateekum minha bikhabarin aw jathwatin mina a  nnari la'allakum tastaloon
verses.30: Falamma ataha noodiya min shatii alwadi alaymani fee albuq'ati almubarakati mina a  shshajarati an ya moosa innee ana Allahu rabbu al'alameen
verses.31: Waan alqi 'asaka falamma raaha tahtazzu kaannaha jannun walla mudbiran walam yu'aqqib ya moosa aqbil wala takhaf innaka mina alamineen
verses.32: Osluk yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin wa  dmum ilayka janahaka mina a  rrahbi fathanika burhanani min rabbika ila fir'awna wamalaihi innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeen
verses.33: Qala rabbi innee qatatu minhum nafsan faakhafu an yaqtuloon
verses.34: Waakhee haroonu huwa afsahu minnee lisanan faarsilhu ma'iya ridan yusaddiqunee innee akhafu an yukaththiboon
verses.35: Qala sanashuddu 'adudaka biakheeka wanaj'alu lakuma sultanan fala yasiloona ilaykuma biayatina antuma wamani ittaba'akuma alghaliboon
verses.36: Falamma jaahum moosa biayatina bayyinatin qaloo ma hatha illa sihrun muftaran wama sami'na bihatha fee abaina alawwaleen
verses.37: Waqala moosa rabbee a'lamu biman jaa bi  lhuda min 'indihi waman takoonu lahu 'aqibatu a  ddari innahu la yuflihu a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.38: Waqala fir'awnu ya ayyuha almalao ma 'alimtu lakum min ilahin ghayree faawqid lee ya hamanu 'ala a  tteeni fa  j'al lee sarhan la'allee attali'u ila ilahi moosa wainnee laa _th_ unnuhu mina alkathibeen
verses.39: Wa  stakbara huwa wajunooduhu fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wa _th_ annoo annahum ilayna la yurja'oon
verses.40: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi fa  n _th_ ur kayfa kana 'aqibatu a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.41: Waja'anahum aimmatan yad'oona ila a  nnari wayawma alqiyamati la yunsaroon
verses.42: Waatba'nahum fee hathihi a  ddunya la'natan wayawma alqiyamati hum mina almaqbooheen
verses.43: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba min ba'di ma ahlakna alquroona aloola basaira li  nnasi wahudan warahmatan la'allahum yatathakkaroon
verses.44: Wama kunta bijanibi algharbiyyi ith qadayna ila moosa alamra wama kunta mina a  shshahideen
verses.45: Walakinna anshana quroonan fatatawala 'alayhimu al'umuru wama kunta thawiyan fee ahli madyana tatloo 'alayhim ayatina walakinna kunna mursileen
verses.46: Wama kunta bijanibi a  ttoori ith nadayna walakin rahmatan min rabbika litunthira qawman ma atahum min natheerin min qablika la'allahum yatathakkaroon
verses.47: Walawla an tuseebahum museebatun bima qaddamat aydeehim fayaqooloo rabbana lawla arsata ilayna rasoolan fanattabi'a ayatika wanakoona mina almumineen
verses.48: Falamma jaahumu alhaqqu min 'indina qaloo lawla ootiya mithla ma ootiya moosa awalam yakfuroo bima ootiya moosa min qablu qaloo sihrani ta _th_ ahara waqaloo inna bikullin kafiroon
verses.49: Qul fatoo bikitabin min 'indi Allahi huwa ahda minhuma attabi'hu in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.50: Fain lam yastajeeboo laka fa  'lam annama yattabi'oona ahwaahum waman adallu mimmani ittaba'a hawahu bighayri hudan mina Allahi inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.51: Walaqad wassana lahumu alqawla la'allahum yatathakkaroon
verses.52: Allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba min qablihi hum bihi yuminoon
verses.53: Waitha yutla 'alayhim qaloo amanna bihi innahu alhaqqu min rabbina inna kunna min qablihi muslimeen
verses.54: Olaika yutawna ajrahum marratayni bimasabaroo wayadraoona bi  lhasanati a  ssayyiata wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoon
verses.55: Waitha sami'oo allaghwa a'radoo 'anhu waqaloo lana a'maluna walakum a'malukum salamun 'alaykum la nabtaghee aljahileen
verses.56: Innaka la tahdee man ahbabta walakinna Allaha yahdee man yashao wahuwa a'lamu bi  lmuhtadeen
verses.57: Waqaloo in nattabi'i alhuda ma'aka nutakhattaf min ardina awalam numakkin lahum haraman aminan yujba ilayhi thamaratu kulli shayin rizqan min ladunna walakinna aktharahum la ya'lamoon
verses.58: Wakam ahlakna min qaryatin batirat ma'eeshataha fatilka masakinuhum lam tuskan min ba'dihim illa qaleelan wakunna nahnu alwaritheen
verses.59: Wama kana rabbuka muhlika alqurahatta yab'atha fee ommiha rasoolan yatloo 'alayhim ayatina wama kunna muhlikee alqura illa waahluha _th_ alimoon
verses.60: Wama ooteetum min shayin famata'u alhayati a  ddunya wazeenatuha wama 'inda Allahi khayrun waabqa afala ta'qiloon
verses.61: Afaman wa'adnahu wa'dan hasanan fahuwa laqeehi kaman matta'nahu mata'a alhayati a  ddunya thumma huwa yawma alqiyamati mina almuhdareen
verses.62: Wayawma yunadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaiya allatheena kuntum taz'umoon
verses.63: Qala allatheena haqqa 'alayhimu alqawlu rabbana haolai allatheena aghwayna aghwaynahum kama ghawayna tabarrana ilayka ma kanoo iyyana ya'budoon
verses.64: Waqeela od'oo shurakaakum fada'awhum falam yastajeeboo lahum waraawoo al'athaba law annahum kanoo yahtadoon
verses.65: Wayawma yunadeehim fayaqoolu matha ajabtumu almursaleen
verses.66: Fa'amiyat 'alayhimu alanbao yawmaithin fahum la yatasaaloon
verses.67: Faamma man taba waamana wa'amila salihan fa'asa an yakoona mina almufliheen
verses.68: Warabbuka yakhluqu ma yashao wayakhtaru ma kana lahumu alkhiyaratu subhana Allahi wata'ala 'amma yushrikoon
verses.69: Warabbuka ya'lamu ma tukinnu sudooruhum wama yu'linoon
verses.70: Wahuwa Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alhamdu fee aloola wa  lakhirati walahu alhukmu wailayhi turja'oon
verses.71: Qul araaytum in ja'ala Allahu 'alaykumu allayla sarmadan ila yawmi alqiyamati man ilahun ghayru Allahi yateekum bidiyain afala tasma'oon
verses.72: Qul araaytum in ja'ala Allahu 'alaykumu a  nnahara sarmadan ila yawmi alqiyamati man ilahun ghayru Allahi yateekum bilaylin taskunoona feehi afala tubsiroon
verses.73: Wamin rahmatihi ja'ala lakumu allayla wa  nnahara litaskunoo feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi wala'allakum tashkuroon
verses.74: Wayawma yunadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaiya allatheena kuntum taz'umoon
verses.75: Wanaza'na min kulli ommatin shaheedan faqulna hatoo burhanakum fa'alimoo anna alhaqqa lillahi wadalla 'anhum ma kanoo yaftaroon
verses.76: Inna qaroona kana min qawmi moosa fabagha 'alayhim waataynahu mina alkunoozi ma inna mafatihahu latanooo bi  l'usbati olee alquwwati ith qala lahu qawmuhu la tafrah inna Allaha la yuhibbu alfariheen
verses.77: Wa  btaghi feemaataka Allahu a  ddara alakhirata wala tansa naseebaka mina a  ddunya waahsin kama ahsana Allahu ilayka wala tabghi alfasada fee alardi inna Allaha la yuhibbu almufsideen
verses.78: Qala innama ooteetuhu 'ala 'ilmin 'indee awalam ya'lam anna Allaha qad ahlaka min qablihi mina alqurooni man huwa ashaddu minhu quwwatan waaktharu jam'an wala yusalu 'an thunoobihimu almujrimoon
verses.79: Fakharaja 'ala qawmihi fee zeenatihi qala allatheena yureedoona alhayata a  ddunya ya layta lana mithla ma ootiya qaroonu innahu lathoo ha _thth_ in 'a _th_ eem
verses.80: Waqala allatheena ootoo al'ilma waylakum thawabu Allahi khayrun liman amana wa'amila salihan wala yulaqqaha illa a  ssabiroon
verses.81: Fakhasafna bihi wabidarihi alarda fama kana lahu min fiatin yansuroonahu min dooni Allahi wama kana mina almuntasireen
verses.82: Waasbaha allatheena tamannaw makanahu bi  lamsi yaqooloona waykaanna Allaha yabsutu a  rrizqa liman yashao min 'ibadihi wayaqdiru lawla an manna Allahu 'alayna lakhasafa bina waykaannahu la yuflihu alkafiroon
verses.83: Tilka a  ddaru alakhiratu naj'aluha lillatheena la yureedoona 'uluwwan fee alardi wala fasadan wa  l'aqibatu lilmuttaqeen
verses.84: Man jaa bi  lhasanati falahu khayrun minha waman jaa bi  ssayyiati fala yujza allatheena 'amiloo a  ssayyiati illa ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.85: Inna allathee farada 'alayka alqurana laradduka ila ma'adin qul rabbee a'lamu man jaa bi  lhuda waman huwa fee dalalin mubeen
verses.86: Wama kunta tarjoo an yulqa ilayka alkitabu illa rahmatan min rabbika fala takoonanna _th_ aheeran lilkafireen
verses.87: Wala yasuddunnaka 'an ayati Allahi ba'da ith onzilat ilayka wa  d'u ila rabbika wala takoonanna mina almushrikeen
verses.88: Wala tad'u ma'a Allahi ilahan akhara la ilaha illa huwa kullu shayin halikun illa wajhahu lahu alhukmu wailayhi turja'oon

verses.2: Ahasiba a  nnasu an yutrakoo an yaqooloo amanna wahum la yuftanoon
verses.3: Walaqad fatanna allatheena min qablihim falaya'lamanna Allahu allatheena sadaqoo walaya'lamanna alkathibeen
verses.4: Am hasiba allatheena ya'maloona a  ssayyiati an yasbiqoona saa ma yahkumoon
verses.5: Man kana yarjoo liqaa Allahi fainna ajala Allahi laatin wahuwa a  ssamee'u al'aleem
verses.6: Waman jahada fainnama yujahidu linafsihi inna Allaha laghaniyyun 'ani al'alameen
verses.7: Wa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati lanukaffiranna 'anhum sayyiatihim walanajziyannahum ahsana allathee kanoo ya'maloon
verses.8: Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi husnan wain jahadaka litushrika bee ma laysa laka bihi 'ilmun fala tuti'huma ilayya marji'ukum faonabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.9: Wa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati lanudkhilannahum fee a  ssaliheen
verses.10: Wamina a  nnasi man yaqoolu amanna bi  llahi faitha oothiya fee Allahi ja'ala fitnata a  nnasi ka'athabi Allahi walain jaa nasrun min rabbika layaqoolunna inna kunna ma'akum awalaysa Allahu bia'lama bima fee sudoori al'alameen
verses.11: Walaya'lamanna Allahu allatheena amanoo walaya'lamanna almunafiqeen
verses.12: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ittabi'oo sabeelana wanahmil khatayakum wama hum bihamileena min khatayahum min shayin innahum lakathiboon
verses.13: Walayahmilunna athqalahum waathqalan ma'a athqalihim walayusalunna yawma alqiyamati 'amma kanoo yaftaroon
verses.14: Walaqad arsana noohan ila qawmihi falabitha feehim alfa sanatin illa khamseena 'aman faakhathahumu a  ttoofanu wahum _th_ alimoon
verses.15: Faanjaynahu waashaba a  ssafeenati waja'anahaayatan lil'alameen
verses.16: Waibraheema ith qala liqawmihi o'budoo Allaha wa  ttaqoohu thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
verses.17: Innama ta'budoona min dooni Allahi awthanan watakhluqoona ifkan inna allatheena ta'budoona min dooni Allahi la yamlikoona lakum rizqan fa  btaghoo 'inda Allahi a  rrizqa wa  'budoohu wa  shkuroo lahu ilayhi turja'oon
verses.18: Wain tukaththiboo faqad kaththaba omamun min qablikum wama 'ala a  rrasooli illa albalaghu almubeen
verses.19: Awalam yaraw kayfa yubdio Allahu alkhalqa thumma yu'eeduhu inna thalika 'ala Allahi yaseer
verses.20: Qul seeroo fee alardi fa  n _th_ uroo kayfa badaa alkhalqa thumma Allahu yunshio a  nnashata alakhirata inna Allaha 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.21: Yu'aththibu man yashao wayarhamu man yashao wailayhi tuqlaboon
verses.22: Wama antum bimu'jizeena fee alardi wala fee a  ssamai wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseer
verses.23: Wa  llatheena kafaroo biayati Allahi waliqaihi olaika yaisoo min rahmatee waolaika lahum 'athabun aleem
verses.24: Fama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo oqtuloohu aw harriqoohu faanjahu Allahu mina a  nnari inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoon
verses.25: Waqala innama ittakhathtum min dooni Allahi awthanan mawaddata baynikum fee alhayati a  ddunya thumma yawma alqiyamati yakfuru ba'dukum biba'din wayal'anu ba'dukum ba'dan wamawakumu a  nnaru wama lakum min nasireen
verses.26: Faamana lahu lootun waqala innee muhajirun ila rabbee innahu huwa al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.27: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa waya'qooba waja'ana fee thurriyyatihi a  nnubuwwata wa  lkitaba waataynahu ajrahu fee a  ddunya wainnahu fee alakhirati lamina a  ssaliheen
verses.28: Walootan ith qala liqawmihi innakum latatoona alfahishata ma sabaqakum biha min ahadin mina al'alameen
verses.29: Ainnakum latatoona a  rrijala wataqta'oona a  ssabeela watatoona fee nadeekumu almunkara fama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo itina bi'athabi Allahi in kunta mina a  ssadiqeen
verses.30: Qala rabbi onsurnee 'ala alqawmi almufsideen
verses.31: Walamma jaat rusuluna ibraheema bi  lbushra qaloo inna muhlikoo ahli hathihi alqaryati inna ahlaha kanoo _th_ alimeen
verses.32: Qala inna feeha lootan qaloo nahnu a'lamu biman feeha lanunajjiyannahu waahlahu illa imraatahu kanat mina alghabireen
verses.33: Walamma an jaat rusuluna lootan seea bihim wadaqa bihim thar'an waqaloo la takhaf wala tahzan inna munajjooka waahlaka illa imraataka kanat mina alghabireen
verses.34: Inna munziloona 'ala ahli hathihi alqaryati rijzan mina a  ssamai bima kanoo yafsuqoon
verses.35: Walaqad tarakna minhaayatan bayyinatan liqawmin ya'qiloon
verses.36: Waila madyana akhahum shu'ayban faqala ya qawmi o'budoo Allaha wa  rjoo alyawma alakhira wala ta'thaw fee alardi mufsideen
verses.37: Fakaththaboohu faakhathathumu a  rrajfatu faasbahoo fee darihim jathimeen
verses.38: Wa'adan wathamooda waqad tabayyana lakum min masakinihim wazayyana lahumu a  shshaytanu a'malahum fasaddahum 'ani a  ssabeeli wakanoo mustabsireen
verses.39: Waqaroona wafir'awna wahamana walaqad jaahum moosa bi  lbayyinati fa  stakbaroo fee alardi wama kanoo sabiqeen
verses.40: Fakullan akhathna bithanbihi faminhum man arsana 'alayhi hasiban waminhum man akhathathu a  ssayhatu waminhum man khasafna bihi alarda waminhum man aghraqna wama kana Allahu liya _th_ limahum walakin kanoo anfusahum ya _th_ limoon
verses.41: Mathalu allatheena ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi awliyaa kamathali al'ankabooti ittakhathat baytan wainna awhana albuyooti labaytu al'ankabooti law kanoo ya'lamoon
verses.42: Inna Allaha ya'lamu ma yad'oona min doonihi min shayin wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.43: Watilka alamthalu nadribuha li  nnasi wama ya'qiluha illa al'alimoon
verses.44: Khalaqa Allahu a  ssamawati wa  larda bi  lhaqqi inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineen
verses.45: Otlu ma oohiya ilayka mina alkitabi waaqimi a  ssalata inna a  ssalata tanha 'ani alfahshai wa  lmunkari walathikru Allahi akbaru wa  llahu ya'lamu ma tasna'oon
verses.46: Wala tujadiloo ahla alkitabi illa bi  llatee hiya ahsanu illa allatheena _th_ alamoo minhum waqooloo amanna bi  llathee onzila ilayna waonzila ilaykum wailahuna wailahukum wahidun wanahnu lahu muslimoon
verses.47: Wakathalika anzana ilayka alkitaba fa  llatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yuminoona bihi wamin haolai man yuminu bihi wama yajhadu biayatina illa alkafiroon
verses.48: Wama kunta tatloo min qablihi min kitabin wala takhuttuhu biyameenika ithan la  rtaba almubtiloon
verses.49: Bal huwa ayatun bayyinatun fee sudoori allatheena ootoo al'ilma wama yajhadu biayatina illa a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.50: Waqaloo lawla onzila 'alayhi ayatun min rabbihi qul innama alayatu 'inda Allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeen
verses.51: Awalam yakfihim anna anzana 'alayka alkitaba yutla 'alayhim inna fee thalika larahmatan wathikra liqawmin yuminoon
verses.52: Qul kafa bi  llahi baynee wabaynakum shaheedan ya'lamu ma fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi wa  llatheena amanoo bi  lbatili wakafaroo bi  llahi olaika humu alkhasiroon
verses.53: Wayasta'jiloonaka bi  l'athabi walawla ajalun musamman lajaahumu al'athabu walayatiyannahum baghtatan wahum la yash'uroon
verses.54: Yasta'jiloonaka bi  l'athabi wainna jahannama lamuheetatun bi  lkafireen
verses.55: Yawma yaghshahumu al'athabu min fawqihim wamin tahti arjulihim wayaqoolu thooqoo ma kuntum ta'maloon
verses.56: Ya 'ibadiya allatheena amanoo inna ardee wasi'atun faiyyaya fa  'budoon
verses.57: Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti thumma ilayna turja'oon
verses.58: Wa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati lanubawwiannahum mina aljannati ghurafan tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha ni'ma ajru al'amileen
verses.59: Allatheena sabaroo wa'ala rabbihim yatawakkaloon
verses.60: Wakaayyin min dabbatin la tahmilu rizqaha Allahu yarzuquha waiyyakum wahuwa a  ssamee'u al'aleem
verses.61: Walain saatahum man khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda wasakhkhara a  shshamsa wa  lqamara layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoon
verses.62: Allahu yabsutu a  rrizqa liman yashao min 'ibadihi wayaqdiru lahu inna Allaha bikulli shayin 'aleem
verses.63: Walain saatahum man nazzala mina a  ssamai maan faahya bihi alarda min ba'di mawtiha layaqoolunna Allahu quli alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la ya'qiloon
verses.64: Wama hathihi alhayatu a  ddunya illa lahwun wala'ibun wainna a  ddara alakhirata lahiya alhayawanu law kanoo ya'lamoon
verses.65: Faitha rakiboo fee alfulki da'awoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu a  ddeena falamma najjahum ila albarri itha hum yushrikoon
verses.66: Liyakfuroo bimaataynahum waliyatamatta'oo fasawfa ya'lamoon
verses.67: Awalam yaraw anna ja'anaharaman aminan wayutakhattafu a  nnasu min hawlihim afabi  lbatili yuminoona wabini'mati Allahi yakfuroon
verses.68: Waman a _th_ lamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allahi kathiban aw kaththaba bi  lhaqqi lamma jaahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkafireen
verses.69: Wa  llatheena jahadoo feena lanahdiyannahum subulana wainna Allaha lama'a almuhsineen

verses.3: Fee adna alardi wahum min ba'di ghalabihim sayaghliboon
verses.4: Fee bid'i sineena lillahi alamru min qablu wamin ba'du wayawmaithin yafrahu almuminoon
verses.5: Binasri Allahi yansuru man yashao wahuwa al'azeezu a  rraheem
verses.6: Wa'da Allahi la yukhlifu Allahu wa'dahu walakinna akthara a  nnasi la ya'lamoon
verses.7: Ya'lamoona _th_ ahiran mina alhayati a  ddunya wahum 'ani alakhirati hum ghafiloon
verses.8: Awalam yatafakkaroo fee anfusihim ma khalaqa Allahu a  ssamawati wa  larda wama baynahuma illa bi  lhaqqi waajalin musamman wainna katheeran mina a  nnasi biliqai rabbihim lakafiroon
verses.9: Awalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayan _th_ uroo kayfa kana 'aqibatu allatheena min qablihim kanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan waatharoo alarda wa'amarooha akthara mimma 'amarooha wajaathum rusuluhum bi  lbayyinati fama kana Allahu liya _th_ limahum walakin kanoo anfusahum ya _th_ limoon
verses.10: Thumma kana 'aqibata allatheena asaoo a  ssooa an kaththaboo biayati Allahi wakanoo biha yastahzioon
verses.11: Allahu yabdao alkhalqa thumma yu'eeduhu thumma ilayhi turja'oon
verses.12: Wayawma taqoomu a  ssa'atu yublisu almujrimoon
verses.13: Walam yakun lahum min shurakaihim shufa'ao wakanoo bishurakaihim kafireen
verses.14: Wayawma taqoomu a  ssa'atu yawmaithin yatafarraqoon
verses.15: Faamma allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati fahum fee rawdatin yuhbaroon
verses.16: Waamma allatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina waliqai alakhirati faolaika fee al'athabi muhdaroon
verses.17: Fasubhana Allahi heena tumsoona waheena tusbihoon
verses.18: Walahu alhamdu fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi wa'ashiyyan waheena tu _th_ hiroon
verses.19: Yukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti wayukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi wayuhyee alarda ba'da mawtiha wakathalika tukhrajoon
verses.20: Wamin ayatihi an khalaqakum min turabin thumma itha antum basharun tantashiroon
verses.21: Wamin ayatihi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwajan litaskunoo ilayha waja'ala baynakum mawaddatan warahmatan inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroon
verses.22: Wamin ayatihi khalqu a  ssamawati wa  lardi wa  khtilafu asinatikum waalwanikum inna fee thalika laayatin lil'alimeen
verses.23: Wamin ayatihi manamukum bi  llayli wa  nnahari wa  btighaokum min fadlihi inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yasma'oon
verses.24: Wamin ayatihi yureekumu albarqa khawfan watama'an wayunazzilu mina a  ssamai maan fayuhyee bihi alarda ba'da mawtiha inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin ya'qiloon
verses.25: Wamin ayatihi an taqooma a  ssamao wa  lardu biamrihi thumma itha da'akum da'watan mina alardi itha antum takhrujoon
verses.26: Walahu man fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi kullun lahu qanitoon
verses.27: Wahuwa allathee yabdao alkhalqa thumma yu'eeduhu wahuwa ahwanu 'alayhi walahu almathalu ala'la fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.28: Daraba lakum mathalan min anfusikum hal lakum mi mma malakat aymanukum min shurakaa fee ma razaqnakum faantum feehi sawaon takhafoonahum kakheefatikum anfusakum kathalika nufassilu alayati liqawmin ya'qiloon
verses.29: Bali ittaba'a allatheena _th_ alamoo ahwaahum bighayri 'ilmin faman yahdee man adalla Allahu wama lahum min nasireen
verses.30: Faaqim wajhaka li  ddeeni haneefan fitrata Allahi allatee fatara a  nnasa 'alayha la tabdeela likhalqi Allahi thalika a  ddeenu alqayyimu walakinna akthara a  nnasi la ya'lamoon
verses.31: Muneebeena ilayhi wa  ttaqoohu waaqeemoo a  ssalata wala takoonoo mina almushrikeen
verses.32: Mina allatheena farraqoo deenahum wakanoo shiya'an kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoon
verses.33: Waitha massa a  nnasa durrun da'aw rabbahum muneebeena ilayhi thumma itha athaqahum minhu rahmatan itha fareequn minhum birabbihim yushrikoon
verses.34: Liyakfuroo bimaataynahum fatamatta'oo fasawfa ta'lamoon
verses.35: Am anzana 'alayhim sultanan fahuwa yatakallamu bima kanoo bihi yushrikoon
verses.36: Wa  tha athaqna a  nnasa rahmatan farihoo biha wain tusibhum sayyiatun bima qaddamat aydeehim itha hum yaqnatoon
verses.37: Awalam yaraw anna Allaha yabsutu a  rrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoon
verses.38: Faati tha alqurbahaqqahu wa  lmiskeena wa  bna a  ssabeeli thalika khayrun lillatheena yureedoona wajha Allahi waolaika humu almuflihoon
verses.39: Wamaataytum min riban liyarbuwa fee amwali a  nnasi fala yarboo 'inda Allahi wamaataytum min zakatin tureedoona wajha Allahi faolaika humu almud'ifoon
verses.40: Allahu allathee khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum hal min shurakaikum man yaf'alu min thalikum min shayin subhanahu wata'ala 'amma yushrikoon
verses.41: _Th_ ahara alfasadu fee albarri wa  lbahri bima kasabat aydee a  nnasi liyutheeqahum ba'da allathee 'amiloo la'allahum yarji'oon
verses.42: Qul seeroo fee alardi fa  n _th_ uroo kayfa kana 'aqibatu allatheena min qablu kana aktharuhum mushrikeen
verses.43: Faaqim wajhaka li  ddeeni alqayyimi min qabli an yatiya yawmun la maradda lahu mina Allahi yawmaithin yassadda'oon
verses.44: Man kafara fa'alayhi kufruhu waman 'amila salihan falianfusihim yamhadoon
verses.45: Liyajziya allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati min fadlihi innahu la yuhibbu alkafireen
verses.46: Wamin ayatihi an yursila a  rriyaha mubashshiratin waliyutheeqakum min rahmatihi walitajriya alfulku biamrihi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi wala'allakum tashkuroon
verses.47: Walaqad arsana min qablika rusulan ila qawmihim fajaoohum bi  lbayyinati fa  ntaqamna mina allatheena ajramoo wakana haqqan 'alayna nasru almumineen
verses.48: Allahu allathee yursilu a  rriyaha fatutheeru sahaban fayabsutuhu fee a  ssamai kayfa yashao wayaj'aluhu kisafan fatara alwadqa yakhruju min khilalihi faitha asaba bihi man yashao min 'ibadihi itha hum yastabshiroon
verses.49: Wain kanoo min qabli an yunazzala 'alayhim min qablihi lamubliseen
verses.50: Fa  n _th_ ur ilaathari rahmati Allahi kayfa yuhyee alarda ba'da mawtiha inna thalika lamuhyee almawta wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.51: Walain arsana reehan faraawhu musfarran la _th_ alloo min ba'dihi yakfuroon
verses.52: Fainnaka la tusmi'u almawta wala tusmi'u a  ssumma a  ddu'aa itha wallaw mudbireen
verses.53: Wama anta bihadi al'umyi 'an dalalatihim in tusmi'u illa man yuminu biayatina fahum muslimoon
verses.54: Allahu allathee khalaqakum min da'fin thumma ja'ala min ba'di da'fin quwwatan thumma ja'ala min ba'di quwwatin da'fan washaybatan yakhluqu ma yashao wahuwa al'aleemu alqadeer
verses.55: Wayawma taqoomu a  ssa'atu yuqsimu almujrimoona ma labithoo ghayra sa'atin kathalika kanoo yufakoon
verses.56: Waqala allatheena ootoo al'ilma wa  leemana laqad labithtum fee kitabi Allahi ila yawmi alba'thi fahatha yawmu alba'thi walakinnakum kuntum la ta'lamoon
verses.57: Fayawmaithin la yanfa'u allatheena _th_ alamoo ma'thiratuhum wala hum yusta'taboon
verses.58: Walaqad darabna li  nnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin walain jitahum biayatin layaqoolanna allatheena kafaroo in antum illa mubtiloon
verses.59: Kathalika yatba'u Allahu 'ala quloobi allatheena la ya'lamoon
verses.60: Fa  sbir inna wa'da Allahi haqqun wala yastakhiffannaka allatheena la yooqinoon

verses.3: Hudan warahmatan lilmuhsineen
verses.4: Allatheena yuqeemoona a  ssalata wayutoona a  zzakata wahum bi  lakhirati hum yooqinoon
verses.5: Olaika 'ala hudan min rabbihim waolaika humu almuflihoon
verses.6: Wamina a  nnasi man yashtaree lahwa alhadeethi liyudilla 'an sabeeli Allahi bighayri 'ilmin wayattakhithaha huzuwan olaika lahum 'athabun muheen
verses.7: Waitha tutla 'alayhi ayatuna walla mustakbiran kaan lam yasma'ha kaanna fee othunayhi waqran fabashshirhu bi'athabin aleem
verses.8: Inna allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati lahum jannatu a  nna'eem
verses.9: Khalideena feeha wa'da Allahi haqqan wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.10: Khalaqa a  ssamawati bighayri 'amadin tarawnaha waalqa fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bikum wabaththa feeha min kulli dabbatin waanzana mina a  ssamai maan faanbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareem
verses.11: Hatha khalqu Allahi faaroonee matha khalaqa allatheena min doonihi bali a  _thth_ alimoona fee dalalin mubeen
verses.12: Walaqad atayna luqmana alhikmata ani oshkur lillahi waman yashkur fainnama yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fainna Allaha ghaniyyun hameed
verses.13: Waith qala luqmanu li  bnihi wahuwa ya'i _th_ uhu ya bunayya la tushrik bi  llahi inna a  shshirka la _th_ ulmun 'a _th_ eem
verses.14: Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi hamalathu ommuhu wahnan 'ala wahnin wafisaluhu fee 'amayni ani oshkur lee waliwalidayka ilayya almaseer
verses.15: Wain jahadaka 'ala an tushrika bee ma laysa laka bihi 'ilmun fala tuti'huma wasahibhuma fee a  ddunya ma'roofan wa  ttabi' sabeela man anaba ilayya thumma ilayya marji'ukum faonabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.16: Ya bunayya innaha in taku mithqala habbatin min khardalin fatakun fee sakhratin aw fee a  ssamawati aw fee alardi yati biha Allahu inna Allaha lateefun khabeer
verses.17: Ya bunayya aqimi a  ssalata wamur bi  lma'roofi wa  nha 'ani almunkari wa  sbir 'ala ma asabaka inna thalika min 'azmi alomoor
verses.18: Wala tusa''ir khaddaka li  nnasi wala tamshi fee alardi marahan inna Allaha la yuhibbu kulla mukhtalin fakhoor
verses.19: Wa  qsid fee mashyika wa  ghdud min sawtika inna ankara alaswati lasawtu alhameer
verses.20: Alam taraw anna Allaha sakhkhara lakum ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi waasbagha 'alaykum ni'amahu _th_ ahiratan wabatinatan wamina a  nnasi man yujadilu fee Allahi bighayri 'ilmin wala hudan wala kitabin muneer
verses.21: Waitha qeela lahumu ittabi'oo ma anzala Allahu qaloo bal nattabi'u ma wajadna 'alayhi abaana awalaw kana a  shshaytanu yad'oohum ila 'athabi a  ssa'eer
verses.22: Waman yuslim wajhahu ila Allahi wahuwa muhsinun faqadi istamsaka bi  l'urwati alwuthqa waila Allahi 'aqibatu alomoor
verses.23: Waman kafara fala yahzunka kufruhu ilayna marji'uhum fanunabbiohum bima 'amiloo inna Allaha 'aleemun bithati a  ssudoor
verses.24: Numatti'uhum qaleelan thumma nadtarruhum ila 'athabin ghalee _th_
verses.25: Walain saatahum man khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda layaqoolunna Allahu quli alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la ya'lamoon
verses.26: Lillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi inna Allaha huwa alghaniyyu alhameed
verses.27: Walaw annama fee alardi min shajaratin aqlamun wa  lbahru yamudduhu min ba'dihi sab'atu abhurin ma nafidat kalimatu Allahi inna Allaha 'azeezun hakeem
verses.28: Ma khalqukum wala ba'thukum illa kanafsin wahidatin inna Allaha samee'un baseer
verses.29: Alam tara anna Allaha yooliju allayla fee a  nnahari wayooliju a  nnahara fee allayli wasakhkhara a  shshamsa wa  lqamara kullun yajree ila ajalin musamman waanna Allaha bima ta'maloona khabeer
verses.30: Thalika bianna Allaha huwa alhaqqu waanna ma yad'oona min doonihi albatilu waanna Allaha huwa al'aliyyu alkabeer
verses.31: Alam tara anna alfulka tajree fee albahri bini'mati Allahi liyuriyakum min ayatihi inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoor
verses.32: Waitha ghashiyahum mawjun ka  _thth_ ulali da'awoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu a  ddeena falamma najjahum ila albarri faminhum muqtasidun wama yajhadu biayatina illa kullu khattarin kafoor
verses.33: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu ittaqoo rabbakum wa  khshaw yawman la yajzee walidun 'an waladihi wala mawloodun huwa jazin 'an walidihi shayan inna wa'da Allahi haqqun fala taghurrannakumu alhayatu a  ddunya wala yaghurrannakum bi  llahi algharoor
verses.34: Inna Allaha 'indahu 'ilmu a  ssa'ati wayunazzilu alghaytha waya'lamu ma fee alarhami wama tadree nafsun matha taksibu ghadan wama tadree nafsun biayyi ardin tamootu inna Allaha 'aleemun khabeer

verses.2: Tanzeelu alkitabi la rayba feehi min rabbi al'alameen
verses.3: Am yaqooloona iftarahu bal huwa alhaqqu min rabbika litunthira qawman ma atahum min natheerin min qablika la'allahum yahtadoon
verses.4: Allahu allathee khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa 'ala al'arshi ma lakum min doonihi min waliyyin wala shafee'in afala tatathakkaroon
verses.5: Yudabbiru alamra mina a  ssamai ila alardi thumma ya'ruju ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu alfa sanatin mimma ta'uddoon
verses.6: Thalika 'alimu alghaybi wa  shshahadati al'azeezu a  rraheem
verses.7: Allathee ahsana kulla shayin khalaqahu wabadaa khalqa alinsani min teen
verses.8: Thumma ja'ala naslahu min sulalatin min main maheen
verses.9: Thumma sawwahu wanafakha feehi min roohihi waja'ala lakumu a  ssam'a wa  labsara wa  lafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroon
verses.10: Waqaloo aithadalana fee alardi ainna lafee khalqin jadeedin bal hum biliqai rabbihim kafiroon
verses.11: Qul yatawaffakum malaku almawti allathee wukkila bikum thumma ila rabbikum turja'oon
verses.12: Walaw tara ithi almujrimoona nakisoo ruoosihim 'inda rabbihim rabbana absarna wasami'na faarji'na na'mal salihan inna mooqinoon
verses.13: Walaw shina laatayna kulla nafsin hudaha walakin haqqa alqawlu minnee laamlaanna jahannama mina aljinnati wa  nnasi ajma'een
verses.14: Fathooqoo bima naseetum liqaa yawmikum hatha inna naseenakum wathooqoo 'athaba alkhuldi bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.15: Innama yuminu biayatina allatheena ithathukkiroo biha kharroo sujjadan wasabbahoo bihamdi rabbihim wahum la yastakbiroon
verses.16: Tatajafa junoobuhum 'ani almadaji'i yad'oona rabbahum khawfan watama'an wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoon
verses.17: Fala ta'lamu nafsun ma okhfiya lahum min qurrati a'yunin jazaan bima kanoo ya'maloon
verses.18: Afaman kana muminan kaman kana fasiqan la yastawoon
verses.19: Amma allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati falahum jannatu almawa nuzulan bima kanoo ya'maloon
verses.20: Waamma allatheena fasaqoo famawahumu a  nnaru kullama aradoo an yakhrujoo minha o'eedoo feeha waqeela lahum thooqoo 'athaba a  nnari allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboon
verses.21: Walanutheeqannahum mina al'athabi aladna doona al'athabi alakbari la'allahum yarji'oon
verses.22: Waman a _th_ lamu mimman thukkira biayati rabbihi thumma a'rada 'anha inna mina almujrimeena muntaqimoon
verses.23: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba fala takun fee miryatin min liqaihi waja'anahu hudan libanee israeel
verses.24: Waja'ana minhum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina lammasabaroo wakanoo biayatina yooqinoon
verses.25: Inna rabbaka huwa yafsilu baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
verses.26: Awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna min qablihim mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin afala yasma'oon
verses.27: Awalam yaraw anna nasooqu almaa ila alardi aljuruzi fanukhriju bihi zar'an takulu minhu an'amuhum waanfusuhum afala yubsiroon
verses.28: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alfathu in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.29: Qul yawma alfathi la yanfa'u allatheena kafaroo eemanuhum wala hum yun _th_ aroon
verses.30: Faa'rid 'anhum wa  nta _th_ ir innahum munta _th_ iroon

verses.1: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu ittaqi Allaha wala tuti'i alkafireena wa  lmunafiqeena inna Allaha kana 'aleeman hakeema
verses.2: Wa  ttabi' ma yooha ilayka min rabbika inna Allaha kana bima ta'maloona khabeera
verses.3: Watawakkal 'ala Allahi wakafa bi  llahi wakeela
verses.4: Ma ja'ala Allahu lirajulin min qalbayni fee jawfihi wama ja'ala azwajakumu allaee tu _th_ ahiroona minhunna ommahatikum wama ja'ala ad'iyaakum abnaakum thalikum qawlukum biafwahikum wa  llahu yaqoolu alhaqqa wahuwa yahdee a  ssabeel
verses.5: Od'oohum liabaihim huwa aqsatu 'inda Allahi fain lam ta'lamoo abaahum faikhwanukum fee a  ddeeni wamawaleekum walaysa 'alaykum junahun feema akhtatum bihi walakin ma ta'ammadat quloobukum wakana Allahu ghafooran raheema
verses.6: A  nnabiyyu awla bi  lmumineena min anfusihim waazwajuhu ommahatuhum waoloo alarhami ba'duhum awla biba'din fee kitabi Allahi mina almumineena wa  lmuhajireena illa an taf'aloo ila awliyaikum ma'roofan kana thalika fee alkitabi mastoora
verses.7: Waith akhathna mina a  nnabiyyeena meethaqahum waminka wamin noohin waibraheema wamoosa wa'eesa ibni maryama waakhathna minhum meethaqan ghalee _th_ a
verses.8: Liyasala a  ssadiqeena 'an sidqihim waa'adda lilkafireena 'athaban aleema
verses.9: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo othkuroo ni'mata Allahi 'alaykum ith jaatkum junoodun faarsana 'alayhim reehan wajunoodan lam tarawha wakana Allahu bima ta'maloona baseera
verses.10: Ith jaookum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum waith zaghati alabsaru wabalaghati alquloobu alhanajira wata _th_ unnoona bi  llahi a  _thth_ unoona
verses.11: Hunalika ibtuliya almuminoona wazulziloo zilzalan shadeeda
verses.12: Waith yaqoolu almunafiqoona wa  llatheena fee quloobihim maradun ma wa'adana Allahu warasooluhu illa ghuroora
verses.13: Waith qalat taifatun minhum ya ahla yathriba la muqama lakum fa  rji'oo wayastathinu fareequn minhumu a  nnabiyya yaqooloona inna buyootana 'awratun wama hiya bi'awratin in yureedoona illa firara
verses.14: Walaw dukhilat 'alayhim min aqtariha thumma suiloo alfitnata laatawha wama talabbathoo biha illa yaseera
verses.15: Walaqad kanoo 'ahadoo Allaha min qablu la yuwalloona aladbara wakana 'ahdu Allahi masoola
verses.16: Qul lan yanfa'akumu alfiraru in farartum mina almawti awi alqatli waithan la tumatta'oona illa qaleela
verses.17: Qul man tha allathee ya'simukum mina Allahi in arada bikum sooan aw arada bikum rahmatan wala yajidoona lahum min dooni Allahi waliyyan wala naseera
verses.18: Qad ya'lamu Allahu almu'awwiqeena minkum wa  lqaileena liikhwanihim halumma ilayna wala yatoona albasa illa qaleela
verses.19: Ashihhatan 'alaykum faitha jaa alkhawfu raaytahum yan _th_ uroona ilayka tadooru a'yunuhum ka  llathee yughsha 'alayhi mina almawti faithathahaba alkhawfu salaqookum biasinatin hidadin ashihhatan 'ala alkhayri olaika lam yuminoo faahbata Allahu a'malahum wakana thalika 'ala Allahi yaseera
verses.20: Yahsaboona alahzaba lam yathhaboo wain yati alahzabu yawaddoo law annahum badoona fee ala'rabi yasaloona 'an anbaikum walaw kanoo feekum ma qataloo illa qaleela
verses.21: Laqad kana lakum fee rasooli Allahi oswatun hasanatun liman kana yarjoo Allaha wa  lyawma alakhira wathakara Allaha katheera
verses.22: Walamma raa almuminoona alahzaba qaloo hatha ma wa'adana Allahu warasooluhu wasadaqa Allahu warasooluhu wama zadahum illa eemanan watasleema
verses.23: Mina almumineena rijalun sadaqoo ma 'ahadoo Allaha 'alayhi faminhum man qada nahbahu waminhum man yanta _th_ iru wama baddaloo tabdeela
verses.24: Liyajziya Allahu a  ssadiqeena bisidqihim wayu'aththiba almunafiqeena in shaa aw yatooba 'alayhim inna Allaha kana ghafooran raheema
verses.25: Waradda Allahu allatheena kafaroo bighay _th_ ihim lam yanaloo khayran wakafa Allahu almumineena alqitala wakana Allahu qawiyyan 'azeeza
verses.26: Waanzala allatheena _th_ aharoohum min ahli alkitabi min sayaseehim waqathafa fee quloobihimu a  rru'ba fareeqan taqtuloona watasiroona fareeqa
verses.27: Waawrathakum ardahum wadiyarahum waamwalahum waardan lam tataooha wakana Allahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeera
verses.28: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu qul liazwajika in kuntunna turidna alhayata a  ddunya wazeenataha fata'alayna omatti'kunna waosarrihkunna sarahan jameela
verses.29: Wain kuntunna turidna Allaha warasoolahu wa  ddara alakhirata fainna Allaha a'adda lilmuhsinati minkunna ajran 'a _th_ eema
verses.30: Ya nisaa a  nnabiyyi man yati minkunna bifahishatin mubayyinatin yuda'af laha al'athabu di'fayni wakana thalika 'ala Allahi yaseera
verses.31: Waman yaqnut minkunna lillahi warasoolihi wata'mal salihan nutiha ajraha marratayni waa'tadna laha rizqan kareema
verses.32: Ya nisaa a  nnabiyyi lastunna kaahadin mina a  nnisai ini ittaqaytunna fala takhda'na bi  lqawli fayatma'a allathee fee qalbihi maradun waqulna qawlan ma'roofa
verses.33: Waqarna fee buyootikunna wala tabarrajna tabarruja aljahiliyyati aloola waaqimna a  ssalata waateena a  zzakata waati'na Allaha warasoolahu innama yureedu Allahu liyuthhiba 'ankumu a  rrijsa ahla albayti wayutahhirakum tatheera
verses.34: Wa  thkurna ma yutla fee buyootikunna min ayati Allahi wa  lhikmati inna Allaha kana lateefan khabeera
verses.35: Inna almuslimeena wa  lmuslimati wa  lmumineena wa  lmuminati wa  lqaniteena wa  lqanitati wa  ssadiqeena wa  ssadiqati wa  ssabireena wa  ssabirati wa  lkhashi'eena wa  lkhashi'ati wa  lmutasaddiqeena wa  lmutasaddiqati wa  ssaimeena wa  ssaimati wa  lhafi _th_ eena furoojahum wa  lhafi _th_ ati wa  ththakireena Allaha katheeran wa  ththakirati a'adda Allahu lahum maghfiratan waajran 'a _th_ eema
verses.36: Wama kana limuminin wala muminatin itha qada Allahu warasooluhu amran an yakoona lahumu alkhiyaratu min amrihim waman ya'si Allaha warasoolahu faqad dalla dalalan mubeena
verses.37: Waith taqoolu lillathee an'ama Allahu 'alayhi waan'amta 'alayhi amsik 'alayka zawjaka wa  ttaqi Allaha watukhfee fee nafsika ma Allahu mubdeehi watakhsha a  nnasa wa  llahu ahaqqu an takhshahu falamma qada zaydun minha wataran zawwajnakaha likay la yakoona 'ala almumineena harajun fee azwaji ad'iyaihim itha qadaw minhunna wataran wakana amru Allahi maf'oola
verses.38: Ma kana 'ala a  nnabiyyi min harajin feema farada Allahu lahu sunnata Allahi fee allatheena khalaw min qablu wakana amru Allahi qadaran maqdoora
verses.39: Allatheena yuballighoona risalati Allahi wayakhshawnahu wala yakhshawna ahadan illa Allaha wakafa bi  llahi haseeba
verses.40: Ma kana muhammadun aba ahadin min rijalikum walakin rasoola Allahi wakhatama a  nnabiyyeena wakana Allahu bikulli shayin 'aleema
verses.41: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo othkuroo Allaha thikran katheera
verses.42: Wasabbihoohu bukratan waaseela
verses.43: Huwa allathee yusallee 'alaykum wamalaikatuhu liyukhrijakum mina a  _thth_ ulumati ila a  nnoori wakana bi  lmumineena raheema
verses.44: Tahiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahu salamun waa'adda lahum ajran kareema
verses.45: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu inna arsanaka shahidan wamubashshiran wanatheera
verses.46: Wada'iyan ila Allahi biithnihi wasirajan muneera
verses.47: Wabashshiri almumineena bianna lahum mina Allahi fadlan kabeera
verses.48: Wala tuti'i alkafireena wa  lmunafiqeena wada' athahum watawakkal 'ala Allahi wakafa bi  llahi wakeela
verses.49: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha nakahtumu almuminati thumma tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna fama lakum 'alayhinna min 'iddatin ta'taddoonaha famatti'oohunna wasarrihoohunna sarahan jameela
verses.50: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu inna ahlana laka azwajaka allatee atayta ojoorahunna wama malakat yameenuka mimma afaa Allahu 'alayka wabanati 'ammika wabanati 'ammatika wabanati khalika wabanati khalatika allatee hajarna ma'aka wa  mraatan muminatan in wahabat nafsaha li  nnabiyyi in arada a  nnabiyyu an yastankihaha khalisatan laka min dooni almumineena qad 'alimna ma faradna 'alayhim fee azwajihim wama malakat aymanuhum likayla yakoona 'alayka harajun wakana Allahu ghafooran raheema
verses.51: Turjee man tashao minhunna watuwee ilayka man tashao wamani ibtaghayta mimman 'azata fala junaha 'alayka thalika adna an taqarra a'yunuhunna wala yahzanna wayardayna bimaataytahunna kulluhunna wa  llahu ya'lamu ma fee quloobikum wakana Allahu 'aleeman haleema
verses.52: La yahillu laka a  nnisao min ba'du wala an tabaddala bihinna min azwajin walaw a'jabaka husnuhunna illa ma malakat yameenuka wakana Allahu 'ala kulli shayin raqeeba
verses.53: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tadkhuloo buyoota a  nnabiyyi illa an yuthana lakum ilata'amin ghayra na _th_ ireena inahu walakin itha du'eetum fa  dkhuloo faithata'imtum fa  ntashiroo wala mustaniseena lihadeethin inna thalikum kana yuthee a  nnabiyya fayastahyee minkum wa  llahu la yastahyee mina alhaqqi waitha saatumoohunna mata'an fa  saloohunna min warai hijabin thalikum atharu liquloobikum waquloobihinna wama kana lakum an tuthoo rasoola Allahi wala an tankihoo azwajahu min ba'dihi abadan inna thalikum kana 'inda Allahi 'a _th_ eema
verses.54: In tubdoo shayan aw tukhfoohu fainna Allaha kana bikulli shayin 'aleema
verses.55: La junaha 'alayhinna fee abaihinna wala abnaihinna wala ikhwanihinna wala abnai ikhwanihinna wala abnai akhawatihinna wala nisaihinna wala ma malakat aymanuhunna wa  ttaqeena Allaha inna Allaha kana 'ala kulli shayin shaheeda
verses.56: Inna Allaha wamalaikatahu yusalloona 'ala a  nnabiyyi ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo salloo 'alayhi wasallimoo tasleema
verses.57: Inna allatheena yuthoona Allaha warasoolahu la'anahumu Allahu fee a  ddunya wa  lakhirati waa'adda lahum 'athaban muheena
verses.58: Wa  llatheena yuthoona almumineena wa  lmuminati bighayri ma iktasaboo faqadi ihtamaloo buhtanan waithman mubeena
verses.59: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu qul liazwajika wabanatika wanisai almumineena yudneena 'alayhinna min jalabeebihinna thalika adna an yu'rafna fala yuthayna wakana Allahu ghafooran raheema
verses.60: Lain lam yantahi almunafiqoona wa  llatheena fee quloobihim maradun wa  lmurjifoona fee almadeenati lanughriyannaka bihim thumma la yujawiroonaka feeha illa qaleela
verses.61: Mal'ooneena aynama thuqifoo okhithoo waquttiloo taqteela
verses.62: Sunnata Allahi fee allatheena khalaw min qablu walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeela
verses.63: Yasaluka a  nnasu 'ani a  ssa'ati qul innama 'ilmuha 'inda Allahi wama yudreeka la'alla a  ssa'ata takoonu qareeba
verses.64: Inna Allaha la'ana alkafireena waa'adda lahum sa'eera
verses.65: Khalideena feeha abadan la yajidoona waliyyan wala naseera
verses.66: Yawma tuqallabu wujoohuhum fee a  nnari yaqooloona ya laytana ata'na Allaha waata'na a  rrasoola
verses.67: Waqaloo rabbana inna ata'na sadatana wakubaraana faadalloona a  ssabeela
verses.68: Rabbanaatihim di'fayni mina al'athabi wa  l'anhum la'nan kabeera
verses.69: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la takoonoo ka  llatheena athaw moosa fabarraahu Allahu mimma qaloo wakana 'inda Allahi wajeeha
verses.70: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waqooloo qawlan sadeeda
verses.71: Yuslih lakum a'malakum wayaghfir lakum thunoobakum waman yuti'i Allaha warasoolahu faqad faza fawzan 'a _th_ eema
verses.72: Inna 'aradna alamanata 'ala a  ssamawati wa  lardi wa  ljibali faabayna an yahmilnaha waashfaqna minha wahamalaha alinsanu innahu kana _th_ alooman jahoola
verses.73: Liyu'aththiba Allahu almunafiqeena wa  lmunafiqati wa  lmushrikeena wa  lmushrikati wayatooba Allahu 'ala almumineena wa  lmuminati wakana Allahu ghafooran raheema

verses.1: Alhamdu lillahi allathee lahu ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi walahu alhamdu fee alakhirati wahuwa alhakeemu alkhabeer
verses.2: Ya'lamu ma yaliju fee alardi wama yakhruju minha wama yanzilu mina a  ssamai wama ya'ruju feeha wahuwa a  rraheemu alghafoor
verses.3: Waqala allatheena kafaroo la tateena a  ssa'atu qul bala warabbee latatiyannakum 'alimi alghaybi la ya'zubu 'anhu mithqalu tharratin fee a  ssamawati wala fee alardi wala asgharu min thalika wala akbaru illa fee kitabin mubeen
verses.4: Liyajziya allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati olaika lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareem
verses.5: Wa  llatheena sa'aw fee ayatina mu'ajizeena olaika lahum 'athabun min rijzin aleem
verses.6: Wayara allatheena ootoo al'ilma allathee onzila ilayka min rabbika huwa alhaqqa wayahdee ilasirati al'azeezi alhameed
verses.7: Waqala allatheena kafaroo hal nadullukum 'ala rajulin yunabbiokum itha muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafee khalqin jadeed
verses.8: Aftara 'ala Allahi kathiban am bihi jinnatun bali allatheena la yuminoona bi  lakhirati fee al'athabi wa  ddalali alba'eed
verses.9: Afalam yaraw ila ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum mina a  ssamai wa  lardi in nasha nakhsif bihimu alarda aw nusqit 'alayhim kisafan mina a  ssamai inna fee thalika laayatan likulli 'abdin muneeb
verses.10: Walaqad atayna dawooda minna fadlan ya jibalu awwibee ma'ahu wa  ttayra waalanna lahu alhadeed
verses.11: Ani i'mal sabighatin waqaddir fee a  ssardi wa  'maloo salihan innee bima ta'maloona baseer
verses.12: Walisulaymana a  rreeha ghuduwwuha shahrun warawahuha shahrun waasana lahu 'ayna alqitri wamina aljinni man ya'malu bayna yadayhi biithni rabbihi waman yazigh minhum 'an amrina nuthiqhu min 'athabi a  ssa'eer
verses.13: Ya'maloona lahu ma yashao min mahareeba watamatheela wajifanin ka  ljawabi waqudoorin rasiyatin i'maloo ala dawooda shukran waqaleelun min 'ibadiya a  shshakoor
verses.14: Falamma qadayna 'alayhi almawta ma dallahum 'ala mawtihi illa dabbatu alardi takulu minsaatahu falamma kharra tabayyanati aljinnu an law kanoo ya'lamoona alghayba ma labithoo fee al'athabi almuheen
verses.15: Laqad kana lisabain fee maskanihim ayatun jannatani 'an yameenin washimalin kuloo min rizqi rabbikum wa  shkuroo lahu badatun tayyibatun warabbun ghafoor
verses.16: Faa'radoo faarsana 'alayhim sayla al'arimi wabaddanahum bijannatayhim jannatayni thawatay okulin khamtin waathlin washayin min sidrin qaleel
verses.17: Thalika jazaynahum bima kafaroo wahal nujazee illa alkafoor
verses.18: Waja'ana baynahum wabayna alqura allatee barakna feeha quran _th_ ahiratan waqaddarna feeha a  ssayra seeroo feeha layaliya waayyaman amineen
verses.19: Faqaloo rabbana ba'id bayna asfarina wa _th_ alamoo anfusahum faja'anahum ahadeetha wamazzaqnahum kulla mumazzaqin inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoor
verses.20: Walaqad saddaqa 'alayhim ibleesu _th_ annahu fa  ttaba'oohu illa fareeqan mina almumineen
verses.21: Wama kana lahu 'alayhim min sultanin illa lina'lama man yuminu bi  lakhirati mimman huwa minha fee shakkin warabbuka 'ala kulli shayin hafee _th_
verses.22: Quli od'oo allatheena za'amtum min dooni Allahi la yamlikoona mithqala tharratin fee a  ssamawati wala fee alardi wama lahum feehima min shirkin wama lahu minhum min _th_ aheer
verses.23: Wala tanfa'u a  shshafa'atu 'indahu illa liman athina lahu hatta itha fuzzi'a 'an quloobihim qaloo matha qala rabbukum qaloo alhaqqa wahuwa al'aliyyu alkabeer
verses.24: Qul man yarzuqukum mina a  ssamawati wa  lardi quli Allahu wainna aw iyyakum la'ala hudan aw fee dalalin mubeen
verses.25: Qul la tusaloona 'amma ajramna wala nusalu 'amma ta'maloon
verses.26: Qul yajma'u baynana rabbuna thumma yaftahu baynana bi  lhaqqi wahuwa alfattahu al'aleem
verses.27: Qul arooniya allatheena alhaqtum bihi shurakaa kalla bal huwa Allahu al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.28: Wama arsanaka illa kaffatan li  nnasi basheeran wanatheeran walakinna akthara a  nnasi la ya'lamoon
verses.29: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwa'du in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.30: Qul lakum mee'adu yawmin la tastakhiroona 'anhu sa'atan wala tastaqdimoon
verses.31: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lan numina bihatha alqurani wala bi  llathee bayna yadayhi walaw tara ithi a  _thth_ alimoona mawqoofoona 'inda rabbihim yarji'u ba'duhum ila ba'din alqawla yaqoolu allatheena istud'ifoo lillatheena istakbaroo lawla antum lakunna mumineen
verses.32: Qala allatheena istakbaroo lillatheena istud'ifoo anahnu sadadnakum 'ani alhuda ba'da ith jaakum bal kuntum mujrimeen
verses.33: Waqala allatheena istud'ifoo lillatheena istakbaroo bal makru allayli wa  nnahari ith tamuroonana an nakfura bi  llahi wanaj'ala lahu andadan waasarroo a  nnadamata lamma raawoo al'athaba waja'ana alaghlala fee a'naqi allatheena kafaroo hal yujzawna illa ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.34: Wama arsana fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroon
verses.35: Waqaloo nahnu aktharu amwalan waawladan wama nahnu bimu'aththabeen
verses.36: Qul inna rabbee yabsutu a  rrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru walakinna akthara a  nnasi la ya'lamoon
verses.37: Wama amwalukum wala awladukum bi  llatee tuqarribukum 'indana zulfa illa man amana wa'amila salihan faolaika lahum jazao a  ddi'fi bima 'amiloo wahum fee alghurufati aminoon
verses.38: Wa  llatheena yas'awna fee ayatina mu'ajizeena olaika fee al'athabi muhdaroon
verses.39: Qul inna rabbee yabsutu a  rrizqa liman yashao min 'ibadihi wayaqdiru lahu wama anfaqtum min shayin fahuwa yukhlifuhu wahuwa khayru a  rraziqeen
verses.40: Wayawma yahshuruhum jamee'an thumma yaqoolu lilmalaikati ahaolai iyyakum kanoo ya'budoon
verses.41: Qaloo subhanaka anta waliyyuna min doonihim bal kanoo ya'budoona aljinna aktharuhum bihim muminoon
verses.42: Fa  lyawma la yamliku ba'dukum liba'din naf'an waladarran wanaqoolu lillatheena _th_ alamoo thooqoo 'athaba a  nnari allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboon
verses.43: Waitha tutla 'alayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qaloo ma hatha illa rajulun yureedu an yasuddakum 'amma kana ya'budu abaokum waqaloo ma hatha illa ifkun muftaran waqala allatheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lamma jaahum in hatha illa sihrun mubeen
verses.44: Wamaataynahum min kutubin yadrusoonaha wama arsana ilayhim qablaka min natheer
verses.45: Wakaththaba allatheena min qablihim wama balaghoo mi'shara maataynahum fakaththaboo rusulee fakayfa kana nakeer
verses.46: Qul innama a'i _th_ ukum biwahidatin an taqoomoo lillahi mathna wafurada thumma tatafakkaroo ma bisahibikum min jinnatin in huwa illa natheerun lakum bayna yaday 'athabin shadeed
verses.47: Qul ma saatukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum in ajriya illa 'ala Allahi wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin shaheed
verses.48: Qul inna rabbee yaqthifu bi  lhaqqi 'allamu alghuyoob
verses.49: Qul jaa alhaqqu wama yubdio albatilu wama yu'eed
verses.50: Qul in dalatu fainnama adillu 'ala nafsee waini ihtadaytu fabima yoohee ilayya rabbee innahu samee'un qareeb
verses.51: Walaw tara ith fazi'oo fala fawta waokhithoo min makanin qareeb
verses.52: Waqaloo amanna bihi waanna lahumu a  ttanawushu min makanin ba'eed
verses.53: Waqad kafaroo bihi min qablu wayaqthifoona bi  lghaybi min makanin ba'eed
verses.54: Waheela baynahum wabayna ma yashtahoona kama fu'ila biashya'ihim min qablu innahum kanoo fee shakkin mureeb

verses.1: Alhamdu lillahi fatiri a  ssamawati wa  lardi ja'ili almalaikati rusulan olee ajnihatin mathna wathulatha waruba'a yazeedu fee alkhalqi ma yashao inna Allaha 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.2: Ma yaftahi Allahu li  nnasi min rahmatin fala mumsika laha wama yumsik fala mursila lahu min ba'dihi wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.3: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu othkuroo ni'mata Allahi 'alaykum hal min khaliqin ghayru Allahi yarzuqukum mina a  ssamai wa  lardi la ilaha illa huwa faanna tufakoon
verses.4: Wain yukaththibooka faqad kuththibat rusulun min qablika waila Allahi turja'u alomoor
verses.5: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu inna wa'da Allahi haqqun fala taghurrannakumu alhayatu a  ddunya wala yaghurrannakum bi  llahi algharoor
verses.6: Inna a  shshaytana lakum 'aduwwun fa  ttakhithoohu 'aduwwan innama yad'oo hizbahu liyakoonoo min ashabi a  ssa'eer
verses.7: Allatheena kafaroo lahum 'athabun shadeedun wa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeer
verses.8: Afaman zuyyina lahu sooo 'amalihi faraahu hasanan fainna Allaha yudillu man yashao wayahdee man yashao fala tathhab nafsuka 'alayhim hasaratin inna Allaha 'aleemun bima yasna'oon
verses.9: Wa  llahu allathee arsala a  rriyaha fatutheeru sahaban fasuqnahu ila baladin mayyitin faahyayna bihi alarda ba'da mawtiha kathalika a  nnushoor
verses.10: Man kana yureedu al'izzata falillahi al'izzatu jamee'an ilayhi yas'adu alkalimu a  ttayyibu wa  l'amalu a  ssalihu yarfa'uhu wa  llatheena yamkuroona a  ssayyiati lahum 'athabun shadeedun wamakru olaika huwa yaboor
verses.11: Wa  llahu khalaqakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma ja'alakum azwajan wama tahmilu min ontha wala tada'u illa bi'ilmihi wama yu'ammaru min mu'ammarin wala yunqasu min 'umurihi illa fee kitabin inna thalika 'ala Allahi yaseer
verses.12: Wama yastawee albahrani hatha 'athbun furatun saighun sharabuhu wahatha milhun ojajun wamin kullin takuloona lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoona hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka feehi mawakhira litabtaghoo min fadlihi wala'allakum tashkuroon
verses.13: Yooliju allayla fee a  nnahari wayooliju a  nnahara fee allayli wasakhkhara a  shshamsa wa  lqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku wa  llatheena tad'oona min doonihi ma yamlikoona min qitmeer
verses.14: In tad'oohum la yasma'oo du'aakum walaw sami'oo ma istajaboo lakum wayawma alqiyamati yakfuroona bishirkikum wala yunabbioka mithlu khabeer
verses.15: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu antumu alfuqarao ila Allahi wa  llahu huwa alghaniyyu alhameed
verses.16: In yasha yuthhibkum wayati bikhalqin jadeed
verses.17: Wamathalika 'ala Allahi bi'azeez
verses.18: Wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra wain tad'u muthqalatun ilahimliha la yuhmal minhu shayon walaw kana tha qurba innama tunthiru allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bi  lghaybi waaqamoo a  ssalata waman tazakka fainnama yatazakka linafsihi waila Allahi almaseer
verses.19: Wama yastawee ala'ma wa  lbaseer
verses.20: Wala a  _thth_ ulumatu wala a  nnoor
verses.21: Wala a  _thth_ illu wala alharoor
verses.22: Wama yastawee alahyao wala alamwatu inna Allaha yusmi'u man yashao wama anta bimusmi'in man fee alquboor
verses.23: In anta illa natheer
verses.24: Inna arsanaka bi  lhaqqi basheeran wanatheeran wain min ommatin illa khala feeha natheer
verses.25: Wain yukaththibooka faqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim jaathum rusuluhum bi  lbayyinati wabi  zzuburi wabi  lkitabi almuneer
verses.26: Thumma akhathtu allatheena kafaroo fakayfa kana nakeer
verses.27: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina a  ssamai maan faakhrajna bihi thamaratin mukhtalifan alwanuha wamina aljibali judadun beedun wahumrun mukhtalifun alwanuha wagharabeebu sood
verses.28: Wamina a  nnasi wa  ddawabbi wa  lan'ami mukhtalifun alwanuhu kathalika innama yakhsha Allaha min 'ibadihi al'ulamao inna Allaha 'azeezun ghafoor
verses.29: Inna allatheena yatloona kitaba Allahi waaqamoo a  ssalata waanfaqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran wa'alaniyatan yarjoona tijaratan lan taboor
verses.30: Liyuwaffiyahum ojoorahum wayazeedahum min fadlihi innahu ghafoorun shakoor
verses.31: Wa  llathee awhayna ilayka mina alkitabi huwa alhaqqu musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi inna Allaha bi'ibadihi lakhabeerun baseer
verses.32: Thumma awrathna alkitaba allatheena istafayna min 'ibadina faminhum _th_ alimun linafsihi waminhum muqtasidun waminhum sabiqun bi  lkhayrati biithni Allahi thalika huwa alfadlu alkabeer
verses.33: Jannatu 'adnin yadkhuloonaha yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin waluluan walibasuhum feehahareer
verses.34: Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee athhaba 'anna alhazana inna rabbana laghafoorun shakoor
verses.35: Allathee ahallana dara almuqamati min fadlihi la yamassuna feeha nasabun wala yamassuna feeha lughoob
verses.36: Wa  llatheena kafaroo lahum naru jahannama la yuqda 'alayhim fayamootoo wala yukhaffafu 'anhum min 'athabiha kathalika najzee kulla kafoor
verses.37: Wahum yastarikhoona feeha rabbana akhrijna na'mal salihan ghayra allathee kunna na'malu awalam nu'ammirkum ma yatathakkaru feehi man tathakkara wajaakumu a  nnatheeru fathooqoo fama li  _thth_ alimeena min naseer
verses.38: Inna Allaha 'alimu ghaybi a  ssamawati wa  lardi innahu 'aleemun bithati a  ssudoor
verses.39: Huwa allathee ja'alakum khalaifa fee alardi faman kafara fa'alayhi kufruhu wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum 'inda rabbihim illa maqtan wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum illa khasara
verses.40: Qul araaytum shurakaakumu allatheena tad'oona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee a  ssamawati am ataynahum kitaban fahum 'ala bayyinatin minhu bal in ya'idu a  _thth_ alimoona ba'duhum ba'dan illa ghuroora
verses.41: Inna Allaha yumsiku a  ssamawati wa  larda an tazoola walain zalata in amsakahuma min ahadin min ba'dihi innahu kana haleeman ghafoora
verses.42: Waaqsamoo bi  llahi jahda aymanihim lain jaahum natheerun layakoonunna ahda min ihda alomami falamma jaahum natheerun ma zadahum illa nufoora
verses.43: Istikbaran fee alardi wamakra a  ssayyii wala yaheequ almakru a  ssayyio illa biahlihi fahal yan _th_ uroona illa sunnata alawwaleena falan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tahweela
verses.44: Awalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayan _th_ uroo kayfa kana 'aqibatu allatheena min qablihim wakanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wama kana Allahu liyu'jizahu min shayin fee a  ssamawati wala fee alardi innahu kana 'aleeman qadeera
verses.45: Walaw yuakhithu Allahu a  nnasa bima kasaboo ma taraka 'ala _th_ ahriha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum fainna Allaha kana bi'ibadihi baseera

verses.3: Innaka lamina almursaleen
verses.4: 'alasiratin mustaqeem
verses.5: Tanzeela al'azeezi a  rraheem
verses.6: Litunthira qawman ma onthira abaohum fahum ghafiloon
verses.7: Laqad haqqa alqawlu 'ala aktharihim fahum la yuminoon
verses.8: Inna ja'ana fee a'naqihim aghlalan fahiya ila alathqani fahum muqmahoon
verses.9: Waja'ana min bayni aydeehim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan faaghshaynahum fahum la yubsiroon
verses.10: Wasawaon 'alayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoon
verses.11: Innama tunthiru mani ittaba'a a  ththikra wakhashiya a  rrahmana bi  lghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin waajrin kareem
verses.12: Inna nahnu nuhyee almawta wanaktubu ma qaddamoo waatharahum wakulla shayin ahsaynahu fee imamin mubeen
verses.13: Wa  drib lahum mathalan ashaba alqaryati ith jaaha almursaloon
verses.14: Ith arsana ilayhimu ithnayni fakaththaboohuma fa'azzazna bithalithin faqaloo inna ilaykum mursaloon
verses.15: Qaloo ma antum illa basharun mithluna wama anzala a  rrahmanu min shayin in antum illa takthiboon
verses.16: Qaloo rabbuna ya'lamu inna ilaykum lamursaloon
verses.17: Wama 'alayna illa albalaghu almubeen
verses.18: Qaloo inna tatayyarna bikum lain lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minna 'athabun aleem
verses.19: Qaloo tairukum ma'akum ain thukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoon
verses.20: Wajaa min aqsa almadeenati rajulun yas'a qala ya qawmi ittabi'oo almursaleen
verses.21: Ittabi'oo man la yasalukum ajran wahum muhtadoon
verses.22: Wama liya la a'budu allathee fataranee wailayhi turja'oon
verses.23: Aattakhithu min doonihi alihatan in yuridni a  rrahmanu bidurrin la tughni 'annee shafa'atuhum shayan wala yunqithoon
verses.24: Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeen
verses.25: Innee amantu birabbikum fa  sma'oon
verses.26: Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee ya'lamoon
verses.27: Bima ghafara lee rabbee waja'alanee mina almukrameen
verses.28: Wama anzana 'ala qawmihi min ba'dihi min jundin mina a  ssamai wama kunna munzileen
verses.29: In kanat illasayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoon
verses.30: Yahasratan 'ala al'ibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioon
verses.31: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarji'oon
verses.32: Wain kullun lamma jamee'un ladayna muhdaroon
verses.33: Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minhahabban faminhu yakuloon
verses.34: Waja'ana feeha jannatin min nakheelin waa'nabin wafajjarna feeha mina al'uyoon
verses.35: Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama 'amilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroon
verses.36: Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la ya'lamoon
verses.37: Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu a  nnahara faitha hum mu _th_ limoon
verses.38: Wa  shshamsu tajree limustaqarrin lahathalika taqdeeru al'azeezi al'aleem
verses.39: Wa  lqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta 'ada ka  l'urjooni alqadeem
verses.40: La a  shshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu a  nnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoon
verses.41: Waayatun lahum annahamanathurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhoon
verses.42: Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboon
verses.43: Wain nasha nughriqhum falasareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoon
verses.44: Illa rahmatan minna wamata'an ilaheen
verses.45: Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon
verses.46: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo 'anha mu'rideen
verses.47: Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anut'imu man law yashao Allahu at'amahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeen
verses.48: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwa'du in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.49: Ma yan _th_ uroona illasayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoon
verses.50: Fala yastatee'oona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarji'oon
verses.51: Wanufikha fee a  ssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloon
verses.52: Qaloo ya waylana man ba'athana min marqadina hatha ma wa'ada a  rrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloon
verses.53: In kanat illasayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jamee'un ladayna muhdaroon
verses.54: Fa  lyawma la tu _th_ lamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum ta'maloon
verses.55: Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoon
verses.56: Hum waazwajuhum fee _th_ ilalin 'ala alaraiki muttakioon
verses.57: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yadda'oon
verses.58: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheem
verses.59: Wa  mtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoon
verses.60: Alam a'had ilaykum ya banee adama an la ta'budoo a  shshaytana innahu lakum 'aduwwun mubeen
verses.61: Waani o'budoonee hathasiratun mustaqeem
verses.62: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon
verses.63: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum too'adoon
verses.64: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroon
verses.65: Alyawma nakhtimu 'ala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboon
verses.66: Walaw nashao latamasna 'ala a'yunihim fa  stabaqoo a  ssirata faanna yubsiroon
verses.67: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum 'ala makanatihim fama istata'oo mudiyyan wala yarji'oon
verses.68: Waman nu'ammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala ya'qiloon
verses.69: Wama 'allamnahu a  shshi'ra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illathikrun waquranun mubeen
verses.70: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu 'ala alkafireen
verses.71: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma 'amilat aydeena an'aman fahum laha malikoon
verses.72: Wathallanaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloon
verses.73: Walahum feeha manafi'u wamasharibu afala yashkuroon
verses.74: Wa  ttakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan la'allahum yunsaroon
verses.75: La yastatee'oona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroon
verses.76: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna na'lamu ma yusirroona wama yu'linoon
