verses.39: Qul ya qawmi i'maloo 'ala makanatikum innee 'amilun fasawfa ta'lamoon
verses.40: Man yateehi 'athabun yukhzeehi wayahillu 'alayhi 'athabun muqeem
verses.41: Inna anzana 'alayka alkitaba li  nnasi bi  lhaqqi famani ihtada falinafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu 'alayha wama anta 'alayhim biwakeel
verses.42: Allahu yatawaffa alanfusa heena mawtiha wa  llatee lam tamut fee manamiha fayumsiku allatee qada 'alayha almawta wayursilu alokhra ila ajalin musamman inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroon
verses.43: Ami ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi shufa'aa qul awalaw kanoo la yamlikoona shayan wala ya'qiloon
verses.44: Qul lillahi a  shshafa'atu jamee'an lahu mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi thumma ilayhi turja'oon
verses.45: Waithathukira Allahu wahdahu ishmaazzat quloobu allatheena la yuminoona bi  lakhirati waithathukira allatheena min doonihi itha hum yastabshiroon
verses.46: Quli allahumma fatira a  ssamawati wa  lardi 'alima alghaybi wa  shshahadati anta tahkumu bayna 'ibadika fee ma kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
verses.47: Walaw anna lillatheena _th_ alamoo ma fee alardi jamee'an wamithlahu ma'ahu la  ftadaw bihi min sooi al'athabi yawma alqiyamati wabada lahum mina Allahi ma lam yakoonoo yahtasiboon
verses.48: Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioon
verses.49: Faitha massa alinsana durrun da'ana thumma itha khawwanahu ni'matan minna qala innama ooteetuhu 'ala 'ilmin bal hiya fitnatun walakinna aktharahum la ya'lamoon
verses.50: Qad qalaha allatheena min qablihim fama aghna 'anhum ma kanoo yaksiboon
verses.51: Faasabahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wa  llatheena _th_ alamoo min haolai sayuseebuhum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wama hum bimu'jizeen
verses.52: Awalam ya'lamoo anna Allaha yabsutu a  rrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoon
verses.53: Qul ya 'ibadiya allatheena asrafoo 'ala anfusihim la taqnatoo min rahmati Allahi inna Allaha yaghfiru a  ththunooba jamee'an innahu huwa alghafooru a  rraheem
verses.54: Waaneeboo ila rabbikum waaslimoo lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu al'athabu thumma la tunsaroon
verses.55: Wa  ttabi'oo ahsana ma onzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an yatiyakumu al'athabu baghtatan waantum la tash'uroon
verses.56: An taqoola nafsun yahasrata 'ala ma farrattu fee janbi Allahi wain kuntu lamina a  ssakhireen
verses.57: Aw taqoola law anna Allaha hadanee lakuntu mina almuttaqeen
verses.58: Aw taqoola heena tara al'athaba law anna lee karratan faakoona mina almuhsineen
verses.59: Bala qad jaatka ayatee fakaththabta biha wa  stakbarta wakunta mina alkafireen
verses.60: Wayawma alqiyamati tara allatheena kathaboo 'ala Allahi wujoohuhum muswaddatun alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilmutakabbireen
verses.61: Wayunajjee Allahu allatheena ittaqaw bimafazatihim la yamassuhumu a  ssooo wala hum yahzanoon
verses.62: Allahu khaliqu kulli shayin wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin wakeel
verses.63: Lahu maqaleedu a  ssamawati wa  lardi wa  llatheena kafaroo biayati Allahi olaika humu alkhasiroon
verses.64: Qul afaghayra Allahi tamuroonnee a'budu ayyuha aljahiloon
verses.65: Walaqad oohiya ilayka waila allatheena min qablika lain ashrakta layahbatanna 'amaluka walatakoonanna mina alkhasireen
verses.66: Bali Allaha fa  'bud wakun mina a  shshakireen
verses.67: Wama qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi wa  lardu jamee'an qabdatuhu yawma alqiyamati wa  ssamawatu matwiyyatun biyameenihi subhanahu wata'ala 'amma yushrikoon
verses.68: Wanufikha fee a  ssoori fasa'iqa man fee a  ssamawati waman fee alardi illa man shaa Allahu thumma nufikha feehi okhra faitha hum qiyamun yan _th_ uroon
verses.69: Waashraqati alardu binoori rabbiha wawudi'a alkitabu wajeea bi  nnabiyyeena wa  shshuhadai waqudiya baynahum bi  lhaqqi wahum la yu _th_ lamoon
verses.70: Wawuffiyat kullu nafsin ma 'amilat wahuwa a'lamu bima yaf'aloon
verses.71: Waseeqa allatheena kafaroo ila jahannama zumaran hatta itha jaooha futihat abwabuha waqala lahum khazanatuha alam yatikum rusulun minkum yatloona 'alaykum ayati rabbikum wayunthiroonakum liqaa yawmikum hatha qaloo bala walakin haqqat kalimatu al'athabi 'ala alkafireen
verses.72: Qeela odkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha fabisa mathwa almutakabbireen
verses.73: Waseeqa allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum ila aljannati zumaran hatta itha jaooha wafutihat abwabuha waqala lahum khazanatuha salamun 'alaykum tibtum fa  dkhulooha khalideen
verses.74: Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee sadaqana wa'dahu waawrathana alarda natabawwao mina aljannati haythu nashao fani'ma ajru al'amileen
verses.75: Watara almalaikata haffeena min hawli al'arshi yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim waqudiya baynahum bi  lhaqqi waqeela alhamdu lillahi rabbi al'alameen

verses.2: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi al'azeezi al'aleem
verses.3: Ghafiri a  ththanbi waqabili a  ttawbi shadeedi al'iqabi thee a  ttawli la ilaha illa huwa ilayhi almaseer
verses.4: Ma yujadilu fee ayati Allahi illa allatheena kafaroo fala yaghrurka taqallubuhum fee albilad
verses.5: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin wa  lahzabu min ba'dihim wahammat kullu ommatin birasoolihim liyakhuthoohu wajadaloo bi  lbatili liyudhidoo bihi alhaqqa faakhathtuhum fakayfa kana 'iqab
verses.6: Wakathalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika 'ala allatheena kafaroo annahum ashabu a  nnar
verses.7: Allatheena yahmiloona al'arsha waman hawlahu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayuminoona bihi wayastaghfiroona lillatheena amanoo rabbana wasi'ta kulla shayin rahmatan wa'ilman fa  ghfir lillatheena taboo wa  ttaba'oo sabeelaka waqihim 'athaba aljaheem
verses.8: Rabbana waadkhilhum jannati 'adnin allatee wa'adtahum waman salaha min abaihim waazwajihim wathurriyyatihim innaka anta al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.9: Waqihimu a  ssayyiati waman taqi a  ssayyiati yawmaithin faqad rahimtahu wathalika huwa alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.10: Inna allatheena kafaroo yunadawna lamaqtu Allahi akbaru min maqtikum anfusakum ith tud'awna ila aleemani fatakfuroon
verses.11: Qaloo rabbana amattana ithnatayni waahyaytana ithnatayni fa  'tarafna bithunoobina fahal ila khuroojin min sabeel
verses.12: Thalikum biannahu itha du'iya Allahu wahdahu kafartum wain yushrak bihi tuminoo fa  lhukmu lillahi al'aliyyi alkabeer
verses.13: Huwa allathee yureekum ayatihi wayunazzilu lakum mina a  ssamai rizqan wama yatathakkaru illa man yuneeb
verses.14: Fa  d'oo Allaha mukhliseena lahu a  ddeena walaw kariha alkafiroon
verses.15: Rafee'u a  ddarajati thoo al'arshi yulqee a  rrooha min amrihi 'ala man yashao min 'ibadihi liyunthira yawma a  ttalaq
verses.16: Yawma hum barizoona la yakhfa 'ala Allahi minhum shayon limani almulku alyawma lillahi alwahidi alqahhar
verses.17: Alyawma tujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat la _th_ ulma alyawma inna Allaha saree'u alhisab
verses.18: Waanthirhum yawma alazifati ithi alquloobu lada alhanajiri ka _th_ imeena ma li  _thth_ alimeena min hameemin wala shafee'in yuta'
verses.19: Ya'lamu khainata ala'yuni wama tukhfee a  ssudoor
verses.20: Wa  llahu yaqdee bi  lhaqqi wa  llatheena yad'oona min doonihi la yaqdoona bishayin inna Allaha huwa a  ssamee'u albaseer
verses.21: Awa lam yaseeroo fee alardi fayan _th_ uroo kayfa kana 'aqibatu allatheena kanoo min qablihim kanoo hum ashadda minhum quwwatan waatharan fee alardi faakhathahumu Allahu bithunoobihim wama kana lahum mina Allahi min waq
verses.22: Thalika biannahum kanat tateehim rusuluhum bi  lbayyinati fakafaroo faakhathahumu Allahu innahu qawiyyun shadeedu al'iqab
verses.23: Walaqad arsana moosa biayatina wasultanin mubeen
verses.24: Ila fir'awna wahamana waqaroona faqaloo sahirun kaththab
verses.25: Falamma jaahum bi  lhaqqi min 'indina qaloo oqtuloo abnaa allatheena amanoo ma'ahu wa  stahyoo nisaahum wama kaydu alkafireena illa fee dalal
verses.26: Waqala fir'awnu tharoonee aqtul moosa walyad'u rabbahu innee akhafu an yubaddila deenakum aw an yu _th_ hira fee alardi alfasad
verses.27: Waqala moosa innee 'uthtu birabbee warabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin la yuminu biyawmi alhisab
verses.28: Waqala rajulun muminun min ali fir'awna yaktumu eemanahu ataqtuloona rajulan an yaqoola rabbiyya Allahu waqad jaakum bi  lbayyinati min rabbikum wain yaku kathiban fa'alayhi kathibuhu wain yaku sadiqan yusibkum ba'du allathee ya'idukum inna Allaha la yahdee man huwa musrifun kaththab
verses.29: Ya qawmi lakumu almulku alyawma _th_ ahireena fee alardi faman yansuruna min basi Allahi in jaana qala fir'awnu ma oreekum illa ma ara wama ahdeekum illa sabeela a  rrashad
verses.30: Waqala allathee amana ya qawmi innee akhafu 'alaykum mithla yawmi alahzab
verses.31: Mithla dabi qawmi noohin wa'adin wathamooda wa  llatheena min ba'dihim wama Allahu yureedu _th_ ulman lil'ibad
verses.32: Waya qawmi innee akhafu 'alaykum yawma a  ttanad
verses.33: Yawma tuwalloona mudbireena ma lakum mina Allahi min 'asimin waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min had
verses.34: Walaqad jaakum yoosufu min qablu bi  lbayyinati fama ziltum fee shakkin mimma jaakum bihi hatta itha halaka qultum lan yab'atha Allahu min ba'dihi rasoolan kathalika yudillu Allahu man huwa musrifun murtab
verses.35: Allatheena yujadiloona fee ayati Allahi bighayri sultanin atahum kabura maqtan 'inda Allahi wa'inda allatheena amanoo kathalika yatba'u Allahu 'ala kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbar
verses.36: Waqala fir'awnu ya hamanu ibni lee sarhan la'allee ablughu alasbab
verses.37: Asbaba a  ssamawati faattali'a ila ilahi moosa wainnee laa _th_ unnuhu kathiban wakathalika zuyyina lifir'awna sooo 'amalihi wasudda 'ani a  ssabeeli wama kaydu fir'awna illa fee tabab
verses.38: Waqala allathee amana ya qawmi ittabi'ooni ahdikum sabeela a  rrashad
verses.39: Ya qawmi innama hathihi alhayatu a  ddunya mata'un wainna alakhirata hiya daru alqarar
verses.40: Man 'amila sayyiatan fala yujza illa mithlaha waman 'amila salihan min thakarin aw ontha wahuwa muminun faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata yurzaqoona feeha bighayri hisab
verses.41: Waya qawmi ma lee ad'ookum ila a  nnajati watad'oonanee ila a  nnar
verses.42: Tad'oonanee liakfura bi  llahi waoshrika bihi ma laysa lee bihi 'ilmun waana ad'ookum ila al'azeezi alghaffar
verses.43: La jarama annama tad'oonanee ilayhi laysa lahu da'watun fee a  ddunya wala fee alakhirati waanna maraddana ila Allahi waanna almusrifeena hum ashabu a  nnar
verses.44: Fasatathkuroona ma aqoolu lakum waofawwidu amree ila Allahi inna Allaha baseerun bi  l'ibad
verses.45: Fawaqahu Allahu sayyiati ma makaroo wahaqa biali fir'awna sooo al'athab
verses.46: A  nnaru yu'radoona 'alayha ghuduwwan wa'ashiyyan wayawma taqoomu a  ssa'atu adkhiloo ala fir'awna ashadda al'athab
verses.47: Waith yatahajjoona fee a  nnari fayaqoolu a  ddu'afao lillatheena istakbaroo inna kunna lakum taba'an fahal antum mughnoona 'anna naseeban mina a  nnar
verses.48: Qala allatheena istakbaroo inna kullun feeha inna Allaha qad hakama bayna al'ibad
verses.49: Waqala allatheena fee a  nnari likhazanati jahannama od'oo rabbakum yukhaffif 'anna yawman mina al'athab
verses.50: Qaloo awalam taku tateekum rusulukum bi  lbayyinati qaloo bala qaloo fa  d'oo wama du'ao alkafireena illa fee dalal
verses.51: Inna lanansuru rusulana wa  llatheena amanoo fee alhayati a  ddunya wayawma yaqoomu alashhad
verses.52: Yawma la yanfa'u a  _thth_ alimeena ma'thiratuhum walahumu alla'natu walahum sooo a  ddar
verses.53: Walaqad atayna moosa alhuda waawrathna banee israeela alkitab
verses.54: Hudan wathikra liolee alalbab
verses.55: Fa  sbir inna wa'da Allahi haqqun wa  staghfir lithanbika wasabbih bihamdi rabbika bi  l'ashiyyi wa  libkar
verses.56: Inna allatheena yujadiloona fee ayati Allahi bighayri sultanin atahum in fee sudoorihim illa kibrun ma hum bibaligheehi fa  sta'ith bi  llahi innahu huwa a  ssamee'u albaseer
verses.57: Lakhalqu a  ssamawati wa  lardi akbaru min khalqi a  nnasi walakinna akthara a  nnasi la ya'lamoon
verses.58: Wama yastawee ala'ma wa  lbaseeru wa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati wala almuseeo qaleelan ma tatathakkaroon
verses.59: Inna a  ssa'ata laatiyatun la rayba feeha walakinna akthara a  nnasi la yuminoon
verses.60: Waqala rabbukumu od'oonee astajib lakum inna allatheena yastakbiroona 'an 'ibadatee sayadkhuloona jahannama dakhireen
verses.61: Allahu allathee ja'ala lakumu allayla litaskunoo feehi wa  nnahara mubsiran inna Allaha lathoo fadlin 'ala a  nnasi walakinna akthara a  nnasi la yashkuroon
verses.62: Thalikumu Allahu rabbukum khaliqu kulli shayin la ilaha illa huwa faanna tufakoon
verses.63: Kathalika yufaku allatheena kanoo biayati Allahi yajhadoon
verses.64: Allahu allathee ja'ala lakumu alarda qararan wa  ssamaa binaan wasawwarakum faahsana suwarakum warazaqakum mina a  ttayyibati thalikumu Allahu rabbukum fatabaraka Allahu rabbu al'alameen
verses.65: Huwa alhayyu la ilaha illa huwa fa  d'oohu mukhliseena lahu a  ddeena alhamdu lillahi rabbi al'alameen
verses.66: Qul innee nuheetu an a'buda allatheena tad'oona min dooni Allahi lamma jaaniya albayyinatu min rabbee waomirtu an oslima lirabbi al'alameen
verses.67: Huwa allathee khalaqakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min 'alaqatin thumma yukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum thumma litakoonoo shuyookhan waminkum man yutawaffa min qablu walitablughoo ajalan musamman wala'allakum ta'qiloon
verses.68: Huwa allathee yuhyee wayumeetu faitha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon
verses.69: Alam tara ila allatheena yujadiloona fee ayati Allahi anna yusrafoon
verses.70: Allatheena kaththaboo bi  lkitabi wabima arsana bihi rusulana fasawfa ya'lamoon
verses.71: Ithi alaghlalu fee a'naqihim wa  ssalasilu yushaboon
verses.72: Fee alhameemi thumma fee a  nnari yusjaroon
verses.73: Thumma qeela lahum ayna ma kuntum tushrikoon
verses.74: Min dooni Allahi qaloo dalloo 'anna bal lam nakun nad'oo min qablu shayan kathalika yudillu Allahu alkafireen
verses.75: Thalikum bima kuntum tafrahoona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wabima kuntum tamrahoon
verses.76: Odkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha fabisa mathwa almutakabbireen
verses.77: Fa  sbir inna wa'da Allahi haqqun faimma nuriyannaka ba'da allathee na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka failayna yurja'oon
verses.78: Walaqad arsana rusulan min qablika minhum man qasasna 'alayka waminhum man lam naqsus 'alayka wama kana lirasoolin an yatiya biayatin illa biithni Allahi faitha jaa amru Allahi qudiya bi  lhaqqi wakhasira hunalika almubtiloon
verses.79: Allahu allathee ja'ala lakumu alan'ama litarkaboo minha waminha takuloon
verses.80: Walakum feeha manafi'u walitablughoo 'alayhahajatan fee sudoorikum wa'alayha wa'ala alfulki tuhmaloon
verses.81: Wayureekum ayatihi faayya ayati Allahi tunkiroon
verses.82: Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayan _th_ uroo kayfa kana 'aqibatu allatheena min qablihim kanoo akthara minhum waashadda quwwatan waatharan fee alardi fama aghna 'anhum ma kanoo yaksiboon
verses.83: Falamma jaathum rusuluhum bi  lbayyinati farihoo bima 'indahum mina al'ilmi wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioon
verses.84: Falamma raaw basana qaloo amanna bi  llahi wahdahu wakafarna bima kunna bihi mushrikeen
verses.85: Falam yaku yanfa'uhum eemanuhum lamma raaw basana sunnata Allahi allatee qad khalat fee 'ibadihi wakhasira hunalika alkafiroon

verses.2: Tanzeelun mina a  rrahmani a  rraheem
verses.3: Kitabun fussilat ayatuhu quranan 'arabiyyan liqawmin ya'lamoon
verses.4: Basheeran wanatheeran faa'rada aktharuhum fahum la yasma'oon
verses.5: Waqaloo quloobuna fee akinnatin mimma tad'oona ilayhi wafee athanina waqrun wamin baynina wabaynika hijabun fa  'mal innana 'amiloon
verses.6: Qul innama ana basharun mithlukum yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun fa  staqeemoo ilayhi wa  staghfiroohu wawaylun lilmushrikeen
verses.7: Allatheena la yutoona a  zzakata wahum bi  lakhirati hum kafiroon
verses.8: Inna allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoon
verses.9: Qul ainnakum latakfuroona bi  llathee khalaqa alarda fee yawmayni wataj'aloona lahu andadan thalika rabbu al'alameen
verses.10: Waja'ala feeha rawasiya min fawqiha wabaraka feeha waqaddara feeha aqwataha fee arba'ati ayyamin sawaan li  ssaileen
verses.11: Thumma istawa ila a  ssamai wahiya dukhanun faqala laha walilardi itiyataw'an aw karhan qalata ataynatai'een
verses.12: Faqadahunna sab'a samawatin fee yawmayni waawha fee kulli samain amraha wazayyanna a  ssamaa a  ddunya bimasabeeha wahif _th_ an thalika taqdeeru al'azeezi al'aleem
verses.13: Fain a'radoo fuqul anthartukum sa'iqatan mithla sa'iqati 'adin wathamood
verses.14: Ith jaathumu a  rrusulu min bayni aydeehim wamin khalfihim alla ta'budoo illa Allaha qaloo law shaa rabbuna laanzala malaikatan fainna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroon
verses.15: Faamma 'adun fa  stakbaroo fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi waqaloo man ashaddu minna quwwatan awalam yaraw anna Allaha allathee khalaqahum huwa ashaddu minhum quwwatan wakanoo biayatina yajhadoon
verses.16: Faarsana 'alayhim reehan sarsaran fee ayyamin nahisatin linutheeqahum 'athaba alkhizyi fee alhayati a  ddunya wala'athabu alakhirati akhza wahum la yunsaroon
verses.17: Waamma thamoodu fahadaynahum fa  stahabboo al'ama 'ala alhuda faakhathathum sa'iqatu al'athabi alhooni bima kanoo yaksiboon
verses.18: Wanajjayna allatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoon
verses.19: Wayawma yuhsharu a'dao Allahi ila a  nnari fahum yooza'oon
verses.20: Hatta itha ma jaooha shahida 'alayhim sam'uhum waabsaruhum wajulooduhum bima kanoo ya'maloon
verses.21: Waqaloo lijuloodihim lima shahidtum 'alayna qaloo antaqana Allahu allathee antaqa kulla shayin wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratin wailayhi turja'oon
verses.22: Wama kuntum tastatiroona an yashhada 'alaykum sam'ukum wala absarukum wala juloodukum walakin _th_ anantum anna Allaha la ya'lamu katheeran mimma ta'maloon
verses.23: Wathalikum _th_ annukumu allathee _th_ anantum birabbikum ardakum faasbahtum mina alkhasireen
verses.24: Fain yasbiroo fa  nnaru mathwan lahum wain yasta'tiboo fama hum mina almu'tabeen
verses.25: Waqayyadna lahum quranaa fazayyanoo lahum ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wahaqqa 'alayhimu alqawlu fee omamin qad khalat min qablihim mina aljinni wa  linsi innahum kanoo khasireen
verses.26: Waqala allatheena kafaroo la tasma'oo lihatha alqurani wa  lghaw feehi la'allakum taghliboon
verses.27: Falanutheeqanna allatheena kafaroo 'athaban shadeedan walanajziyannahum aswaa allathee kanoo ya'maloon
verses.28: Thalika jazao a'dai Allahi a  nnaru lahum feeha daru alkhuldi jazaan bima kanoo biayatina yajhadoon
verses.29: Waqala allatheena kafaroo rabbana arina allathayni adallana mina aljinni wa  linsi naj'alhuma tahta aqdamina liyakoona mina alasfaleen
verses.30: Inna allatheena qaloo rabbuna Allahu thumma istaqamoo tatanazzalu 'alayhimu almalaikatu alla takhafoo wala tahzanoo waabshiroo bi  ljannati allatee kuntum too'adoon
verses.31: Nahnu awliyaokum fee alhayati a  ddunya wafee alakhirati walakum feeha ma tashtahee anfusukum walakum feeha ma tadda'oon
verses.32: Nuzulan min ghafoorin raheem
verses.33: Waman ahsanu qawlan mimman da'a ila Allahi wa'amila salihan waqala innanee mina almuslimeen
verses.34: Wala tastawee alhasanatu wala a  ssayyiatu idfa' bi  llatee hiya ahsanu faitha allathee baynaka wabaynahu 'adawatun kaannahu waliyyun hameem
verses.35: Wama yulaqqaha illa allatheena sabaroo wama yulaqqaha illathoo ha _thth_ in 'a _th_ eem
verses.36: Waimma yanzaghannaka mina a  shshaytani nazghun fa  sta'ith bi  llahi innahu huwa a  ssamee'u al'aleem
verses.37: Wamin ayatihi allaylu wa  nnaharu wa  shshamsu wa  lqamaru la tasjudoo li  shshamsi wala lilqamari wa  sjudoo lillahi alathee khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyahu ta'budoon
verses.38: Faini istakbaroo fa  llatheena 'inda rabbika yusabbihoona lahu bi  llayli wa  nnahari wahum la yasamoon
verses.39: Wamin ayatihi annaka tara alarda khashi'atan faitha anzana 'alayha almaa ihtazzat warabat inna allathee ahyaha lamuhyee almawta innahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.40: Inna allatheena yulhidoona fee ayatina la yakhfawna 'alayna afaman yulqa fee a  nnari khayrun am man yatee aminan yawma alqiyamati i'maloo ma shitum innahu bima ta'maloona baseer
verses.41: Inna allatheena kafaroo bi  ththikri lamma jaahum wainnahu lakitabun 'azeez
verses.42: La yateehi albatilu min bayni yadayhi wala min khalfihi tanzeelun min hakeemin hameed
verses.43: Ma yuqalu laka illa ma qad qeela li  rrusuli min qablika inna rabbaka lathoo maghfiratin wathoo 'iqabin aleem
verses.44: Walaw ja'anahu quranan a'jamiyyan laqaloo lawla fussilat ayatuhu aa'jamiyyun wa'arabiyyun qul huwa lillatheena amanoo hudan washifaon wa  llatheena la yuminoona fee athanihim waqrun wahuwa 'alayhim 'aman olaika yunadawna min makanin ba'eed
verses.45: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba fa  khtulifa feehi walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum wainnahum lafee shakkin minhu mureeb
verses.46: Man 'amila salihan falinafsihi waman asaa fa'alayha wama rabbuka bi _th_ allamin lil'abeed
verses.47: Ilayhi yuraddu 'ilmu a  ssa'ati wama takhruju min thamaratin min akmamiha wama tahmilu min ontha wala tada'u illa bi'ilmihi wayawma yunadeehim ayna shurakaee qaloo athannaka ma minna min shaheed
verses.48: Wadalla 'anhum ma kanoo yad'oona min qablu wa _th_ annoo ma lahum min mahees
verses.49: La yasamu alinsanu min du'ai alkhayri wain massahu a  shsharru fayaoosun qanoot
verses.50: Walain athaqnahu rahmatan minna min ba'di darraa massathu layaqoolanna hatha lee wama a _th_ unnu a  ssa'ata qaimatan walain ruji'tu ila rabbee inna lee 'indahu lalhusna falanunabbianna allatheena kafaroo bima 'amiloo walanutheeqannahum min 'athabin ghalee _th_
verses.51: Waitha an'amna 'ala alinsani a'rada wanaa bijanibihi waitha massahu a  shsharru fathoo du'ain 'areed
verses.52: Qul araaytum in kana min 'indi Allahi thumma kafartum bihi man adallu mimman huwa fee shiqaqin ba'eed
verses.53: Sanureehim ayatina fee alafaqi wafee anfusihim hatta yatabayyana lahum annahu alhaqqu awalam yakfi birabbika annahu 'ala kulli shayin shaheed
verses.54: Ala innahum fee miryatin min liqai rabbihim ala innahu bikulli shayin muheet

verses.3: Kathalika yoohee ilayka waila allatheena min qablika Allahu al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.4: Lahu ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa al'aliyyu al'a _th_ eem
verses.5: Takadu a  ssamawatu yatafattarna min fawqihinna wa  lmalaikatu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayastaghfiroona liman fee alardi ala inna Allaha huwa alghafooru a  rraheem
verses.6: Wa  llatheena ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa Allahu hafee _th_ un 'alayhim wama anta 'alayhim biwakeel
verses.7: Wakathalika awhayna ilayka quranan 'arabiyyan litunthira omma alqura waman hawlaha watunthira yawma aljam'i la rayba feehi fareequn fee aljannati wafareequn fee a  ssa'eer
verses.8: Walaw shaa Allahu laja'alahum ommatan wahidatan walakin yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi wa  _thth_ alimoona ma lahum min waliyyin wala naseer
verses.9: Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa fa  llahu huwa alwaliyyu wahuwa yuhyee almawta wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.10: Wama ikhtalaftum feehi min shayin fahukmuhu ila Allahi thalikumu Allahu rabbee 'alayhi tawakkatu wailayhi oneeb
verses.11: Fatiru a  ssamawati wa  lardi ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwajan wamina alan'ami azwajan yathraokum feehi laysa kamithlihi shayon wahuwa a  ssamee'u albaseer
verses.12: Lahu maqaleedu a  ssamawati wa  lardi yabsutu a  rrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru innahu bikulli shayin 'aleem
verses.13: Shara'a lakum mina a  ddeeni ma wassa bihi noohan wa  llathee awhayna ilayka wama wassayna bihi ibraheema wamoosa wa'eesa an aqeemoo a  ddeena wala tatafarraqoo feehi kabura 'ala almushrikeena ma tad'oohum ilayhi Allahu yajtabee ilayhi man yashao wayahdee ilayhi man yuneeb
verses.14: Wama tafarraqoo illa min ba'di ma jaahumu al'ilmu baghyan baynahum walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ila ajalin musamman laqudiya baynahum wainna allatheena oorithoo alkitaba min ba'dihim lafee shakkin minhu mureeb
verses.15: Falithalika fa  d'u wa  staqim kama omirta wala tattabi' ahwaahum waqul amantu bima anzala Allahu min kitabin waomirtu lia'dila baynakum Allahu rabbuna warabbukum lana a'maluna walakum a'malukum lahujjata baynana wabaynakumu Allahu yajma'u baynana wailayhi almaseer
verses.16: Wa  llatheena yuhajjoona fee Allahi min ba'di ma istujeeba lahu hujjatuhum dahidatun 'inda rabbihim wa'alayhim ghadabun walahum 'athabun shadeed
verses.17: Allahu allathee anzala alkitaba bi  lhaqqi wa  lmeezani wama yudreeka la'alla a  ssa'ata qareeb
verses.18: Yasta'jilu biha allatheena la yuminoona biha wa  llatheena amanoo mushfiqoona minha waya'lamoona annaha alhaqqu ala inna allatheena yumaroona fee a  ssa'ati lafee dalalin ba'eed
verses.19: Allahu lateefun bi'ibadihi yarzuqu man yashao wahuwa alqawiyyu al'azeez
verses.20: Man kana yureedu hartha alakhirati nazid lahu fee harthihi waman kana yureedu hartha a  ddunya nutihi minha wama lahu fee alakhirati min naseeb
verses.21: Am lahum shurakao shara'oo lahum mina a  ddeeni ma lam yathan bihi Allahu walawla kalimatu alfasli laqudiya baynahum wainna a  _thth_ alimeena lahum 'athabun aleem
verses.22: Tara a  _thth_ alimeena mushfiqeena mimma kasaboo wahuwa waqi'un bihim wa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati fee rawdati aljannati lahum ma yashaoona 'inda rabbihim thalika huwa alfadlu alkabeer
verses.23: Thalika allathee yubashshiru Allahu 'ibadahu allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati qul la asalukum 'alayhi ajran illa almawaddata fee alqurba waman yaqtarif hasanatan nazid lahu feehahusnan inna Allaha ghafoorun shakoor
verses.24: Am yaqooloona iftara 'ala Allahi kathiban fain yashai Allahu yakhtim 'ala qalbika wayamhu Allahu albatila wayuhiqqu alhaqqa bikalimatihi innahu 'aleemun bithati a  ssudoor
verses.25: Wahuwa allathee yaqbalu a  ttawbata 'an 'ibadihi waya'foo 'ani a  ssayyiati waya'lamu ma taf'aloon
verses.26: Wayastajeebu allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati wayazeeduhum min fadlihi wa  lkafiroona lahum 'athabun shadeed
verses.27: Walaw basata Allahu a  rrizqa li'ibadihi labaghaw fee alardi walakin yunazzilu biqadarin ma yashao innahu bi'ibadihi khabeerun baseer
verses.28: Wahuwa allathee yunazzilu alghaytha min ba'di ma qanatoo wayanshuru rahmatahu wahuwa alwaliyyu alhameed
verses.29: Wamin ayatihi khalqu a  ssamawati wa  lardi wama baththa feehima min dabbatin wahuwa 'ala jam'ihim itha yashao qadeer
verses.30: Wama asabakum min museebatin fabima kasabat aydeekum waya'foo 'an katheer
verses.31: Wama antum bimu'jizeena fee alardi wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseer
verses.32: Wamin ayatihi aljawari fee albahri ka  la'lam
verses.33: In yasha yuskini a  rreeha faya _th_ lana rawakida 'ala _th_ ahrihi inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoor
verses.34: Aw yoobiqhunna bima kasaboo waya'fu 'an katheer
verses.35: Waya'lama allatheena yujadiloona fee ayatina ma lahum min mahees
verses.36: Fama ooteetum min shayin famata'u alhayati a  ddunya wama 'inda Allahi khayrun waabqa lillatheena amanoo wa'ala rabbihim yatawakkaloon
verses.37: Wa  llatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi wa  lfawahisha waitha ma ghadiboo hum yaghfiroon
verses.38: Wa  llatheena istajaboo lirabbihim waaqamoo a  ssalata waamruhum shoora baynahum wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoon
verses.39: Wa  llatheena itha asabahumu albaghyu hum yantasiroon
verses.40: Wajazao sayyiatin sayyiatun mithluha faman 'afa waaslaha faajruhu 'ala Allahi innahu la yuhibbu a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.41: Walamani intasara ba'da _th_ ulmihi faolaika ma 'alayhim min sabeel
verses.42: Innama a  ssabeelu 'ala allatheena ya _th_ limoona a  nnasa wayabghoona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi olaika lahum 'athabun aleem
verses.43: Walaman sabara waghafara inna thalika lamin 'azmi alomoor
verses.44: Waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min waliyyin min ba'dihi watara a  _thth_ alimeena lamma raawoo al'athaba yaqooloona hal ila maraddin min sabeel
verses.45: Watarahum yu'radoona 'alayha khashi'eena mina a  ththulli yan _th_ uroona min tarfin khafiyyin waqala allatheena amanoo inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala inna a  _thth_ alimeena fee 'athabin muqeem
verses.46: Wama kana lahum min awliyaa yansuroonahum min dooni Allahi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min sabeel
verses.47: Istajeeboo lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun la maradda lahu mina Allahi ma lakum min maljain yawmaithin wama lakum min nakeer
verses.48: Fain a'radoo fama arsanaka 'alayhim hafee _th_ an in 'alayka illa albalaghu wainna itha athaqna alinsana minna rahmatan fariha biha wain tusibhum sayyiatun bima qaddamat aydeehim fainna alinsana kafoor
verses.49: Lillahi mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi yakhluqu ma yashao yahabu liman yashao inathan wayahabu liman yashao a  ththukoor
verses.50: Aw yuzawwijuhum thukranan wainathan wayaj'alu man yashao 'aqeeman innahu 'aleemun qadeer
verses.51: Wama kana libasharin an yukallimahu Allahu illa wahyan aw min warai hijabin aw yursila rasoolan fayoohiya biithnihi ma yashao innahu 'aliyyun hakeem
verses.52: Wakathalika awhayna ilayka roohan min amrina ma kunta tadree ma alkitabu wala aleemanu walakin ja'anahu nooran nahdee bihi man nashao min 'ibadina wainnaka latahdee ilasiratin mustaqeem
verses.53: Sirati Allahi allathee lahu ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi ala ila Allahi taseeru alomoor

verses.3: Inna ja'anahu quranan 'arabiyyan la'allakum ta'qiloona
verses.4: Wainnahu fee ommi alkitabi ladayna la'aliyyun hakeem
verses.5: Afanadribu 'ankumu a  ththikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeen
verses.6: Wakam arsana min nabiyyin fee alawwaleen
verses.7: Wama yateehim min nabiyyin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioon
verses.8: Faahlakna ashadda minhum batshan wamada mathalu alawwaleen
verses.9: Walain saatahum man khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda layaqoolunna khalaqahunna al'azeezu al'aleem
verses.10: Allathee ja'ala lakumu alarda mahdan waja'ala lakum feeha subulan la'allakum tahtadoon
verses.11: Wa  llathee nazzala mina a  ssamai maan biqadarin faansharna bihi badatan maytan kathalika tukhrajoon
verses.12: Wa  llathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha waja'ala lakum mina alfulki wa  lan'ami ma tarkaboon
verses.13: Litastawoo 'ala _th_ uhoorihi thumma tathkuroo ni'mata rabbikum itha istawaytum 'alayhi wataqooloo subhana allathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineen
verses.14: Wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon
verses.15: Waja'aloo lahu min 'ibadihi juzan inna alinsana lakafoorun mubeen
verses.16: Ami ittakhatha mimma yakhluqu banatin waasfakum bi  lbaneen
verses.17: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bimadaraba li  rrahmani mathalan _th_ alla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa ka _th_ eem
verses.18: Awaman yunashshao fee alhilyati wahuwa fee alkhisami ghayru mubeen
verses.19: Waja'aloo almalaikata allatheena hum 'ibadu a  rrahmani inathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahadatuhum wayusaloon
verses.20: Waqaloo law shaa a  rrahmanu ma 'abadnahum ma lahum bithalika min 'ilmin in hum illa yakhrusoon
verses.21: Am ataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoon
verses.22: Bal qaloo inna wajadnaabaana 'ala ommatin wainna 'alaatharihim muhtadoon
verses.23: Wakathalika ma arsana min qablika fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna wajadnaabaana 'ala ommatin wainna 'alaatharihim muqtadoon
verses.24: Qala awalaw jitukum biahda mimma wajadtum 'alayhi abaakum qaloo inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroon
verses.25: Fa  ntaqamna minhum fa  n _th_ ur kayfa kana 'aqibatu almukaththibeen
verses.26: Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi waqawmihi innanee baraon mimma ta'budoon
verses.27: Illa allathee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeen
verses.28: Waja'alaha kalimatan baqiyatan fee 'aqibihi la'allahum yarji'oon
verses.29: Bal matta'tu haolai waabaahum hatta jaahumu alhaqqu warasoolun mubeen
verses.30: Walamma jaahumu alhaqqu qaloo hatha sihrun wainna bihi kafiroon
verses.31: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu 'ala rajulin mina alqaryatayni 'a _th_ eem
verses.32: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamna baynahum ma'eeshatahum fee alhayati a  ddunya warafa'na ba'dahum fawqa ba'din darajatin liyattakhitha ba'duhum ba'dan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mimma yajma'oon
verses.33: Walawla an yakoona a  nnasu ommatan wahidatan laja'ana liman yakfuru bi  rrahmani libuyootihim suqufan min fiddatin wama'arija 'alayha ya _th_ haroon
verses.34: Walibuyootihim abwaban wasururan 'alayha yattakioon
verses.35: Wazukhrufan wain kullu thalika lamma mata'u alhayati a  ddunya wa  lakhiratu 'inda rabbika lilmuttaqeen
verses.36: Waman ya'shu 'an thikri a  rrahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuwa lahu qareen
verses.37: Wainnahum layasuddoonahum 'ani a  ssabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoon
verses.38: Hatta itha jaana qala ya layta baynee wabaynaka bu'da almashriqayni fabisa alqareen
verses.39: Walan yanfa'akumu alyawma ith _th_ alamtum annakum fee al'athabi mushtarikoon
verses.40: Afaanta tusmi'u a  ssumma aw tahdee al'umya waman kana fee dalalin mubeen
verses.41: Faimma nathhabanna bika fainna minhum muntaqimoon
verses.42: Aw nuriyannaka allathee wa'adnahum fainna 'alayhim muqtadiroon
verses.43: Fa  stamsik bi  llathee oohiya ilayka innaka 'alasiratin mustaqeem
verses.44: Wainnahu lathikrun laka waliqawmika wasawfa tusaloon
verses.45: Wa  sal man arsana min qablika min rusulina aja'ana min dooni a  rrahmani alihatan yu'badoon
verses.46: Walaqad arsana moosa biayatina ila fir'awna wamalaihi faqala innee rasoolu rabbi al'alameen
verses.47: Falamma jaahum biayatina itha hum minha yadhakoon
verses.48: Wama nureehim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min okhtiha waakhathnahum bi  l'athabi la'allahum yarji'oon
verses.49: Waqaloo ya ayyuha a  sahiru od'u lana rabbaka bima 'ahida 'indaka innana lamuhtadoon
verses.50: Falamma kashafna 'anhumu al'athaba itha hum yankuthoon
verses.51: Wanada fir'awnu fee qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahathihi alanharu tajree min tahtee afala tubsiroon
verses.52: Am ana khayrun min hatha allathee huwa maheenun wala yakadu yubeen
verses.53: Falawla olqiya 'alayhi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaa ma'ahu almalaikatu muqtarineen
verses.54: Fa  stakhaffa qawmahu faata'oohu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeen
verses.55: Falammaasafoona intaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum ajma'een
verses.56: Faja'anahum salafan wamathalan lilakhireen
verses.57: Walammaduriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoon
verses.58: Waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa madaraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoon
verses.59: In huwa illa 'abdun an'amna 'alayhi waja'anahu mathalan libanee israeel
verses.60: Walaw nashao laja'ana minkum malaikatan fee alardi yakhlufoon
verses.61: Wainnahu la'ilmun li  ssa'ati fala tamtarunna biha wa  ttabi'ooni hathasiratun mustaqeem
verses.62: Wala yasuddannakumu a  shshaytanu innahu lakum 'aduwwun mubeen
verses.63: Walamma jaa 'eesa bi  lbayyinati qala qad jitukum bi  lhikmati waliobayyina lakum ba'da allathee takhtalifoona feehi fa  ttaqoo Allaha waatee'oon
verses.64: Inna Allaha huwa rabbee warabbukum fa  'budoohu hathasiratun mustaqeem
verses.65: Fa  khtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena _th_ alamoo min 'athabi yawmin aleem
verses.66: Hal yan _th_ uroona illa a  ssa'ata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yash'uroon
verses.67: Alakhillao yawmaithin ba'duhum liba'din 'aduwwun illa almuttaqeen
verses.68: Ya 'ibadi la khawfun 'alaykumu alyawma wala antum tahzanoon
verses.69: Allatheena amanoo biayatina wakanoo muslimeen
verses.70: Odkhuloo aljannata antum waazwajukum tuhbaroon
verses.71: Yutafu 'alayhim bisihafin min thahabin waakwabin wafeeha ma tashtaheehi alanfusu watalaththu ala'yunu waantum feeha khalidoon
verses.72: Watilka aljannatu allatee oorithtumooha bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.73: Lakum feeha fakihatun katheeratun minha takuloon
verses.74: Inna almujrimeena fee 'athabi jahannama khalidoon
verses.75: La yufattaru 'anhum wahum feehi mublisoon
verses.76: Wama _th_ alamnahum walakin kanoo humu a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.77: Wanadaw ya maliku liyaqdi 'alayna rabbuka qala innakum makithoon
verses.78: Laqad jinakum bi  lhaqqi walakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi karihoon
verses.79: Am abramoo amran fainna mubrimoon
verses.80: Am yahsaboona anna la nasma'u sirrahum wanajwahum bala warusuluna ladayhim yaktuboon
verses.81: Qul in kana li  rrahmani waladun faana awwalu al'abideen
verses.82: Subhana rabbi a  ssamawati wa  lardi rabbi al'arshi 'amma yasifoon
verses.83: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayal'aboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yoo'adoon
verses.84: Wahuwa allathee fee a  ssamai ilahun wafee alardi ilahun wahuwa alhakeemu al'aleem
verses.85: Watabaraka allathee lahu mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi wama baynahuma wa'indahu 'ilmu a  ssa'ati wailayhi turja'oon

verses.87: Walain saatahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoon
verses.88: Waqeelihi yarabbi inna haolai qawmun la yuminoon
verses.89: Fa  sfah 'anhum waqul salamun fasawfa ya'lamoon

verses.3: Inna anzanahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireen

verses.15: Inna kashifoo al'athabi qaleelan innakum 'aidoon

verses.18: An addoo ilayya 'ibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameen
verses.19: Waan la ta'loo 'ala Allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeen

verses.22: Fada'a rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoon
verses.23: Faasri bi'ibadee laylan innakum muttaba'oon
verses.24: Wa  truki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoon
verses.25: Kam tarakoo min jannatin wa'uyoon
verses.26: Wazuroo'in wamaqamin kareem
verses.27: Wana'matin kanoo feeha fakiheen
verses.28: Kathalika waawrathnaha qawman akhareen
verses.29: Fama bakat 'alayhimu a  ssamao wa  lardu wama kanoo mun _th_ areen
verses.30: Walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina al'athabi almuheen
verses.31: Min fir'awna innahu kana 'aliyan mina almusrifeen
verses.32: Walaqadi ikhtarnahum 'ala 'ilmin 'ala al'alameen
verses.33: Waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeen
verses.34: Inna haolai layaqooloon
verses.35: In hiya illa mawtatuna aloola wama nahnu bimunshareen
verses.36: Fatoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.37: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubba'in wa  llatheena min qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeen
verses.38: Wama khalaqna a  ssamawati wa  larda wama baynahuma la'ibeen
verses.39: Ma khalaqnahuma illa bi  lhaqqi walakinna aktharahum la ya'lamoon
verses.40: Inna yawma alfasli meeqatuhum ajma'een
verses.41: Yawma la yughnee mawlan 'an mawlan shayan wala hum yunsaroon
verses.42: Illa man rahima Allahu innahu huwa al'azeezu a  rraheem
verses.43: Inna shajarata a  zzaqqoom
verses.44: Ta'amu alatheem
verses.45: Ka  lmuhli yaghlee fee albutoon
verses.46: Kaghalyi alhameem
verses.47: Khuthoohu fa  'tiloohu ila sawai aljaheem
verses.48: Thumma subboo fawqa rasihi min 'athabi alhameem
verses.49: Thuq innaka anta al'azeezu alkareem
verses.50: Inna hatha ma kuntum bihi tamtaroon
verses.51: Inna almuttaqeena fee maqamin ameen
verses.52: Fee jannatin wa'uyoon
verses.53: Yalbasoona min sundusin waistabraqin mutaqabileen
verses.54: Kathalika wazawwajnahum bihoorin 'een
verses.55: Yad'oona feeha bikulli fakihatin amineen
verses.56: La yathooqoona feeha almawta illa almawtata aloola wawaqahum 'athaba aljaheem
verses.57: Fadlan min rabbika thalika huwa alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.58: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika la'allahum yatathakkaroon
verses.59: Fa  rtaqib innahum murtaqiboon

verses.2: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi al'azeezi alhakeem
verses.3: Inna fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi laayatin lilmumineen
verses.4: Wafee khalqikum wama yabuththu min dabbatin ayatun liqawmin yooqinoon
verses.5: Wa  khtilafi allayli wa  nnahari wama anzala Allahu mina a  ssamai min rizqin faahya bihi alarda ba'da mawtiha watasreefi a  rriyahi ayatun liqawmin ya'qiloon
verses.6: Tilka ayatu Allahi natlooha 'alayka bi  lhaqqi fabiayyi hadeethin ba'da Allahi waayatihi yuminoon
verses.7: Waylun likulli affakin atheem
verses.8: Yasma'u ayati Allahi tutla 'alayhi thumma yusirru mustakbiran kaan lam yasma'ha fabashshirhu bi'athabin aleem
verses.9: Waitha 'alima min ayatina shayan ittakhathaha huzuwan olaika lahum 'athabun muheen
verses.10: Min waraihim jahannamu wala yughnee 'anhum ma kasaboo shayan wala ma ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi awliyaa walahum 'athabun 'a _th_ eem
verses.11: Hatha hudan wa  llatheena kafaroo biayati rabbihim lahum 'athabun min rijzin aleem
verses.12: Allahu allathee sakhkhara lakumu albahra litajriya alfulku feehi biamrihi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi wala'allakum tashkuroon
verses.13: Wasakhkhara lakum ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi jamee'an minhu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroon
verses.14: Qul lillatheena amanoo yaghfiroo lillatheena la yarjoona ayyama Allahi liyajziya qawman bima kanoo yaksiboon
verses.15: Man 'amila salihan falinafsihi waman asaa fa'alayha thumma ila rabbikum turja'oon
verses.16: Walaqad atayna banee israeela alkitaba wa  lhukma wa  nnubuwwata warazaqnahum mina a  ttayyibati wafaddanahum 'ala al'alameen
verses.17: Waataynahum bayyinatin mina alamri fama ikhtalafoo illa min ba'di ma jaahumu al'ilmu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
verses.18: Thumma ja'anaka 'ala sharee'atin mina alamri fa  ttabi'ha wala tattabi' ahwaa allatheena la ya'lamoon
verses.19: Innahum lan yughnoo 'anka mina Allahi shayan wainna a  _thth_ alimeena ba'duhum awliyao ba'din wa  llahu waliyyu almuttaqeen
verses.20: Hatha basairu li  nnasi wahudan warahmatun liqawmin yooqinoon
verses.21: Am hasiba allatheena ijtarahoo a  ssayyiati an naj'alahum ka  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati sawaan mahyahum wamamatuhum saa ma yahkumoon
verses.22: Wakhalaqa Allahu a  ssamawati wa  larda bi  lhaqqi walitujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat wahum la yu _th_ lamoon
verses.23: Afaraayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu waadallahu Allahu 'ala 'ilmin wakhatama 'ala sam'ihi waqalbihi waja'ala 'ala basarihi ghishawatan faman yahdeehi min ba'di Allahi afala tathakkaroon
verses.24: Waqaloo ma hiya illahayatuna a  ddunya namootu wanahya wama yuhlikuna illa a  ddahru wama lahum bithalika min 'ilmin in hum illa ya _th_ unnoon
verses.25: Waitha tutla 'alayhim ayatuna bayyinatin ma kana hujjatahum illa an qaloo itoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.26: Quli Allahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajma'ukum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi walakinna akthara a  nnasi la ya'lamoon
verses.27: Walillahi mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi wayawma taqoomu a  ssa'atu yawmaithin yakhsaru almubtiloon
verses.28: Watara kulla ommatin jathiyatan kullu ommatin tud'a ila kitabiha alyawma tujzawna ma kuntum ta'maloon
verses.29: Hatha kitabuna yantiqu 'alaykum bi  lhaqqi inna kunna nastansikhu ma kuntum ta'maloon
verses.30: Faamma allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fee rahmatihi thalika huwa alfawzu almubeen
verses.31: Waamma allatheena kafaroo afalam takun ayatee tutla 'alaykum fa  stakbartum wakuntum qawman mujrimeen
verses.32: Waitha qeela inna wa'da Allahi haqqun wa  ssa'atu la rayba feeha qultum ma nadree ma a  ssa'atu in na _th_ unnu illa _th_ annan wama nahnu bimustayqineen
verses.33: Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma 'amiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioon
verses.34: Waqeela alyawma nansakum kama naseetum liqaa yawmikum hatha wamawakumu a  nnaru wama lakum min nasireen
verses.35: Thalikum biannakumu ittakhathtum ayati Allahi huzuwan wagharratkumu alhayatu a  ddunya fa  lyawma la yukhrajoona minha wala hum yusta'taboon
verses.36: Falillahi alhamdu rabbi a  ssamawati warabbi alardi rabbi al'alameen
verses.37: Walahu alkibriyao fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem

verses.2: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi al'azeezi alhakeem
verses.3: Ma khalaqna a  ssamawati wa  larda wama baynahuma illa bi  lhaqqi waajalin musamman wa  llatheena kafaroo 'amma onthiroo mu'ridoon
verses.4: Qul araaytum ma tad'oona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee a  ssamawati eetoonee bikitabin min qabli hatha aw atharatin min 'ilmin in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.5: Waman adallu mimman yad'oo min dooni Allahi man la yastajeebu lahu ila yawmi alqiyamati wahum 'an du'aihim ghafiloon
verses.6: Waithahushira a  nnasu kanoo lahum a'daan wakanoo bi'ibadatihim kafireen
verses.7: Waitha tutla 'alayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lamma jaahum hatha sihrun mubeen
verses.8: Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul ini iftaraytuhu fala tamlikoona lee mina Allahi shayan huwa a'lamu bima tufeedoona feehi kafa bihi shaheedan baynee wabaynakum wahuwa alghafooru a  rraheem
verses.9: Qul ma kuntu bid'an mina a  rrusuli wama adree ma yuf'alu bee wala bikum in attabi'u illa ma yooha ilayya wama ana illa natheerun mubeen
verses.10: Qul araaytum in kana min 'indi Allahi wakafartum bihi washahida shahidun min banee israeela 'ala mithlihi faamana wa  stakbartum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.11: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo law kana khayran ma sabaqoona ilayhi waith lam yahtadoo bihi fasayaqooloona hatha ifkun qadeem
verses.12: Wamin qablihi kitabu moosa imaman warahmatan wahatha kitabun musaddiqun lisanan 'arabiyyan liyunthira allatheena _th_ alamoo wabushra lilmuhsineen
verses.13: Inna allatheena qaloo rabbuna Allahu thumma istaqamoo fala khawfun 'alayhim wala hum yahzanoon
verses.14: Olaika ashabu aljannati khalideena feeha jazaan bima kanoo ya'maloon
verses.15: Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi ihsanan hamalathu ommuhu kurhan wawada'athu kurhan wahamluhu wafisaluhu thalathoona shahran hatta itha balagha ashuddahu wabalagha arba'eena sanatan qala rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mataka allatee an'amta 'alayya wa'ala walidayya waan a'mala salihan tardahu waaslih lee fee thurriyyatee innee tubtu ilayka wainnee mina almuslimeen
verses.16: Olaika allatheena nataqabbalu 'anhum ahsana ma 'amiloo wanatajawazu 'an sayyiatihim fee ashabi aljannati wa'da a  ssidqi allathee kanoo yoo'adoon
verses.17: Wa  llathee qala liwalidayhi offin lakuma ata'idaninee an okhraja waqad khalati alquroonu min qablee wahuma yastagheethani Allaha waylaka amin inna wa'da Allahi haqqun fayaqoolu ma hatha illa asateeru alawwaleen
verses.18: Olaika allatheena haqqa 'alayhimu alqawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina aljinni wa  linsi innahum kanoo khasireen
verses.19: Walikullin darajatun mimma 'amiloo waliyuwaffiyahum a'malahum wahum la yu _th_ lamoon
verses.20: Wayawma yu'radu allatheena kafaroo 'ala a  nnari athhabtum tayyibatikum fee hayatikumu a  ddunya wa  stamta'tum biha fa  lyawma tujzawna 'athaba alhooni bima kuntum tastakbiroona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wabima kuntum tafsuqoon
verses.21: Wa  thkur akha 'adin ith anthara qawmahu bi  lahqafi waqad khalati a  nnuthuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi alla ta'budoo illa Allaha innee akhafu 'alaykum 'athaba yawmin 'a _th_ eem
verses.22: Qaloo ajitana litafikana 'an alihatina fatina bima ta'iduna in kunta mina a  ssadiqeen
verses.23: Qala innama al'ilmu 'inda Allahi waoballighukum ma orsiltu bihi walakinnee arakum qawman tajhaloon
verses.24: Falamma raawhu 'aridan mustaqbila awdiyatihim qaloo hatha 'aridun mumtiruna bal huwa ma ista'jatum bihi reehun feeha 'athabun aleem
verses.25: Tudammiru kulla shayin biamri rabbiha faasbahoo la yura illa masakinuhum kathalika najzee alqawma almujrimeen
verses.26: Walaqad makkannahum feema in makkannakum feehi waja'ana lahum sam'an waabsaran waafidatan fama aghna 'anhum sam'uhum wala absaruhum wala afidatuhum min shayin ith kanoo yajhadoona biayati Allahi wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioon
verses.27: Walaqad ahlakna mahawlakum mina alqura wasarrafna alayati la'allahum yarji'oon
verses.28: Falawla nasarahumu allatheena ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi qurbanan alihatan bal dalloo 'anhum wathalika ifkuhum wama kanoo yaftaroon
verses.29: Waithsarafna ilayka nafaran mina aljinni yastami'oona alqurana falammahadaroohu qaloo ansitoo falamma qudiya wallaw ila qawmihim munthireen
verses.30: Qaloo ya qawmana inna sami'na kitaban onzila min ba'di moosa musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi yahdee ila alhaqqi wailatareeqin mustaqeem
verses.31: Ya qawmana ajeeboo da'iya Allahi waaminoo bihi yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayujirkum min 'athabin aleem
verses.32: Waman la yujib da'iya Allahi falaysa bimu'jizin fee alardi walaysa lahu min doonihi awliyaa olaika fee dalalin mubeen
verses.33: Awalam yaraw anna Allaha allathee khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda walam ya'ya bikhalqihinna biqadirin 'ala an yuhyiya almawta bala innahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.34: Wayawma yu'radu allatheena kafaroo 'ala a  nnari alaysa hatha bi  lhaqqi qaloo bala warabbina qala fathooqoo al'athaba bima kuntum takfuroon
verses.35: Fa  sbir kamasabara oloo al'azmi mina a  rrusuli wala tasta'jil lahum kaannahum yawma yarawna ma yoo'adoona lam yalbathoo illa sa'atan min naharin balaghun fahal yuhlaku illa alqawmu alfasiqoon

verses.1: Allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo 'an sabeeli Allahi adalla a'malahum
verses.2: Wa  llatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati waamanoo bima nuzzila 'ala muhammadin wahuwa alhaqqu min rabbihim kaffara 'anhum sayyiatihim waaslaha balahum
verses.3: Thalika bianna allatheena kafaroo ittaba'oo albatila waanna allatheena amanoo ittaba'oo alhaqqa min rabbihim kathalika yadribu Allahu li  nnasi amthalahum
verses.4: Faitha laqeetumu allatheena kafaroo fadarba a  rriqabi hatta itha athkhantumoohum fashuddoo alwathaqa faimma mannan ba'du waimma fidaan hatta tada'a alharbu awzarahathalika walaw yashao Allahu la  ntasara minhum walakin liyabluwa ba'dakum biba'din wa  llatheena qutiloo fee sabeeli Allahi falan yudilla a'malahum
verses.5: Sayahdeehim wayuslihu balahum
verses.6: Wayudkhiluhumu aljannata 'arrafaha lahum
verses.7: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in tansuroo Allaha yansurkum wayuthabbit aqdamakum
verses.8: Wa  llatheena kafaroo fata'san lahum waadalla a'malahum
verses.9: Thalika biannahum karihoo ma anzala Allahu faahbata a'malahum
verses.10: Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayan _th_ uroo kayfa kana 'aqibatu allatheena min qablihim dammara Allahu 'alayhim walilkafireena amthaluha
verses.11: Thalika bianna Allaha mawla allatheena amanoo waanna alkafireena la mawla lahum
verses.12: Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu wa  llatheena kafaroo yatamatta'oona wayakuloona kama takulu alan'amu wa  nnaru mathwan lahum
verses.13: Wakaayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatika allatee akhrajatka ahlaknahum fala nasira lahum
verses.14: Afaman kana 'ala bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sooo 'amalihi wa  ttaba'oo ahwaahum
verses.15: Mathalu aljannati allatee wu'ida almuttaqoona feeha anharun min main ghayri asinin waanharun min labanin lam yataghayyar ta'muhu waanharun min khamrin laththatin li  shsharibeena waanharun min 'asalin musaffan walahum feeha min kulli a  ththamarati wamaghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khalidun fee a  nnari wasuqoo maan hameeman faqatta'a am'aahum
verses.16: Waminhum man yastami'u ilayka hatta itha kharajoo min 'indika qaloo lillatheena ootoo al'ilma matha qala anifan olaika allatheena taba'a Allahu 'ala quloobihim wa  ttaba'oo ahwaahum
verses.17: Wa  llatheena ihtadaw zadahum hudan waatahum taqwahum
verses.18: Fahal yan _th_ uroona illa a  ssa'ata an tatiyahum baghtatan faqad jaa ashratuha faanna lahum itha jaathum thikrahum
verses.19: Fa  'lam annahu la ilaha illa Allahu wa  staghfir lithanbika walilmumineena wa  lmuminati wa  llahu ya'lamu mutaqallabakum wamathwakum
verses.20: Wayaqoolu allatheena amanoo lawla nuzzilat sooratun faitha onzilat sooratun muhkamatun wathukira feeha alqitalu raayta allatheena fee quloobihim maradun yan _th_ uroona ilayka na _th_ ara almaghshiyyi 'alayhi mina almawti faawla lahum
verses.21: Ta'atun waqawlun ma'roofun faitha 'azama alamru falaw sadaqoo Allaha lakana khayran lahum
verses.22: Fahal 'asaytum in tawallaytum an tufsidoo fee alardi watuqatti'oo arhamakum
verses.23: Olaika allatheena la'anahumu Allahu faasammahum waa'ma absarahum
verses.24: Afala yatadabbaroona alqurana am 'ala quloobin aqfaluha
verses.25: Inna allatheena irtaddoo 'ala adbarihim min ba'di ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda a  shshaytanu sawwala lahum waamla lahum
verses.26: Thalika biannahum qaloo lillatheena karihoo ma nazzala Allahu sanutee'ukum fee ba'di alamri wa  llahu ya'lamu israrahum
verses.27: Fakayfa itha tawaffathumu almalaikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbarahum
verses.28: Thalika biannahumu ittaba'oo ma askhata Allaha wakarihoo ridwanahu faahbata a'malahum
verses.29: Am hasiba allatheena fee quloobihim maradun an lan yukhrija Allahu adghanahum
verses.30: Walaw nashao laaraynakahum fala'araftahum biseemahum walata'rifannahum fee lahni alqawli wa  llahu ya'lamu a'malakum
verses.31: Walanabluwannakum hatta na'lama almujahideena minkum wa  ssabireena wanabluwa akhbarakum
verses.32: Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo 'an sabeeli Allahi washaqqoo a  rrasoola min ba'di ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda lan yaduroo Allaha shayan wasayuhbitu a'malahum
verses.33: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo atee'oo Allaha waatee'oo a  rrasoola wala tubtiloo a'malakum
verses.34: Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo 'an sabeeli Allahi thumma matoo wahum kuffarun falan yaghfira Allahu lahum
verses.35: Fala tahinoo watad'oo ila a  ssalmi waantumu ala'lawna wa  llahu ma'akum walan yatirakum a'malakum
verses.36: Innama alhayatu a  ddunya la'ibun walahwun wain tuminoo watattaqoo yutikum ojoorakum wala yasalkum amwalakum
verses.37: In yasalkumooha fayuhfikum tabkhaloo wayukhrij adghanakum
verses.38: Haantum haolai tud'awna litunfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi faminkum man yabkhalu waman yabkhal fainnama yabkhalu 'an nafsihi wa  llahu alghaniyyu waantumu alfuqarao wain tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma la yakoonoo amthalakum

verses.2: Liyaghfira laka Allahu ma taqaddama min thanbika wama taakhkhara wayutimma ni'matahu 'alayka wayahdiyaka siratan mustaqeema
verses.3: Wayansuraka Allahu nasran 'azeeza
verses.4: Huwa allathee anzala a  ssakeenata fee quloobi almumineena liyazdadoo eemanan ma'a eemanihim walillahi junoodu a  ssamawati wa  lardi wakana Allahu 'aleeman hakeema
verses.5: Liyudkhila almumineena wa  lmuminati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wayukaffira 'anhum sayyiatihim wakana thalika 'inda Allahi fawzan 'a _th_ eema
verses.6: Wayu'aththiba almunafiqeena wa  lmunafiqati wa  lmushrikeena wa  lmushrikati a  _thth_ anneena bi  llahi _th_ anna a  ssawi 'alayhim dairatu a  ssawi waghadiba Allahu 'alayhim wala'anahum waa'adda lahum jahannama wasaat maseera
verses.7: Walillahi junoodu a  ssamawati wa  lardi wakana Allahu 'azeezan hakeema
verses.8: Inna arsanaka shahidan wamubashshiran wanatheera
verses.9: Lituminoo bi  llahi warasoolihi watu'azziroohu watuwaqqiroohu watusabbihoohu bukratan waaseela
verses.10: Inna allatheena yubayi'oonaka innama yubayi'oona Allaha yadu Allahi fawqa aydeehim faman nakatha fainnama yankuthu 'ala nafsihi waman awfa bima 'ahada 'alayhu Allaha fasayuteehi ajran 'a _th_ eema
verses.11: Sayaqoolu laka almukhallafoona mina ala'rabi shaghalatna amwaluna waahloona fa  staghfir lana yaqooloona biasinatihim ma laysa fee quloobihim qul faman yamliku lakum mina Allahi shayan in arada bikum darran aw arada bikum naf'an bal kana Allahu bima ta'maloona khabeera
verses.12: Bal _th_ anantum an lan yanqaliba a  rrasoolu wa  lmuminoona ila ahleehim abadan wazuyyina thalika fee quloobikum wa _th_ anantum _th_ anna a  ssawi wakuntum qawman boora
verses.13: Waman lam yumin bi  llahi warasoolihi fainna a'tadna lilkafireena sa'eera
verses.14: Walillahi mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi yaghfiru liman yashao wayu'aththibu man yashao wakana Allahu ghafooran raheema
verses.15: Sayaqoolu almukhallafoona itha intalaqtum ila maghanima litakhuthoohatharoona nattabi'kum yureedoona an yubaddiloo kalama Allahi qul lan tattabi'oona kathalikum qala Allahu min qablu fasayaqooloona bal tahsudoonana bal kanoo la yafqahoona illa qaleela
verses.16: Qul lilmukhallafeena mina ala'rabi satud'awna ila qawmin olee basin shadeedin tuqatiloonahum aw yuslimoona fain tutee'oo yutikumu Allahu ajran hasanan wain tatawallaw kama tawallaytum min qablu yu'aththibkum 'athaban aleema
verses.17: Laysa 'ala ala'maharajun wala 'ala ala'raji harajun wala 'ala almareedi harajun waman yuti'i Allaha warasoolahu yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu waman yatawalla yu'aththibhu 'athaban aleema
verses.18: Laqad radiya Allahu 'ani almumineena ith yubayi'oonaka tahta a  shshajarati fa'alima ma fee quloobihim faanzala a  sakeenata 'alayhim waathabahum fathan qareeba
verses.19: Wamaghanima katheeratan yakhuthoonaha wakana Allahu 'azeezan hakeema
verses.20: Wa'adakumu Allahu maghanima katheeratan takhuthoonaha fa'ajjala lakum hathihi wakaffa aydiya a  nnasi 'ankum walitakoona ayatan lilmumineena wayahdiyakum siratan mustaqeema
verses.21: Waokhra lam taqdiroo 'alayha qad ahata Allahu biha wakana Allahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeera
verses.22: Walaw qatalakumu allatheena kafaroo lawallawoo aladbara thumma la yajidoona waliyyan wala naseera
verses.23: Sunnata Allahi allatee qad khalat min qablu walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeela
verses.24: Wahuwa allathee kaffa aydiyahum 'ankum waaydiyakum 'anhum bibatni makkata min ba'di an a _th_ farakum 'alayhim wakana Allahu bima ta'maloona baseera
verses.25: Humu allatheena kafaroo wasaddookum 'ani almasjidi alharami wa  lhadya ma'koofan an yablugha mahillahu walawla rijalun muminoona wanisaon muminatun lam ta'lamoohum an tataoohum fatuseebakum minhum ma'arratun bighayri 'ilmin liyudkhila Allahu fee rahmatihi man yashao law tazayyaloo la'aththabna allatheena kafaroo minhum 'athaban aleema
verses.26: Ith ja'ala allatheena kafaroo fee quloobihimu alhamiyyata hamiyyata aljahiliyyati faanzala Allahu sakeenatahu 'ala rasoolihi wa'ala almumineena waazamahum kalimata a  ttaqwa wakanoo ahaqqa biha waahlaha wakana Allahu bikulli shayin 'aleema
verses.27: Laqad sadaqa Allahu rasoolahu a  rruya bi  lhaqqi latadkhulunna almasjida alharama in shaa Allahu amineena muhalliqeena ruoosakum wamuqassireena la takhafoona fa'alima ma lam ta'lamoo faja'ala min dooni thalika fathan qareeba
verses.28: Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bi  lhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyu _th_ hirahu 'ala a  ddeeni kullihi wakafa bi  llahi shaheeda
verses.29: Muhammadun rasoolu Allahi wa  llatheena ma'ahu ashiddao 'ala alkuffari ruhamao baynahum tarahum rukka'an sujjadan yabtaghoona fadlan mina Allahi waridwanan seemahum fee wujoohihim min athari a  ssujoodi thalika mathaluhum fee a  ttawrati wamathaluhum fee alinjeeli kazar'in akhraja shatahu faazarahu fa  staghla _th_ a fa  stawa 'ala sooqihi yu'jibu a  zzurra'a liyaghee _th_ a bihimu alkuffara wa'ada Allahu allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati minhum maghfiratan waajran 'a _th_ eema

verses.1: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tuqaddimoo bayna yadayi Allahi warasoolihi wa  ttaqoo Allaha inna Allaha samee'un 'aleem
verses.2: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tarfa'oo aswatakum fawqa sawti a  nnabiyyi wala tajharoo lahu bi  lqawli kajahri ba'dikum liba'din an tahbata a'malukum waantum la tash'uroon
verses.3: Inna allatheena yaghuddoona aswatahum 'inda rasooli Allahi olaika allatheena imtahana Allahu quloobahum li  ttaqwa lahum maghfiratun waajrun 'a _th_ eem
verses.4: Inna allatheena yunadoonaka min warai alhujurati aktharuhum la ya'qiloon
verses.5: Walaw annahum sabaroo hatta takhruja ilayhim lakana khayran lahum wa  llahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.6: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in jaakum fasiqun binabain fatabayyanoo an tuseeboo qawman bijahalatin fatusbihoo 'ala ma fa'atum nadimeen
verses.7: Wa  'lamoo anna feekum rasoola Allahi law yutee'ukum fee katheerin mina alamri la'anittum walakinna Allaha habbaba ilaykumu aleemana wazayyanahu fee quloobikum wakarraha ilaykumu alkufra wa  lfusooqa wa  l'isyana olaika humu a  rrashidoon
verses.8: Fadlan mina Allahi wani'matan wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.9: Wain taifatani mina almumineena iqtataloo faaslihoo baynahuma fain baghat ihdahuma 'ala alokhra faqatiloo allatee tabghee hatta tafeea ila amri Allahi fain faat faaslihoo baynahuma bi  l'adli waaqsitoo inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteen
verses.10: Innama almuminoona ikhwatun faaslihoo bayna akhawaykum wa  ttaqoo Allaha la'allakum turhamoon
verses.11: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la yaskhar qawmun min qawmin 'asa an yakoonoo khayran minhum wala nisaon min nisain 'asa an yakunna khayran minhunna wala talmizoo anfusakum wala tanabazoo bi  lalqabi bisa alismu alfusooqu ba'da aleemani waman lam yatub faolaika humu a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.12: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ijtaniboo katheeran mina a  _thth_ anni inna ba'da a  _thth_ anni ithmun wala tajassasoo wala yaghtab ba'dukum ba'dan ayuhibbu ahadukum an yakula lahma akheehi maytan fakarihtumoohu wa  ttaqoo Allaha inna Allaha tawwabun raheem
verses.13: Ya ayyuha a  nnasu inna khalaqnakum min thakarin waontha waja'anakum shu'ooban waqabaila lita'arafoo inna akramakum 'inda Allahi atqakum inna Allaha 'aleemun khabeer
verses.14: Qalati ala'rabu amanna qul lam tuminoo walakin qooloo aslamna walamma yadkhuli aleemanu fee quloobikum wain tutee'oo Allaha warasoolahu la yalitkum min a'malikum shayan inna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.15: Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo bi  llahi warasoolihi thumma lam yartaboo wajahadoo biamwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allahi olaika humu a  ssadiqoon
verses.16: Qul atu'allimoona Allaha bideenikum wa  llahu ya'lamu ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi wa  llahu bikulli shayin 'aleem
verses.17: Yamunnoona 'alayka an aslamoo qul la tamunnoo 'alayya islamakum bali Allahu yamunnu 'alaykum an hadakum lileemani in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.18: Inna Allaha ya'lamu ghayba a  ssamawati wa  lardi wa  llahu baseerun bima ta'maloon
