verses.1: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.2: Lahu mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi yuhyee wayumeetu wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.3: Huwa alawwalu wa  lakhiru wa  _thth_ ahiru wa  lbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin 'aleem
verses.4: Huwa allathee khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa 'ala al'arshi ya'lamu ma yaliju fee alardi wama yakhruju minha wama yanzilu mina a  ssamai wama ya'ruju feeha wahuwa ma'akum ayna ma kuntum wa  llahu bima ta'maloona baseer
verses.5: Lahu mulku a  ssamawati wa  lardi waila Allahi turja'u alomoor
verses.6: Yooliju allayla fee a  nnahari wayooliju a  nnahara fee allayi wahuwa 'aleemun bithati a  ssudoor
verses.7: Aminoo bi  llahi warasoolihi waanfiqoo mimma ja'alakum mustakhlafeena feehi fa  llatheena amanoo minkum waanfaqoo lahum ajrun kabeer
verses.8: Wama lakum la tuminoona bi  llahi wa  rrasoolu yad'ookum lituminoo birabbikum waqad akhatha meethaqakum in kuntum mumineen
verses.9: Huwa allathee yunazzilu 'ala 'abdihi ayatin bayyinatin liyukhrijakum mina a  _thth_ ulumati ila a  nnoori wainna Allaha bikum laraoofun raheem
verses.10: Wama lakum alla tunfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi walillahi meerathu a  ssamawati wa  lardi la yastawee minkum man anfaqa min qabli alfathi waqatala olaika a' _th_ amu darajatan mina allatheena anfaqoo min ba'du waqataloo wakullan wa'ada Allahu alhusna wa  llahu bima ta'maloona khabeer
verses.11: Man tha allathee yuqridu Allaha qardan hasanan fayuda'ifahu lahu walahu ajrun kareem
verses.12: Yawma tara almumineena wa  lmuminati yas'a nooruhum bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim bushrakumu alyawma jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feehathalika huwa alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.13: Yawma yaqoolu almunafiqoona wa  lmunafiqatu lillatheena amanoo on _th_ uroona naqtabis min noorikum qeela irji'oo waraakum fa  ltamisoo nooran faduriba baynahum bisoorin lahu babun batinuhu feehi a  rrahmatu wa _th_ ahiruhu min qibalihi al'athab
verses.14: Yunadoonahum alam nakun ma'akum qaloo bala walakinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbastum wa  rtabtum wagharratkumu alamaniyyu hatta jaa amru Allahi wagharrakum bi  llahi algharoor
verses.15: Fa  lyawma la yukhathu minkum fidyatun wala mina allatheena kafaroo mawakumu a  nnaru hiya mawlakum wabisa almaseer
verses.16: Alam yani lillatheena amanoo an takhsha'a quloobuhum lithikri Allahi wama nazala mina alhaqqi wala yakoonoo ka  llatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablu fatala 'alayhimu alamadu faqasat quloobuhum wakatheerun minhum fasiqoon
verses.17: I'lamoo anna Allaha yuhyee alarda ba'da mawtiha qad bayyanna lakumu alayati la'allakum ta'qiloon
verses.18: Inna almussaddiqeena wa  lmussaddiqati waaqradoo Allaha qardan hasanan yuda'afu lahum walahum ajrun kareem
verses.19: Wa  llatheena amanoo bi  llahi warusulihi olaika humu a  ssiddeeqoona wa  shshuhadao 'inda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wanooruhum wa  llatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu aljaheem
verses.20: I'lamoo annama alhayatu a  ddunya la'ibun walahwun wazeenatun watafakhurun baynakum watakathurun fee alamwali wa  lawladi kamathali ghaythin a'jaba alkuffara nabatuhu thumma yaheeju fatarahu musfarran thumma yakoonu hutaman wafee alakhirati 'athabun shadeedun wamaghfiratun mina Allahi waridwanun wama alhayatu a  ddunya illa mata'u alghuroor
verses.21: Sabiqoo ila maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin 'arduha ka'ardi a  ssamai wa  lardi o'iddat lillatheena amanoo bi  llahi warusulihi thalika fadlu Allahi yuteehi man yashao wa  llahu thoo alfadli al'a _th_ eem
verses.22: Ma asaba min museebatin fee alardi wala fee anfusikum illa fee kitabin min qabli an nabraaha inna thalika 'ala Allahi yaseer
verses.23: Likayla tasaw 'ala ma fatakum wala tafrahoo bimaatakum wa  llahu la yuhibbu kulla mukhtalin fakhoor
verses.24: Allatheena yabkhaloona wayamuroona a  nnasa bi  lbukhli waman yatawalla fainna Allaha huwa alghaniyyu alhameed
verses.25: Laqad arsana rusulana bi  lbayyinati waanzana ma'ahumu alkitaba wa  lmeezana liyaqooma a  nnasu bi  lqisti waanzana alhadeeda feehi basun shadeedun wamanafi'u li  nnasi waliya'lama Allahu man yansuruhu warusulahu bi  lghaybi inna Allaha qawiyyun 'azeez
verses.26: Walaqad arsana noohan waibraheema waja'ana fee thurriyyatihima a  nnubuwwata wa  lkitaba faminhum muhtadin wakatheerun minhum fasiqoon
verses.27: Thumma qaffayna 'alaatharihim birusulina waqaffayna bi'eesa ibni maryama waataynahu alinjeela waja'ana fee quloobi allatheena ittaba'oohu rafatan warahmatan warahbaniyyatan ibtada'ooha ma katabnaha 'alayhim illa ibtighaa ridwani Allahi fama ra'awhahaqqa ri'ayatiha faatayna allatheena amanoo minhum ajrahum wakatheerun minhum fasiqoon
verses.28: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waaminoo birasoolihi yutikum kiflayni min rahmatihi wayaj'al lakum nooran tamshoona bihi wayaghfir lakum wa  llahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.29: Lialla ya'lama ahlu alkitabi alla yaqdiroona 'ala shayin min fadli Allahi waanna alfadla biyadi Allahi yuteehi man yashao wa  llahu thoo alfadli al'a _th_ eem

verses.1: Qad sami'a Allahu qawla allatee tujadiluka fee zawjiha watashtakee ila Allahi wa  llahu yasma'u tahawurakuma inna Allaha samee'un baseer
verses.2: Allatheena yu _th_ ahiroona minkum min nisaihim ma hunna ommahatihim in ommahatuhum illa allaee waladnahum wainnahum layaqooloona munkaran mina alqawli wazooran wainna Allaha la'afuwwun ghafoor
verses.3: Wa  llatheena yu _th_ ahiroona min nisaihim thumma ya'oodoona lima qaloo fatahreeru raqabatin min qabli an yatamassathalikum too'a _th_ oona bihi wa  llahu bima ta'maloona khabeer
verses.4: Faman lam yajid fasiyamu shahrayni mutatabi'ayni min qabli an yatamassa faman lam yastati' fait'amu sitteena miskeenan thalika lituminoo bi  llahi warasoolihi watilka hudoodu Allahi walilkafireena 'athabun aleem
verses.5: Inna allatheena yuhaddoona Allaha warasoolahu kubitoo kama kubita allatheena min qablihim waqad anzanaayatin bayyinatin walilkafireena 'athabun muheen
verses.6: Yawma yab'athuhumu Allahu jamee'an fayunabbiohum bima 'amiloo ahsahu Allahu wanasoohu wa  llahu 'ala kulli shayin shaheed
verses.7: Alam tara anna Allaha ya'lamu ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi ma yakoonu min najwa thalathatin illa huwa rabi'uhum wala khamsatin illa huwa sadisuhum wala adna min thalika wala akthara illa huwa ma'ahum ayna ma kanoo thumma yunabbiohum bima 'amiloo yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha bikulli shayin 'aleem
verses.8: Alam tara ila allatheena nuhoo 'ani a  nnajwa thumma ya'oodoona lima nuhoo 'anhu wayatanajawna bi  lithmi wa  l'udwani wama'siyati a  rrasooli waitha jaooka hayyawka bima lam yuhayyika bihi Allahu wayaqooloona fee anfusihim lawla yu'aththibuna Allahu bima naqoolu hasbuhum jahannamu yaslawnaha fabisa almaseer
verses.9: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha tanajaytum fala tatanajaw bi  lithmi wa  l'udwani wama'siyati a  rrasooli watanajaw bi  lbirri wa  ttaqwa wa  ttaqoo Allaha allathee ilayhi tuhsharoon
verses.10: Innama a  nnajwa mina a  shshaytani liyahzuna allatheena amanoo walaysa bidarrihim shayan illa biithni Allahi wa'ala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoon
verses.11: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha qeela lakum tafassahoo fee almajalisi fa  fsahoo yafsahi Allahu lakum waitha qeela onshuzoo fa  nshuzoo yarfa'i Allahu allatheena amanoo minkum wa  llatheena ootoo al'ilma darajatin wa  llahu bima ta'maloona khabeer
verses.12: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha najaytumu a  rrasoola faqaddimoo bayna yaday najwakum sadaqatan thalika khayrun lakum waatharu fain lam tajidoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.13: Aashfaqtum an tuqaddimoo bayna yaday najwakum sadaqatin faith lam taf'aloo wataba Allahu 'alaykum faaqeemoo a  ssalata waatoo a  zzakata waatee'oo Allaha warasoolahu wa  llahu khabeerun bima ta'maloon
verses.14: Alam tara ila allatheena tawallaw qawman ghadiba Allahu 'alayhim ma hum minkum wala minhum wayahlifoona 'ala alkathibi wahum ya'lamoon
verses.15: a'adda Allahu lahum 'athaban shadeedan innahum saa ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.16: Ittakhathoo aymanahum junnatan fasaddoo 'an sabeeli Allahi falahum 'athabun muheen
verses.17: Lan tughniya 'anhum amwaluhum wala awladuhum mina Allahi shayan olaika ashabu a  nnari hum feeha khalidoon
verses.18: Yawma yab'athuhumu Allahu jamee'an fayahlifoona lahu kama yahlifoona lakum wayahsaboona annahum 'ala shayin ala innahum humu alkathiboon
verses.19: Istahwatha 'alayhimu a  shshaytanu faansahum thikra Allahi olaika hizbu a  shshaytani ala inna hizba a  shshaytani humu alkhasiroon
verses.20: Inna allatheena yuhaddoona Allaha warasoolahu olaika fee alathalleen
verses.21: Kataba Allahu laaghlibanna ana warusulee inna Allaha qawiyyun 'azeez
verses.22: La tajidu qawman yuminoona bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri yuwaddoona man hadda Allaha warasoolahu walaw kanoo abaahum aw abnaahum aw ikhwanahum aw 'asheeratahum olaika kataba fee quloobihimu aleemana waayyadahum biroohin minhu wayudkhiluhum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha radiya Allahu 'anhum waradoo 'anhu olaika hizbu Allahi ala inna hizba Allahi humu almuflihoon

verses.1: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.2: Huwa allathee akhraja allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi min diyarihim liawwali alhashri ma _th_ anantum an yakhrujoo wa _th_ annoo annahum mani'atuhum husoonuhum mina Allahi faatahumu Allahu min haythu lam yahtasiboo waqathafa fee quloobihimu a  rru'ba yukhriboona buyootahum biaydeehim waaydee almumineena fa  'tabiroo ya olee alabsar
verses.3: Walawla an kataba Allahu 'alayhimu aljalaa la'aththabahum fee a  ddunya walahum fee alakhirati 'athabu a  nnar
verses.4: Thalika biannahum shaqqoo Allaha warasoolahu waman yushaqqi Allaha fainna Allaha shadeedu al'iqab
verses.5: Ma qata'tum min leenatin aw taraktumooha qaimatan 'ala osooliha fabiithni Allahi waliyukhziya alfasiqeen
verses.6: Wama afaa Allahu 'ala rasoolihi minhum fama awjaftum 'alayhi min khaylin wala rikabin walakinna Allaha yusallitu rusulahu 'ala man yashao wa  llahu 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.7: Ma afaa Allahu 'ala rasoolihi min ahli alqura falillahi wali  rrasooli walithee alqurba wa  lyatama wa  lmasakeeni wa  bni a  ssabeeli kay la yakoona doolatan bayna alaghniyai minkum wamaatakumu a  rrasoolu fakhuthoohu wama nahakum 'anhu fa  ntahoo wa  ttaqoo Allaha inna Allaha shadeedu al'iqab
verses.8: Lilfuqarai almuhajireena allatheena okhrijoo min diyarihim waamwalihim yabtaghoona fadlan mina Allahi waridwanan wayansuroona Allaha warasoolahu olaika humu a  ssadiqoon
verses.9: Wa  llatheena tabawwaoo a  ddara wa  leemana min qablihim yuhibboona man hajara ilayhim wala yajidoona fee sudoorihim hajatan mimma ootoo wayuthiroona 'ala anfusihim walaw kana bihim khasasatun waman yooqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihoon
verses.10: Wa  llatheena jaoo min ba'dihim yaqooloona rabbana ighfir lana waliikhwanina allatheena sabaqoona bi  leemani wala taj'al fee quloobina ghillan lillatheena amanoo rabbana innaka raoofun raheem
verses.11: Alam tara ila allatheena nafaqoo yaqooloona liikhwanihimu allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi lain okhrijtum lanakhrujanna ma'akum wala nutee'u feekum ahadan abadan wain qootiltum lanansurannakum wa  llahu yashhadu innahum lakathiboon
verses.12: Lain okhrijoo la yakhrujoona ma'ahum walain qootiloo la yansuroonahum walain nasaroohum layuwallunna aladbara thumma la yunsaroon
verses.13: Laantum ashaddu rahbatan fee sudoorihim mina Allahi thalika biannahum qawmun la yafqahoon
verses.14: La yuqatiloonakum jamee'an illa fee quran muhassanatin aw min warai judurin basuhum baynahum shadeedun tahsabuhum jamee'an waquloobuhum shattathalika biannahum qawmun la ya'qiloon
verses.15: Kamathali allatheena min qablihim qareeban thaqoo wabala amrihim walahum 'athabun aleem
verses.16: Kamathali a  shshaytani ith qala lilinsani okfur falamma kafara qala innee bareeon minka innee akhafu Allaha rabba al'alameen
verses.17: Fakana 'aqibatahuma annahuma fee a  nnari khalidayni feeha wathalika jazao a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.18: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha watan _th_ ur nafsun ma qaddamat lighadin wa  ttaqoo Allaha inna Allaha khabeerun bima ta'maloon
verses.19: Wala takoonoo ka  llatheena nasoo Allaha faansahum anfusahum olaika humu alfasiqoon
verses.20: La yastawee ashabu a  nnari waashabu aljannati ashabu aljannati humu alfaizoon
verses.21: Law anzana hatha alqurana 'ala jabalin laraaytahu khashi'an mutasaddi'an min khashyati Allahi watilka alamthalu nadribuha li  nnasi la'allahum yatafakkaroon
verses.22: Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa 'alimu alghaybi wa  shshahadati huwa a  rrahmanu a  rraheem
verses.23: Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa almaliku alquddoosu a  ssalamu almuminu almuhayminu al'azeezu aljabbaru almutakabbiru subhana Allahi 'amma yushrikoon
verses.24: Huwa Allahu alkhaliqu albario almusawwiru lahu alasmao alhusna yusabbihu lahu ma fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem

verses.1: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo 'aduwwee wa'aduwwakum awliyaa tulqoona ilayhim bi  lmawaddati waqad kafaroo bima jaakum mina alhaqqi yukhrijoona a  rrasoola waiyyakum an tuminoo bi  llahi rabbikum in kuntum kharajtum jihadan fee sabeelee wa  btighaa mardatee tusirroona ilayhim bi  lmawaddati waana a'lamu bima akhfaytum wama a'lantum waman yaf'alhu minkum faqad dalla sawaa a  ssabeel
verses.2: In yathqafookum yakoonoo lakam a'daan wayabsutoo ilaykum aydiyahum waasinatahum bi  ssooi wawaddoo law takfuroon
verses.3: Lan tanfa'akum arhamukum wala awladukum yawma alqiyamati yafsilu baynakum wa  llahu bima ta'maloona baseer
verses.4: Qad kanat lakum oswatun hasanatun fee ibraheema wa  llatheena ma'ahu ith qaloo liqawmihim inna buraao minkum wamimma ta'budoona min dooni Allahi kafarna bikum wabada baynana wabaynakumu al'adawatu wa  lbaghdao abadan hatta tuminoo bi  llahi wahdahu illa qawla ibraheema liabeehi laastaghfiranna laka wama amliku laka mina Allahi min shayin rabbana 'alayka tawakkana wailayka anabna wailayka almaseer
verses.5: Rabbana la taj'ana fitnatan lillatheena kafaroo wa  ghfir lana rabbana innaka anta al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.6: Laqad kana lakum feehim oswatun hasanatun liman kana yarjoo Allaha wa  lyawma alakhira waman yatawalla fainna Allaha huwa alghanniyyu alhameed
verses.7: 'asa Allahu an yaj'ala baynakum wabayna allatheena 'adaytum minhum mawaddatan wa  llahu qadeerun wa  llahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.8: La yanhakumu Allahu 'ani allatheena lam yuqatilookum fee a  ddeeni walam yukhrijookum min diyarikum an tabarroohum watuqsitoo ilayhim inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteen
verses.9: Innama yanhakumu Allahu 'ani allatheena qatalookum fee a  ddeeni waakhrajookum min diyarikum wa _th_ aharoo 'ala ikhrajikum an tawallawhum waman yatawallahum faolaika humu a  _thth_ alimoon
verses.10: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha jaakumu almuminatu muhajiratin fa  mtahinoohunna Allahu a'lamu bieemanihinna fain 'alimtumoohunna muminatin fala tarji'oohunna ila alkuffari la hunna hillun lahum wala hum yahilloona lahunna waatoohum ma anfaqoo wala junaha 'alaykum an tankihoohunna ithaataytumoohunna ojoorahunna wala tumsikoo bi'isami alkawafiri wa  saloo ma anfaqtum walyasaloo ma anfaqoo thalikum hukmu Allahi yahkumu baynakum wa  llahu 'aleemun hakeem
verses.11: Wain fatakum shayon min azwajikum ila alkuffari fa'aqabtum faatoo allatheena thahabat azwajuhum mithla ma anfaqoo wa  ttaqoo Allaha allathee antum bihi muminoon
verses.12: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu itha jaaka almuminatu yubayi'naka 'ala an la yushrikna bi  llahi shayan wala yasriqna wala yazneena wala yaqtulna awladahunna wala yateena bibuhtanin yaftareenahu bayna aydeehinna waarjulihinna wala ya'seenaka fee ma'roofin fabayi'hunna wa  staghfir lahunna Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.13: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tatawallaw qawman ghadiba Allahu 'alayhim qad yaisoo mina alakhirati kama yaisa alkuffaru min ashabi alquboor

verses.1: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.2: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo lima taqooloona ma la taf'aloon
verses.3: Kabura maqtan 'inda Allahi an taqooloo ma la taf'aloon
verses.4: Inna Allaha yuhibbu allatheena yuqatiloona fee sabeelihi saffan kaannahum bunyanun marsoos
verses.5: Waith qala moosa liqawmihi ya qawmi lima tuthoonanee waqad ta'lamoona annee rasoolu Allahi ilaykum falamma zaghoo azagha Allahu quloobahum wa  llahu la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeen
verses.6: Waith qala 'eesa ibnu maryama ya banee israeela innee rasoolu Allahi ilaykum musaddiqan lima bayna yadayya mina a  ttawrati wamubashshiran birasoolin yatee min ba'dee ismuhu ahmadu falamma jaahum bi  lbayyinati qaloo hatha sihrun mubeen
verses.7: Waman a _th_ lamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allahi alkathiba wahuwa yud'a ila alislami wa  llahu la yahdee alqawma a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.8: Yureedoona liyutfioo noora Allahi biafwahihim wa  llahu mutimmu noorihi walaw kariha alkafiroon
verses.9: Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bi  lhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyu _th_ hirahu 'ala a  ddeeni kullihi walaw kariha almushrikoon
verses.10: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo hal adullukum 'ala tijaratin tunjeekum min 'athabin aleem
verses.11: Tuminoona bi  llahi warasoolihi watujahidoona fee sabeeli Allahi biamwalikum waanfusikum thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
verses.12: Yaghfir lakum thunoobakum wayudkhilkum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu wamasakina tayyibatan fee jannati 'adnin thalika alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.13: Waokhra tuhibboonaha nasrun mina Allahi wafathun qarreebun wabashshiri almumineen
verses.14: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo koonoo ansara Allahi kama qala 'eesa ibnu maryama lilhawariyyeena man ansaree ila Allahi qala alhawariyyoona nahnu ansaru Allahi faamanat taifatun min banee israeela wakafarat taifatun faayyadna allatheena amanoo 'ala 'aduwwihim faasbahoo _th_ ahireen

verses.1: Yusabbihu lillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi almaliki alquddoosi al'azeezi alhakeem
verses.2: Huwa allathee ba'atha fee alommiyyeena rasoolan minhum yatloo 'alayhim ayatihi wayuzakkeehim wayu'allimuhumu alkitaba wa  lhikmata wain kanoo min qablu lafee dalalin mubeen
verses.3: Waakhareena minhum lamma yalhaqoo bihim wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem
verses.4: Thalika fadlu Allahi yuteehi man yashao wa  llahu thoo alfadli al'a _th_ eem
verses.5: Mathalu allatheena hummiloo a  ttawrata thumma lam yahmilooha kamathali alhimari yahmilu asfaran bisa mathalu alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayati Allahi wa  llahu la yahdee alqawma a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.6: Qul ya ayyuha allatheena hadoo in za'amtum annakum awliyao lillahi min dooni a  nnasi fatamannawoo almawta in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.7: Wala yatamannawnahu abadan bima qaddamat aydeehim wa  llahu 'aleemun bi  _thth_ alimeen
verses.8: Qul inna almawta allathee tafirroona minhu fainnahu mulaqeekum thumma turaddoona ila 'alimi alghaybi wa  shshahadati fayunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maloon
verses.9: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha noodiya li  ssalati min yawmi aljumu'ati fa  s'aw ilathikri Allahi watharoo albay'a thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
verses.10: Faitha qudiyati a  ssalatu fa  ntashiroo fee alardi wa  btaghoo min fadli Allahi wa  thkuroo Allaha katheeran la'allakum tuflihoon
verses.11: Waitha raaw tijaratan aw lahwan infaddoo ilayha watarakooka qaiman qul ma 'inda Allahi khayrun mina allahwi wamina a  ttijarati wa  llahu khayru a  rraziqeen

verses.1: Itha jaaka almunafiqoona qaloo nashhadu innaka larasoolu Allahi wa  llahu ya'lamu innaka larasooluhu wa  llahu yashhadu inna almunafiqeena lakathiboon
verses.2: Ittakhathoo aymanahum junnatan fasaddoo 'an sabeeli Allahi innahum saa ma kanoo ya'maloon
verses.3: Thalika biannahum amanoo thumma kafaroo fatubi'a 'ala quloobihim fahum la yafqahoon
verses.4: Waitha raaytahum tu'jibuka ajsamuhum wain yaqooloo tasma' liqawlihim kaannahum khushubun musannadatun yahsaboona kulla sayhatin 'alayhim humu al'aduwwu fa  htharhum qatalahumu Allahu anna yufakoon
verses.5: Waitha qeela lahum ta'alaw yastaghfir lakum rasoolu Allahi lawwaw ruoosahum waraaytahum yasuddoona wahum mustakbiroon
verses.6: Sawaon 'alayhim astaghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum lan yaghfira Allahu lahum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeen
verses.7: Humu allatheena yaqooloona la tunfiqoo 'ala man 'inda rasooli Allahi hatta yanfaddoo walillahi khazainu a  ssamawati wa  lardi walakinna almunafiqeena la yafqahoon
verses.8: Yaqooloona lain raja'na ila almadeenati layukhrijanna ala'azzu minha alathalla walillahi al'izzatu walirasoolihi walilmumineena walakinna almunafiqeena la ya'lamoon
verses.9: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tulhikum amwalukum wala awladukum 'an thikri Allahi waman yaf'al thalika faolaika humu alkhasiroon
verses.10: Waanfiqoo min ma razaqnakum min qabli an yatiya ahadakumu almawtu fayaqoola rabbi lawla akhkhartanee ila ajalin qareebin faassaddaqa waakun mina a  ssaliheen
verses.11: Walan yuakhkhira Allahu nafsan itha jaa ajaluha wa  llahu khabeerun bima ta'maloon

verses.1: Yusabbihu lillahi ma fee a  ssamawati wama fee alardi lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.2: Huwa allathee khalaqakum faminkum kafirun waminkum muminun wa  llahu bima ta'maloona baseer
verses.3: Khalaqa a  ssamawati wa  larda bi  lhaqqi wasawwarakum faahsana suwarakum wailayhi almaseer
verses.4: Ya'lamu ma fee a  ssamawati wa  lardi waya'lamu ma tusirroona wama tu'linoona wa  llahu 'aleemun bithati a  ssudoor
verses.5: Alam yatikum nabao allatheena kafaroo min qablu fathaqoo wabala amrihim walahum 'athabun aleem
verses.6: Thalika biannahu kanat tateehim rusuluhum bi  lbayyinati faqaloo abasharun yahdoonana fakafaroo watawallaw wa  staghna Allahu wa  llahu ghaniyyun hameed
verses.7: Za'ama allatheena kafaroo an lan yub'athoo qul bala warabbee latub'athunna thumma latunabbaonna bima 'amiltum wathalika 'ala Allahi yaseer
verses.8: Faaminoo bi  llahi warasoolihi wa  nnoori allathee anzana wa  llahu bima ta'maloona khabeer
verses.9: Yawma yajma'ukum liyawmi aljam'i thalika yawmu a  ttaghabuni waman yumin bi  llahi waya'mal salihan yukaffir 'anhu sayyiatihi wayudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan thalika alfawzu al'a _th_ eem
verses.10: Wa  llatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu a  nnari khalideena feeha wabisa almaseer
verses.11: Ma asaba min museebatin illa biithni Allahi waman yumin bi  llahi yahdi qalbahu wa  llahu bikulli shayin 'aleem
verses.12: Waatee'oo Allaha waatee'oo a  rrasoola fain tawallaytum fainnama 'ala rasoolina albalaghu almubeen
verses.13: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa wa'ala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoon
verses.14: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo inna min azwajikum waawladikum 'aduwwan lakum fa  htharoohum wain ta'foo watasfahoo wataghfiroo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheem
verses.15: Innama amwalukum waawladukum fitnatun wa  llahu 'indahu ajrun 'a _th_ eem
verses.16: Fa  ttaqoo Allaha ma istata'tum wa  sma'oo waatee'oo waanfiqoo khayran lianfusikum waman yooqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihoon
verses.17: In tuqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan yuda'ifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum wa  llahu shakoorun haleem
verses.18: 'alimu alghaybi wa  shshahadati al'azeezu alhakeem

verses.1: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu ithatallaqtumu a  nnisaa fatalliqoohunna li'iddatihinna waahsoo al'iddata wa  ttaqoo Allaha rabbakum la tukhrijoohunna min buyootihinna wala yakhrujna illa an yateena bifahishatin mubayyinatin watilka hudoodu Allahi waman yata'adda hudooda Allahi faqad _th_ alama nafsahu la tadree la'alla Allaha yuhdithu ba'da thalika amra
verses.2: Faitha balaghna ajalahunna faamsikoohunna bima'roofin aw fariqoohunna bima'roofin waashhidoo thaway 'adlin minkum waaqeemoo a  shshahadata lillahi thalikum yoo'a _th_ u bihi man kana yuminu bi  llahi wa  lyawmi alakhiri waman yattaqi Allaha yaj'al lahu makhraja
verses.3: Wayarzuqhu min haythu la yahtasibu waman yatawakkal 'ala Allahi fahuwa hasbuhu inna Allaha balighu amrihi qad ja'ala Allahu likulli shayin qadra
verses.4: Wa  llaee yaisna mina almaheedi min nisaikum ini irtabtum fa'iddatuhunna thalathatu ashhurin wa  llaee lam yahidna waolatu alahmali ajaluhunna an yada'na hamlahunna waman yattaqi Allaha yaj'al lahu min amrihi yusra
verses.5: Thalika amru Allahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi Allaha yukaffir 'anhu sayyiatihi wayu' _th_ im lahu ajra
verses.6: Askinoohunna min haythu sakantum min wujdikum wala tudarroohunna litudayyiqoo 'alayhinna wain kunna olati hamlin faanfiqoo 'alayhinna hatta yada'na hamlahunna fain arda'na lakum faatoohunna ojoorahunna watamiroo baynakum bima'roofin wain ta'asartum fasaturdi'u lahu okhra
verses.7: Liyunfiq thoo sa'atin min sa'atihi waman qudira 'alayhi rizquhu falyunfiq mimmaatahu Allahu la yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa maataha sayaj'alu Allahu ba'da 'usrin yusra
verses.8: Wakaayyin min qaryatin 'atat 'an amri rabbiha warusulihi fahasabnahahisaban shadeedan wa'aththabnaha 'athaban nukra
verses.9: Fathaqat wabala amriha wakana 'aqibatu amriha khusra
verses.10: a'adda Allahu lahum 'athaban shadeedan fa  ttaqoo Allaha ya olee alalbabi allatheena amanoo qad anzala Allahu ilaykum thikra
verses.11: Rasoolan yatloo 'alaykum ayati Allahi mubayyinatin liyukhrija allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo a  ssalihati mina a  _thth_ ulumati ila a  nnoori waman yumin bi  llahi waya'mal salihan yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan qad ahsana Allahu lahu rizqa
verses.12: Allahu allathee khalaqa sab'a samawatin wamina alardi mithlahunna yatanazzalu alamru baynahunna lita'lamoo anna Allaha 'ala kulli shayin qadeerun waanna Allaha qad ahata bikulli shayin 'ilma

verses.1: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu lima tuharrimu ma ahalla Allahu laka tabtaghee mardata azwajika wa  llahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.2: Qad farada Allahu lakum tahillata aymanikum wa  llahu mawlakum wahuwa al'aleemu alhakeem
verses.3: Waith asarra a  nnabiyyu ila ba'di azwajihi hadeethan falamma nabbaat bihi waa _th_ harahu Allahu 'alayhi 'arrafa ba'dahu waa'rada 'an ba'din falamma nabbaaha bihi qalat man anbaaka hatha qala nabbaaniya al'aleemu alkhabeer
verses.4: In tatooba ila Allahi faqad saghat quloobukuma wain ta _th_ ahara 'alayhi fainna Allaha huwa mawlahu wajibreelu wasalihu almumineena wa  lmalaikatu ba'da thalika _th_ aheer
verses.5: 'asa rabbuhu in tallaqakunna an yubdilahu azwajan khayran minkunna muslimatin muminatin qanitatin taibatin 'abidatin saihatin thayyibatin waabkara
verses.6: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo qoo anfusakum waahleekum naran waqooduha a  nnasu wa  lhijaratu 'alayha malaikatun ghila _th_ un shidadun la ya'soona Allaha ma amarahum wayaf'aloona ma yumaroon
verses.7: Ya ayyuha allatheena kafaroo la ta'tathiroo alyawma innama tujzawna ma kuntum ta'maloon
verses.8: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo tooboo ila Allahi tawbatan nasoohan 'asa rabbukum an yukaffira 'ankum sayyiatikum wayudkhilakum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu yawma la yukhzee Allahu a  nnabiyya wa  llatheena amanoo ma'ahu nooruhum yas'a bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim yaqooloona rabbana atmim lana noorana wa  ghfir lana innaka 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.9: Ya ayyuha a  nnabiyyu jahidi alkuffara wa  lmunafiqeena wa  ghlu _th_ 'alayhim wamawahum jahannamu wabisa almaseer
verses.10: Daraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena kafaroo imraata noohin wa  mraata lootin kanata tahta 'abdayni min 'ibadinasalihayni fakhanatahuma falam yughniya 'anhuma mina Allahi shayan waqeela odkhula a  nnara ma'a a  ddakhileen
verses.11: Wadaraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena amanoo imraata fir'awna ith qalat rabbi ibni lee 'indaka baytan fee aljannati wanajjinee min fir'awna wa'amalihi wanajjinee mina alqawmi a  _thth_ alimeen
verses.12: Wamaryama ibnata 'imrana allatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feehi min roohina wasaddaqat bikalimati rabbiha wakutubihi wakanat mina alqaniteen

verses.1: Tabaraka allathee biyadihi almulku wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
verses.2: Allathee khalaqa almawta wa  lhayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalan wahuwa al'azeezu alghafoor
verses.3: Allathee khalaqa sab'a samawatin tibaqan ma tara fee khalqi a  rrahmani min tafawutin fa  rji'i albasara hal tara min futoor
verses.4: Thumma irji'i albasara karratayni yanqalib ilayka albasaru khasian wahuwa haseer
verses.5: Walaqad zayyanna a  ssamaa a  ddunya bimasabeeha waja'anaha rujooman li  shshayateeni waa'tadna lahum 'athaba a  ssa'eer
verses.6: Walillatheena kafaroo birabbihim 'athabu jahannama wabisa almaseer
verses.7: Itha olqoo feeha sami'oo laha shaheeqan wahiya tafoor
verses.8: Takadu tamayyazu mina alghay _th_ i kullama olqiya feeha fawjun saalahum khazanatuha alam yatikum natheer
verses.9: Qaloo bala qad jaana natheerun fakaththabna waqulna ma nazzala Allahu min shayin in antum illa fee dalalin kabeer
verses.10: Waqaloo law kunna nasma'u aw na'qilu ma kunna fee ashabi a  ssa'eer
verses.11: Fa  'tarafoo bithanbihim fasuhqan liashabi a  ssa'eer
verses.12: Inna allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bi  lghaybi lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeer
verses.13: Waasirroo qawlakum awi ijharoo bihi innahu 'aleemun bithati a  ssudoor
verses.14: Ala ya'lamu man khalaqa wahuwa allateefu alkhabeer
verses.15: Huwa allathee ja'ala lakumu alarda thaloolan fa  mshoo fee manakibiha wakuloo min rizqihi wailayhi a  nnushoor
verses.16: Aamintum man fee a  ssamai an yakhsifa bikumu alarda faitha hiya tamoor
verses.17: Am amintum man fee a  ssamai an yursila 'alaykum hasiban fasata'lamoona kayfa natheer
verses.18: Walaqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim fakayfa kana nakeer
verses.19: Awalam yaraw ila a  ttayri fawqahum saffatin wayaqbidna ma yumsikuhunna illa a  rrahmanu innahu bikulli shayin baseer
verses.20: Amman hatha allathee huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min dooni a  rrahmani ini alkafiroona illa fee ghuroor
verses.21: Amman hatha allathee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajjoo fee 'utuwwin wanufoor
verses.22: Afaman yamshee mukibban 'ala wajhihi ahda amman yamshee sawiyyan 'alasiratin mustaqeem
verses.23: Qul huwa allathee anshaakum waja'ala lakumu a  ssam'a wa  labsara wa  lafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroon
verses.24: Qul huwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoon
verses.25: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwa'du in kuntum sadiqeen
verses.26: Qul innama al'ilmu 'inda Allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeen
verses.27: Falamma raawhu zulfatan seeat wujoohu allatheena kafaroo waqeela hatha allathee kuntum bihi tadda'oon
verses.28: Qul araaytum in ahlakaniya Allahu waman ma'iya aw rahimana faman yujeeru alkafireena min 'athabin aleem
verses.29: Qul huwa a  rrahmanu amanna bihi wa'alayhi tawakkana fasata'lamoona man huwa fee dalalin mubeen
verses.30: Qul araaytum in asbaha maokum ghawran faman yateekum bimain ma'een

verses.1: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istama'a nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna sami'na quranan 'ajaba
